jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Product Manager – Digital Payments & Financial Services**

**Company: AvenuesAI Limited**

**Location:** Mumbai, Maharashtra

**Department:** Product Management

**Experience:** 8–12 years

**Employment Type:** Full-time

**Reporting To:** Head of Product / Business Head / Senior Management

**Role Overview**

**AvenuesAI Limited** is looking for an experienced and result-oriented Product Manager to manage and drive the development, enhancement and performance of its digital payment products and financial technology solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in payment processing, digital payment ecosystems, prepaid payment instruments (PPI), banking and financial integrations, regulatory compliance and product operations.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the product lifecycle, identifying business opportunities, coordinating with technology and business teams, implementing product enhancements and ensuring seamless product delivery in line with business objectives, regulatory requirements and customer expectations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management**

* + Define and execute product strategies aligned with the company's business goals.
  + Manage the complete product lifecycle, from conceptualisation and requirement gathering to development, launch and post-launch performance monitoring.
  + Identify opportunities for new product development, enhancements and business expansion.
  + Prepare product roadmaps, business requirement documents (BRDs), product requirement documents (PRDs) and functional specifications.
  + Monitor product performance and recommend improvements based on business and customer feedback.

**2. Digital Payments & Financial Integrations**

* + Manage and drive payment products and integrations across BBPS, PPI and other applicable payment channels.
  + Coordinate with banks, NPCI, payment aggregators, technology partners and other financial institutions for product integrations.
  + Oversee payment workflows, transaction processing, settlement, reconciliation and exception management.
  + Ensure smooth implementation, testing and deployment of new payment features and integrations.
  + Identify and resolve product-related operational challenges affecting transaction success rates and customer experience.

**3. Product Development & Technology Coordination**

* + Work closely with technology, engineering, QA and operations teams to translate business requirements into product specifications.
  + Define product priorities, development milestones and implementation timelines.
  + Coordinate UAT, functional testing, integration testing and product acceptance.
  + Track product development progress and ensure timely delivery.
  + Identify system gaps, process bottlenecks and opportunities for automation.

**4. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management**

* + Ensure product processes and functionalities are aligned with applicable RBI guidelines, NPCI regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.
  + Work closely with compliance, risk and legal teams to implement regulatory changes.
  + Monitor transaction risks, fraud indicators, operational exceptions and control mechanisms.
  + Support internal, external and regulatory audits by maintaining appropriate product documentation and operational records.
  + Ensure appropriate controls are incorporated into product design and delivery.

**5. Business & Operational Performance**

* + Define and monitor product KPIs, including transaction success rates, transaction volumes, revenue, active users, turnaround time and customer complaints.
  + Analyse product performance and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
  + Drive initiatives to improve customer and merchant experience.
  + Work with sales and business development teams to support product adoption, partner onboarding and revenue growth.
  + Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for product-related processes.

**6. Stakeholder & Team Management**

* + Act as the primary coordination point between business, technology, operations, compliance and external partners.
  + Manage relationships with banks, payment networks, vendors and technology service providers.
  + Lead product review meetings and provide regular updates to senior management.
  + Guide and mentor team members involved in product operations and implementation.

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + Graduate degree in Business Administration, Finance, Commerce, Technology or a related discipline.
  + 8–12 years of experience in fintech, digital payments, banking, financial services or payment operations.
  + Strong understanding of digital payment systems, payment processing and settlement mechanisms.
  + Practical experience in UPI, IMPS, PPI and other payment integrations.
  + Experience in product onboarding, implementation, product enhancement and operational management.
  + Good understanding of RBI guidelines, NPCI processes, compliance requirements and risk management.
  + Proven experience working with technology, operations, business and compliance teams.

**Required Skills**

* + Product lifecycle and roadmap management
  + Digital payment ecosystem knowledge
  + Payment processing and reconciliation
  + UPI, IMPS, PPI and banking integrations
  + BRD, PRD and functional requirement documentation
  + UAT and product implementation
  + RBI and NPCI regulatory understanding
  + Risk management and fraud monitoring
  + Data analysis and KPI monitoring
  + Stakeholder and vendor management
  + Team leadership and problem-solving
  + Strong communication and decision-making skills

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated on the basis of:

* + Successful and timely delivery of product launches and enhancements.
  + Improvement in transaction success rates and payment processing efficiency.
  + Reduction in transaction failures, reconciliation issues and operational exceptions.
  + Timely completion of banking, NPCI and third-party integrations.
  + Compliance with applicable regulatory and internal control requirements.
  + Improvement in product adoption, customer experience and business performance.
  + Effective coordination with internal teams and external stakeholders.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

The preferred candidate should be a hands-on fintech professional with a strong understanding of the Indian digital payments ecosystem. The candidate should be capable of bridging the gap between business requirements and technology execution, while ensuring operational efficiency, regulatory compliance and sustainable product growth.

Experience in PPI services, UPI/IMPS integrations, payment settlements, banking partnerships and payment product implementation will be an added advantage.

jobs.description:

**Domain:** Banking, Wealth Management, Fintech

**About the Role**

We are hiring a Sitecore Engineer to join the digital delivery team of a leading UAE bank, working from Chennai. You will build, customize and scale the bank's customer-facing web platforms, focusing on banking and wealth journeys. You will also help the team adopt Sitecore's AI features (Sitecore AI, formerly XM Cloud, and Sitecore Stream) to deliver content faster and personalize it better.

* Define and build Sitecore templates, page layouts, renderings and components following Helix architecture principles
* Implement custom rules, personalization and content targeting for retail banking and wealth customer journeys
* Customize and extend Sitecore content APIs, including GraphQL / Experience Edge, used by other applications such as mobile apps and partner platforms
* Build and support headless implementations using Sitecore JSS / Next.js where applicable
* Configure and integrate Sitecore AI features: AI assisted content generation and optimization, Brand Kits, and AI driven personalization through Sitecore Personalize and CDP
* Use AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot responsibly to improve delivery speed, code quality and test coverage
* Deploy and support Sitecore in scaled, multi environment setups (Azure, containers, CI/CD pipelines)
* Follow banking grade standards for secure coding, unit testing, code review and documentation
* Take an active part in Scrum ceremonies with the UAE team: sprint planning, daily stand ups, reviews and retrospectives
* Research and benchmark new technologies, and share knowledge to raise the productivity of the wider team
* Present technical ideas and solution options clearly to senior and executive stakeholders

**Must Have**

* Bachelor's or postgraduate degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience
* 4+ years of development and design experience on Sitecore
* Sitecore Certified Developer
* Strong skills in ASP.NET, C#, MVC and SQL
* Solid knowledge of Helix architecture and Sitecore development best practices
* Proven experience creating templates, pages and custom personalization rules
* Experience customizing Sitecore content APIs used by other applications
* Experience deploying and supporting Sitecore in a scaled enterprise environment
* Working experience in an Agile / Scrum team

**Good to Have**

* Exposure to Sitecore AI (XM Cloud), Sitecore Stream, Agentic Studio or Sitecore AI Search
* Hands-on experience with Sitecore Personalize, CDP or A/B testing for customer journeys
* Experience integrating LLM services such as Azure Open AI into web platforms, with awareness of data privacy and responsible AI controls in a regulated environment
* Headless experience with Sitecore JSS, Next.js and GraphQL
* Banking, financial services or fintech project experience in an enterprise setting
* Wealth management product knowledge: investments, mutual funds, bonds, structured products, priority and private banking propositions
* Familiarity with UAE banking regulatory expectations around security, accessibility and data handling

**Soft Skills**

* Self motivated and self starting; owns tasks end to end with minimal supervision
* Eager to learn and quick to adapt when requirements change
* Strong team player with an agile mindset and a drive for continuous improvement
* Able to influence teams on technical decisions by sharing deep knowledge
* Clear communicator who can explain technical ideas to senior and executive management

**Why Join**

* Work on high-visibility digital platforms for one of the region's leading banks
* Get hands-on with Sitecore's latest AI and composable capabilities
* Grow within a collaborative, Scrum-based engineering culture working with a UAE client team

jobs.title: Associate - Integrity & Investigations
jobs.description:
**Associate - Integrity & Investigations**
==========================================

Req ID: 128329

Department: Financial Crime - Strategy and Threat Management

Division: Risk

Location: Bengaluru

**About Us**
------------

At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers.

**About the Role**
------------------

**Note:** We have multiple opportunities available at the Associate - Group Integrity level. Candidates who meet the role requirements may be considered for more than one vacancy as part of the selection process.

  

The Associate - Group Integrity plays an important role in protecting ANZ by conducting investigations into internal fraud, theft, conflicts of interest, and other forms of insider misconduct. Working within a highly regulated environment, you will gather and assess evidence, conduct investigative activities, and develop clear, evidence-based findings that support fair and consistent outcomes.

  

This role offers the opportunity to work on a diverse range of integrity matters while partnering with stakeholders across the business to identify risks, strengthen controls, and contribute to a culture of accountability and ethical conduct.

  

Role Type: Permanent  
Role Location: Bengaluru

**What will your day look like?**
---------------------------------

As an Associate - Group Integrity, you will:

  

* Conduct internal fraud, theft, and insider risk investigations in accordance with established investigation standards and methodologies.
* Assist in defining investigation scope and approach, gather and assess evidence, conduct interviews, and maintain accurate case documentation.
* Analyze information from multiple sources to identify key facts, themes, and findings that support investigation outcomes.
* Prepare clear, concise, and evidence-based investigation reports, findings, and recommendations.
* Engage with stakeholders across Risk, Legal, Employee Relations, Security, and business teams to obtain information and support effective case management.
* Escalate significant risks, control issues, conflicts, or investigation concerns through appropriate governance channels.
* Contribute to thematic reviews, fraud trend analysis, and the identification of opportunities to strengthen controls and risk management practices.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives, quality assurance activities, and knowledge sharing within the Group Integrity team.

**What will you bring?**
------------------------

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:

  

* 6+ years' experience in investigations, fraud risk, misconduct, compliance, or related disciplines.
* Experience investigating fraud, theft, misconduct, insider risk, or integrity-related matters.
* Knowledge of investigation principles, including evidence assessment, interviewing, and procedural fairness.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.
* Experience gathering, interpreting, and synthesizing information from multiple sources.
* Strong report-writing and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes.
* Experience engaging with stakeholders across Risk, Legal, Employee Relations, Compliance, and business teams.
* Knowledge of banking operations, products, fraud risks, and control environments.
* Exposure to forensic analysis, digital evidence review, or investigative technologies.
* Understanding of risk frameworks and governance within a regulated environment.
* Experience contributing to process improvements and continuous improvement initiatives.

**So why join us?**
-------------------

ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.

  

We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.

  

We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.

  

To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can

**Senior Platform Engineer (AI Gateway, Identity & Observability)**

**Agentic AI Platform | Financial Services | Full-time**

*Experience: 8+ years overall, including 5+ years hands-on API platform, identity or observability engineering*

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
==================

We are building an enterprise agentic AI platform for a financial services client: the runtime, gateway, developer tooling and data interfaces that internal engineering teams will use to build and run AI agents in production.

You will build the control plane every agent passes through, regardless of where that agent runs. That means three connected things: the AI gateway that fronts all model traffic, the identity and registration path that governs which agents are allowed to call it, and the observability plane that makes the whole fleet visible and attributable.

These are deliberately held together in one position rather than split. The gateway is where identity is enforced and where much of the telemetry originates, so an engineer who understands only one of the three will build seams into what should be a single plane. You will be expected to work across all three, with depth in at least one and real working competence in the others.

This work is also the most time-critical on the platform: an external engineering team needs the gateway carrying production traffic early in the engagement, and the interface published to them cannot change afterwards.

This is a hands-on engineering position on a small, senior delivery team. It is not an oversight or coordination role.

**INDICATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES**
===============================

*The platform is being designed as the engagement progresses, so responsibilities will evolve. Indicative, and not limited to:*

**? Deliver the AI gateway** that routes model traffic across cloud-hosted models, other providers and on-premises inference, presenting one consistent, provider-agnostic interface to every consuming agent.

**? Implement gateway policy:** routing and backend pools, token-based rate limiting and quotas, retries, failover and circuit breaking, caching, and request and response transformation.

**? Harden an existing service for production** and run a controlled migration to the long-term gateway, moving consumers across without changing the contract they already integrated against.

**? Build the agent identity and registration path:** workload or service identity for agents, registration on deployment, and the promotion gate that governs what reaches production. Full automation is not assumed; part of the work is automating what can be automated and designing a clean, documented path for the steps that require human approval.

**? Design and implement the telemetry schema** and the OpenTelemetry pipelines that carry it, spanning agents in every runtime, so traces are consistent and attributable to an owning team.

**? Build the fleet view** showing each agent, its owner, version, environment, health and consumption, including the identifiers that make usage chargeable back to consuming teams.

**? Own the reliability view of the platform:** defining what good telemetry looks like, verifying that traces are complete and correctly attributed across every runtime, setting service level indicators and objectives for the gateway and the agent fleet, and building the alerting that surfaces failures, latency regressions and cost anomalies before consuming teams report them.

**? Apply guardrails at the gateway,** including content safety policy and a callout path to custom filtering services.

**? Establish the network and integration paths** the control plane depends on, including private connectivity or controlled egress to observability backends and third-party services, DNS and certificate handling, and the security review each path requires.

**? Load test and prove the gateway** under realistic production volume, and produce the runbooks and operational documentation the client will run it from.

**MUST HAVE**
=============

**? 5+ years hands-on engineering across API platforms, identity or observability,** with production depth in at least one and working competence in the others. All three areas are in scope for this position.

**? 4+ years building and operating API gateways in production:** routing, policy authoring, rate limiting and quotas, authentication, transformation and versioning. Azure API Management is strongly preferred; comparable depth in Apigee, Kong or an equivalent enterprise gateway is acceptable.

**? 3+ years enterprise identity and access engineering:** OAuth2, OpenID Connect and JWT validation, service principals and workload or managed identity, and secrets management using an enterprise vault.

**? 3+ years hands-on OpenTelemetry** or equivalent distributed tracing: instrumentation, collectors, resource attributes, span design, and trace, metric and log pipelines.

**? 3+ years in a site reliability, production engineering or platform operations role,** or equivalent hands-on responsibility for a service other teams depend on: service level objectives and error budgets, alerting design, on-call and incident response, and post-incident analysis. This position owns whether the telemetry is trustworthy, not only whether it is being collected.

**? 2+ years working with LLM or AI workloads in production,** including model routing across providers, token-based limits and quotas, streaming responses, content filtering, and how inference cost accrues and is attributed.

**? Experience with LLM observability tooling,** such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize or an equivalent platform, including how agent traces differ from conventional application traces.

**? 3+ years production API operations:** failover, circuit breaking, caching, load testing to prove capacity, and incident response for a service other teams depend on.

**? 2+ years integrating third-party or self-hosted services into an enterprise network,** including private connectivity or controlled egress, DNS resolution, TLS and certificate management, and working the firewall and security review needed to get each path approved.

**? Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure** on at least one major hyperscaler: networking, identity, container platforms and infrastructure-as-code.

**? Programming competence** in Python, C# or an equivalent language, sufficient to build and maintain policy extensions, callout services and instrumentation libraries.

**PREFERRED**
=============

Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry observability and Azure Monitor or Application Insights,** including agent tracing, continuous evaluation and how a managed observability plane compares with a self-hosted one such as Langfuse. This platform may run one, the other, or both, and the choice is still open.

**? Microsoft Entra ID experience,** including managed identity, app registrations and conditional access.

**? Familiarity with emerging agent identity models** and how agent-to-service authentication differs from conventional service-to-service patterns.

**? Experience implementing chargeback or showback** for a shared platform service.

### **Description**

**Job Purpose:** Responsible for performing and monitoring reconciliations of contingent and off-balance sheet General Ledger accounts, ensuring the accuracy and completeness of balances between source systems and the General Ledger. The role supports effective financial control through the identification, investigation, escalation and resolution of reconciliation exceptions while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

* Perform daily reconciliations between source applications, sub-ledgers and the General Ledger for assigned contingent and off-balance sheet accounts.
* Review and analyse reconciliation reports covering Trade Finance, Collections, loan commitments, undisbursed facilities and other designated contingent accounts.
* Identify and investigate reconciliation differences, unmatched entries, aged items, abnormal balances and other exceptions.
* Review transaction details, accounting entries, interfaces and audit trails to determine root causes of reconciliation breaks.
* Engage with Operations, Product and Technology teams to facilitate timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
* Maintain exception trackers and monitor progress until all issues are appropriately resolved and closed.
* Escalate significant, recurring or overdue reconciliation exceptions to management.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation MIS, ageing analysis, trend reporting and management dashboards.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and recommend enhancements to controls, data quality and automation.
* Ensure compliance with Bank policies, accounting controls, audit requirements and applicable regulatory standards.

  

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* Professional accounting qualification such as CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent is preferred.
* 5–8 years of relevant experience in banking operations, Trade Finance, reconciliation, financial control, business analysis or systems/change delivery.
* Hands-on experience in application-to-General Ledger reconciliation, exception investigation and management reporting.
* Working knowledge of contingent and off-balance sheet accounts and Trade Finance products is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with DCR (Data Control Reconciliation) or a similar automated reconciliation platform is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to investigate and resolve financial discrepancies.
* Good understanding of General Ledger reconciliation, accounting controls, exception ageing and balance substantiation.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including PivotTables, lookups and data reconciliation techniques.
* Exposure to Power BI, Power Query, SQL or similar analytics tools would be advantageous.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities within tight reporting deadlines.

The Teller provides accurate, secure, and efficient cash and banking services to customers at the branch. Qualifications

The other half is a product marketing and content function: working directly with product owners and innovation teams to understand the mobile banking and fintech products being developed for banks and financial institutions, and turning them into clear, compelling sales material that the Sales and Business Development teams can use in the field.

The ideal candidate blends creative storytelling with analytical rigor, can speak confidently with technical and product teams, and translates complex financial products into compelling market propositions.

**Digital Marketing, SEO & Web**

* Own the company's regional digital footprint across display and social media platforms, with a primary focus on LinkedIn and Google marketing.

* Safeguard brand identity and governance across all regional touchpoints, presentations, and product collateral.

* Produce tailored B2B content including whitepapers, case studies, press releases, newsletters, and executive thought-leadership articles.

**Education & Credentials**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or a related discipline from an accredited university (e.g., American University in Dubai, University of Wollongong in Dubai, Middlesex University Dubai, Heriot-Watt University Dubai, or equivalent).

* Demonstrated experience in product marketing or product content creation, such as product profiles, presentations, and sales enablement material.

* Demonstrated experience managing regional campaigns and exhibitions across Middle East and African markets.

* Proven experience generating B2B leads through LinkedIn and research-driven outreach.

**Technical & Platform Skills**

* Hands-on mastery of Google Analytics (GA4), Google Tag Manager, Google Search Console, and SEO audit tools (SEMrush, Ahrefs, or Moz).

* Proficient in LinkedIn Campaign Manager, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, search platforms, and email automation and CRM tools (HubSpot, Marketo, or similar).

* Experience with website CMS platforms (WordPress, Webflow) and a basic understanding of HTML/CSS.

* Strong presentation and design skills (PowerPoint, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite) for product decks, flyers, and social media creative.

**Competencies & Language**

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic or French proficiency is an advantage for North and West African market coverage.

* Strong stakeholder skills, with the confidence to work with product owners, innovation teams, and senior sales leaders.

YuCos is the platform our collections teams work in every day. **About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa and drives tangible, impactful results for clients. Drawing on our expertise in consulting, data analytics, technology, payments and economics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients. The core client segments of VCA include issuers, acquirers, merchants, fintechs, payment enablers and governments.

Role Summary:

The Analyst for Digital, Strategy and AI supports the delivery of digital transformation, strategy and artificial intelligence (AI) engagements across the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region.

  

The Digital, Strategy and AI Consulting practice is a team of experts specializing in strategy and digital transformation topics, including but not limited to:

Strategy:

* Defining business, segment, channel and functional strategies, such as digital banking, affluent banking, loyalty, open finance, stablecoins and artificial intelligence.

Ideation:

* Supporting the innovation agenda of clients through foresight, strategic trends research and co-creation activities.

Value proposition design:

* Developing holistic offerings, including products, services and customer experience, for strategic consumer, business and corporate customer segments.

Customer experience and engagement:

* Developing best-in-class digital customer journeys and engagement strategies, including digital onboarding, end-to-end digital journey transformation, digital channel benchmarking and user interface and user experience enhancement.

Performance analytics:

* Improving client performance and process efficiency by deploying data, digital and AI tools.

Digital delivery:

* Supporting clients with the implementation of digital strategies, including the design and development of digital channels, generative AI (GenAI) use cases and proofs of concept.

Key Responsibilities:

* As an Analyst, you will work within project teams under the guidance of senior consultants and managers, contributing to research, analysis and the development of client deliverables.
* Support the delivery of digital, strategy and AI projects across the GCC, from scoping through to final recommendations.
* Conduct market, competitor and customer research, including benchmarking and trends analysis, to inform client recommendations.
* Gather, clean and analyze data from Visa and industry sources to generate insights that support client recommendations.
* Contribute to the problem-solving process, including structuring analytical frameworks and developing insight-driven recommendations.
* Build business cases and financial models that measure business performance and quantify return on investment (ROI).
* Prepare clear and compelling client presentations and reports that communicate findings and recommendations.
* Support the preparation and running of client workshops and stakeholder sessions, and document findings, decisions and next steps.
* Track project workplans and deliverables, and keep the project leadership informed of progress, risks and issues.
* Collaborate with Visa Account Executives and the Product, Value-Added Services (VAS), Marketing and other internal teams to deliver integrated solutions as One Visa.
* Contribute to proposals and responses to requests for proposal (RFPs), as well as practice thought leadership, points of view and case studies.
* Help build reusable toolkits, templates and best practice documents that can be applied across the VCA practice.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* At least 2 years of work experience in management consulting, preferably on financial services, payments, digital or AI projects.
* Degree from a leading university, preferably in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field.
* Professional proficiency in English.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, including building clear and compelling presentations, financial models and data analyses.
* Strong curiosity about AI, including GenAI and agentic AI, with hands-on experience using AI tools for research, analysis or content creation and an understanding of how to use them responsibly.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience working on projects in the GCC region.
* Exposure to digital transformation, strategy or digital banking projects.
* Knowledge of banking products, services, operations; payment schemes, services, card issuing and marketing initiatives.
* Strong interest in fintech and payments.
* Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

What You Will Need to Be Successful:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex problems and work with large data sets.
* Strong storytelling skills, with the ability to turn analysis into clear and compelling presentations.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Commercial awareness and an understanding of the financial indicators used to measure business performance.
* A collaborative, diplomatic and flexible working style, with the ability to work effectively in a matrixed organization.
* High attention to detail and a commitment to deliverables quality.
* Self-motivated and results-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines at the same time.
* Curiosity and a willingness to learn, take on feedback and develop new skills quickly.
* Ability to build strong working relationships with clients and colleagues.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Manager Internal Audit
jobs.description:
**Key Accountabilities**

* Audit planning and governance
  + Establish and maintain the Internal Audit Charter, audit methodology and risk-based annual audit plan for Board/Audit Committee approval.

  + Coordinate with du Group Audit on methodologies, specialist support and assurance coverage while maintaining accountability to du Pay’s Board.

  + Audit wallet operations, payments, cards, digital remittances, finance, treasury, settlement and customer service.

  + Audit governance and controls supporting lending, investment and insurance partnerships.

Skills

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Business Banking - Assets
jobs.description:
Dubai, Dubai, AE Experienced Permanent ID: 101458

  

### **Description**

Operating in the UAE for over 50 years, CBD manages the financial requirements of some of the largest corporates and businesses operating in the country, driving the UAE economy. Over the years, CBD has transformed into a progressive and modern banking institution winning multiple awards for its digital initiatives, credit cards, bank accounts, mobile app features and services.

CBD has been recognized as the number one bank in the UAE on the Forbes list of The World’s Best Banks 2022.

As we continue to build upon our successes, we are looking for ambitious individuals who are passionate about the banking and finance industry and the markets in which CBD operates. Just as important to us is your ability to demonstrate a talent for dealing with people - your colleagues and our customers and delivering service that really goes the extra mile.

  
  

**Job Purpose:**

The Senior Product Manager, Business Banking - Assets is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for the bank’s business banking asset portfolio. The role drives sustainable growth, profitability, customer value, and portfolio quality across lending solutions, including working capital, term finance, trade-related facilities, and secured and unsecured business loans. It leads the end-to-end product lifecycle, using market and customer insights to develop competitive propositions while ensuring effective risk, regulatory, operational, and digital delivery.

**Principal Accountabilities:**

**Product Strategy & Portfolio Growth**

Define and execute the business banking assets product strategy, roadmap, and annual business plan in line with the bank’s objectives and risk appetite.

Identify market opportunities and customer needs across working capital, term lending, trade-related finance, and secured and unsecured business loans.

Own portfolio KPIs covering origination, utilization, balances, revenue, margin, risk-adjusted returns, customer penetration, and portfolio quality.

**Product Development & Lifecycle Management**

Lead the end-to-end design, approval, launch, enhancement, and rationalization of asset products and propositions.

Develop product features, pricing, eligibility, collateral, tenor, and channel propositions that balance customer value, competitiveness, profitability, and risk.

Maintain product programmes, policies, procedures, customer documentation, and governance approvals.

**Commercial Performance & Distribution**

Partner with relationship management, sales, segments, and channels to build pipelines, improve conversion, and deepen customer relationships.

Develop campaigns, sales tools, training, and performance insights to support disciplined portfolio growth.

Monitor competitor activity, market trends, and customer feedback and translate insights into product actions.

**Risk, Compliance & Portfolio Quality**

Work with Credit Risk to define credit parameters, underwriting criteria, portfolio limits, and risk-based pricing.

Monitor arrears, delinquency, concentration, early-warning indicators, and emerging risks, and implement corrective actions.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, conduct standards, internal policies, and product-governance frameworks.

**Digital, Process & Customer Experience**

Lead digitization and process-improvement initiatives across origination, fulfilment, servicing, and renewals.

Use customer journeys and operational data to reduce turnaround time, remove friction, and improve service quality.

**Stakeholder & Delivery Management**

Lead cross-functional delivery with Credit Risk, Finance, Operations, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Marketing, and Distribution.

Prepare business cases, requirements, implementation plans, and management updates, ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes.

Manage relevant external partners and vendors and represent the portfolio in governance forums.

  

### **Requirements**

**Education and Experience**

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification or MBA is preferred.

Minimum 8 years of relevant banking experience, including at least 5 years in business banking, SME or commercial lending product management.

Demonstrated experience managing asset products across the full lifecycle, from proposition design and governance through launch and performance optimization.

Strong knowledge of lending structures, pricing, credit assessment, collateral, portfolio risk, and the regulatory environment.

Proven ability to develop business cases and interpret financial, customer, market, and portfolio data.

Strong stakeholder leadership, communication, negotiation, and programme-delivery capabilities.

Proficiency in Excel and data-visualization tools; knowledge of SQL or other analytics tools is an advantage.

jobs.title: Director, Product Development/Management
jobs.description:
**About Us**
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
  
  
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.
  
  
Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.
  
  
**Job Description**
Directors in Product Development/Management at Visa are responsible for leading the development, commercialization, and optimization of technology products within the payments ecosystem. This role requires deep expertise in product strategy, design, and execution, with a focus on delivering innovative solutions that address customer needs and drive business growth. Directors operate in complex, matrixed environments, collaborating across functions to define product goals, manage lifecycles, and ensure successful launches and ongoing enhancements.
  
  
Visa’s Risk and Identity Solutions (RaIS) group delivers advanced fraud detection and prevention solutions, ensuring seamless, secure payment experiences. The Predictive Fraud Intelligence (PFI) team develops core AI/ML products within the Visa Protect suite, empowering clients to detect and prevent fraud throughout the payment lifecycle.
  
  
As fraud vectors have rapidly evolved, PFI has significantly expanded its product portfolio and reimagined its approach to building, deploying, and monitoring real-time, low-latency AI models. We seek a seasoned AI product Manager to drive platform capabilities and tooling, accelerating model development and supporting diverse client needs.
  
  
Visa is seeking a seasoned Director Product Manager with a keen interest in heavy tech platforms, deep understanding of ML development lifecycle & MLOps, and a strong passion for innovation. This role is pivotal in enhancing some of the fastest fraud detection models in the world. It is an opportunity to improve the end-to-end process, bring in continuous learning, keeping them up to date to catch the latest fraud trends.
  
  
As a product leader, you will collaborate closely with Technology, Data Science, Cross-functional Product, and Regional teams to define priorities, craft solutions, and deliver key product capabilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Customer-Centric Product: Understand customer needs and build empathy with technical users like data scientists and data engineers to define and evolve the product roadmap.
* Product Vision: Define and execute product strategy, vision statements, and product goals. Lead product design, customer discovery, and the development of new products based on market and customer insights.
* Data Ecosystem Leadership: Develop a deep understanding of the data lifecycle and drive strategic improvements across data sourcing, quality, and governance.
* Model Optimization: Continuously enhance existing AI/ML models to improve fraud detection accuracy and performance.
* GenAI Integration: Leverage generative AI to streamline model development, deployment, and monitoring processes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with engineering, data science, and product teams across geographies to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.
* Leadership: Set a role model of product management for the rest of product management team. Mentor new product managers, set processes. Take team forward on the set vision. Recruit, grow, and retain high-caliber technical talent.
* Execution Excellence: Lead the delivery of complex, high-impact initiatives that transform the model development lifecycle and accelerate innovation. Structure and manage complex projects and processes with multiple stakeholders.
* The successful execution of this role will be achieved through a combination of leadership, technology/AI-ML knowledge, platform thinking, innovation, passion for customers, and applied strategy.
* All roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* 12+ years of professional experience with a bachelor’s degree. 5+ years in product management, focused on platforms and/or data products.
* Senior product management experience in deep technical platform with exposure to Data management, ML/AI platform solutions.
* Strong grasp of Agile methodologies and proven success in fast-paced, iterative environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional AI/ML and data science teams.
* Strategic thinker with sharp analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills across global, diverse teams.
* Superior analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated intellectual rigor.
* Understanding payments, fraud and authentication landscape and ability to translate product strategy into executable plans.
* Experience recruiting, growing, retaining, and leading technical talent.
* Experience collaborating in global, cross-functional teams.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**
Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

You will make evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology and delivery considerations, partnering closely with Engineering, Design, Architecture, Payments Operations, frontline teams, Risk and other specialist teams.
  
  
You will work closely with other Product Leads and Product Managers across the PEX stream to ensure your product area contributes to coherent end-to-end payment exception journeys and reusable capabilities rather than creating isolated solutions.
  
  
**Impact & contribution:**
As a Product Lead within the Payments Channel and Reporting Crew, you will work closely with the business to deliver exceptional outcomes for our business stakeholders and customers. You will be responsible for developing and delivering customer reporting capability for the Payments Domain. This will incorporate the delivery of reports, modernisation of existing reporting capabilities and development of the strategic roadmap for future state delivery. You will be leading a team of engineering experts to achieve this, while creating a psychologically safe, inclusive, accountable and high-performance culture, and working collaboratively within and across Crews.
  
  
**Reporting lines:**
Dhivya Elanchezhian – Senior Product Capability Lead
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Own and evolve the product vision, outcomes and roadmap for a defined Payment Exceptions & Investigations product area, aligned to the overall PEX product strategy.
* Deeply understand the customer, colleague and operational problems within your product area through discovery, data, research and engagement with frontline and operational teams.
* Translate those problems into clearly defined product opportunities, measurable outcomes and prioritised initiatives.
* Own squad-level prioritisation and roadmap decisions, balancing customer value, operational efficiency, risk, technology, delivery constraints and expected business outcomes.
* Lead discovery and delivery of reusable product capabilities that contribute to the broader PEX target state rather than creating point solutions for individual processes or systems.
* Shape simple experiences for customers, bankers, investigators and payment operations colleagues within your product area.
* Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture on product and engineering trade-offs, feasibility, sequencing, integration and delivery confidence
* Identify opportunities to move journeys from manual handling toward assisted resolution and straight-through processing where policy, evidence and controls support it.
* Explore practical applications of automation and AI for use cases such as context reconstruction, classification, summarisation, investigation support, next-best-action and response drafting.
* Ensure AI-enabled and automated outcomes within your product area are explainable, evidence-backed, auditable and appropriately bounded by human accountability and risk controls.Use customer, operational and product data to understand product performance, identify recurring pain points and continuously optimise outcomes.Define and own measurable product outcomes relevant to your area, which may include resolution time, straightthrough-processing rate, repeat contact, touches per case, queue ageing, SLA performance, customer-update timeliness, control effectiveness and colleague adoption.Embed risk, controls, regulatory and operational resilience considerations throughout discovery, design, delivery and ongoing product management.Lead and develop Product Managers within your squad/product area and contribute to strong product discipline across the broader PEX stream.Partner with other PEX Product Leads and Product Managers to manage dependencies and deliver consistent endto-end customer and colleague outcomes.

**Essential Skills:**
We’re interested in hearing from people who:
  
  

* Bring strong product management and product leadership experience, with a track record of taking complex products from discovery through delivery, adoption and continuous optimisation.
* Have payments domain knowledge, ideally across Australian domestic and/or international payments, payment processing, exceptions or servicing.
* Understand, or are able to develop strong knowledge of, payment ecosystems such as NPP, BECS/Direct Entry, BPAY, RTGS/HVCS, SWIFT and international/correspondent banking.
* Have experience with payment investigations, trace and recall, returns, repairs, failed payments, mistaken payments or related exception-servicing journeys.
* Have worked with complex workflow, case-management, servicing, operational or platform products, preferably within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Demonstrate strong product discovery, customer research, roadmap, prioritisation and lifecycle-management disciplines.
* Can turn complex customer and operational problems into simple product propositions and pragmatic delivery increments.
* Are comfortable making evidence-based trade-offs across customer value, operational outcomes, technology, risk and delivery considerations.
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and customer-facing teams.Understand risk, controls and operational resilience and embed them into product decisions rather than treating them as downstream gates.
* Are curious about automation, AI and emerging technologies and can identify where they create genuine customer or operational value.
* Coach Product Managers, create clarity through ambiguity and build collaborative, outcome-focused teams

**Years of Experience:**
11+
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Product Lead with business/product background and payments domain expertise.

B.Tech

jobs.title: Business Head - Navi UPI
jobs.description:
**About Navi**

At Navi, our mission is to simplify finance for a billion people, through technology-first products built at scale.

Founded in 2018 by Sachin Bansal and Ankit Agarwal, Navi has grown rapidly across Loans, UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds and Digital Gold – building products designed around speed, simplicity and customer experience.

Today, millions of customers use Navi for experiences like instant personal loans, fully digital home loan sanctions within minutes, low-cost mutual funds, instant credit lines in minutes and one of India’s fastest-growing UPI platforms.

**What makes Navi different is the way we build. We move fast, solve real customer problems and give people the ownership to create meaningful impact early in their journey.**

**Why Explore a Career at Navi?**

**Where Ownership Creates Real Impact**

At Navi, ownership starts early. People here are trusted to solve problems, make decisions and drive outcomes that directly shape the products and experiences used by millions of customers every day.

**Where Careers Accelerate**

Growth at Navi is driven by impact, not tenure. We strongly believe in promoting from within and creating opportunities for people to take on larger responsibilities as they grow. If you consistently raise the bar, you’ll find the space to grow quickly here.

**Where Great Talent Builds Together**

We take pride in building high talent-density teams where ambitious people learn from one another every day. Working on high-scale business and technology problems creates steep learning curves, fast execution cycles and opportunities to make visible impact throughout your journey.

**About the Team**

Since launching in August 2023, Navi UPI has grown from strength to strength to become India’s fourth-largest UPI TPAP. In a crowded market with large incumbents, Navi UPI has been able to capture a significant market share and win the loyalty of users on the back of a customer-first, product-led strategy. Our mission is clear: build on this foundation and become a leading and dominant player in India’s payments landscape.

**About the Role**

As Business Head, you will drive:

* The core acquisition engine of the group, bridging efforts across teams including product, growth, engineering, data and marketing; and
* The go-to-market strategy and execution of our to-be-launched PA (Payment Aggregator, i.e. merchant acquisition) business.

You will also act as the primary point of contact for our key partners and stakeholders including NPCI and work closely with our compliance, fraud, risk and engineering teams to ensure we deliver a stable and reliable experience to our customers. As a leader, you will be responsible for overseeing cross-functional efforts to build the Navi UPI user base, increase its loyalty and grow market share.

**What Makes You a Great Fit**

* Proven experience in driving outcomes in business, sales, operations or other generalist roles;
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the ability to make data-driven decisions and measure impact / ROI;
* Entrepreneurial mindset and work ethic with high ownership and comfort operating in a 0-to-1 setup;
* Sharp attention to detail and a strategic mindset for long-term process optimisation;
* Ability to think outside the box and be comfortable dealing with unstructured problem statements;
* Exceptional leadership, team management, collaboration and communication skills; and
* Adaptability to navigate the evolving payments landscape, leveraging new trends and technologies to drive innovation.

**Soft Skills & Traits**

To succeed in this role, you will need to:

* Operate with speed, ownership and a builder mindset—constantly challenging the status quo to scale our UPI and, eventually, PA businesses;
* Lead end-to-end program management, ensuring timely delivery, execution excellence and speedy resolution of issues;
* Constantly design, execute and iterate experiments to test new ideas and identify the most effective approaches to drive business growth or cost optimisation;
* Leverage data to identify pockets of inefficiency and opportunity and influence stakeholders and leaders across the organisation;
* Partner with marketing, product, analytics, data science, FRS (Fraud Risk & Strategy), compliance and finance teams to ensure delivery of key business goals;
* Lead, manage and mentor a lean and dynamic team, and foster a culture of collaboration that ensures each team member contributes effectively to Navi's goals;
* Build and manage relationships with key stakeholders such as NPCI, PSP banks and other partners to ensure Navi UPI’s strategic goals are being met; and
* Collaborate with our FRS), Data and Engineering teams to drive our Trust & Safety (TnS) and reliability agendas.

**The Navi OS**

The Navi OS is our Operating System for how we work every day. Success at Navi is defined by living these core values.

* Start with the Customer
* Master the Details
* Act with Urgency
* Own the Outcome
* Build for a Decade - Not a Day
* Win as One

We hire talented individuals who already show these strengths, because those who share these values thrive at Navi and grow with the organisation.

To read more about the Navi OS, visit
navi.com/our-values

**Life at Navi**

Life at Navi is fast-paced, ambitious and deeply collaborative. Beyond work, teams come together through sports, celebrations, offsites, music jams, team outings and many more shared experiences that make the journey exciting and memorable.

We believe people do their best work when they feel supported, through flexible leave policies, strong health and wellness benefits, free financial, legal and medical consultations, ESOPs and a workplace designed for both productivity and well-being.

Whether it’s the sports turf, gym, focus zone or nap rooms, the campus is built to make everyday work more enjoyable.

If you’d like to know more about life at Navi, our culture and employee benefits, head to our careers page:
navi.com/careers/life-at-navi

If solving meaningful problems, building at scale and growing alongside ambitious teams excites you,

**Navi could be the place for you.**

**Role Purpose**
The MD for the Implementation Center of Excellence (iCoE) is accountable for establishing, scaling, and governing State Street’s high‑capability PMO function for client implementation across various workstreams in STT Alpha. The MD ensures that the iCoE becomes a
**strategic capability**
, reducing vendor dependency, improving cost efficiency, strengthening internal expertise, and enabling predictable client delivery at scale.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**iCoE Strategy, Design & Build**
‑
**Out**

* Lead the end‑to‑end design and multi‑year implementation of the iCoE operating model, including functional scope, hiring strategy, location footprint, and resource mix. Transition execution‑heavy work from high‑cost vendors into the iCoE through structured knowledge transfer, scaling internal capability, and reducing dependence on vendors
* Aligning contractor‑to‑FTE transitions and phasing resource migration strategically. Drive FTE vs Contractor ratio strategy, establishing a sustainable talent supply model for PMO, and other iCoEs as required

**PMO CoE**

* The MD will oversee and build leadership capability across PMO functions – STT End to end implementation planning, Risk management, Reporting , Tools & Automation / Ai initiatives

* Establish Standard governance, cadence, reporting standards, milestone planning, and dependencies management.
* Drive collaboration and partnerships with other CoEs and Alpha implementation teams to deliver client implementation programs successfully
* Stand up a unified India‑based PMO function with SMEs, leads, and analyst teams.

* Ensure consistent delivery across front, middle, and back‑office End to end implementations, complex data flows, and integrations.
* Enable OBM (Outcome‑Based Model) transition by linking partner payments to outcomes and making sure that sub-outcomes are delivered in a timely manner with expected quality

**People Leadership & Capability Development**

* Build and lead a leadership team (VP/AVP layers) across PMO teams.
* Establish senior leadership layers within iCoE
* Manage onboarding of new hires, training, knowledge transfer and creation of standard PMO playbooks, frameworks and best practices.
* Drive capability building across CoEs, ensuring consistent training and best‑practice adoption.

* Create and operate iCoE governance structures across program reporting (client implementations), risk management, productivity metrics, and leadership oversight.
* Represent iCoE progress to senior leadership and participate in recurring strategic governance meetings.
* Provide clear executive‑level reporting on quality, risks, dependencies, and decision points.

* Achieve targeted cost reductions by shifting work from high‑cost locations to the India hub. Improve FTE‑to‑contractor and HCL‑to‑Hub ratios, driving labor arbitrage benefits and operational scalability.
* Responsible for process simplification, automation, digitalization and AI adoption to improve productivity and scalability.
* Drive automation, standardization, tool adoption, reporting quality, and process enhancement. Track financials, onboarding flows, hiring dependencies, and realization of Outcome based milestone payments
* Accountability for tracking and delivering business benefits/ outcomes, including contractor reduction, productivity improvements and cost savings.
* Engage with vendor partners to manage consultants and deliver quality results
* Support sales and pre‑sales activities through estimation models, proposals, and client solution shaping

****Experience****
**Required Skills & Experience**

* 15+ years in large‑scale implementation, transformation, PMO leadership in client implementation programs (global model), or delivery operations in financial services.
* Proven success managing global delivery hubs or Centers of Excellence at scale.
* Demonstrated experience transitioning vendor work in‑house and managing hybrid workforce models.
* Proven track record leading global, complex, client‑facing transformation programmes.
* Deep understanding of financial services platforms, data‑heavy architectures, and regulated environments.

**Leadership & Execution**

* Exceptional ability to build and lead multi‑disciplinary teams across Testing, PMO, Conversion, Product, Data, and Ops.
* Strong stakeholder influence across MD/SVP levels in Operations, Technology, and Client organizations.

**Technical & Functional Acumen**

* Solid understanding of Front office, middle office and Back office components, implementation workflows, PMO tools and data migration models.

**Governance & Change Management**

* Deep knowledge of PMO governance, risk management, performance metrics, and delivery controls.

****About State Street****
**What we do.**
State Street is one of the largest custodian banks, asset managers and asset intelligence companies in the world. From technology to product innovation we’re making our mark on the financial services industry. For more than two centuries, we’ve been helping our clients safeguard and steward the investments of millions of people. We provide investment servicing, data & analytics, investment research & trading and investment management to institutional clients.
  
  
**Work, Live and Grow.**
We make all efforts to create a great work environment. Our benefits packages are competitive and comprehensive. Details vary in locations, but you may expect generous medical care, insurance and savings plans among other perks. You’ll have access to flexible Work Program to help you match your needs. And our wealth of development programs and educational support will help you reach your full potential.
  
  
**Inclusion, Diversity and Social Responsibility.**
We truly believe our employees’ diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspective are a powerful contributor to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their maximum potential while adding value to both our organization and our clients. We warmly welcome the candidates of diverse origin, background, ability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and personality. jobs.title: Global AML Center, Vice President
jobs.description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
We are looking for an experienced leader with a strong track record in AML/KYC operations and transformation to provide senior leadership within the Global AML Center (GAC) in Hyderabad.
  
  
As part of the GAC leadership team, you will own delivery & transformation across AML/KYC portfolios - onboarding, event-driven reviews, periodic reviews, screening and quality assurance. You will also help shape and drive GAC’s strategic agenda. That means leading technology-enabled change, automation and AI adoption to build a scalable, standardized and data-led operating model. You will also take on Chief Administrative Officer (CAO) responsibilities for GAC: overseeing business management, budget and headcount planning, governance, and the site and people agenda in Hyderabad. You will balance strong day-to-day delivery with a clear view of where the function needs to be in the future.
  
  
**Why this role is important to us**
The Global AML Center carries out AML/KYC activities as part of State Street’s global AML operating model. This includes Customer Identification Program (CIP), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD), customer verification and customer risk rating across all business areas. Hyderabad is a key part of GAC’s global footprint.
  
  
Volumes, regulatory expectations and methodology changes keep growing, and adding capacity alone is not a sustainable answer. This role is central to changing how GAC operates: cutting manual effort, strengthening controls through technology and data, and positioning GAC as a strategic partner to the business rather than a purely operational function. As GAC grows, it also needs strong business management discipline: clear financial and headcount oversight, consistent governance, and a well-run site and people agenda.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
As Vice President you will:
  
  
***Operational Leadership***

* Provide senior leadership for GAC operations in Hyderabad and act as a key point of contact for local India management and global stakeholders
* Own end-to-end delivery across assigned AML/KYC portfolios against agreed service, quality, risk and productivity standards
* Keep active oversight of volumes, pipeline, ageing and capacity, and raise emerging pressure before it affects delivery or compliance
* Set clear priorities across BAU, new business, remediation and regulatory commitments, and move resources as demand changes

***Strategy & Technology Change***

* Help shape GAC’s strategic direction and multi-year transformation roadmap, in line with business growth, regulatory change and the target operating model
* Lead strategic change initiatives from idea through to delivery and adoption, with clear business cases, measurable outcomes and benefits tracking
* Act as the business lead for technology change, working with Technology, product and change teams on enhancements to KYC platforms, workflow tools and data capability
* Identify and drive opportunities for automation, AI, digitization and workflow integration that reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times and strengthen controls
* Champion data-led decision making through better MI, dashboards and real-time visibility of pipeline, risk and performance
* Make sure process, policy and methodology changes are turned into sustainable system and operational changes, reducing reliance on manual workarounds
* Prioritize the change portfolio and balance investment, capacity and risk to deliver the greatest business value
* Build a culture of innovation and continuous improvement, and grow change and digital capability within the team

***Business Management & CAO***

* Act as CAO for GAC, partnering with the GAC Head on business management, planning and execution of the leadership agenda
* Lead annual budget, headcount and workforce planning, including capacity models, run-rate tracking, attrition and backfill planning
* Track expenses, productivity and cost efficiency, and support business cases for investment and location strategy
* Run the GAC management operating rhythm, including leadership meetings, governance forums, management reporting and executive or board materials
* Coordinate senior stakeholder and regulatory reporting, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and on time
* Track key initiatives, decisions and actions across the leadership team, making sure commitments are followed through
* Oversee administrative controls, including policies and procedures, entitlements and access, business continuity and resilience planning
* Partner with HR, Finance, Procurement, Real Estate and Technology on hiring, onboarding, workforce management, space and infrastructure
* Lead the Hyderabad site and culture agenda, including employee engagement, communications, town halls, recognition and talent programs

***Risk, Control & Governance***

* Maintain a strong control environment in line with AML/KYC policies, procedures and regulatory requirements
* Identify and address emerging operational and regulatory risks before they affect the business, and escalate where needed
* Ensure new technology, automation and AI solutions are put in place with appropriate controls, governance and risk oversight
* Support audit, regulatory and governance requirements

***Stakeholder Leadership***

* Work with Business Units, Compliance, Technology and Risk teams to resolve dependencies, close control gaps and drive accountability
* Represent GAC in senior forums with clear, fact-based views on delivery, strategy, risk, capacity and the decisions required
* Influence senior stakeholders to secure support and investment for strategic and technology initiatives

***People Leadership***

* Attract, develop and retain strong talent, and build leadership depth and succession across the Hyderabad organization
* Hold managers and teams accountable for outcomes while empowering them to make decisions, and create opportunities for them to realize their full potential
* Lead teams through change, building adoption and new ways of working

**What We Value**
These skills will help you succeed in this role
  
  

* Strong understanding of KYC/CDD/EDD, client onboarding, periodic reviews, screening and financial crime controls
* Strategic thinking: the ability to set direction and turn a long-term vision into executable plans
* A proven track record of leading technology-enabled transformation, automation or digital change in a regulated environment
* An understanding of how workflow platforms, data, automation and AI can redesign operating models
* Proven ability to lead large, complex teams, including managing other managers
* A forward-looking approach to risk, with the ability to anticipate issues rather than react to them
* Strong analytical skills, with experience using MI, KPIs and capacity data to drive decisions
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively
* Strong business management and financial acumen, including budgeting, headcount and workforce planning
* Ability to run a disciplined management rhythm and produce clear executive and board-level materials
* A collaborative leadership style that balances empowerment with accountability

**Education & Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in AML/KYC, financial crime or operations within a large global financial institution
* Demonstrated experience leading strategic transformation and technology change programs, from business case to adoption
* Significant senior people leadership experience, including leading leaders
* Experience in business management role, including budget, headcount and governance ownership, is strongly preferred
* Bachelor’s degree required
* Strong knowledge of global AML/KYC regulatory requirements
* Experience with KYC workflow platforms (e.g., Fenergo/FenX), automation tools or AI solutions is an advantage
* Change or pro

jobs.description:
**Product Manager, Input Zone**

  

**About our Team:-**

DSM Product is the product management team within Data Source Management (DSM, led by Adrian Scotney), part of Data Operations (led by Kanwar Singh). It is led by the Head of Product Management and owns product management for how publisher content enters the Input Zone, Elsevier’s governed gateway for academic publisher content. This includes technical onboarding, ingestion development, publisher rights data (Salesforce) and the Platform Intelligence reporting that supports content providers.

The team is organised around three areas: Platform Intelligence (PLINT), Salesforce/SCM, and the Content Acquisition Liaisons functions that cover ingestion development and technical onboarding.

  

**About the Role:-**

The Product Manager, Input Zone will own the technical onboarding and ingestion-development activities for the Content Acquisition Liaisons group and lead execution of related workstreams. They will own the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow, represent this area within the PM team, and have a solid understanding of content providers and publishers. They will represent their technical needs to the delivery team, prioritise and communicate production issues affecting ingestion or onboarding, and support and participate in demos to key stakeholders at programme milestones.

  

**Responsibilities:-**

  

**Customer Focus**

* Interacts with content providers, publishers, and internal engineering teams during technical onboarding and represents their requirements.

* Anticipates onboarding and ingestion needs (for example, journal processing moving to the DPOP-601 workflow and the Scopus transition off the legacy OpsBank workflow) and prioritises them for the group.

* Acts as a named Onboarding Technical Liaison, fielding technical questions from content providers and publishers during negotiation so engineering capacity stays focused on implementation.

* Focuses on meeting onboarding timelines without compromising the completeness or quality of ingested content.

**Data-Driven Decision-Making & Analysis**

* Autonomously analyses onboarding, delivery, and completeness-checking data from multiple sources (content providers, engineering, Governance reporting).

* Compares and evaluates ingestion and onboarding options, and makes recommendations that consider business implications.

* Uses AI tools responsibly to accelerate analysis, and validates the results before acting on them.

**Onboarding & Content Acquisition Lifecycle**

* Communicates technical requirements and timelines clearly to negotiation and engineering stakeholders.

* Coordinates with the LeapSpace negotiation team, system test team, and OpsBank test team on technical onboarding execution once a negotiation concludes.

* Answers internal and provider-facing questions on ingestion capability, manifest handling, and onboarding scope.

* Prioritises and communicates production issues and defects affecting ingestion or onboarding, based on relevant data.

**Product Delivery & Development Lifecycle**

* Leads execution of the development plan for the ingestion pipeline and technical onboarding workflow.

* Defines and prioritises requirement changes for engineering and performs analysis to meet acceptance criteria.

* Authors clear, testable specifications (requirements, acceptance criteria, manifest and validation rules) as the shared source of truth for engineering and AI-assisted development, in line with spec-driven development (SDD).

* Reviews AI-assisted outputs (generated specs, test cases, prototypes) against requirements and is accountable for their quality before they reach engineering.

* Participates in product discovery and process improvement, and contributes to prototypes (for example, content provider manifest ingestion and PDF identification).

* Is familiar with SDLCs identified by management, for example agile processes.

**Strategy & Commercial Acumen**

* Contributes to the strategy and development plans for ingestion and technical onboarding, shared across the roles carrying the Onboarding Technical Liaison responsibility.

* Understands the operating cost and effort involved in onboarding a new content provider or source.

* Makes links between personal goals and the team and business strategy.

**Technical Skills**

* Understands the Input Zone's data and technical architecture — publisher drop zones, ingestion validation, and the downstream handoff — well enough to liaise credibly with engineering.

* Uses technologies to assist day-to-day tasks (Excel, SQL, Jira, Confluence; familiarity with Salesforce/Snowflake rights data flows and sFTP/S3 publisher landing zones).

* Has working experience with generative AI tools and AI-assisted development workflows (for example prompt design, specification-to-code generation, AI-supported testing) and understands their limitations, including accuracy, data confidentiality, and publisher-content handling.

* Ability to engage developers to understand technology constraints.

**Competencies**

**Personal Capability**

**Practices Self-Development**

* Is curious and keen to learn and develop new ideas, skills, and knowledge.

* Acts on feedback to improve him/herself.

* Looks for developmental opportunities in day-to-day work.

* Invests time and energy in self-development (professional qualifications, relevant reading, networking, keeping up with AI-assisted product and development practices).

**Solves Problems and Analyses Issues**

* Is able to ask effective questions and collect facts from multiple sources in order to solve problems.

* Is able to effectively identify and analyse problems and propose solutions.

* Effectively manages day-to-day issues and problems without intervention.

**Innovates**

* Brainstorms with others to look for different approaches to current processes and tasks.

* Looks for opportunities to develop new ideas or thinking within own role.

* Experiments with new ideas, including applying AI and SDD to onboarding and ingestion workflows, and shares what works with the team.

**Interpersonal Skills**

**Communicates Powerfully and Prolifically**

* Demonstrates effective conversational skills, including active listening and questioning.

* Shares information relevant to own role.

* Participates in team presentations.

**Collaboration and Teamwork**

* Develops co-operative working relationships within the team.

* Considers how own style affects others and tailors interactions accordingly.

* Looks for ways to develop mutually beneficial relationships across teams.

**Builds Relationships**

* Is approachable and friendly.
