jobs.title: Applied Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning- Markets Operations - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
As an Applied AI & ML Lead in the Market Operations team, you will drive the design and delivery of AI agents and ML solutions that enhance and transform Market Operations. You will lead a team of scientists and engineers, partner with business stakeholders and technology leaders, and ensure the successful implementation and scaling of AI-driven tools. You will identify opportunities, set technical direction, and deliver measurable impact by automating and augmenting complex operational workflows with reliable, auditable agents.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Agent Development and Delivery

+ Lead the end-to-end design, development, and delivery of LLM-based agents and advanced ML models for Market Operations.
+ Design and own the agent harness: orchestration loop, tool and API interfaces, context and memory management, multi-agent coordination, human-in-the-loop escalation, and guardrails.

* Evals and Prompt Improvement

+ Build and run the evaluation program for agents: task-level benchmarks built from real operational cases, regression gates in CI, and online monitoring tied to business outcomes.
+ Lead systematic prompt and program improvement using automated optimization techniques (e.g., GEPA, DSPy, AutoPrompt), driven by execution traces and failure analysis.

* Scalable AI/ML Architecture & Deployment

+ Partner with AI Engineering to design scalable agent and model serving on cloud-native infrastructure (Kubernetes, Bedrock/SageMaker), with orchestration, model gateway routing, versioned prompt/model registries, sandboxed tool execution, and rollouts gated by eval regressions.
+ Define and enforce SLOs for task success, latency, and cost per task, using distributed tracing, caching, and tiered model routing to meet them.

* Team Management & Mentorship following Agile Practices

+ Lead and mentor a team of AI/ML data scientists, guiding iterative experimentation and tracking progress to deliver measurable outcomes in an agile manner.

* Drive Model Methodology Documentation

+ Champion documentation of methodologies, results, and best practices for knowledge sharing

* Execution Excellence and Stakeholder Engagement

+ Align design and delivery across partner teams to maintain execution velocity, and drive clarity on prerequisites for AI/ML development.
+ Engage stakeholders in an agile manner to develop, demo, and iterate on deliverables. Work closely with Operations, Technology, and Transformation teams to solve complex problems with AI.

**Required Qualifications**

* MSc/PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
* Significant proven experience building and deploying AI applications, including LLM-based agents, in large-scale production environments.
* Hands-on experience building production agents, including the harness (function calling, context and memory, planning, orchestration, human-in-the-loop controls), rigorous evals for multi-step systems, and systematic prompt optimization (GEPA, DSPy, or AutoPrompt) with measured production gains.
* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn).
* Strong understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and evaluation techniques and experience working with large, complex datasets and applying statistical analysis
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Experience managing data science teams and couching team members
* Problem-solving skills and ability to work independently and as a leader within cross-functional teams
* Strong communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Demonstrated experience in financial services, particularly investment banking operations.
* Experience with agent safety and security: prompt injection defense, permissioning, sandboxing, audit logging, and adversarial testing of autonomous workflows
* Publications, patents, open-source contributions, or conference talks on agents, evals, or LLM optimization.

* Lead proactive consumer engagement to demonstrate trusted source offering and enable definition of f2b pricing requirements across the business in partnership with Consumer Delivery colleagues: Lead the determination of outcomes and benefits across data producer and data consumer landscapes associated with trusted source adoption including financial and budgetary analysis to unlock business case strategies and composition

The Product Control GBS team is accountable for delivery of the end-to-end product & valuation control functions in GBS and lead different strategic initiatives for Macro Product Control.
  
  
We are seeking a dynamic and technically skilled professional to join our team as Vice President – Macro Product Control, reporting into the Product Control Management which rolls up to Global Head, Product Control. This role will play a pivotal part in expanding the Bank’s Macro capabilities, developing compliant and commercially effective strategies, and supporting transition initiatives. The successful candidate will act as lead running the Macro Product Control team, working closely with Technical Accounting, COO’s, Product Control, and other key stakeholders to deliver best-in-class Macro Product Control across the Group.

**Strategy**

* Responsible for producing and managing the Daily P&L workflow for the Macro desk
* Spearhead the end-to-end design and implementation of Macro changes —from opportunity assessment to final accounting approval. This could include TP changes, accounting changes etc.
* Identification and remediation of control gaps
* Lead Proof-of-Concept (PoC) initiatives for new strategies, business models, sig trade reviews and new product approvals for the bank

**Business**

* Partner with Technical Accounting, Group Reporting, and Product Control to drive compliance with applicable accounting standards (e.g., IAS 39, IFRS 9).
* Coordinate with Valuation Control and other key stakeholders to ensure book closure is accurate.

**Processes**

* Responsible for running various PC Handbook related controls like Daily P&L reporting, Actual vs Estimates, P&L commentaries, VaR backtesting submissions.
* Collaborate closely with regional and cross-functional teams (e.g., Macro, local CFOs, TA, COO, VC) to deliver enterprise-wide initiatives.
* Champion thought leadership, mentor peers, and support knowledge-sharing across regions.

**People & Talent**

* To lead, inspire and motivate the team ensuring that everyone achieves their potential and that the team delivers its collective agenda.
* Lead through example and build the appropriate culture and values. Set appropriate tone and expectations from the team and work in collaboration with risk and control partners across the organization.

**Risk Management**

* Prepare and present complex technical Macro Product papers under IAS 39/IFRS 9 for internal stakeholders and external auditor endorsement

**Governance**

* Lead and manage financial projects, ensuring they are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

**Key Stakeholders**

* Head and Directors, Macro, Global
* Technical Accountant team, Singapore
* Valuation Control team, Singapore, India
* Macro COO team, Singapore, India
* Macro CFO team, Singapore, India
* Product Control, India
* Sabre Tech team, Singapore

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field; a Master’s degree or professional certification (e.g., CA, CPA, CFA) is strongly preferred.
* 12+ years of experience in finance or accounting functions, with a strong preference for candidates with Macro Product expertise.
* Deep technical knowledge of Macro Products and their accounting (e.g., IAS 39) and practical experience in financial instrument valuation.
* Demonstrated success in designing and executing Macro Product strategies across multiple risk types.
* Strong analytical mindset and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to apply judgment in data-driven decisions.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively influence and collaborate across business, finance, and technical teams.
* Familiarity with Macro Product tools and financial systems (e.g., Sabre Cortex, Murex) is an advantage.

Solution Architect, VP
jobs.description:
Join us as a Solution Architect
  
  

* We’ll look to you to lead the solution architecture definition for your assigned change programme, in addition to delivering business outcomes for both customers and colleagues
* You'll be driving technology innovation by identifying and evaluating emerging technologies and their potential impact on the bank
* If you’re ready for a new challenge and want to make a far-reaching impact through your work, this could be the opportunity you’re looking for
* We're offering this role at vice president level

What you'll do
  
  
As a Solution Architect, you’ll be architecting customer centric, high performance, secure and robust end to end digital products, solutions, and services that deliver business value while aligning to the bank’s strategic target architecture.
  
  
You’ll be actively contributing to the growth of architecting capability and the community across the bank by sharing knowledge including best practices, proven solutions and key learnings, contributing to the community of practice, and building capability in others through coaching, mentoring and teaching.
  
  
**As Well As This, You’ll Be**

* Supporting the realisation of the Enterprise and Solution Architecture, working as part of development teams throughout the engineering development lifecycle
* Providing technical guidance, resolving architectural impediments, and championing the adoption of architecture patterns and practices
* Proactively influencing stakeholders to embed the reuse of digital capabilities, contributing to simplification and the realisation of the bank’s strategic target architecture
* Partnering and engaging with programme stakeholders and following the bank’s data driven architecture method and framework to define and evolve the minimum viable solution architectures that deliver the programme objectives and business value
* Promoting a DevOps mindset by working as part of development teams to embed architecture guidance in CI/CD pipelines
* Undertaking design reviews of delivery programmes of high architectural significance or high architectural risk

The skills you'll need
  
  
To take on this role, you’ll need extensive knowledge of solution architecture frameworks, modern technologies such as Cloud, microservices and AI, agile architecture and DevOps practices, including a deep understanding of business use cases and emerging trends that drive organisational success.
  
  
You’ll bring experience of defining and developing strategic solution architectures that align with organisational objectives. This will include experience of engaging with partners across the organisation to define architectures that deliver tangible business outcomes. You'll need an experience of 15+ years for this role.
  
  
**You’ll Also Demonstrate Experience Of**

* Collaborative decision-making processes, partnering with business and technology colleagues to articulate and evolve architectural direction
* Creating business cases to influence senior stakeholders to secure investment for architecture initiatives
* Overseeing and assuring the quality of architecture designs, with a focus on risk management and governance
* Participating in architecture and design reviews to validate that solutions meet business needs and comply with architecture standards
* Proven people capability development, including mentoring, supporting professional development, encouraging knowledge sharing across architecture teams and promoting best practices

jobs.title: Sr Principal - ServiceNow Product Owner
jobs.description:
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
**About The Role**

* Lead the end-to-end product management of the ServiceNow platform at Northern Trust
* Define and execute a strategic vision and roadmap through a federated operating model across business, technology, and risk stakeholders
* Drive the implementation, governance, optimization, and expansion of ServiceNow modules, including ITSM, ITOM, IRM/GRC, SecOps, HRSD, CSM, and AI-enabled capabilities
* Ensure the platform delivers business value, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and cost optimization

**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Strategy & Vision**

* Define and own the ServiceNow platform vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap
* Translate enterprise priorities into a cohesive product strategy across modules and domains
* Lead a federated roadmap planning process across business units, ensuring alignment and prioritization
* Drive adoption of platform-first and automation-first principles

**Platform Governance & Delivery**

* Establish and enforce platform governance models (design authority, standards, data models, and architecture guardrails)
* Ensure consistent implementation of best practices, reusable components, and scalable design
* Oversee delivery of strategic programs across ServiceNow Modules in a federated partnership with assigned Capability Level Product Owners
* Partner with engineering and operations teams to ensure resiliency, scalability, and performance

**AI & Intelligent Automation Strategy**

* Define and execute roadmap for AI/GenAI capabilities within ServiceNow (e.g., virtual agents, predictive intelligence, Now Assist)
* Identify high-impact use cases for:

+ Automation of service operations
+ Predictive incident/problem management
+ Intelligent workflows and self-healing systems

* Establish governance for AI adoption, model transparency, and responsible AI usage
* Measure and track AI-driven outcomes (deflection rates, automation % , MTTR reduction)

**Vendor & Ecosystem Management**

* Own strategic relationship with ServiceNow and implementation partners
* Drive vendor performance through:

+ Quarterly business reviews (QBRs)
+ Value realization and KPI tracking
+ Innovation alignment and roadmap influence

* Evaluate and onboard ecosystem tools and integrations to extend platform capabilities

**Financial & Cost Management**

* Manage platform TCO (Total Cost of Ownership) including licensing, infrastructure, and operational costs
* Develop and execute cost optimization strategies
* Drive transparency through chargeback/showback models
* Ensure optimal utilization of ServiceNow licenses and features

**Data Management & Insights**

* Define and govern ServiceNow data strategy, including:

+ CMDB maturity and accuracy
+ Data quality frameworks
+ Data ownership and stewardship

* Enable data-driven decision making through dashboards, reporting, and analytics
* Integrate ServiceNow data with enterprise data platforms (e.g., data lake, analytics tools)

**Stakeholder & Federated Engagement**

* Act as the single point of accountability for platform outcomes
* Partner with:

+ Business stakeholders
+ IT operations and engineering
+ Risk, compliance, and audit teams

* Facilitate alignment across a federated model with distributed ownership
* Drive change management, adoption, and user experience improvement

**Key Deliverables**

* Enterprise ServiceNow strategy and roadmap
* AI adoption roadmap and value realization metrics
* Platform governance framework and standards
* Cost optimization plan and financial model
* Data governance maturity roadmap
* Vendor performance and innovation roadmap

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of experience in product management, ITSM/platform engineering, or enterprise platforms
* 5+ years of deep ServiceNow platform experience across multiple modules
* Proven experience in large-scale ServiceNow implementations in financial services or regulated environments
* Strong understanding of:

+ ITIL / ITSM frameworks
+ Enterprise architecture principles
+ Risk and compliance requirements (SOX, audit, etc.)

* Experience managing federated product models and cross-functional stakeholders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow certifications (e.g., CSA, CIS – ITSM/ITOM/IRM, Certified Product Owner)
* Experience with AI/ML or GenAI capabilities within ServiceNow or similar platforms
* Exposure to cloud platforms, data platforms, and automation frameworks
* Experience driving platform standardization and consolidation initiatives

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic thinking with strong execution focus
* Stakeholder influence and executive communication
* Data-driven decision making
* Vendor negotiation and partnership management
* Strong governance and risk mindset
* Continuous improvement and innovation orientation

**Success Metrics**

* Platform adoption and user satisfaction
* Reduction in incident volumes and MTTR
* Automation and AI-driven efficiency gains
* Cost optimization and license utilization
* CMDB accuracy and data quality improvements
* Delivery of roadmap milestones and business value realization

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Bangalore Office**
The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

jobs.title: Vice President, Data Management & Quantitative Analysis
jobs.description:
We are looking to hire a **Senior Vice President, Data** **& Infrastructure** , to join our **Risk & Compliance Analytics & Reporting team** . This position is based in **Pune/Chennai** , with an expectation of 4-5 days per week in the office. The role will report to the Head of Data & Infrastructure horizontal in Risk and Compliance Analytics & Reporting.

**In this role, you’ll make an impact in the following ways:**

* Apply quantitative techniques from applied mathematics, statistics, econometrics, and risk modeling to solve business problems, assess risk, and generate insights that support decision-making across Risk & Compliance.
* Work on AI,GenAI,and machine learning use cases, using modern data science approaches for document intelligence, summarization, classification, knowledge extraction, intelligent search, workflow automation, and advanced analytics.
* Design and deliver scalable digital solutions by contributing across the full solution lifecycle, including ideation, development, testing, deployment, and continuous improvement, in partnership with business and engineering teams.
* Build and enhance data pipelines, dashboards, UI/UX and reporting solutions using Python, SQL, APIs, and enterprise platforms, working with both structured and unstructured data.
* Support data-driven transformation by improving processes, strengthening controls, and building hands on skills across analytics, data, engineering, automation, and emerging technologies
* Build and operationalize a centralized calculations service (rules, versioning, traceability) to ensure consistency, reproducibility, and audit-readiness across dashboards and reports.
* Build and govern a comprehensive metadata program—including catalog, lineage capture, classification, ownership (RACI), stewardship, and approval workflows—to improve discovery, traceability, and audit-readiness.
* Elevate data quality through critical data element (CDE) governance, validation rules, profiling, anomaly detection, and proactive remediation workflows; publish data quality scorecards and ownership.
* Provide executive-ready data health reporting and platform metrics that link infrastructure performance to business outcomes, risk posture, and regulatory commitments; maintain clear decision logs and evidence packs.
Align platform strategy with BNY’s strategic pillars—be more for our clients through usable data products, run our company better with automation and controls, and power our culture through collaboration and standards.  

**To be successful in this role, we’re seeking the following:**

* 8-10 years in in data architecture, platform engineering, analytics or data product leadership; experience in financial services and Risk/Compliance domains strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of risk and compliance frameworks (e.g., KRIs/KCIs, RCSA, issues/actions, surveillance, regulatory reporting) and ability to map them to measurable analytics.
* Proven expertise in enterprise data design (dimensional/normalized models), canonical data forms, vectorization/embeddings, semantic layers, and distributed data systems.
* Hands-on experience with metadata cataloging, lineage, data governance, and access controls across regulated environments.
* Familiarity with AI/ML platform components (feature stores, embedding/vector databases, model registries, monitoring/explainability) and MLOps/DataOps practices.
* Demonstrated track record delivering executive-grade dashboards and reporting at enterprise scale based on understanding of user journeys
* Proficiency with SQL, data warehousing/data lakes, streaming, orchestration, and observability tools; familiarity with Python and ML pipelines is advantageous.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—able to translate technical concepts into business outcomes and influence senior leaders.
* Intellectual curiosity, enthusiasm, and adaptability to rapidly assimilate new information and operate with a strong delivery focus in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor's degree required; advance degree in a quantitative areas like business, finance, engineering, or related disciplines; relevant industry certifications or qualifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Vice President, DataDesk – Vendor Onboarding & Automation
jobs.description:
Your Team Responsibilities:

MSCI's DataDesk team owns the onboarding of new vendor datasets into MSCI's data ecosystem — ensuring new sources are integrated quickly, validated rigorously, and governed well from day one. We're looking for a Vice President to lead and scale this function by embedding AI and automation into the onboarding lifecycle, while bringing genuine technical fluency with data to work credibly alongside Research content, Products, engineering and AI teams.

Your Key Responsibilities:

**Vendor Onboarding & Due Diligence**

* Own end-to-end onboarding of new vendor datasets — from initial due diligence and scope assessment through integration and go-live
* Define and enforce onboarding standards: identifier mapping at ingestion, full scope pre-onboarding assessment, QA assessment and fit for purpose qualification, formal SLAs definition with clear escalation ownership
* Conduct vendor due diligence and maintain trusted relationships with data providers
* Assess onboarded datasets to identify coverage gaps and quality issues, and partner with the vendor to remediate them
* Lead root-cause analysis on onboarding delays or quality gaps, and drive process fixes (as opposed to one-off fire-fighting)

**AI & Automation-Led Scaling**

* Identify and implement AI/automation opportunities across the onboarding pipeline — e.g., automated identifier/field mapping, validation rule generation, matching and reconciliation logic
* Partner with engineering/AI teams to build or adopt tooling that automates QA diagnostic and certification, reduce manual onboarding effort and turnaround time, acting as the functional expert who validates outputs against real onboarding scenarios
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI techniques and apply them to reduce onboarding cycle time and error rates
* Track and report onboarding efficiency metrics (cycle time, automation coverage, error/rework rates) to leadership
* Incorporate AI-based data usage/rights validation into the data collection process, ensuring new vendor sources are governance-compliant before integration
* Enrich and expose AI powered catalogue of data, QA / Diagnostic and other DataDesk Services

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Define validation rules and quality benchmarks for newly onboarded vendor data
* Ensure onboarded datasets meet MSCI's data standards for accuracy, consistency, and compliance before integration
* Collaborate with product and downstream teams to assess data fit and flag risks early in the onboarding process
* Conduct a quarterly assessment of MSCI's vendor data risk across product lines and single points of failure, identify possible remediations or alternatives, and present findings to senior leadership to inform operational planning and investment decisions

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Lead and mentor a team of analysts/associates involved in onboarding and vendor evaluation
* Engage with internal and external stakeholders to align on onboarding priorities, resolve escalations, and ensure timely, transparent communication throughout the onboarding lifecycle
* Partner with global stakeholders across product, research, technology, and operations to align onboarding priorities and standards
* Present onboarding pipeline status, risks, and automation roadmap to senior leadership

Your skills and experience that will help you excel:

**Experience:** 10+ years in data operations, vendor management, or data onboarding, ideally in financial data/index/analytics

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong understanding of data structures, formats, and identifiers (LEI, DUNS, CUSIP/ISIN) sufficient to assess vendor data fit and define validation logic
* Working proficiency in SQL and Python — able to review/write validation and matching logic, not just specify requirements
* Experience applying AI/ML or automation tools to data matching, validation, or process acceleration
* Comfort working directly with engineering/AI teams as a technical counterpart, not just a requirements source

**Domain Knowledge:**

* Familiarity with vendor data landscape (e.g., FactSet, LSEG/EJV, ICE, EDI) and cross-vendor field mapping challenges
* Understanding of financial reference data concepts (entities, securities, classifications) as they relate to onboarding validation

**Soft Skills:** Strong stakeholder and vendor relationship management, project management, and the ability to translate operational pain points into automation opportunities

  
About MSCI:

**What we offer you**

* Flexible working arrangements, advanced technology, and collaborative workspaces.

jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer - Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Title: Lead AI Engineer - Vice President**

**Location: Bangalore, India**

**Role Description**

* The AI Technology Vice President is a senior, hands-on individual contributor who turns high-value banking use cases into secure, scalable and measurable AI solutions. Embedded within Corporate Functions Technology, the role works directly with delivery teams and business stakeholders to design, prototype, engineer and productionise AI capabilities, while ensuring that implementation choices are aligned with enterprise architecture, data governance, model risk, security and regulatory expectations.
* The role connects grassroots experimentation with top-down strategy. It contributes practical implementation insight to the AI Centre of Excellence and translates approved tooling, roadmaps and ways of working into reusable engineering patterns that delivery teams can adopt. The position has no dependency on formal people management; influence is achieved through technical depth, demonstrable delivery, coaching and trusted partnership.
This is an individual contributor role with senior technical accountability. The role may lead workstreams, guide engineers and coordinate multidisciplinary delivery, but its primary value comes from hands-on technical implementation, engineering judgement and influence rather than direct people management. Final ownership of business decisions, model-risk acceptance and control approvals remains with the relevant accountable functions.  

**What we’ll offer you**

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy,

* Best in class leave policy.
* Gender neutral parental leaves
* 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
* Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
* Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
* Accident and Term life Insurance
Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above  

  

**Your key responsibilities**

**Hands-on AI solution engineering**

* Build and productionise: Design, code, test and deploy AI applications, services, agents and reusable components for banking and Corporate Functions use cases.
* Prototype with purpose: Develop rapid proofs of concept to test business value, technical feasibility, control implications and operational readiness before scaling.
* Own the engineering pathway: Translate business problems into solution architecture, data flows, model or service choices, APIs, integration patterns and production acceptance criteria.
* Integrate enterprise systems: Connect AI capabilities with approved data platforms, workflow tools, document repositories, APIs and user channels without bypassing established controls.
* Engineer for reliability: Implement automated testing, versioning, observability, evaluation, deployment and rollback mechanisms across the solution lifecycle.
Troubleshoot deeply: Diagnose data, model, prompt, retrieval, integration, performance and production issues and drive them through to resolution.  

  

**Generative AI and applied machine learning**

* Generative AI: Implement solutions using large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, tool use, structured output and agentic workflows where justified.
* Model selection: Compare hosted models, enterprise AI services and conventional machine-learning approaches against accuracy, explainability, latency, cost, privacy and control requirements.
* Evaluation: Define repeatable evaluation datasets and measures for quality, groundedness, robustness, safety, bias, latency and business usefulness.
* Prompt and context engineering: Develop maintainable prompt templates, context strategies, guardrails and model interaction patterns, with appropriate version control and test coverage.
Classical AI/ML: Apply supervised or unsupervised learning, NLP, document intelligence, forecasting or anomaly detection when these approaches are better suited than generative AI.  

  

**Data, platform and MLOps/LLMOps implementation**

* Data readiness: Assess source quality, lineage, entitlement, retention and fitness for AI use; design data preparation and retrieval pipelines with accountable owners.

* Production lifecycle: Establish CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, automated evaluation, release controls, monitoring and operational support patterns.

* Platform engineering: Use approved cloud, on-premises or hybrid platforms and contribute reusable reference implementations, accelerators and paved-road components.

* Performance and cost: Optimize token usage, compute, caching, retrieval, throughput and service design while maintaining required quality and controls.

Operational resilience: Design for availability, failure handling, auditability, recoverability and human intervention in business-critical workflows.  

  

**Banking controls and responsible AI**

* Control by design: Embed privacy, confidentiality, information security, data minimisation, records management, access control and segregation of duties into solution design.
* Responsible AI: Implement explainability, human oversight, fairness assessment, traceability, content safety and appropriate usage boundaries.
* Risk partnership: Work with Model Risk, Compliance, Legal, Data, Architecture, Cyber Security and Operational Risk stakeholders to evidence design decisions and address findings.
* Audit evidence: Maintain clear documentation covering data sources, design rationale, evaluation outcomes, limitations, approvals, change history and production controls.
Third-party risk: Assess external models, libraries and services for security, licensing, concentration, data handling, lock-in and ongoing support considerations.  

  

**Technology leadership without line management**

* Technical influence: Set a high bar through working code, design reviews, engineering standards and pragmatic decision-making.
* Community of Practice: Create and nurture peer learning through demonstrations, code walkthroughs, implementation clinics, reusable examples and lessons learned.
* Coaching: Support engineers, analysts and product teams in adopting approved AI techniques and resolving difficult implementation problems.
* Strategic feedback loop: Maintain continuous collaboration with the AI Centre of Excellence so delivery experience informs enterprise tooling, roadmaps and ways of working, and strategic direction is translated into execution.
External awareness: Track relevant developments in AI engineering and banking technology, then assess them against real business value and risk appetite rather than novelty alone.  

  

**Use-case delivery and stakeholder partnership**

* Shape demand: Partner with business, product and technology stakeholders to frame the problem, users, expected outcomes, constraints and measurable value.
* Prioritize pragmatically: Distinguish use cases suitable for experimentation from those ready for production investment, using evidence rather than technology enthusiasm.
* Deliver iteratively: Work in multidisciplinary teams, demonstrate progress early and incorporate user, control and operational feedback throughout delivery.
* Communicate clearly: Explain complex AI design choices, limitations and trade-offs in language suitable for engineers, senior management, control functions and business users.
Adoption: Design for usability and changed ways of working so approved AI capabilities are used safely and generate sustained value.  

  

**Your skills and experience**

**Essential Experience**

* Relevant professional experience designing and implementing production technology solutions, including recent hands-on delivery of AI, machine-learning or generative-AI capabilities.
* Demonstrable evidence of moving AI use cases from discovery and prototype through engineering,

Join us as Business Oversight Compliance Specialist where you will lead the Financial Crime framework for India IB, ensuring compliance with Financial Crime Policies and Standards, as well as applicable Indian legal and regulatory requirements. Provide oversight of the India IB Financial Crime team in Mumbai, including the transaction monitoring function and responsibility for local alert closure. Ensure appropriate local Financial Crime controls and procedures are in place across Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC), KYC and transaction monitoring. Provide advice and guidance to India IB businesses on Financial Crime risks, including customer onboarding queries, new product initiatives and other regulatory matters, while providing effective second-line check and challenge. Manage Financial Crime-related regulatory and audit enquiries for the Mumbai branch, working closely with Compliance and relevant regional and global stakeholders. Support regulatory requests, submissions, inspections, risk assessments, compliance reviews and timely submission of applicable regulatory reports. Monitor regulatory developments and consultations relevant to the India business, assess their impact and support implementation of required changes. Partner with regional and global Financial Crime teams across AML, Sanctions, ABC Advisory, Intelligence & Investigations and Compliance Assurance. Support testing and quality assurance programmes to assess the effectiveness of controls in mitigating Financial Crime risk. Develop effective reporting and communication routines and support senior leadership with key Financial Crime and regulatory matters. Participate in industry and firm-wide regulatory committees and contribute to policy development, control enhancement and identification of potential Financial Crime risks. Ensure employees receive appropriate Financial Crime training aligned with their roles and responsibilities.

  
  

To be successful in this role, you should:

* Have extensive experience managing Financial Crime and Compliance risks within the Indian financial services environment.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of Indian Financial Crime laws, regulations and regulatory expectations, particularly those applicable to foreign banks.
* Have hands-on expertise across AML, Sanctions, Anti-Bribery & Corruption and Anti-Terrorism regulatory requirements.
* Be able to provide pragmatic and well-reasoned Financial Crime advice while maintaining the independence and challenge expected from a second-line-of-defence function.
* Have strong analytical and decision-making capabilities, with the ability to understand complex compliance matters, identify control weaknesses and respond appropriately.
* Be a confident communicator and relationship builder capable of engaging with senior business leaders, regulators and regional/global stakeholders.
* Demonstrate ownership, sound judgement and the ability to escalate and resolve Financial Crime and regulatory issues promptly.
  

  

Essential Skills/Basic Qualifications:

* Relevant Financial Crime and Compliance experience in India.
* Minimum University degree.
* Extensive risk, compliance and/or legal experience within financial services.
* Experience in a Compliance role covering Anti-Money Laundering, Anti-Bribery & Corruption, Sanctions and Anti-Terrorism regulations.
* Detailed understanding and practical familiarity with Indian Financial Crime laws and regulations.
* Strong knowledge of the Indian regulatory environment for foreign banks.
* Good understanding of the products and services offered by the India business.
  

  

Desirable Skills/Preferred Qualifications:

* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced and complex environment and engage confidently across different levels of an organisation.
* Hands-on approach with demonstrated execution and process-management capabilities.
* Strong organisational skills with a clear focus on delivering results.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to manage senior stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across regional, global and cross-functional teams.
* Ability to exercise sound judgement, take ownership and respond to issues promptly and appropriately.

**Assistant Vice President – Settlement Operations**

**Department:** Business Operations
  
**Location:** Mumbai
  
**Employment type:** Full-time, Permanent
  
**Reports to:** Head of Operations / SVP, Business Operations

**About HSBC**

Some careers open more doors than others.

International Wealth and Premier Banking helps deliver HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing customers with borderless banking and wealth management through mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people.

**Role purpose**

The Assistant Vice President – Settlement Operations will manage securities clearing and settlement across cash, Futures & Options and currency segments, where applicable.

The role will oversee securities pay-in and payout, early pay-in, NSDL and CDSL operations, collateral pledging and re-pledging, settlement reconciliations, auction and shortage management, client and stakeholder queries, regulatory reporting, audit support, UAT and process improvement.

The role will ensure accurate and timely settlement within exchange and clearing-corporation deadlines, while maintaining effective controls, operational resilience and compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, clearing-corporation and depository requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Clearing and settlement**

* Manage daily clearing and settlement activities for NSE and BSE cash-market, F&O and currency segments, as applicable.
* Process trades from settlement validation through securities pay-in, payout and final reconciliation.
* Execute normal and early pay-in and payout within prescribed cut-off times.
* Prepare, review and process exchange and clearing obligations.
* Monitor settlement calendars, exchange timelines and operational dependencies.
* Coordinate with exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories and internal teams to complete settlement on time.
* Monitor failed, delayed, rejected and unmatched settlement transactions.
* Maintain settlement trackers, exception logs and management updates.
* Ensure all activities follow approved procedures and regulatory requirements.

**2. Securities pay-in, payout and depository operations**

* Process securities pay-in and payout through NSDL and CDSL.
* Manage securities movement through pool, clearing, beneficiary and client demat accounts.
* Reconcile balances across exchange, clearing, depository, pool and beneficiary accounts.
* Process and confirm normal and early pay-in transactions.
* Support direct payout and other approved delivery models for POA and non-POA clients.
* Process authorised off-market transfer instructions.
* Coordinate with depositories and internal teams on failed, pending or rejected instructions.
* Maintain records of securities movements, approvals and confirmations.
* Support corporate-action processing, including dividends, bonus issues, stock splits and other securities entitlements where applicable.

**3. Shortage and auction management**

* Identify securities shortages arising from trading and settlement.
* Coordinate with branches, clients, sub-brokers and internal teams to resolve shortages within prescribed timelines.
* Prepare provisional auction reports and provide details to relevant teams.
* Manage NSE and BSE auction processes, including auction obligations and auction bills.
* Track auction items through closure and escalate unresolved issues.
* Maintain records of shortages, client communication, auction processing and resolution.
* Analyse recurring shortages and recommend preventive controls.

**4. Collateral and pledge operations**

* Manage client securities pledging, unpledging and re-pledging activities.
* Process authorised instructions through approved channels and systems.
* Manage collateral workflows through CCPledge or an equivalent platform.
* Reconcile pledged securities with depository, client and internal records.
* Support MTF-related securities reconciliation, including comparison of MTF positions with client pledge balances.
* Process early pay-in activities to reduce margin requirements.
* Monitor collateral exceptions, margin mismatches and incomplete instructions.
* Coordinate with Risk, Technology, depositories and clearing teams on collateral matters.
* Maintain pledge instructions, approvals, confirmations and reconciliation evidence.

**5. Reconciliations and controls**

* Oversee daily reconciliations for:
* + Exchange and clearing records
  + Pool and beneficiary demat accounts
  + NSDL and CDSL balances
  + Securities pay-in and payout
  + Client holdings
  + MTF and pledged securities
  + Auction and shortage records
  + Settlement-related operational accounts
* Investigate breaks, identify root causes and complete corrective action within agreed timelines.
* Escalate aged, material or recurring breaks through appropriate governance channels.
* Validate exchange records, depository statements, settlement confirmations and internal reports.
* Ensure all reconciling items are supported by appropriate evidence.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation summaries.
* Maintain maker-checker, access-control and segregation-of-duties requirements.
* Ensure records are complete and available for audit or regulatory inspection.

**6. Reporting and regulatory support**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly settlement MIS.
* Provide accurate data for reporting client securities holdings to NSE, BSE, MCX and other applicable exchanges.
* Prepare reports covering pay-in, payout, shortages, auctions, collateral, reconciliations and exceptions.
* Support exchange, clearing-corporation and depository reporting requirements.
* Provide management with timely information on settlement status, operational risks and open items.
* Maintain reporting evidence, review records and approval trails.
* Update reporting processes when exchange or regulatory requirements change.
* Support preparation of regulatory information and responses within prescribed timelines.

**7. Audit, risk and compliance**

* Support internal, statutory, exchange and regulatory audits.
* Prepare evidence packs containing exchange and clearing reports, depository statements, reconciliations, pay-in and payout records, auction reports, collateral records, SOPs and exception logs.
* Respond to audit and inspection queries within agreed timelines.
* Track observations, action owners, remediation plans and closure dates.
* Identify operational risks, control weaknesses and client-impacting issues.
* Maintain incident logs, root-cause analyses and corrective-action plans.
* Ensure compliance with applicable SEB

* Product design and structuring: Design the product: investment proposition, mandate and benchmark, vehicle and domicile, share classes, currency and hedging, distribution model and target investor base; structuring here is design, not legal implementation.
* Business case and pipeline: Build the business case for each new product and prepare the papers required by the relevant committees; own the product pipeline and the multi-year roadmap, aligned to the commercial strategy and distribution capacity.
* Commercial positioning: Define the positioning, differentiation and value proposition of each product, and equip the commercial teams with the content, arguments and competitive comparisons needed to sell effectively.
* RFPs and commercial proposals: Contribute actively to the commercial effort with the sales and distribution teams by drafting and reviewing the product, strategy and competitive sections of RFPs, DDQs and client proposals, and by maintaining a reusable library of approved product content and Q&A.
* Lifecycle management: Monitor the performance, flows, profitability and relevance of the existing range, and drive rationalisation, repositioning, mergers and closures where appropriate.
* Cross-functional delivery: Act as design authority and business owner through the delivery of each product, working with Investments, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Technology and external counsel who execute documentation, filing and implementation.
* Regulatory awareness and reporting: Maintain a solid understanding of the ADGM and CMA product frameworks and their implications for product design and distribution, and report to management on pipeline, launches, pricing and product economics.

**Requirements / Qualifications**

* Experience: 5 to 10 years in product development, product management or product strategy within asset management or regulated financial services.
* Market, competition and pricing: Hands-on experience analysing markets, client demand and competitor ranges using industry databases, and defining or challenging fee structures and product profitability.
* Product knowledge: Solid understanding of investment products, strategies and vehicle structures across all asset classes and product types, including share class and distribution mechanics, and sufficient familiarity with product documentation to direct the teams executing it.
* Commercial support: Practical experience responding to RFPs and due diligence questionnaires and producing client-facing proposal content, with excellent written English and the ability to meet tight commercial deadlines.
* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: Working knowledge of the regulatory environment applicable to product design and distribution; proven ability to lead multi-stakeholder workstreams and manage timelines and dependencies.
* Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business or a related discipline.
* Capabilities: Analytical rigour, commercial judgement, initiative and the ability to turn market insight into a credible, differentiated and profitable product proposition.

**Preferred / Beneficial**

* Regulatory and stakeholder skills: ADGM and CMA an advantage.
* Qualifications: CFA, CAIA or equivalent professional qualifications are advantageous.

**Description**

At the **International Finance Corporation (IFC)**, a member of the **World Bank Group (WBG)**, you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. In fiscal year 2026, IFC committed a record $105.6 billion to private companies and financial institutions in developing countries. For more information, visit www.ifc.org.

The CFO and Capital Mobilization Vice Presidency, led by IFC’s Vice President and CFO, mobilizes private capital at scale to support clients that create jobs and drive growth in emerging markets. It brings together debt and equity mobilization, investor engagement, blended finance, and partnerships functions to expand the pool of capital available for development, while also overseeing the Corporation’s financial strategy and reporting, balance sheet management, and treasury functions. This prudent financial stewardship safeguards IFC’s AAA credit rating and ensures discipline, transparency, and alignment with institutional priorities.

Looking ahead, the VPU’s vision is to channel private capital into the sectors with the greatest potential to create jobs by embedding Originate-to-Distribute (OtD) approaches into IFC’s operating model, deepening and diversifying engagement with investors, donors, and development partners, and delivering innovative financial solutions that attract institutional capital to emerging markets. It will leverage data, technology, and market expertise to scale impact and improve efficiency.

As IFC continues to scale its impact and mobilize private capital at scale, in support of the WBG goal of creating jobs that lift people out of poverty, its ability to attract long term institutional investors to invest in IFC-originated emerging market assets has become increasingly central to its operating and financial model. In the context of heightened global uncertainty, constrained public resources, and rising development needs, effective engagement with institutional investors is critical to creating jobs, and sustaining and expanding development impact across emerging markets.

IFC’s originate-to-distribute and capital mobilization initiatives—including securitization, the Managed Co Lending Portfolio Program (MCPP), B Loan syndications, parallel loans, private equity funds and anchor bond investing, thematic bond issuances, blended finance facilities, and other structured mobilization vehicles—have expanded substantially in recent years, reflecting IFC’s strong focus on originating assets that both meet World Bank Group’s development mandate and are consistent with the investment preferences of institutional investors.

To support this strategically critical agenda, IFC is seeking Principal Investor Relations Officers in IFC’s Global Investor Relations function to work in collaboration with IFC’s originate-to-distribute (OtD) initiative and to help embed OtD into the operating model of IFC, by leading and strengthening IFC’s global investor engagement approach. The role will be to lead IFC’s critical institutional investor relationships, positioning IFC as a partner of choice for institutional investors while embedding scalable, best-in-class investor relationship management practices across the organization.

The Principal Investor Relations Officer will be responsible for deepening long-term investor relationships, expanding and diversifying IFC’s investor base, aligning investor mandates with IFC’s mobilization priorities, strengthening IFC’s visibility and credibility in global capital markets, integrating investor intelligence into institutional decision-making, and institutionalizing robust systems, governance, and standards for investor relationship management.

This vacancy announcement is for nine (9) positions posted across multiple duty stations. The selected candidates’ duty stations will be determined based on organizational requirements and business needs.

**Duties and Accountabilities:**

The selected candidate is responsible for performing activities in the following areas:

Own day-to-day IFC relationships with assigned Tier 1 and Tier 2 investors, under the Director’s executive sponsorship for the most significant relationships and expand participation in IFC-originated assets by connecting investor demand with IFC opportunities and the Originate-to-Distribute agenda.

**Relationship ownership & growth responsibilities:**

* Serve as accountable owner and primary point of contact for assigned investors. Where designated as geography Team Lead, lead and coordinate the other officers in the regional hub.
* Map investor interests and identify opportunities across IFC products, platforms and programs.
* Build trusted senior relationships and coordinate integrated engagement with product, regional, industry, transaction and country teams.
* Sponsor priority platforms, roadshows, investor education and external engagements for assigned relationships

**Planning, reviews & execution responsibilities:**

* Develop customized engagement plans, including strategic dialogues, co-investment discussions, site visits, reporting, events and investor education.
* Lead MOUs, frameworks, and commercial terms, subject to Legal clearance and authorized approval/signature.
* Lead onboarding and coordinate KYC and due diligence logistics.
* Conduct quarterly business and annual strategic reviews and maintain accurate Salesforce records and relationship updates.
* Support syndication and structuring teams while engaging with investors.

**Demand, risk & coordination responsibilities:**

* Capture risk appetite, pricing, tenor, sector interests and other actionable demand signals.
* Consolidate and propose relationship risk limits for funds, subsidiaries and insurers and assess financial sustainability.
* Communicate structured investor feedback to Syndications, with the OTD Analytical Team supporting consolidation and analysis.
* Advise underwriting and structuring on investor demand; designated authorities retain decisions. Participate occasionally in OtD or strategy meetings when relevant.
* Ensure that investor engagement activities are conducted in accordance with IFC policies, World Bank Group ethical standards, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
* Partner with Legal and Compliance teams on investor agreements, side letters, and co-investment arrangements.

**Selection Criteria**

jobs.description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.

If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.

**About the Role:**

At CoinDCX, brand and growth are one system. Brand earns trust, and trust brings in users who stay, trade and recommend us. As
**SVP – Growth & Marketing**
, you will own both sides and make them work as one.

Your mandate is not to promote crypto, but to normalise it and make it trusted. You will shape how millions of Indians understand, assess and use this new asset class. You will own the full path from first awareness to a loyal customer: brand trust, recall, acquisition, activation, retention, win-back, product-led growth and consumer understanding.

You will work at the meeting point of cultural narrative, regulatory nuance, reputation and capital discipline. We need a leader who plans in multi-year horizons, stays steady under public scrutiny and builds systems that hold up through market cycles.

You will lead the full marketing organisation (Brand, Creative, Content, Social and Community, PR), the Growth teams (Retention, Resurrection, PLG, Product Marketing, SEO and Digital Marketing) and Consumer Insights. You will partner closely with the Business unit, which owns CLM, and with Product, Policy, Analytics and Leadership, so that what we build, say and stand for stays aligned.

If building one of India’s most consequential financial brands, and the growth engine behind it, excites you, this role will both challenge and reward you.

**What You'll Do:**

* You are the
  **DRI (Directly Responsible Individual)**
  for the full Growth & Marketing budget across ATL, BTL, digital media, performance, social, content and PR. You are accountable not just for outcomes, but for the reasoning behind every spend decision.
* **Metric & Budget Ownership:**
  Own the brand KPIs (brand health, social media metrics, organic acquisition) and the growth KPIs (new users, activation, retention, blended CAC, LTV). You are accountable for full funnel marketing and building brand trust.
* **Brand Strategy:**
  Own the multi-year brand roadmap. Turn complex VDA (Virtual Digital Asset) topics into simple, education-led stories that enhance trust while keeping technical accuracy.
* **Growth Strategy:**
  Own the plan from first install to long-term customer, with one shared view of the funnel across marketing and growth.
* **Retention & Resurrection:**
  Keep active users coming back, and bring lapsed users back, through product-led and marketing-led programmes.
* **PLG & Product Marketing:**
  Build referrals, in-product loops and organic acquisition with Product. Own positioning, launches and go-to-market for each product line.
* **SEO & Digital Marketing:**
  Own organic search and paid digital channels. Manage CAC, ROAS and cost per activated user, and direct media buying and budget allocation.
* **Consumer Insights:**
  Lead the insights team. Use research, user behaviour data and brand tracking to guide decisions across marketing, growth, product and business.
* **Org Design:**
  Lead and grow the full team, from creatives to analysts to performance specialists. Build a strong layer of second-level leaders so day-to-day execution does not depend on you.
* **Reputation Systems:**
  Design and own proactive PR and “Issue Readiness” playbooks to protect institutional credibility during market volatility.
* **Product & Policy Partnership:**
  Work with Product and Policy so the brand promise of “Responsible Education” shows up in the app experience and in all advertising, and stays compliant.
* **Experimentation & Measurement:**
  Run a steady pipeline of growth and brand experiments with Product and Analytics, and set one trusted set of numbers for the whole function.

**You’ll Excel in This Role If You Have:**

* **Think in First Principles:**
  You look for the real reason users do not trust us or do not stay, rather than applying standard marketing frameworks.
* **Act as an Owner:**
  You treat company capital and reputation as your own, and make hard trade-offs to protect long-term brand value over short-term “hacks.”
* **Are Equally at Ease with Story and Numbers:**
  You can judge a brand film and read a funnel or cohort chart with the same confidence.
* **Translate Strategy:**
  You turn disruptive technology into simple, trusted, mass-market stories without losing technical accuracy.
* **Build Systems:**
  You build scalable content, PR and growth engines instead of managing individual tasks.
* **Lead Leaders:**
  You have led large, mixed teams of creatives, analysts and performance specialists, and earned the respect of each.
* **Decide Under Scrutiny:**
  You are comfortable being the final decision maker in moments of reputational, regulatory or public pressure.

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**

* **Trust & Recall:**
  “Institutional Trust” scores and “Responsible Education” recall rise in a measurable way.
* **Growth:**
  More new users complete KYC, make a first deposit and place a first trade, and retention and win-back rates improve.
* **Efficiency:**
  Blended CAC falls as organic acquisition and brand-led conversion improve.
* **Market Share:**
  CoinDCX’s share of the total Indian crypto user base grows.
* **Evidence-Led Decisions:**
  Consumer Insights visibly shapes major campaign, product and business decisions.
* **One Plan with Business:**
  Growth, Marketing and CLM run to shared targets without friction.
* **Independence:**
  Your leadership bench runs high-impact campaigns and growth programmes with little intervention from you.

**Why This Role Matters & What’s In It For You:**

You will bring brand and growth together under one leader at a $2.45B unicorn, and shape how a nation learns to trust a new financial system. You will work side by side with the founders to drive the company’s mission, and you will see first-hand how a brand and a user base scale from 10 → 100 in one of the world’s fastest-evolving industries. Very few roles offer this. This is one of them.

**Hiring Process:**

Here’s what your journey with us looks like:

* **Application Review**
  – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* **Recruiter Connect**
  – A short conversation to understand you better
* **Functional Round(s)**
  – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* **Assignment / Simulation Round**
  –A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* **Culture & Values Discussion**
  – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* **Founder Conversation (Optional)**
  – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**

We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bangalore**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.

**Perks That Empower You:**

We believe great people deserve great experiences.

* **Design Your Own Benefits:**
  Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* **Unlimited Wellness Leaves:**
  Rest and recharge as you need
* **Mental Wellness Support:**
  Access to therapy and wellness resources
* **Learning Sessions:**
  Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

jobs.description:
About
**Bright Money**

Bright Money
is a Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers. It brings together SaaS products that help consumers build credit, manage their debt, and access suitable loans and credit cards - the major financial needs of middle-income consumers living paycheck to paycheck.

Bright is a profitable, India-built, U.S.-market Consumer FinTech, with a revenue trajectory to $100M in the coming 6 months. The business model combines subscription revenue with financial services marketplace revenue from loans, credit cards, and credit-building tools.

Bright has launched an AI money assistant and AI agentic UX flows for access to credit. It will be the first AI-driven Consumer FinTech for middle-income consumers.

The Bright product suite has potential for global markets beyond the US. The market size is 100M global middle-income consumers, with a revenue pool opportunity of $15B.

Bright is backed by three top global venture capital firms and leading tech angel investors in the USA, Europe, and Asia.

Bright was established in 2019 by a leadership team drawn from McKinsey’s Banking Practice (Petko Plachkov and Avi Patchava) and InMobi’s Data Sciences organisation (Varun Modi and Avi Patchava). The core team is ex-InMobi Engineering and Data Sciences, joined more recently by senior leaders from McKinsey. Bright has a data-driven, fast-paced execution culture, and is building a global Consumer FinTech with all functions operating from India.

**What is the role about?**

Bright is looking for a Director - Engineering to lead and scale a core part of our engineering organisation in Bengaluru, reporting to the CTO. You will own delivery and technical direction for the systems behind Bright’s consumer app, credit decisioning, and AI products, and you will build the leadership layer that runs them.

This is a leader-of-leaders role. You will manage engineering managers and leads, shape architecture and platform strategy for your area within the CTO’s technical direction, own headcount, budget, and cloud spend for your teams, and partner with Product, Data Sciences, and the wider leadership team on what gets built next.

Bright is profitable, scaling fast in the U.S. market, and building AI into both the product and how the company runs. The systems are distributed, data-heavy, and carry real money and credit decisions, so engineering quality is a business outcome here, not an internal metric.

**What will you do?**

* Lead your organisation: Own and scale a multi-team group, with engineering managers and leads reporting to you; set the operating rhythm, standards, and performance bar across your teams.
* Build the leadership layer: Hire, coach, and retain senior engineers, leads, and managers, and develop the next line of engineering leadership beneath you.
* Technical strategy: Shape and execute architecture and platform strategy across services, data, and developer tooling for your area, in line with the CTO’s technical direction, and make the build-versus-buy and platformisation calls that shape how fast your teams can ship.
* Delivery at scale: Own end-to-end delivery of distributed, data-heavy systems - roadmap commitments, release predictability, and the trade-offs between speed and durability.
* Reliability & risk: Own availability, performance, security, and the engineering side of compliance obligations for the systems your teams run in a U.S. consumer-lending business.
* AI & ML in production: Partner with Data Sciences to productionise ML and Gen AI systems-serving, monitoring, and retraining - and raise engineering leverage through AI tooling across the org.
* Cross-functional leadership: Partner with Product, Data Sciences, Infrastructure, and business teams on priorities, sequencing, and the commitments engineering makes to them.
* Planning & budget: Own annual and quarterly planning for your area - headcount, vendor decisions, cloud cost and TCO, and the resourcing choices behind them.
* Reporting & visibility: Report clearly to the CTO and the wider leadership team on progress, risk, capacity, and investment, and contribute to leadership reviews as needed.

**Ideal candidate profile**

**Experience & Background:**

* Experience: 12+ years in engineering, with 5+ years in engineering leadership and at least 2 years managing managers or leads.
* Organisation scale: Has led a multi-team group of 20+ engineers, and has grown a team through a period of rapid scaling.

jobs.title: Full Stack Lead Engineer
jobs.description:
* Are you curious, excited by experimentation and always looking to innovate?
* Do you want to work in embedded payments where you can keep learning and developing whilst getting hands-on experience?
* Do you want to have the opportunity to play an important role in a rapidly growing and exciting Fintech business?

If so, we would love to connect and collaborate!
  
  
We want to hire ambitious, and value-adding talent into Modulr, one of the fastest growing payments businesses in the UK and Europe. Modulr is experiencing significant growth, and in this role you will work in a cross-functional team who are asked to solve a problem, rather than be handed a task to do. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a high-growth environment with a fast-paced and collaborative culture where you will have great opportunities to work on challenging problems across the entire technology stack.
  
  
**About Us**
At Modulr our mission is to move money efficiently to power business productivity. We are building a new digital payments service to make money flow more efficiently through businesses and the economy. This is a new type of payments account that is built for businesses that need faster, easier and more reliable ways to move money.
  
  
Our flexible platform and innovative approach allows our customers to utilise our payments account instead of a traditional bank account. Our accounts come with a sort code and account number, access to payment systems (eg Faster Payments and Visa) and everything our customers need from a payments account. They can instantly open as many accounts as they need, automate how they make and receive payments as well as the reconciliation processes these create. All in real time, 24/7 through their own systems utilising our API that integrates into any platform.
  
  
Our founding team has a wealth of experience in the payments industry and growing successful businesses. Modulr is backed by payments giants PayPal Ventures and FIS Ventures, as well as startup and scale up specialists Blenheim Chalcot, General Atlantic, Frog and Highland Europe which enables us to leverage their resources and expertise to drive our growth initiatives. These partnerships provide us with the necessary provisions to propel our business to new heights.
  
  
**Modulr values**

* Building the extraordinary; going that extra mile.
* Owning the opportunity; be passionate and proud of the time you invest.
* Move at pace; reach goals faster whilst supported on your career journey.
* Achieve it together, working collaboratively and being a Modulite.

**The Role**
The Full Stack Lead Engineer is a vital role within Modulr, where you will be responsible for building an autonomous, high performing engineering squad to foster an environment where decisions are delegated, made and communicated effectively. You will drive technical strategy with a strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI backend development while remaining deeply hands-on with core development. The role is a blend of hands-on Python development, technical leadership, mentoring, and operational excellence. You will lead
  
  
the architecture and implementation of robust, scalable backend systems using FastAPI, cloud infrastructure on AWS, and coordinate full-stack solutions with frontend teams.
  
  
**Specific duties**

* Lead a squad of software engineers, driving technical excellence through code reviews, architectural guidance, pair programming, and mentoring with strong emphasis on Python and FastAPI best practices.
* Technically efficient to write production-quality Python code, designing high-performance REST APIs, managing databases, async operations, and establishing coding standards.
* Own backend architecture decisions and lead the design of scalable, robust systems using Python, relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL), caching layers, and message queues.
* Lead technical strategy for AWS cloud deployments, ensuring security, reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.
* Mentor team members to develop deep full stack expertise for both backend & frontend through 1-2-1s, code reviews, and pair programming, fostering their technical growth and career progression.
* Plan squad deliverables and delegate responsibilities clearly, ensuring the team has well-defined goals, unblocked paths to success, and regular progress tracking.
* Collaborate with Frontend, DevOps, and Product teams to deliver integrated solutions, ensuring seamless API integration between backend and frontend.
* Drive agile practices and conduct productive ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, reviews, retros), promoting continuous improvement and team autonomy.
* Drive hiring and recruitment, conducting technical interviews, assessments, and candidate evaluations while representing Modulr's engineering culture and values.
* Report on squad progress, outcomes, and technical achievements to leadership; share knowledge and best practices across the broader Engineering organisation.

**About You**
**Must Have**
:
  
  

* Expert-level proficiency in Python (9+ years), with deep knowledge of Python frameworks, async programming, and backend development best practices.
* Strong, hands-on experience with FastAPI, including building high-performance REST APIs, dependency injection, validation, and async operations.
* Solid experience with React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with understanding of full-stack integration and frontend-backend communication patterns.
* Hands-on experience designing, building and deploying systems on AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, API Gateway, etc).
* Proven software development and technical team leadership experience, with a strong understanding of backend engineering practices and processes.
* Strong understanding of system design, microservices architecture, database design, and cloud-native application patterns.
* Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and understanding of data modeling, optimization, and migrations.
* Strong testing discipline (unit, integration, and end-to-end testing) with TDD mindset for backend systems.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and lead technical decision-making in a collaborative environment.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration.
* Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code.

**Good to have:**

* Experience with caching solutions (Redis), message queues (RabbitMQ, Kafka), and async task processing.
* Experience in the fintech or payments domain.

**Key Attributes:**

* Strong problem-solver with deep analytical and critical thinking skills; ability to balance pragmatism with technical excellence.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Self-directed and proactive, with a drive to continuously learn and innovate in Python and backend technologies.
* Passionate about code quality, performance optimization, and building scalable, maintainable systems.
* Team player with strong collaborative and leadership presence, comfortable guiding the team through technical decisions.

**ModInclusion**
At Modulr, we are working hard to build a more positive diverse and inclusive culture that helps everyone to feel they belong and can truly bring their whole self to work. Not only is it the right thing to do for everyone in the Modulr team, it's also the right thing to do for our business, the community we operate in and attracting future talent. As part of our approach, we actively welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds.

We are seeking a seasoned technology leader to serve as Senior Manager, Software Engineering. This role is accountable for end-to-end delivery across Azure Cloud, modern web applications, Salesforce, and payment platforms. The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with disciplined execution, build high-performing engineering teams, and coordinate complex initiatives across multiple functions and geographies. This leader will translate business priorities into scalable technology outcomes while strengthening engineering practices, operational resilience, security, and accountability.
