jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Senior AI Engineer, AI Engineering
  
  
Mastercard’s Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth & innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a ‘Lead Engineer, Machine Learning Engineering’ for Operational Intelligence Program, within B&MI group. This role will lead ML engineering team to execute on AI/ML strategy for the program that enables business growth, enhances customer experience, and ensures delivery of secure, scalable, and high-performing software solutions. As a technology leader, this role will also focus on engineering best practices, next gen innovation and stakeholder management, while fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence within the team.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Implement multi-agent intelligence frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) to enable reasoning, coordination, and adaptive decision-making across specialized AI agents.
* Design and operationalize multi-modal AI pipelines combining text, image, tabular, and graph data using transformer-based architectures (BERT, CLIP, LLaVA, T5, Whisper, etc.) for unified intelligence.
* Build scalable RAG and Graph-RAG systems integrating vector stores and knowledge graphs (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) to enable contextual retrieval, semantic linking, and entity-aware reasoning.
* Develop and productionize transformer-based models for NLP, vision-language understanding, and sequential prediction tasks leveraging Hugging Face, PyTorch, and TensorFlow ecosystems.
* Implement advanced Python-based backend services for inference orchestration, async job handling, and distributed data workflows supporting high-throughput AI operations.
* Establish end-to-end LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS) integrating MLflow, feature stores, model lineage, prompt evaluation, and continuous retraining frameworks.
* Apply traditional AI/ML and statistical modeling techniques (regression, clustering, forecasting, ensemble methods) alongside deep learning models for hybrid interpretability and explainability.
* Engineer state and memory management subsystems that preserve context, track embeddings, and enable agents to reason temporally across multiple modalities and interactions.
* Implement Responsible AI practices—bias detection, explainability dashboards, data ethics checks, and performance governance ensuring fairness and transparency of deployed models.
* Continuously research, benchmark, and productionize innovations in multimodal transformers, generative modeling, and agentic orchestration to drive enterprise-scale intelligence and automation.

**All About You**

* Master’s/bachelor’s degree in computer science or engineering, and a considerable work experience with a proven track-record of successfully leading and managing complex projects/products and delivering to aggressive market needs.
* Expert-level hands on experience designing, building and deploying both conventional AI/ML solutions and LLM/Agentic solutions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with quick adaptation to new technologies, methodologies, and systems.
* Strong applied knowledge and hands on experience in advanced statistical techniques, predictive modelling, machine learning algorithms, GenAI and deep learning frameworks. Experience with AI and machine learning platforms such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or similar.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as Python/SQL is a must. Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and understanding of cloud computing services (AWS, Azure, GCP) related to data processing and storage is a plus.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) is responsible for establishing, implementing, operating, monitoring, and continuously enhancing OneFin’s Information Security Management System (ISMS) across all product lines and enterprise infrastructure.

This leader will own end-to-end information security strategy, cloud security governance (AWS), regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines for digital lending and IT governance), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standards, and client-facing security assessments for institutional banking partners. Implement zero trust security architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Information Security Governance & Strategy**

* Define, maintain, and enforce OneFin's Level-1 ISMS policies, standards, and guidelines in alignment with business goals.
* Report security posture, risk profiles, and incident metrics directly to the CEO, C-suite, and Board of Directors.
* Lead the annual risk assessment framework across all business units, maintaining the enterprise Risk Register and tracking remediation strategies.
* Establish annual security objectives, measurable parameters, and operational security targets.

**2. Regulatory, Compliance & Client Audit Management**

* Direct compliance for ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certifications, surveillance audits, and internal security audits.
* Ensure strict adherence to Reserve Bank of India (RBI) guidelines regarding digital lending, data localization, outsourcing, and cloud management.
* Act as the executive point of contact for financial institution (FI) client audits, managing Information Security Group (ISG) checklists, VAPT review points, and security questionnaires.
* Oversee Data Protection and Privacy compliance, protecting Personally Identifiable Information (PII) and Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI).
* Oversee source code audits, and conduct internal security audits of codebase.

**3. Cloud Infrastructure & Product Security**

* Oversee security configuration across AWS environments, ensuring AES-256 encryption at rest (S3, RDS, ECR) and enforced TLS/HTTPS in transit.
* Enforce secure architecture models for single-tenant / dedicated client deployments on Financial Institution AWS infrastructure.
* Direct Web Application Firewall (WAF) policies, IP/URL whitelisting, geo-blocking, and network perimeter controls.
* Maintain DevSecOps rigor within CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), ensuring automated peer reviews, static analysis, code coverage thresholds, and container image vulnerability management.

**4. Threat Management & Security Operations (SecOps)**

* Lead the Incident Response Team; ensure end-to-end management, SLA tracking, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for all P1/Critical incidents.
* Oversee centralized logging, Database Activity Monitoring (DAM), and integration capabilities with Bank SIEM systems.
* Mandate periodic Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT) across applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
* Enforce robust Access Control & Identity Management (IAM), including mandatory multi-factor authentication (MFA) across email, code repositories, and cloud portals.

**5. Third-Party Risk & Business Continuity**

* Enforce Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) guidelines, ensuring mandatory MSAs and NDAs across all vendors.
* Manage annual Business Continuity Planning (BCP) and Disaster Recovery (DR) drills, validating Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO).
* Conduct annual enterprise-wide security awareness training programs and specialized DevSecOps workshops.

**Candidate Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or related engineering fields.
* **Experience:** 12+ years in Information Security and Technology Risk, with at least 4+ years in a leadership role (CISO, Head of Security, or Director of InfoSec).
* **Domain Background:** Prior experience in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems is strictly required.

**Technical & Professional Competencies**

**Cloud Security**- Deep expertise in AWS Security Hub, WAF, KMS, CloudTrail, IAM, RDS/S3 encryption, and containerized deployments (ECS/ECR).

**Frameworks**- Hands-on mastery of ISO/IEC 27001:2022, NIST CSF, OWASP Top 10, and SOC 2 Type II compliance.

**Regulatory Knowledge**- In depth knowledge of RBI Cybersecurity Framework, RBI Digital Lending Directions, and Indian Data Protection laws.

**Application Security**- Expertise in DevSecOps, API security, automated code scanners, tesseract/OCR pipeline security, and LLM/AI model deployment governance.

**Leadership**- Exceptional stakeholder management, board-level reporting, and experience negotiating security requirements with Tier-1 Bank CISOs.

**Certifications (Preferred)**

* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* Certified Information Security Manager (CISM)
* Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
* ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of prior experience do you have in Fintech, B2B SaaS, Banking, or Financial Services ecosystems?

Experience:

* Information security: 10 years (Required)
* Leadership: 4 years (Required)

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Global Process Owner Support (GPOS) role exists to strengthen first-line-of-defence risk management and governance across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes within Client Coverage. It supports Global Process Owners in embedding applicable policies, standards and controls into day-to-day business activities, helping the business manage operational and process risks consistently across markets. The role delivers oversight of control effectiveness, coordinated remediation of control gaps and exceptions, and clear reporting and escalation of material risks to support informed governance decisions. Working with business, country teams and second-line stakeholders, it also supports process simplification and the implementation of change with appropriate risk assessments and controls. Its primary focus is to maintain effective, consistent and efficient credit processes that support business delivery while operating within established risk tolerances.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

The role holder is an individual contributor with no formal people-management accountability. The role leads and coordinates assigned risk, control and process-improvement activities through stakeholder collaboration, supporting the Global Process Owner / delegate and GPOS Lead across Credit Origination, Credit Monitoring and Credit Allied Risk processes. The role holder is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of assigned assessments, assurance oversight, reporting and remediation coordination; designated action owners remain responsible for completing their actions.
  
**Risk assessment and control implementation**  
• Implement applicable control requirements and procedures, and support each stage of the RCSA, from process and risk identification to monitoring implemented controls, at least annually and when trigger events occur, to maintain a current view of process and residual risks.
  
**Timely risk treatment**  
• Coordinate and track agreed elevated residual-risk actions and treatment plans with designated action owners, maintain records in the Group operational risk management system, and escalate delays to support timely completion.
  
**Learning from risk events**  
• Initiate Root Cause Reviews for in-scope material risk events and, where required, aggregate smaller events with similar root causes to identify recurring weaknesses and support corrective action.
  
**Controlled change delivery**  
• Identify delivery risks and dependencies, assess impacts on critical processes and residual risk, and review and support Operational and Change Risk Assessments and process-impact assessments before go-live, including minor changes where required.

**Broad Accountabilities**  
**Strategy**  
• Targeted Improvements: Work with internal stakeholders to identify gaps and improvement opportunities in credit processes, and lead assigned change and remediation activities to make processes more effective and streamlined.
  
• Support the GPO’s credit transformation agenda by translating agreed priorities into implementation activities and delivering assigned work within agreed timelines.
  
• Automation and Streamlining: Review operational efficiency, effectiveness and quality against changing business and customer needs, and identify actions to improve process performance.
  
• Drive continuous improvement and automation, and remove or simplify unnecessary process steps to improve efficiency and consistency across systems and processes.
  
• Support CPA Team Heads, including the CPA Hub, in improving process efficiency, simplifying processes and increasing capacity.
  
**Business**  
• Assess the process and operational-risk implications of business strategies, projects and programmes, and provide remediation guidance to support informed decisions.
  
• Support global adoption of Credit COE initiatives and work with management to implement agreed process improvements and strategic credit transformation initiatives.
  
• Maintain effective relationships with Business, Finance, Risk, Technology and Operations to resolve process issues and coordinate delivery across markets.
  
• Coordinate stakeholder inputs and supporting information for regulatory and audit requests to enable timely responses.

**Processes**  
• Support the Process Owner in delivering BAU operational-risk requirements on time and in designing and maintaining the Control Assessment Standards framework for front-office processes globally.
  
• Monitor CST/KCI exception trends and agree practical improvement actions with countries to strengthen processes and controls.
  
• Guide QC teams in GBS and countries in understanding and consistently applying checks, particularly those involving qualitative or subjective assessments.
  
• Support process governance by streamlining existing processes, rolling out new processes and resolving Credit and Credit Monitoring queries with the relevant GPOS Lead.
  
• Work with CPAs, Client Management, CPOs, R&C, Business Heads and other regional and country stakeholders to share developments, lessons and best practices, and deliver agreed requirements on time.
  
• Assess change impacts through CCIA, evaluate change readiness and perform GRAM assessments. Provide subject-matter expertise to help mitigate identified process risks.
  
• Support the resolution of Group-specific process issues and related actions identified by GIA.
  
• Support the Process Owner in promptly escalating significant risks and issues to Process Universe Owners, relevant RFOs or Policy Owners. Maintain effective relationships with 2LOD across applicable risk types to support management of the Bank’s risk profile.
  
**Risk Management**  
• Identify process risks and support implementation of the Operational Risk Framework and appropriate controls. Help operations manage risk within established tolerance thresholds and minimise risks and losses in Credit Origination.

* Identify non-standard processes and agree appropriate controls with the GPOS Lead. Review proposed process and system changes for material impacts, and keep DOIs and process documentation up to date.

• Support implementation of applicable Credit, Fraud, Climate, Reputational and Sustainability Risk policies and standards within CC COE, embedding their requirements in managed processes.
  
• Prepare updates on risk initiatives for CC Governance Committee packs, and provide subject-matter expertise for Root Cause Reviews and boundary events to support oversight and corrective action.
  
• Support the design and delivery of relevant Credit Transformation initiatives and partner with TB, FM and Lending to improve the operating model and execution through existing CC credit processes.
  
• Provide ongoing learning and guidance on policies, process risks, controls and governance. Work with 2LOD and Product partners to develop and implement a roadmap for improving the control framework.
  
• Support implementation and closure of Group-level audit Management Action Plans, and delivery of actions arising from PRA Dear CEO Letters and specific reviews relating to owned processes.
  
**Governance**  
• Ensure risks are clearly identified, quantified and reported to the appropriate governance forums, with timely visibility and escalation of material issues.
  
• Assess how effectively the control framework addresses key risks and initiate treatment plans where required. Coordinate remediation of capability, process, data and documentation gaps.
  
• Provide central oversight of CST/KCI assurance checks performed by GBS, including ongoing training and guidance, to maintain standardised and consistent assessments.

We offer products across 35 categories, 40,000+SKUs from 300+ brands across* ***Building Material, Chemicals & Metals****. We launched private labels in 3 categories : Tiles, Ply and Bath ware. Our customer base now spans top-tier EPC companies, civil contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, fabricators, manufacturing companies, dealers, and retailers. We connect Sellers, Buyers, Logistics service providers, Lending partners, Payment solution providers on a unified digital backbone thereby creating end to end visibility and providing a B2C like fulfilment experience for the B2B ecosystem.*

*The evolution of B2B ecommerce is expected to mirror the B2C ecommerce journey, where technology transformed discovery, pricing, fulfilment, and customer experience at scale. Digital penetration today in B2B ecommerce is still under* ***2%****, indicating massive headroom for scalable digital-first platforms. As the Aditya Birla Group, we are uniquely positioned to transform and shape the way commerce is done across these verticals by leveraging our deep industry expertise and scale. We have built a unique Quote based, Credit linked commerce journey that solves for the needs of B2B commerce with a diverse team that is a mix of deep industry expertise and experience of building complex technology platforms from the ground up. Our goal is to drive this digital adoption and create a distribution platform that can become* ***the most trusted B2B ecommerce platform in the country.***
  
  
***Why is this role exciting?***
  
  
***As our Security Engineer, you are the single hands-on owner of security operations and governance for Birla Pivot's cloud native B2B commerce platform —keeping every security KRI Green and closing audits with no major findings. In this role you get to:***
  
***?Own both sides of security —vulnerability, cloud posture, detection and access controls, and the policies, evidence and cadence that audits and the DPDP Act require.***
  
***?Shape how a high-growth business adopts AI securely, from the AI usage policy to reviews of every AI use case.***
  
***?Work closely with the Head of Cybersecurity, InfoSec & Cloud, the ABG central security team, legal and our vendors.***
  
  
***What will you do?***
  
  
***Security Operations & Incident Response***
  
  
***?Triage SIEM and EDR alerts daily; act as first responder for security incidents.***
  
***?Run incident response playbooks; prepare CERT-In reports within 6 hours of a reportable incident.***
  
***?Run tabletop exercises and post-incident reviews.***
  
  
***Vulnerability & Exposure Management***
  
***?Run vulnerability scanning across cloud, containers, code and endpoints; track remediation against SLA (Critical 7 days, High 30 days).***
  
***?Coordinate VAPT and red team engagements and drive findings to closure.***
  
***?Maintain WAF rules and virtual patching for internet-facing apps.***
  
  
***Endpoint, Patching & Resilience***
  
  
***?Keep EDR healthy on all endpoints and servers; validate patch compliance monthly.***
  
***?Verify backup restore tests and support DR drills.***
  
  
***Cloud Security (AWS)***

**📍 Location:**

Dubai, UAE (On-site)

**📌 Type:**

Full-time

**💰 Compensation:**

Competitive Salary

**🏥 Benefits:**

Visa sponsorship, medical insurance

**About Comfi**

* Comfi provides SMEs across the Middle East with the fastest and simplest access to working capital.
* We help suppliers and businesses unlock cash flow in hours rather than weeks through products such as Invoice Financing, Payable Financing, and Dealer Financing.
* By turning future payments into immediate liquidity, we enable businesses to operate, grow, and remain in control of their finances.
* Today, Comfi serves companies across industries including automotive, electronics, healthcare, and F&B, eliminating the complexity, uncertainty, and delays associated with traditional financing.
* Backed by $68M in venture debt facilities and growing at 20% month-over-month, Comfi is rapidly expanding across the region. We are not improving traditional financing — we are redefining how businesses access capital.

**The Role**

We're looking for a Head of Referral Partnerships to own Comfi's referral program as a business. This is a P&L-owning role, not a relationship-management role. You will be the single business owner of the channel: its strategy, its growth, its partners, its incentives and its team.

Your scope is Comfi's standard referral offering for every affiliate partner — financial brokers, accountants, auditors, business setup firms, existing customers and any other player that sits close to SMEs — whether they send cases through the partner dashboard or through the API. 

You'll report to the CRO and work daily with Product, Risk, Customer Success, Finance and Marketing. Success is simple to measure: the referral program hits its KYB, origination and revenue goals every month, and leadership can rely on you to run it.

**What You'll Do**

🔹
**Growth & P&L**

* Own the P&L of the referral division and its monthly goals: KYB submissions, origination and revenue
* Grow the number of active partners and the output of each partner
* Set the strategy for the program and focus the team on the few things that move the numbers most

🔹
**Partner Ecosystem**

* Build a large ecosystem of referral partners on Comfi's standard offering, via dashboard or API
* Open new partner types beyond financial brokers: accounting firms, audit firms, business setup firms, existing customers and other SME ecosystem players
* Design the acquisition, onboarding and activation motion for each partner type, from first contact to first funded case

🔹
**Partner Relationships**

* Be the main face of Comfi for all referral partners
* Build real rapport with partner owners and their teams, and keep the top partners close
* Handle escalations, hard conversations and commercial negotiations yourself

🔹
**Incentives & Partner Tiers**

* Design and run the motivational structure of the program, including the introduction of partner tiers
* Measure what each incentive returns and change what does not pay back

🔹
**Business Requirements for Product**

* Act as the business owner for the referral dashboard and partner journey
* Write clear, systematic specifications for the product team: the problem, the rules, the edge cases, the acceptance criteria and the metric it should move
* Decide what gets built first and say no to what does not matter

🔹
**Data & Infrastructure**

* Run the program on numbers and facts: partner funnel, conversion at every step, unit economics per partner type
* Dig deep into the data and check whether it can be trusted before acting on it
* Design the infrastructure of the channel — stages, tracking, reporting and processes — so it scales without adding headcount at the same rate

🔹
**Team & Stakeholders**

* Lead, coach and grow the referral team
* Manage dependencies with Product, Risk, Customer Success, Finance and Marketing so partner cases move fast and nothing waits on you

**What You Bring**

✅ 5+ years in B2B partnerships, channel or affiliate programs, or business development, ideally in fintech or a high-growth startup

✅ Proven ownership of a P&L or a revenue number for a partner channel, not just execution against a target

✅ Track record of building a large network of small and mid-size partners and making it produce, with numbers to show for it

✅ Structured thinker who speaks in numbers and facts, and designs systems rather than one-off fixes

✅ Extremely strong with data: you pull it yourself, question it, and can tell when a number cannot be trusted

✅ Experience writing business requirements that a product and engineering team can build from

✅ Experience designing incentive or commission structures, such as tiers, bonuses or rev-share

✅ A natural relationship builder who earns the trust of partner owners and negotiates with confidence

✅ Sharp prioritisation: you focus on the most important thing and drop the rest

✅ Team leadership experience, with a record of hiring, coaching and holding people to targets

✅ Strong cross-functional operator, comfortable working through dependencies you do not control

*Nice to have:*

⭐ An existing network among UAE financial brokers, accounting, audit or business setup firms

⭐ Background in fintech, SME lending, BNPL or payments

⭐ Hands-on experience with SQL, BI tools or a CRM such as HubSpot

⭐ Experience with partner dashboards, referral platforms or API-based partner integrations

⭐ Prior experience in the UAE or GCC market

**Why Us?**

🚀
**Run a business, not a function:**

full ownership of the referral P&L, strategy and team

💡
**Build the ecosystem:**

open new partner types and shape how SMEs across the UAE reach Comfi

📈
**Fast-growing fintech:**

join a company scaling at 20% month-over-month

🤝
**Direct line to leadership:**

work side by side with the CRO and founders, with decisions made in days

🌍
**Regional scale:**

grow with Comfi as it expands across the Middle East

**About myZoi**
myZoi is an exciting fintech start-up aiming to promote financial inclusion globally. Our vision is to provide a level playing field to the unbanked and the underbanked in accessing essential financial services in an affordable, convenient, and transparent fashion. We are looking for smart, ambitious, and purpose driven individuals to join us in this journey.
  
  
This is an opportunity to join myZoi as a Chief Technology Officer. The role will be based in the UAE.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Business**

* Working with the CEO, CPO, Product Owners, and partners to lead technology build, evaluate technology trade-offs, oversee vendor engineering engagements, and deliver features and capabilities aligned to the business model to build on the minimum viable product (MVP) to successful global rollout.
* The Chief Technology Officer will discuss with partners, fintechs, co-creation clients, and business to expand the Company’s product offering and geographical footprint.
* Co-ordinate, question and interrogate technology opportunities with engineering team and innovate to sustain a competitive advantage.
* Employ a managerial mindset that seeks to optimise business outcomes for the Company while establishing sound governance, internal processes, adherence to policies and standards. This role requires close coordination with the SC Ventures CTO.

* Establish a sound technology operation covering incident management, problem management, service levels (SLAs) and business continuity processes

**Skills And Experience**

* Knowledgeable on modern object orientated programming practises including entity frameworks, dynamic reflection, and reusable interfaces.
* Familiarity with 3rd party system integrations via APIs (HTTP/REST), host-to-host (file exchange by FTP), with background jobs processing of real-time, event triggered, and async automations.
* Familiar with OWASP, secure by design, secure coding practises, code scanning, unit testing, dependency management (deprecation, vulnerabilities, licensing)

* Ability to wear multiple hats such as individual contributor, team lead, solution architect, facilitator.
* Beneficial is knowledge of FinTech ecosystem, inclusive of Blockchain, Digital Payments, Primer Services and Transaction Banking Enhancements, as well as other innovations in this space.

**Qualifications**
**Other Responsibilities**

* Have expertise and professional experience in software development and deep understanding of technology delivery.

**Subject Matter Knowledge And Experience**

* 15 years’ experience in similar technology leadership role
* Experience in startups & technology companies a major plus
* Understanding and appreciation for the complexities of the Group’s footprint
* Motivated to address the impact of innovation technology in Financial Services

**Skills And Characteristics**

* Imaginative and creative approach to how we do work
* Curiosity about new technologies, workflows, and products

The role holder is authorised to manage and operate within the scope of the roles and responsibilities outlined above. Role holders are not authorised beyond the scope of this job description unless they have a formal delegation of authority.

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.
  
  
Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

jobs.title: Product Manager I
jobs.description:
Take a step forward and let Edenred surprise you.

Every day, we deliver innovative solutions to improve the life of millions of people, connecting employees, companies, and merchants all around the world.

We know there are hundred ways for you to grow. With us, you will expand your skills in a multicultural, challenging, and dynamic environment.

**Dare to join Edenred and get ready to thrive in a global company that will offer you endless opportunities.**

Edenred is all about meritocracy. You come as you are, and you contribute. Indeed, the Edenred Group recognizes, recruits and develops all talents and singularities.

We are committed to preventing all forms of discrimination and to providing all our candidates with equal opportunities regardless of their gender and gender expression, disability, origin, religious belief and sexual orientation or any other criteria.

**About Edenred**

Edenred is the leading digital platform for corporate services in the areas of benefits, professional mobility, and B2B payments.

Operating in 44 countries, it connects more than 60 million users to over 2 million partner merchants through more than 1 million client companies.

Edenred offers solutions dedicated to employee engagement (meal vouchers, commuting, gift vouchers, wellness, rewards, and preferential offers to boost purchasing power), mobility (multi-energy solutions, including EV charging, fleet management services, maintenance, toll, and parking), and corporate payments (virtual cards). In addition to its own solutions, Edenred also distributes offers from more than 120 partners on its platform.

True to the Group's purpose, “Enrich connections. For good.”, these solutions enhance users' well-being and purchasing power and simplify the lives of professional drivers while promoting access to healthier food, more environmentally friendly products, and more sustainable mobility. They improve the attractiveness and efficiency of businesses and vitalize the employment market and the local economy.

Edenred's 12,000 employees are committed to making the world of work a connected ecosystem that is safer, more efficient and more responsible every day.

In 2024, thanks to its global technology assets, the Group generated a business volume of nearly €45 billion, mainly through mobile applications, online platforms and cards.

Edenred is listed on the Euronext Paris stock exchange and included in the following indices: CAC Next 20, CAC Large 60, Euronext 100, Euronext Tech Leaders, FTSE4Good, DJSI Europe Index, DJSI World Index, and MSCI Europe.

  

**The UAE CONTEXT**

Edenred UAE is a fast-growing payroll service provider serving more than 20,000 businesses and more than 2.2 million unbanked employees. We service over 10 banks and 35 financial institutions.

We offer a unique value proposition for companies to manage their payroll, and for employees to receive their salaries and use them in the simplest way — through multiple value-added services in our mobile app (money transfer, mobile recharge, card services and more).

  

**THE ROLE**

Most of our users receive their salary on a card we issue, send money home through our app, and pay for their week with a product our team built. For a large share of them, we are their first and only financial relationship. That raises the stakes on every decision — and makes this one of the more interesting product jobs in the region.

You will own product strategy and delivery for a product area inside an organisation that has the autonomy of a startup and the reach of a multinational. You set direction for your area, shape its strategy, and make day-to-day calls that are demonstrably aligned to a clear product vision — with the coaching and air cover to get it right.

Depending on where the business needs you most, you might begin in financial crime and compliance — making onboarding fast without weakening controls, catching fraud earlier, turning regulatory requirements into changes engineering can actually build. Or you might begin on the consumer side — remittance, cards, wallet, lending — working acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation problems for 2.2 million people.

The PMs who do best here are the ones who can hold a regulatory constraint and a growth funnel in their head at the same time.

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Own a product area. Identify the levers and problems that matter, build a now / next / later roadmap you can defend against real resource constraints, and treat company resources as your own.

* Set and evangelise a vision. Make sure your decisions and your squad's decisions stay aligned to it, and that everyone can explain the “why” without you in the room.

* Lead discovery. Decide independently what to ask and who to ask, know when research is and isn't needed, and turn what you learn into decisions rather than decks.

* De-risk deliberately. Define the riskiest assumptions behind an initiative, prioritise them, and pick the right test for each — balancing speed against certainty instead of defaulting to trial and error.

* Use data properly. Judge which metrics matter, read experiment results honestly, and make confident scale-or-pivot calls. You self-serve across Excel, CleverTap and SQL.

* Ship with engineering. Write crisp PRDs, mitigate feasibility risk early, hold the bar on specifications, and clear blockers before they bite.

* Drive outcomes, not output. Take initiatives, objectives and key results to completion on time, and be honest about what moved and what didn't.

* Work the room. Frame ambiguous problems, facilitate strong problem-solving discussions, manage stakeholder expectations, and pull in senior leaders when that's what unblocks the outcome.

* Communicate top-down. Present a cohesive narrative to data, design, engineering and senior business audiences, and make the trade-offs legible.

Stay close to a unique customer. Our users are underbanked, often first-time app users, sending money to families across several corridors. Every decision comes back to what they're trying to achieve.  

  

**YOUR PROFILE**

* 3+ years in product management - with a track record of independently owning a product or product area and shipping.

* Evidence you moved the numbers - KPIs and OKRs that mattered, not just features that launched.

* Range - Comfort operating in a regulated environment and appetite for consumer growth problems. Experience in payments, fintech, fraud, compliance or high-scale consumer products is a plus, not a requirement.

* Strong analytical instincts - You can set sensible thresholds, spot risk in data, size an opportunity, and check whether something is actually working.

* Technical fluency - Enough to discuss APIs, automation and trade-offs with engineers and be taken seriously.

* Excellent organisation, judgment and attention to detail - you can operate without direction.

* Communication and influence - You drive consensus, articulate recommendations and trade-offs to senior executives, and write specs engineers can build from without guessing.

Beyond the craft, we care a lot about how you work:

* Ownership — you take responsibility for outcomes, speak up when something looks wrong, and follow through on what you commit to.

* Collaboration — you listen actively, build trust across teams, and bring people along rather than pushing work over the wall.

* Problem solving — creative and structured, using both data and judgment to land on an answer.

* Drive — proactive and entrepreneurial; you clear your own obstacles and ask for help early when you're stuck.

* Curiosity — genuinely interested in users, and in how the product works under the hood.

Senior candidates will also be expected to coach and mentor junior product managers, review their work, and contribute to hiring.

  

**REPORTING STRUCTURE**

Reporting to: Product Lead / Senior Product Manager, depending on the area you join.

Working with: Engineering, Design, Data, Compliance,

* Develop comprehensive account plans, stakeholder maps, competitive strategies, and deal-closing plans for strategic opportunities.

* Engage senior leadership strategically to strengthen customer relationships and advance critical opportunities.

------------------------------------

The ideal candidate is a results-oriented enterprise sales professional with strong hunting capabilities, deep technology sales expertise, and an established network of senior decision-makers. * Partner with administrative departments across the organization to identify applicable legal requirements and ensure ongoing compliance.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FEMA, ODI, FDI regulations and other corporate laws.
* Track regulatory amendments and ensure timely compliance as laws evolve.

* Engage external counsel for legal opinions as needed, and manage that relationship end to end.

**Qualifications**

* Qualified Company Secretary (ICSI); an additional law degree (LLB) is preferred.
* 8-10 years of post-qualification experience in a combined Company Secretarial and Corporate Legal role, ideally in-house with a corporate.

**Skills & Experience**

* Demonstrated ability to independently run the full Company Secretarial function – Board/Committee governance, statutory filings, and ROC/MCA/RBI liaison – without close supervision.
* Working knowledge of FEMA, the Companies Act, labour and industrial laws, and other applicable corporate statutes.
* Strong legal drafting and vetting skills across contracts, agreements and banking documentation.
* Experience managing litigation, external counsel relationships, and ideally cross-border/international arbitration matters.
* Comfortable working across a multi-jurisdictional structure (India plus international subsidiaries).
* Strong interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills, with a practical, business-first approach to problem-solving.

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. **Role summary**

Lead the evolution and operational excellence of Chalhoub's Finance technology landscape on SAP S/4HANA, acting as a key partner to Finance and Technology leadership. * Deep expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance, with strong functional understanding across Record-to-Report (R2R), Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), and Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A).

**Who We Are**

At Goldman Sachs, we connect people, capital and ideas to help solve problems for our clients. We are a leading global financial services firm providing investment banking, securities and investment management services to a substantial and diversified client base that includes corporations, financial institutions, governments and individuals.

In Private Wealth Management, we help our clients pursue their wealth management goals through careful advice & astute investment management. PWM Engineering plays a pivotal role in building the tools and applications our business needs to effectively manage and support our client’s diverse requirements. We support the entire user experience starting with onboarding through to trading, reporting, as well as providing clients access to their portfolios online via native iOS and Android apps. We also build and support numerous applications for our Business and Operations users to help them effectively manage risk and provide the best white-glove service possible to our clients.

The Data Distribution team supports PWM's Quantum data distribution platform which is considered the primary source of data relating to Client Holdings, Transactions, Taxlots and reference data like Accounts, Products and Prices in PWM. Several teams/projects requires this data and our team has built several distribution channels for different usage patterns.

We are currently enhancing our platform based on new business requirements as well as increasing stability and scalability needs to support a growing business. The platform will be required to manage very high volumes of requests with varying time sensitivities and prioritizing across multiple tenants via an event based framework.

**Your Impact**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Cloud Database Specialist** to join our core data platform team. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical expertise in managing and optimizing modern cloud data stacks, specifically focusing on **Snowflake**, **Databricks**, and/or **SingleStore Helios**. You will be responsible for architecting scalable data environments, implementing robust performance tuning strategies, and ensuring the seamless integration of high-performance analytical and operational workloads.

This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of Data Engineering and Cloud Infrastructure, driving the evolution of our global data platform. You will serve as a technical authority, mentoring junior engineers and influencing the strategic direction of our multi-cloud data architecture to support mission-critical business intelligence and AI/ML initiatives.

**HOW YOU WILL FULFILL YOUR POTENTIAL**

* You will develop financial products with direct impact on millions of consumers
* Systems under your watch will be the primary sources of revenue for the organization
* You build it: engineers are in control of decisions about systems they own from the first line of code written
* You run it: engineers with assistance from global SRE guild are responsible for operation of systems they built
* You own it: engineers do not wait for orders here. They do research, pitch projects. Great ideas are valued and implemented
* Professional network: you will meet and collaborate with very influential people within the global organization and the entire industry

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Back-End Development:*

* Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Java , Spring Boot etc.
* Implement business logic, database interactions, and integrations with third-party services.
* Optimize application performance and ensure scalability.

*Front-End Development:*

* Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using modern front-end frameworks (e.g., Angular, React, or Vue.js).
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement designs and ensure a seamless user experience.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

*Database Management:*

* Design and manage relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB).
* Write efficient queries and optimize database performance.

*DevOps and Deployment:*

* Collaborate with DevOps to deploy applications in cloud environments

*Testing and Debugging:*

* Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code quality.
* Debug and resolve application issues in a timely manner.

**SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

* Between 1-3 years experience
* B.S. or higher in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent work experience)
* Expertise in Java, React JS, HTML5
* Familiar with one or more of the following:

  + Distributed systems
  + NoSQL and relational databases
  + Distributed messaging
  + Transactional services
* Experience integrating with Restful web services
* Ability to establish trusted partnerships with product heads, and executive level stakeholders
* Comfortable with Agile Operating Models

*Preferred Qualifications:*

* Experience with microservice based architecture
* Experience with Kafka, MongoDB, Spring, vert.X

**Goldman Sachs Engineering Culture**

At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.

Engineering is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here!

© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2026 All rights reserved.
  
Goldman Sachs is an equal employment/affirmative action employer Female/Minority/Disability/Veteran/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity.

We Offer Best-In-Class Benefits

Healthcare & Medical Insurance

We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short-term disability, long-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance.

Holiday & Vacation Policies

We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year.

Financial Wellness & Retirement

We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities.

Health Services

We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state-of-the-art on-site health centers in certain offices.

Fitness

To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre-approved amount).

Child Care & Family Care

We offer on-site child care centers that provide full-time and emergency back-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents

**About the Role**

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to work closely with the Managing Director as a finance manager across all Pratibha Group companies, associated entities and investments.

The role will focus on financial and operational performance reviews, management reporting, tracking key decisions and ensuring timely closure of corrective actions. It will also involve strengthening financial governance, improving finance processes through automation and AI-enabled solutions, and supporting strategic finance and business initiatives.

**Responsibilities:**

**1. Financial & Business Performance Reviews**

* Collect and consolidate monthly financial and operational MIS from all Group companies.
* Prepare MD review presentations covering actual vs budget, previous month, previous year and forecasts.
* Analyse financial and operational variances, identify root causes and highlight key business risks.
* Coordinate with Finance and Operations teams to define corrective actions.
* Maintain an action tracker and ensure timely follow-up and closure of management decisions.
* Prepare monthly performance summaries highlighting key issues, financial impact and decisions required.

**2. Group Financial Monitoring:**

* Monitor monthly P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow and Working Capital across Group companies.
* Maintain dashboards covering sales, EBITDA, margins, costs, debt, cash flow, receivables, inventory and CAPEX.
* Link operational performance indicators with financial results.
* Identify liquidity, profitability and working capital risks and track improvement plans.
* Coordinate financial data reconciliation across Indian and overseas entities.

**3. Finance Governance & Compliance:**

* Maintain a consolidated statutory and financial compliance calendar.
* Develop and implement SOPs for Finance, Accounts, Treasury, MIS, reconciliations and approvals.
* Monitor internal controls, audit observations and pending compliance matters.
* Coordinate with CFOs, Company Secretaries, auditors, tax teams and legal advisors.
* Ensure proper implementation and periodic review of finance processes and controls.

**4. Automation & AI-Enabled Finance Operations:**

* Drive automation of MIS, reporting, reconciliations and compliance tracking in coordination with IT and ERP teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency and turnaround time.
* Implement automated reminders, digital records and exception dashboards.
* Explore AI-based solutions for financial analysis, reporting and documentation.
* Ensure proper data validation, approval controls and audit trails.

**5. Treasury, Banking & Strategic Finance:**

* Coordinate cash flow forecasting, working capital reviews and borrowing requirements.
* Monitor liquidity, debt servicing, interest costs and funding requirements.
* Prepare financial projections, business plans and investment assessment documents.
* Coordinate lender reporting and financial documentation for strategic initiatives.
* Organise financial records, due diligence documents, disclosures and information memorandums.
* Coordinate with banks, auditors, advisors and other authorised external stakeholders.

**6. Business Understanding & Leadership Development:**

* Develop a thorough understanding of Group businesses through regular visits to manufacturing units and other locations.
* Work closely with Finance Heads and functional leaders across Group companies.
* Gradually take ownership of budgeting, internal controls, treasury monitoring and audit coordination.
* Develop the capability to independently lead Finance, Accounts and MIS for a designated Group company within 2–3 years.

**Preferred Skills & Competencies:**

* Strong knowledge of financial analysis, financial statements and management reporting.
* Expertise in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and working capital management.

* Experience in MIS dashboards, financial consolidation and internal controls.

Director, East Arabia Division Lead – Security Solutions

Role

**Role Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Head of IT to lead our global IT function within MultiBank Group. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role with accountability for infrastructure, cloud, networks, corporate systems, AI applications, IT service management, business continuity and IT audits across all our offices worldwide.

You will lead the Support, Network and Systems Engineering teams and the Jira team, drive IT projects from start to finish, and build the IT foundation for every new office we open. The ideal candidate is technically strong, structured, security-minded and comfortable leading people in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

**Required Knowledge & Experience**

* At least 10 years of experience in IT, including 5 years in a senior leadership role managing multiple technical teams.
* Proven experience running IT across multiple countries or offices, ideally in financial services, fintech or another regulated industry.

* Strong hands-on experience with:

* Cloudflare, DNS and domain management

* Telephony platforms

* Experience designing and testing Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plans.
* Experience leading internal and external IT audits, for example ISO 27001, SOC 2 or regulator-driven reviews.

**Desirable Knowledge & Experience**

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with an industry-leading global financial institution.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Collaborative, inclusive, and dynamic work environment.
* Commitment to innovation and professional excellence.

*Become part of our international community at MultiBank Group, dedicated to excellence, innovation, and shaping the future of finance.*

jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.description:
**Date Posted:** 27 November, 2026

**Industry:** IT Services and IT Consulting

**Location:** VAPORVM IT SERVICES DMCC

  

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Department:** Cybersecurity / Information Security

**Position:** Security Operations Centre (SOC) Analyst

**Experience:** 3 + years of experience

**Reporting To:** SOC Manager / Head of Cybersecurity

**Location:** UAE

  

**1. Job Summary**
------------------

The Senior SOC Analyst is responsible for managing and strengthening the organisation’s security monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response capabilities. The role involves monitoring enterprise IT infrastructure, networks, endpoints, cloud environments, and applications to identify, analyse, and mitigate cybersecurity threats.

The position requires strong hands-on experience with SIEM, SOAR, EDR, threat intelligence, incident response, and vulnerability management. The successful candidate will also contribute to SOC process improvement, detection engineering, threat hunting, security reporting, and mentoring junior SOC analysts.

The role ensures that security operations are aligned with organisational security policies, industry best practices, and applicable regulatory requirements.

  

**2. Key Roles and Responsibilities**
-------------------------------------

  

### **A. SOC Monitoring and Threat Detection**

* Monitor and analyse security events and alerts across enterprise networks, servers, endpoints, applications, and cloud environments.
* Operate and administer SIEM, SOAR, and EDR platforms to ensure effective security monitoring and threat detection.
* Analyse security logs, network traffic, endpoint activities, and authentication events to identify suspicious behaviour and potential security incidents.
* Develop, implement, and continuously optimise SIEM correlation rules, detection use cases, and alerting mechanisms.
* Perform proactive threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, and threat intelligence indicators.
* Identify indicators of compromise (IOCs), anomalous activities, and advanced persistent threats (APTs).
* Improve detection coverage and reduce false-positive alerts through continuous tuning and optimisation.
  

### **B. Security Incident Response and Investigation**

* Lead and coordinate security incident investigation, triage, containment, eradication, and recovery activities.
* Investigate malware infections, ransomware, phishing, suspicious network activities, privilege escalation, unauthorised access, and potential data breaches.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and identify the attack vectors, affected systems, and business impact.
* Coordinate incident response with infrastructure, network, application, cloud, and IT teams.
* Conduct digital forensic investigations, preserve security evidence, and maintain incident documentation.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks, escalation procedures, and response workflows.
* Ensure timely incident resolution in accordance with defined MTTD and MTTR targets.
  

### **C. SOC Operations and Team Coordination**

* Oversee daily SOC monitoring activities and ensure effective security event management and incident escalation.
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and operational support to L1 and L2 SOC analysts.
* Coordinate incident prioritisation, investigation assignments, shift handovers, and escalation processes.
* Monitor SOC operational performance through defined KPIs, SLAs, and management reports.
* Identify opportunities to improve SOC efficiency through automation, orchestration, and process optimisation.
* Conduct periodic reviews of SOC procedures, detection capabilities, and operational effectiveness.
  

### **D. Vulnerability Management and Security Assessment**

* Coordinate vulnerability assessment and remediation activities across servers, endpoints, network devices, and applications.
* Identify, assess, prioritise, and track vulnerabilities based on severity, exploitability, and business risk.
* Work with infrastructure and application teams to ensure vulnerabilities are remediated within agreed SLAs.
* Monitor remediation progress and validate closure of identified vulnerabilities.
* Support vulnerability management using tools such as Rapid7 InsightVM and other enterprise vulnerability assessment platforms.
* Identify recurring security weaknesses and recommend preventive security controls.
  

### **E. Threat Intelligence and Proactive Security**

* Monitor emerging cyber threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and threat intelligence feeds.
* Analyse IOCs and correlate threat intelligence with internal security telemetry.
* Map detected threats and attack patterns against MITRE ATT&CK techniques.
* Conduct proactive threat hunting to identify potential compromises that may not trigger conventional security alerts.
* Develop and enhance detection use cases based on emerging threat intelligence.
* Prepare threat analysis reports and recommend preventive and corrective security measures.
  

### **F. Security Technology and Infrastructure Monitoring**

* Monitor and investigate security events generated by NGFW, IPS/IDS, VPN, NAC, email security, endpoint protection, and identity security solutions.
* Analyse network security events involving technologies such as Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, and Cisco.
* Monitor identity-related threats, including suspicious logins, compromised accounts, privilege misuse, and unauthorised access.
* Support security monitoring across Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Coordinate with infrastructure teams to strengthen security configurations and improve endpoint and network protection.
  

### **G. Compliance, Reporting and Governance**

* Ensure SOC operations comply with organisational security policies, procedures, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Support security compliance with ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and CIS Controls v8.
* Support UAE NESA/IAS and Saudi NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls (ECC) requirements, where applicable.
* Maintain SOC operational documentation, incident reports, investigation records, and audit evidence.
* Prepare periodic SOC performance reports, incident trend analysis, vulnerability reports, and management dashboards.
* Participate in internal and external audits and support the closure of identified security findings.
  

**3. Required Technical Skills**
--------------------------------

* **SIEM:** IBM QRadar, LogRhythm, Splunk or equivalent enterprise SIEM platforms.
* **SOAR:** Security automation, orchestration, incident workflows, and response playbooks.
* **EDR/XDR:** Endpoint monitoring, threat investigation, detection, and response.
* **Network Security:** Palo Alto, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, IDS/IPS, VPN and network segmentation.
* **Threat Detection:** MITRE ATT&CK, Cyber Kill Chain, IOC analysis, threat hunting, and detection engineering.
* **Incident Response:** Incident triage, malware analysis, forensic investigation, containment, and recovery.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Rapid7 InsightVM, Nessus, Qualys, or equivalent tools.
* **Cloud Security:** Microsoft Azure, AWS, Oracle Cloud, and hybrid infrastructure monitoring.
* **Identity Security:** Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, SSO, and privileged access monitoring.
* **Security Frameworks:** ISO 27001, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53, and CIS Controls.
  

**4. Education and Professional Certifications**
------------------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.

**Preferred Certifications:**

* CISSP – Certified Information Systems Security Professional.
* CISM – Certified Information Security Manager.
* CEH – Certified Ethical Hacker.
* CHFI – Computer Hacking Forensic Investigator.
* GIAC GCIH / GCIA / GCFA.
* CompTIA Security+ or equivalent

jobs.title: Product Head,Voice AI
jobs.description:
**About Exotel**

Exotel is a Customer Engagement Platform for businesses, built for interactions handled by both people and AI agents.

We provide the stack behind those interactions - voice, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS and the telephony infrastructure underneath it. Our customers use Exotel to sell, support, collect payments, resolve issues and serve millions of their own customers.

Voice AI is a major part of where this is going.

Our Voice AI agents answer and place phone calls, reason with an LLM, integrate with customer systems and complete tasks. Customers are already running them in production and paying us by the minute.

The market is moving fast. Models are getting better and cheaper, latency is falling and new competitors appear constantly. We need someone who can build the business at that pace.

**Build and run Voice AI as a business**

Exotel is building the infrastructure behind customer conversations across voice, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS and AI agents.

Voice AI is becoming a major part of this business. Our AI agents answer and place calls, reason using LLMs, connect with customer systems and complete real-world tasks. Customers are already running these agents in production and paying us based on usage.

The market is moving extremely quickly. Models are getting better and cheaper, latency is falling, and competition is increasing.

We are looking for someone who can turn this technology into a large, profitable business.

This is not a traditional Product leadership role.

You will own where we play, what we build, who we sell to, how we price, how we scale, and ultimately whether the business wins.

**What You Will Own**

**1. Strategy – Decide Where We Win**

Build a clear view of:

* Which customer segments and use cases are worth pursuing.
* Where Voice AI can create meaningful business value.
* Where we have a genuine competitive advantage.
* Where we are behind the market.
* What we should build, buy, partner for or ignore.
* Which opportunities are attractive enough to invest in.

You will continuously test this thesis through customers, deals, product usage and losses.

The roadmap should be a consequence of this strategy — not the starting point.

**2. Product – Build What Customers Will Pay For**

Set the product direction for Voice AI.

Decide:

* Which workflows agents should handle end-to-end.
* Which capabilities should become core product features.
* What should remain customer-specific.
* How agents integrate with customer systems.
* When to use the best model versus the most economical model.
* What should be built internally versus sourced externally.

You own the customer experience.

If an agent is slow, unreliable, interrupts unnecessarily, makes mistakes or fails to complete a task — you own the problem.

**3. Business – Own the Number**

You will own the business outcome.

You will:

* Build the business plan with GTM and Finance.
* Determine where revenue should come from by segment, use case and account.
* Work directly with Sales on strategic opportunities.
* Set pricing and commercial guardrails.
* Decide which deals are worth pursuing.
* Understand why the business is ahead or behind plan.
* Balance growth with profitability.

You should be equally comfortable discussing product metrics and revenue numbers.

**4. Economics – Know What Every Interaction Costs**

Voice AI economics are fundamentally different from traditional SaaS.

Model choice, inference, routing, caching, infrastructure, latency and architecture directly impact margins.

You will:

* Build and own the unit-economic model.
* Define cost-per-minute targets.
* Understand contribution margin by use case/customer.
* Drive down inference and infrastructure costs.
* Make quality vs latency vs cost trade-offs.
* Decide when higher model cost is justified by higher customer value.

The cost of a minute is a product and business decision.

**5. Customers & GTM – Stay Close to the Market**

You will spend significant time with customers and prospects.

You should be comfortable:

* Joining strategic customer calls.
* Running important product demonstrations.
* Understanding customer workflows.
* Listening to successful and failed conversations.
* Working with Sales on important opportunities.
* Understanding why we win and lose.
* Turning market feedback into product, pricing and positioning decisions.

The expectation is not to sit behind the product team and wait for customer feedback.

You are expected to be in the market.

**6. Build a High-Agency Pod**

You will lead a self-contained Voice AI pod comprising:

* Product
* Engineering
* Delivery
* Forward-Deployed Engineering

The pod owns the journey from:

Customer problem → Solution → Production Voice Agent → Measurable outcome

Your job is to give the team direction, raise the quality of decision-making and remove dependencies that slow execution.

You should be comfortable operating with high autonomy and limited structure.

**7. Turn Customer Work Into Product**

Early customers will require significant hands-on implementation.

Your job is to continuously reduce this dependency.

You will decide:

* What FDEs should build for a customer.
* What should become a reusable product capability.
* What should never be built again.
* Which patterns across customers deserve product investment.

A key measure of success is:

Less custom work → Faster deployment → Better margins → More scalable growth.

**What We're Looking For**

We care more about what you have actually owned than your previous title.

**You have ideally:**

* Built and launched an AI product used by paying customers in production.
* Taken a product from 0→1 or early scale and materially influenced its direction.
* Owned revenue, gross margin, P&L or meaningful business metrics.
* Personally made pricing or commercial decisions.
* Built or deeply understood product unit economics.
* Worked directly with Sales and customers on important deals.
* Led cross-functional Product and Engineering teams.
* Operated with significant autonomy and incomplete information.
* Made difficult product/business trade-offs.
* Changed or killed initiatives when evidence showed they were not working.

**Particularly relevant experience**

* Voice AI / Conversational AI
* LLM applications
* Real-time AI systems
* Speech-to-Text / Text-to-Speech
* LLM inference economics
* Model routing/caching/optimisation
* CPaaS / Contact Centre / Telephony
* Enterprise SaaS
* AI products with usage-based pricing
* Working with Forward-Deployed Engineering / Delivery teams

**This Role May Be a Strong Fit If You Are**

* A Product leader who has genuinely owned a business, not just a roadmap.
* A GM / Business leader with deep product and technology understanding.
* A Founder / early-stage leader who has built an AI product and taken it to customers.
* An AI product leader who has worked closely with GTM, customers, pricing and unit economics.

**This is probably not the right role if:**

* Your experience is primarily roadmap execution.
* You have worked on AI technology but haven't shipped products to paying customers.
* You have limited exposure to revenue, pricing or business economics.
* You prefer large, well-defined organisations and established processes.
* You are primarily an engineering leader without product/customer/business ownership.

**What Success Looks Like After a Year**

Voice AI is a better business because you ran it.

* We know where to compete and where not to.
* The product strategy is clear, and the roadmap follows from it.
* Customers reach production faster.
* Agents complete more of the jobs they are given.
* Conversation quality, latency and reliability improve materially.
* Cost per minute falls, and gross margins improve.
* Custom work decreases as FDE learnings become product capabilities.
* The pod operates with high autonomy.
* Revenue grows, and customers continue to expand their usage.

The numbers should confirm the story:

Revenue growth

Are you a product engineering leader who excels at driving massive platform consolidations, leading high-performing global teams, and solving complex distributed systems challenges? Do you believe in solving complex problem through technology simplification and modernisation?
  
  
At Citi, we are executing a bold, multi-year technology modernisation strategy. A critical pillar of this transformation is the unification of our global compliance enterprise workflow and case management systems. As the
**Head of Product and Engineering**
, you will be the strategic engineering leader and product visionary responsible for driving the consolidation, modernisation, and scaling of our global compliance case management platforms.

**Lead Global Case Management & Workflow Platforms:**
Direct a globally distributed engineering organisation tasked with building and scaling our unified, high-throughput enterprise workflow and decisioning platforms.
  
  
**Serve as the India Site Lead:**
Act as the senior technology executive for our regional engineering hub in India, driving talent strategy, engineering culture, and operational excellence across the site.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, executive-level role reporting directly to the Managing Director, Global Head of Product and Engineering.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Technical Strategy ,Platform Unification and Product Management
* Drive Platform Consolidation: Define and execute the technical strategy to consolidate disparate legacy workflow and case management systems into a single, modern, global platform.
* Architectural Modernization: Lead the transition of core platforms to a cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architecture capable of processing millions of complex events daily with sub-second latency.

* Culture & Collaboration: Build a vibrant, inclusive, and high-performance engineering culture that mirrors the best practices of top-tier product technology companies.
* Local Governance: Ensure compliance with local regulations, operational standards, and corporate policies.

**Our Target Tech Stack & Architecture**
We are actively migrating our platforms to a modern, cloud-native stack:
  
  

* Backend & Microservices: Go, Java (Spring Boot), Python, gRPC, REST APIs

**What We’re Looking For (Qualifications)**

* Experience: 15+ years of professional software engineering experience, with 5+ years in an engineering leadership role (Director, Senior Engineering Manager, or equivalent) at Product-Engineering first setup
* Platform Unification: Proven track record of successfully leading large-scale platform consolidations, legacy migrations, or enterprise-wide system unifications.

We value core engineering leadership and platform-building capabilities above specific domain experience.

**Why Join Citi?**
