Engineering Managers are leading these teams, and they are key to our success. We are growing and evolving Investment Book of Record (IBOR), a key element in the long standing success of SimCorp and in particular we are expanding the Transactions area to meet increasing client demand and deliver more outcomes.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**
▪ First and foremost, you are going to hire and onboard software engineers in Hyderabad, build and nurture engineering teams, thereby be the driver in our quest to scale up our engineering capacity.
  
  
▪ You are the leader of 1-2 teams of Software Engineers with responsibility for growing and upskilling your team through 1:1s, feedback, mentoring, coaching, and goal setting
  
  
▪ You have responsibility for both the short-term deliverables in the sprints and the long-term improvements of your team(s)
  
  
▪ You are responsible for fostering a healthy working environment for your teams
  
  
▪ You work closely with your peers in both Engineering Management and Product Management to understand and refine the customer outcomes that you and your teams are responsible for delivering
  
  
▪ You collaborate with other leaders to deliver cross area initiatives, and to ensure knowledge sharing and consistency where needed
  
  
▪ You understand and define relevant engineering metrics to gain insight into your team’s performance and to help drive improvement
  
  
▪ You are responsible for the planning and the delivery of the outcomes of your teams
  
  
**What We Value**

* Experience with engineer recruitment and building engineering teams
* Overall 10+ years of experience, including:

+ 5+ years of software engineering experience. Especially into .Net Technologies
+ 0-5 years of (people, process, technical) leadership experience.

* Knowledge and experience with AI, with the purpose of improving efficiency
* Experience from a workplace that produces financial software, uses investment management software, has a global workforce, and distributed teams
* Personal accountability and initiative. When something is unclear, you dig in rather than waiting for someone to hand you an answer. You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and you follow through.
* Stakeholder management and collaboration across borders.

**Benefits**
Attractive salary, bonus scheme, and pension are essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.
  
  
Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.
  
  
**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on a positive growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are focused on continually improving our talent acquisition process and making everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**Who We Are**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.title: Quantum Product & Engineering Manager - Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
Head of Product
jobs.description:
#### **Job Description**

**Location:** Bengaluru, with regular travel to our Raipur head office. **Reports to:** CEO. **Type:** Full-time.

### **About Elxer**

Elxer has connected Chhattisgarh since 2014. We run fibre broadband for homes and businesses, enterprise connectivity (leased lines, managed Wi-Fi and security), a data centre, and Elxer Solar for rooftop solar installations. We build much of our own technology in-house, including our customer app, field and sales app, HR system and a new operations platform, and we use AI across the business. We are now creating a product function, and we are looking for the leader to own it.

### **The role**

You will own what Elxer builds and sells, and why: the software our teams and customers use every day, and the services we add on top of a connection, a rack or a solar installation. You will turn business problems into clear, prioritised products, take them to real users and prove they work with measured results. You will not be judged on documents or features shipped alone.

You will work directly with the CEO. You will partner with the Software team, which owns architecture and delivery, and with Sales, Operations, Network, Support, Marketing, Finance and HR as business owners. An AI product assistant will support analysis, requirements drafting and reporting.

### **Key responsibilities**

**Portfolio and roadmap**

* Own one product portfolio across the new operations platform, the in-house systems that run the business today (customer and field apps, HRMS, billing and ticketing integrations) and our experimental tools.
* Build and run the idea register, scoring and quarterly roadmap. Decide with the CEO what to build, improve, retire or stop.
* Set clear rules for when an experimental tool becomes a supported product or is retired.

**Discovery and requirements**

* Spend regular time with field engineers, NOC, support agents, sales teams and customers to find the problems worth solving.
* Write problem statements, user journeys, acceptance criteria and non-goals that the Software team can estimate and build against.
* Make sure each business owner confirms the need before work starts and accepts the result before it counts as done.

**Commercial products and services**

* Shape the add-on and complementary products for home, enterprise, wholesale and solar customers, such as managed Wi-Fi, managed security, CCTV with cloud storage and solar maintenance.
* For each one, define the offer, SLA, pricing inputs, billing, fulfilment, support model and compliance checks, then hand over a launch-ready package to Sales and Marketing.
* Work with Finance on margin and with legal advisers on licence scope before anything is sold.

**Delivery and quality**

* Track each product slice from idea to production, and raise blockers early.
* Keep product data honest: correct metric definitions, complete records and dashboards management can trust.
* Plan releases with the Software lead, so changes reach users safely and with training.

**Measurement**

* Define and report product measures: active users by function, adoption, idea-to-production lead time, add-on attach rates and ARPU, churn and support tickets per customer.
* Present a monthly product review to the CEO.

**Team**

* Build the product function over time, starting with yourself and the AI assistant, and later product analysts or owners.

**Compliance**

* Make sure products follow India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, TRAI and DoT licence conditions, CERT-In directions and labour-law requirements where they apply.

### **What success looks like in the first year**

* One product register and roadmap in use across all software and services, reviewed every quarter.
* At least one platform slice used daily by real business users, with acceptance recorded by its business owner.
* Trusted definitions and dashboards for tickets, attendance and leads.
* At least two complementary products launched with measured attach rate and margin.
* A shorter, measured idea-to-production lead time.

### **Must have**

* 8+ years in product management, with 3+ years owning a roadmap and outcomes for an internal platform, a B2B product or a service business: ISP or telecom, SaaS, logistics, fintech, energy or a similar operations-heavy category.
* Has shipped products used by field or operations teams, not only web or consumer apps.
* Strong in discovery and requirements: can turn a messy workflow into clear acceptance criteria.
* Analytical: comfortable with SQL or BI tools, funnels, unit economics and product metrics.
* Works well with engineers. Understands APIs, data models, mobile apps and release processes well enough to make sound trade-offs.
* Excellent Hindi and English; clear writing.

### **Good to have**

* Experience with broadband or telecom systems: billing, Radius/AAA, ticketing, GIS or network inventory.
* Experience pricing and launching a service product, including SLAs and margins.
* Familiarity with HR, field-workforce or CRM systems.
* Uses AI tools in everyday product work.
* Engineering degree; MBA a plus, not a requirement.

### **What we offer**

* A leadership role reporting directly to the CEO, with the mandate to build the product function from scratch.
* Real influence over what a growing regional technology group builds and sells.
* In-house engineering, our own data and AI tools to work with.
* Competitive compensation based on experience.

### **How to apply**

Apply on this page, or email your CV and a short note on a product you led, the problem it solved and the measured result, to **hr@elxer.com** with the subject "Head of Product".

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (India)
jobs.description:
**Head of Engineering, India**  
  
Location: Bangalore, India (on-site or hybrid)  
  
Reports to: Chief Technology Officer  
  
Level: Vice President  
  
Team size: 50–100 engineers  
  
About Machinify  
  
Machinify is a healthcare payment integrity company formed through the 2024–2025 merger of five industry-leading businesses: Apixio Payment Integrity (CPS/ClaimLogiq), Varis, Rawlings Company (Right Payer Solutions), legacy Machinify, and Performant Health. Machinify's customers are health insurance companies and healthcare payers, and its products combine SaaS platforms with professional services to detect and prevent improper healthcare payments. The company is in the midst of consolidating four distinct technology organizations onto a unified platform and operating model.  
  
Role Summary  
  
Machinify is hiring a VP, Head of Engineering to lead the company's India-based engineering organization. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for building and scaling a unified engineering team of 50–100 engineers in India, delivering against the global product roadmap, and serving as the senior technical and people leader for the India site. The role reports directly to the CTO and is a key partner in consolidating engineering practices across Machinify's four legacy entities onto a single technology and delivery model.  
  
Key Responsibilities

* Own end-to-end delivery for the India engineering organization, partnering with global product, design, and engineering leadership to ship on the committed roadmap.
* Build, scale, and lead a high-performing engineering team in India, including hiring, org design, career development, and performance management.
* Drive the technical and cultural integration of engineering teams and practices inherited from Machinify's legacy entities (Apixio/CPS, Varis, Rawlings, legacy Machinify, Performant) into a single, unified engineering organization.
* Establish and maintain engineering standards for code quality, architecture, testing, and operational excellence appropriate for a healthcare payer-grade SaaS platform.
* Ensure engineering practices meet HIPAA/HITECH requirements and support the company's HITRUST r2 and SOC 2 compliance obligations; work with security and compliance teams on control implementation and audit readiness.
* Partner with the CTO and global engineering leaders on technical architecture decisions, particularly around integrating mixed cloud and on-premise infrastructure across entities.

machinify.com

* Serve as the senior Machinify leader on the ground in India: represent engineering in cross-functional planning, manage stakeholder relationships, and act as an escalation point for the India team.
* Manage engineering budget, vendor relationships, and resourcing for the India site.
* Champion engineering culture, retention, and talent development in a competitive India tech talent market.

Requirements

* 12+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years leading engineering organizations of 50+ people.
* Proven experience building and scaling engineering teams in India, ideally within a global, multi-site organization.
* Experience operating in a regulated industry (healthcare, fintech, insurance, or similar) with exposure to compliance frameworks such as HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, or equivalent.
* Track record of leading technology integration following M&A, or unifying engineering practices across previously separate teams or codebases.
* Strong technical background across modern SaaS architecture, cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure/GCP), and data-intensive systems; able to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.
* Experience managing distributed/cross-time-zone engineering organizations and collaborating with US-based executive leadership.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and people-leadership skills.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

* Prior experience in healthcare payment integrity, claims processing, or health insurance technology.
* Experience with the specific technology stack used by Machinify's platforms (details shared during interview process).

What Machinify Offers

* The opportunity to lead engineering for a fast-growing, market-leading healthcare payment integrity company at a pivotal moment of technical consolidation.
* Direct partnership with the CTO and executive leadership on company-defining technology decisions.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.

jobs.title: Customer Data engineer
jobs.description:
**About the role**  
  
This role is a strong fit for data engineers with 2 to 4 years of experience who want to take their technical depth into a customer-facing role. If you have spent the last few years building pipelines, working with cloud warehouses, and solving real data problems, but you are starting to wonder what comes next, this is worth a closer look.  
  
In this role, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and ANZ. You will help them design the right data architecture, walk them through trade-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a partnership. You will do this independently, often as the sole technical person on the call. There is no senior SE in the background. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e-commerce company, earn their technical respect in the first five minutes, and hold it for the rest of the engagement.  
  
The technical depth you have built does not go away. It gets applied to a much wider set of problems, a much larger audience, and a global stage.  
  
Hevo runs real-time data pipelines from 150+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.  
  
**Why this role is worth considering**  
  
A. You move from building pipelines to shaping data strategy  
  
In your current role, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them decide what to build across the modern data stack. Your existing experience in CDC, warehouse design, and pipeline reliability becomes the foundation for higher-leverage work.  
  
B. You get global exposure that is hard to find elsewhere  
  
You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where decisions get made. This is rare exposure for someone at the 2 to 4 year mark, and almost unheard of from Bangalore.  
  
C. Your technical depth stays central  
  
This is not a pivot away from engineering. Everything you know about Postgres, CDC, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, and pipeline reliability gets used every day. The difference is that your technical opinion shapes the customer’s architecture instead of staying inside a Jira ticket.  
  
D. The career path is real  
  
Strong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is significant.  
  
**What you will do**  
  
Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversations, primarily with customers in North America and Europe, and you will own them end to end.  
Design and present reference architectures showing how Hevo fits into their existing data stack (e.g., Salesforce, Postgres, GA4, Snowflake, dbt).  
Run live product demos tailored to the customer’s stack. These are not scripted walkthroughs. You will need to read the room, adapt on the fly, and handle unexpected technical questions with confidence.  
Own the technical evaluation from first conversation to closed deal by addressing deep technical questions and earning trust with engineering teams.  
Build proofs-of-concept by configuring real pipelines from source systems (Salesforce, Outreach, Postgres, MySQL) into destinations like Snowflake or BigQuery.  
Develop deep expertise in the data integration landscape, including native solutions from AWS, GCP, and Azure (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) as well as other data pipeline and integration platforms, and articulate Hevo’s technical advantages in a way that lands with both technical and non-technical buyers.  
Partner with Account Executives to drive technical wins, and with Customer Success to ensure smooth handoffs after a deal closes.  
Share customer feedback and patterns with Product and Engineering to influence the roadmap.  
  
**What we are looking for**  
  
**Must-haves**  
  
2 to 4 years of hands-on experience as a data engineer, analytics engineer, ETL/ELT developer, or data warehouse engineer.  
Experience building and operating real data pipelines in production, including handling source schema changes, failures, and reliability issues.  
Strong fundamentals in SQL and at least one cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift).  
Experience with at least one orchestration or transformation tool (Airflow, dbt, or similar).  
Exceptional communication and presentation skills. This is non-negotiable. You will be the face of Hevo’s technical capability to a global customer base. That means:  
Your spoken English is clear, confident, and easy to follow for an international audience. You are comfortable presenting to groups of 5 to 15 people, including senior technical leaders, over video calls. You can structure a technical narrative, not just answer questions but guide a conversation toward the right conclusion. You can hold your own when a customer pushes back or challenges your recommendation. You have presented or demo’d something technical to an audience before, in any context: internal reviews, client calls, meetups, or conferences.  
Genuine interest in customer-facing work, even if you have not done it formally before.  
  
**Good to have**  
  
Experience with CDC tools or data integration platforms, whether cloud-native (AWS Glue, Azure Data Factory, Google Cloud Dataflow) or third-party pipeline and integration tools.  
Exposure to multiple source system types such as CRMs, ad platforms, SaaS APIs, and OLTP databases.  
Public technical writing, conference talks, or open-source contributions.  
Prior experience in customer conversations, even informally. For example, presenting to internal stakeholders, analytics teams, or working with international teams across time zones.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

*As a Senior Associate in the International Consumer Bank at JPMorgan Chase, you will be a part of a flat-structure organization, you will be a part of a flat-structure organization. Your responsibilities are to contribute to the delivery of end-to-end cutting-edge solutions in the form of cloud-native microservices architecture applications leveraging the latest technologies and the best industry practices. We work in tribes and squads that focus on specific products and projects – and depending on your strengths and interests, you'll have the opportunity to move between them.*

Morgan and Chase brands. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our professionals in our Corporate Functions cover a diverse range of areas from finance and risk to human resources and marketing. Our corporate teams are an essential part of our company, ensuring that we're setting our businesses, clients, customers and employees up for success.

jobs.title: Head of Marketing & Content
jobs.description:
ABOUT HYPEFLY

Hypefly India is an authenticated premium marketplace for sneakers, streetwear, wearables, beauty, collectibles and luxury bags.

THE ROLE

You own marketing at Hypefly: organic and paid, every channel, every campaign, every shoot. You work directly with the founder, who is available to you 24/7. You build your own team, and you set the brand's language for everyone else to follow.

Drops happen at all hours. A product lands, the internet notices, and we need a reel out before the competition wakes up. This role is for someone who can conceptualise, script, shoot and ship content on immediate notice, then plan a festive season three months out the same afternoon.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Content and social:

- Instagram and all social channels: organic content, reels, statics, stories, campaigns

- Short-form and long-form content, from ideation to final edit, including YouTube Shorts and long-form YouTube content

- Run and direct shoots; direct, approve and oversee every edit

- Creator and UGC pipeline: brief, source, negotiate, approve

- Monthly content and campaign calendar: festive, drops, sales, always-on

Campaigns and sales:

- Plan and execute every sale, deal and campaign end to end

- Website campaigns, banners, landing pages and site copy

- Email marketing: campaigns, flows, revenue attribution

- Store marketing: help launch the first Hypefly store and everything after

Paid:

- Ads are run by our agency. You lead the calls, set the direction, and own the results

- Conceptualise, script and produce every ad creative, from ideation to execution

- Own the numbers: ROAS, CAC, campaign revenue, email revenue, reach and growth, reported weekly

- Own the content and shoot budget

Brand and team:

- Brand language and brand study: the playbook captions, emails, DMs and site copy are written from

- Public voice: how the brand sounds in comments, reviews and on Reddit, alongside CX

- Manage the Marketing Executive (your junior, hired alongside you) and the video team; hire the next two as the function grows

- Bring new, fresh ideas constantly; this is a hype business

WHAT WE NEED

- 5-8 years in marketing, ideally including 3-4 years in e-commerce or D2C. This range is preferred, not a hard cutoff. Strong candidates with fewer years and standout work should apply

- Brand-side D2C background preferred. Creator-led or agency-side backgrounds also qualify if the work speaks for itself

- Fashion, lifestyle, sneakers, streetwear or beauty category experience. FMCG or fintech marketers will not be a fit

- Proven work. You'll be asked to show: campaigns that went viral; a sale or campaign that moved revenue, with the before and after; shoots and video edits you directed end to end, not just briefed; creative you built with a performance agency that lowered CAC; email marketing with revenue attribution; something you launched, whether a product, a store or a category

- Deep interest in sneakers, streetwear, beauty and wearables: sizing, drops, hype cycles, product names. Content that gets a product wrong gets torn apart in the comments

- Quick on your feet. Comfortable with zero planning time and same-day turnarounds

- Uses AI daily: ideation, scripts, captions, ad variations, research

- Comfortable on camera or directing the founder on camera; a lot of what works for Hypefly is founder-led

- Graduate

COMPENSATION

CTC ₹12,00,000 to ₹20,00,000 per annum, depending on experience. Employee of the Month recognition of ₹10,000, at the CEO's discretion.

DETAILS

- Reports to: Founder & CEO

- Hours: Mon-Sat, 10:30 AM to 7:30 PM. Sunday off

- Probation: 1 month. Notice period: 2 months post confirmation

- Work from office, Andheri West (Versova), Mumbai. No work from home

Immediate joiners preferred; candidates serving notice are welcome too. Apply with CV, portfolio or links to work, and current/expected salary

Pay: ₹1,200,000.00 - ₹2,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Coupa makes margins multiply through its community-generated AI and industry-leading total spend management platform for businesses large and small. Coupa AI is informed by trillions of dollars of direct and indirect spend data across a global network of 10M+ buyers and suppliers. We empower you with the ability to predict, prescribe, and automate smarter, more profitable business decisions to improve operating margins.

**Why join Coupa?**

* **Pioneering Technology:** At Coupa, we're at the forefront of innovation, leveraging the latest technology to empower our customers with greater efficiency and visibility in their spend.
* **Collaborative Culture:** We value collaboration and teamwork, and our culture is driven by transparency, openness, and a shared commitment to excellence.
* **Global Impact:** Join a company where your work has a global, measurable impact on our clients, the business, and each other.

Learn more on Life at Coupa blog and hear from our employees about their experiences working at Coupa.

**The Impact of Sr Product Manager to Coupa**

Coupa Expenses is a modern expense management solution that helps companies simplify employee spend, from submitting and approving expenses to reimbursing employees and gaining real-time visibility into travel and expense (T&E) activity. By having a fully integrated Mobile and Card solutions, Coupa continually delivers customer value while meeting the evolving needs of our customers.

As the primary product manager on the Coupa Expenses team, you will drive product initiatives that deliver innovation, strengthen adoption, and unblock customers. This role calls for someone who thrives in ambiguity, builds trust across teams, and uses data to inform decisions. You bring a strong bias for action, deep curiosity about how our products work end-to-end, and a genuine desire to make both customers and colleagues successful.

### **What You’ll Do**

* Lead the Expenses teams product design and requirements across complex, cross-functional initiatives, partnering closely with Engineering, UX, Platform, and Success teams to align on scope, dependencies, and delivery approach.

* Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give internal teams (Product, Growth, Leadership) clear visibility into product adoption, usage, and customer health.

* Act as a go-to subject matter expert for customer escalations, partnering with Support, Services, and Engineering to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

* Translate customer feedback and usage data into clear product requirements and prioritization recommendations.

* Conduct competitive market analysis and continually assess the product's competitive position domestically and internationally.

* Support and help scale internal and external enablement (webinars, documentation, training) so Support, Services, and Customer Success teams can operate more self-sufficiently.

* Represent the product in customer-facing settings, including advisory boards, escalation calls, and adoption reviews.

### **What You Will Bring to Coupa**

* 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, or payments with a proven track record of **building buyer-facing products and consumer-grade UX**

* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives from ambiguous requirements through to delivery, coordinating effectively across Engineering, UX, and business stakeholders.

* Strong analytical skills, with hands-on experience building or using dashboards/reporting tools (e.g., Metabase, Looker, Tableau) to drive product and business decisions.

* A track record of resolving complex customer issues and turning escalations into durable product or process improvements.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.

* A collaborative, "roll up your sleeves" mindset paired with sound judgment on when to lead and when to support.

* Comfort operating with incomplete information and adapting quickly as priorities shift.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience in Expense Management, Corporate Cards, or related Finance/Procurement domains.

* Familiarity with SQL and comfort querying data directly to answer product questions.

* Experience working with or presenting to customer advisory boards or executive audiences.

* Knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, or PeopleSoft.

jobs.title: Founding Product Manager Voice AI - Karta AI
jobs.description:
**Founding Product Manager – Voice AI**

**Department:** Product

**Reports to:** Founders

**Location:** HSR Layout, Bengaluru

**Stage:** Seed

**Role Type:** Founding Team / Individual Contributor

**Scope:** Voice AI, Conversational Intelligence, Product Strategy, Agent Performance, Customer Outcomes

  

**About Karta**

Karta is building the AI operating system for customer-facing teams. We build AI agents that handle complex customer conversations across voice, chat and WhatsApp. Our agents don't just respond to questions—they understand context, reason through workflows and take action across business systems. We're building for high-volume, complex industries like fintech, where conversations require contextual understanding, objection handling, multilingual communication and reliable execution. Our ambition is to make AI conversations indistinguishable from great human interactions—not just in how they sound, but in how intelligently they work. We need a product leader who can turn this ambition into reality.

**Why This Role Exists**

Voice AI is moving beyond speech recognition and text-to-speech. The real challenge is building agents that can listen, understand, respond, interrupt, reason and act in real time. A great voice agent must know when to speak, when to listen, how to handle objections, when to retrieve context and how to recover when a conversation goes wrong. Your job is to own this experience end-to-end. You will work directly with customers, engineers and AI researchers to identify the biggest problems, design solutions and ship improvements that materially change agent performance.
  
You won't just build voice features. You'll build agents that perform better in real conversations.

**What You Own**

**1. Voice Experience**

Build natural, low-latency, human-like voice interactions.

Latency and response-time optimisation

Interruption handling and turn-taking

Natural pauses, speech rhythm and conversational flow

Full-duplex voice experiences

Multilingual conversations across Indian languages

Emotion-aware responses and contextual acknowledgement

**2. Conversational Intelligence**

Make agents better at handling complex conversations.

Intent and context understanding

Objection handling and root-problem identification

Memory across turns and sessions

Contextual personalisation

Conversation recovery when agents misunderstand

Natural transitions between listening, reasoning and responding

The goal is to move beyond agents that sound human to agents that think and respond appropriately in human conversations.

**3. Agent Evaluation & Observability**

Build the system that tells us whether our agents are actually good.

Voice-specific evaluation frameworks

Automated conversation simulations

Golden evaluation datasets

Failure categorisation and root-cause analysis

Real-time monitoring and agent observability

Metrics across latency, resolution, CSAT and conversation quality

You will turn production failures into systematic product improvements.

**4. Product Discovery & Customer Outcomes**

Work with customers and business leaders to understand where voice AI creates measurable value.

Identify high-value use cases

Shadow real customer conversations

Analyse human-agent performance

Translate customer pain into product requirements

Prioritise features based on business impact

Define success metrics and validate outcomes

Start with the problem, not the feature request.

**5. Product Execution**

Own the product lifecycle from idea to production.

Product strategy and roadmap

PRDs and feature specifications

UX and conversational flow design

Engineering and research prioritisation

Release quality and adoption

Feedback loops from customers and production data

You will work closely with engineering, AI/ML and GTM teams to ship quickly without compromising reliability.

**What We're Looking For**

**Voice AI experience:** Hands-on experience with conversational AI, speech systems, voice agents or real-time AI products.

**Technical depth:** Understand ASR, TTS, speech pipelines, latency, LLMs, tool calling and agent architectures.

**Product judgment:** Can distinguish a technically interesting feature from one that materially improves customer outcomes.

**Customer obsession:** Will listen to hundreds of conversations to understand what is actually going wrong.

**Execution intensity:** Can move from an ambiguous problem to a shipped solution quickly.

**High agency:** Comfortable operating without a fully defined roadmap, process or team.

**Data-driven:** Comfortable designing evaluations, analysing failures and prioritising based on evidence.

We care more about what you've built and how you think than the title you held previously.

**What This Role Is Not**

This is not a feature factory PM role.

It is not a role where you simply write PRDs and hand them to engineering.

It is not limited to managing a speech API or improving a voice interface.

You will be expected to understand the technology, listen to actual conversations, investigate failures, make trade-offs and drive solutions into production.

**You own whether the product works—not just whether it ships.**

**What Success Looks Like**

**First 30 days — Understand**

Understand the voice stack, listen to production calls, identify major failure modes and establish a baseline for quality and latency.

**First 60 days — Improve**

Ship improvements to conversational quality, interruption handling, latency or objection resolution, with measurable results.

**First 90 days — Systematise**

Establish a repeatable evaluation and improvement loop that makes every release more reliable and effective.

**Core Metrics**

End-to-end conversational latency

Interruption and turn-taking quality

Task completion and resolution rates

Conversation quality and objection handling

Agent failure rates and recovery

CSAT and customer business outcomes

**Why Take It**

**Ownership:** Shape the core product experience at an early-stage AI company.

**Technical depth:** Work at the intersection of voice, LLMs, real-time systems and agent intelligence.

**Customer impact:** See your work change how thousands of customer conversations are handled.

**Founder exposure:** Work directly with founders and influence product direction, architecture trade-offs and company strategy.

**Career trajectory:** Build toward Head of Product or Product Leadership as Karta scales.

**The Person We're Really Looking For**

Someone who listens to a voice agent call and doesn't stop at saying:

"The voice sounds robotic."

They ask:

Why did the agent interrupt the customer?

Why did it miss the underlying objection?

Why did it repeat the same question?

Why did it respond without retrieving the right context?

What should the agent have done differently?

How do we measure that improvement and prevent the failure from recurring?

Then they work with engineering and AI researchers to fix it, test it and ship the solution.

**Obsessive. Technical. Customer-first.**

**That's the Founding Product Manager at Karta.**

jobs.description:
**Job Title**

Martech & CRM Campaign Manager

**Job Description**

**So, who are we?**
===================

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.

The bar is high – bring a curious and forward-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next.

Join us at IG – the future gets built here.

Your core KPI would be to ensure smooth onboarding of new platforms/services & Personalize marketing communications to best in market standards. This role demands a rare combination: deep technical capability across CRM platforms and data infrastructure, plus the commercial instinct and stakeholder management skills to lead a complex migration programme. jobs.title: Director of Product Design (B2C)
jobs.description:
Looking for a **Director of Product Design** to lead the design charter for its B2C business. This is not a role about managing design output. It is about shaping how an entire team thinks, and co-owning product decisions alongside Product and Business leaders.

Insurance in India is a hard design problem. Trust is low, financial literacy varies widely, and the market grew up on agent-led distribution. You will turn those constraints into a clear design vision, from a customer's first encounter with Acko to a multi-year relationship.

What You Will Do

**Vision and strategy**

* Define a well-reasoned design vision for how Acko customers experience insurance across the full lifecycle.
* Build and maintain a strong point of view on the Indian insurance market: trust dynamics, purchase psychology, financial literacy and the legacy of agent-led distribution.
* Turn strategy into a prioritised design agenda the team can execute with clarity.

**Raise the standard of thinking**

* Set the bar for how problems are framed before solutions are proposed, with rigour in hypothesis formation, assumption mapping and contextual research.
* Review design work at a strategic level: are we solving the right problem, for the right user, within the right constraints?
* Build a culture where the first idea is the beginning of the process, not the end.

**Coach and lead**

* Work closely with product designers to sharpen how they think, not to manage what they produce.
* Coach designers on problem framing, questioning briefs and building hypotheses before reaching for solutions.
* Create the conditions for great work: strong briefs, structured critique sessions and a design review culture that asks hard questions.

**Drive business outcomes**

* Own design's contribution to key B2C metrics: conversion, activation, retention and claims satisfaction.
* Partner with Product and Data to build a feedback loop between design decisions and business results.
* Make the case for design investment in the language of business impact.

Who You Are

**You must have:**

* 12+ years in product design, including at least 3 years leading a design *function* (not just a project or a team), and at least 2 years in B2C in a recent role.
* Experience operating and solving for scale in a consumer-facing business. Pure 0-to-1 experience will not be a fit.
* A background in a scaled B2C business, preferably a pure digital product. FinTech, InsurTech and Healthtech are strongly preferred over Mobility or E-commerce.
* Strong first-principles thinking: you start from the user, the market context and the constraints to form a hypothesis, not from a competitor audit.
* Deep consumer psychology and creative problem-solving, with real curiosity about how people relate to complex, low-familiarity products (trust gaps, financial literacy, decision-making).
* The ability to form a clear, defensible strategic point of view and persuade product, business and leadership stakeholders.
* A track record of leading design through how you shape your team's thinking (coaching through problem framing and questions), not through personal output. Strong ICs with demonstrated leadership are also considered.
* Ownership of design's contribution to business outcomes (conversion, activation, retention, claims or equivalent), and experience making the case for design in business terms.
* A current title such as Director of Design or Head of Design, or you are a founder with a strong design background.
* A strong portfolio showing original thinking and a distinctive point of view, not just polished execution. Talks, writing or case studies are a plus.

Pay: ₹5,100,000.00 - ₹8,500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Do you currently hold a title such as Director of Design, Head of Design, VP Design, or are you a founder with a strong design background?
* How many years have you led a design function (owning the design charter, hiring, team direction and standards), not just a project or a single team?
* Have you worked in a B2C / consumer-facing product for at least 2 years in a recent role?
* How many total years of product design experience do you have?

Education:

* Bachelor's (Required)

Experience:

* Product Design to lead the design charter for its B2C: 10 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
### **A****BOUT TIDE**

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

**Tide facts:**

* Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs
* Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing
* Over $300 million raised in funding
* 3,000 Tideans globally
* We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

### **ABOUT THE TEAM:**

Tide is hiring a Director of Engineering to lead the engineering organisation behind Commercial Services. You will report to the CDTO and partner with Product and Design leadership as one leadership team accountable for the outcomes of the domain.

Commercial Services is where Tide extends from helping members run their business to helping them grow it. You will shape how quickly every member becomes discoverable, how much of their buying and selling runs through Tide, and how far AI can turn that into a lasting advantage across every market we serve.

Sell gives every member a live, discoverable presence, from the Tide Business Pages we are launching for 2 million members across the UK and Europe, to Own Website, catalogue, bookings, CRM and lead capture, and embedded fulfilment through Delivery as a Service.

Buy turns that member base into a two-sided marketplace through the Tide Online Network, alongside Tide Promotions (gift cards, cashback and personalised offers), business supplies from partners, and Vendor Hub for e-procurement.

You will be the single owner accountable for engineering delivery, architecture and people across both.

### **ABOUT THE ROLE:**

This role sits at the intersection of SME commerce, marketplaces and banking. Our members sit on both sides of the marketplace, our partners extend what we can offer them, and our banking platform lets us layer payments, credit, insurance and rewards into the experience at the point of need, which few commerce players can do. We need someone who can bring both streams onto one consistent engineering bar, ship quickly and build the platforms that turn Commercial Services into a material recurring revenue line for Tide.

As Director of Engineering you will

* Set the engineering strategy and technical direction across the Sell and Buy value streams, from launch through to scale.
* Lead the Heads of Engineering for Sell and Buy, build the leadership bench underneath them, and own headcount planning, hiring and organisation design.

* Build trust into the marketplace in partnership with Ongoing Monitoring and Risk, from verified seller status to initial and ongoing monitoring of listings and member-to-member communication.
* Set a consistent engineering practice and quality bar across architecture, delivery health measured through DORA metrics, reliability and security.
* Lead our move towards AI-assisted and agentic commerce, where a member describes what they need and Tide finds, compares and sources it.
* Apply our OnePlatform principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated.

### **WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:**

* Director engineering leadership of a multi-team organisation of around 50 engineers across backend, frontend, data and analytics, led through at least one layer of engineering leaders.
* Domain experience in e-commerce, two-sided marketplaces, CRM or procurement platforms, including the trust and safety controls they need, with fintech or SME banking experience a plus.
* Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable product and commercial outcomes.
* Experience building partner and third-party integration platforms at scale.
* Strong product and design partnership instincts.
* Comfortable setting direction through ambiguity and launching new products into multiple markets.
* Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, architecture and technical quality.
* Experience bringing AI or agentic experiences into customer-facing commerce products would be a bonus.

### **OUR TECH STACK:**

* Backend: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, microservices architecture
* Mobile/Web: Flutter / Angular
* Infrastructure: AWS (SNS+SQS), PostgreSQL via RDS or Aurora, GCP (BigQuery, Vertex)
* Observability: Coralogix (OpenTelemetry
* Claude for agentic ways of working

* Competitive Compensation - Competitive salary and share options.
* Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
* Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.

jobs.description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

* **Company:** Niyo (Finnew Solutions Pvt. Ltd.)
* **Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka (On-site / Hybrid)
* **Experience:** 4–7 Years (post-qualification)
* **Qualification:** Chartered Accountant (CA) / MBA (Finance) from a Tier-1 institute
* **Department:** FP&A & Business Finance

### **About Niyo**

Niyo is a leading Indian consumer fintech platform transforming how millions of Indians bank, save, and spend globally. Operating in partnership with regulated banking and financial institutions, Niyo offers zero-forex-markup international travel cards, digital savings and salary accounts, remittances, and wealth solutions. As we scale across product verticals and global corridors, we are looking for a sharp, commercially driven **Business Finance Partner** to act as a strategic co-pilot to our Product, Growth, and Business leaders.

### **Role Overview**

Reporting to the CFO, the Business Finance Partner will own unit economics,revenue modeling, cost optimization, and strategic decision support for key business verticals . Moving beyond traditional reporting, this role sits at the intersection of finance, data analytics, and product strategy—translating user cohorts, transaction volumes, and partner-bank commercials into actionable insights that drive profitable growth.

### **Key Responsibilities**

#### **1. Unit Economics & Product P&L Ownership**

* Own end-to-end **Product P&Ls and contribution margin tracking** across assigned business lines
* Build dynamic **cohort-level LTV/CAC models** in partnership with Growth and Data Science teams to evaluate customer acquisition payback periods and retention economics.
* Identify margin leakage, optimize payment routing/vendor costs, and recommend pricing or fee-structure refinements to improve net take-rates.

#### **2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting (FP&A)**

* Lead the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), quarterly re-forecasting, and rolling monthly financial projections for assigned verticals.
* Track actuals vs. budget rigorously—conducting deep-dive variance analyses on Gross Transaction Value (GTV), active card metrics, forex volumes, and operating expenses.
* Partner with Corporate Finance / Controllership during month-end close to ensure accurate revenue accruals, marketing spend provisions, and cost allocations.

#### **3. Commercial Deal Structuring & Business Cases**

* Build robust financial models and scenario analyses for **new product launches, international corridors, bank/card-network partnerships, and co-marketing campaigns**.
* Evaluate commercial terms with partner banks, payment aggregators, KYC vendors, and card manufacturers, supporting leadership during contract negotiations.
* Establish clear ROI guardrails and post-launch performance reviews for growth experiments, referral programs, and brand campaigns.

#### **4. MIS, Board Reporting & Automation**

* Design real-time executive dashboards (using SQL, Power BI/Tableau, and Excel) giving business heads daily/weekly visibility into key financial and operational KPIs.
* Prepare monthly business review (MBR) decks, board materials, and investor-ready financial narratives highlighting business drivers and strategic risks.

### **Qualifications & Skills**

**Criteria**

**Requirements**

  

**Education**

**Chartered Accountant (CA)** or **MBA in Finance** from a premier institution.

  

**Experience**

**4–7 years** in Business Finance, FP&A, or Strategic Finance—with at least **2+ years in FinTech, Payments, Consumer Internet, or Banking/NBFCs**.

  

**Analytical & Data Skills**

Advanced Excel financial modeling; working proficiency in **SQL** and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker) to query large transaction datasets independently.

  

**Domain Acumen**

Strong grasp of fintech unit economics (interchange, MDR, forex spreads, CAC/LTV, cohort retention, and contribution margins).

  

**Stakeholder Management**

High-ownership, consultative mindset with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively and influence Product and Growth leaders using data.

**About**

Concretio 75-person AI and Salesforce consultancy based in Jaipur. Alongside our Salesforce practice, we build custom AI agents, LLM-powered systems, and intelligent automation for mid-market and enterprise clients across India and the US. This role sits inside our pure AI services practice, which operates independently of the Salesforce stack.

**The Role**

You hunt for companies that are ready to build AI but haven't found the right partner yet. Your prospects are CTOs sitting on a backlog of AI ideas they can't execute internally, COOs running manual processes that should have been automated two years ago, and product leaders who want to ship AI-powered features without hiring a full ML team.

The entry point for almost every deal is a proof of concept: a focused, time-boxed build that proves value before a large commitment. Your job is to find the right company, frame the right problem, and get them into that PoC conversation, and everything follows from there.

**What You Will Do**

* Run discovery calls independently. Surface the manual process or business problem, quantify the cost or volume, and propose a PoC scope. Pass a clean brief to the AI engineering lead, not a vague requirement.
* Work with the AI engineering lead to scope and price PoC proposals ($15K to $75K range). You co-own the proposal. You do not throw requirements over the wall.
* Attend AI-focused events as a prospecting channel: NASSCOM AI summits, PyCon India, industry-specific tech conferences, and relevant LinkedIn Live events.
* Own all inbound from digital platforms (Clutch, GoodFirms etc) for AI-tagged inquiries. Respond within 4 hours and qualify before escalating.
* Track every account and deal in HubSpot. Weekly pipeline report every Friday without prompting.

**You Are a Fit If You Have**

* 3 to 6 years selling custom tech services: software development, data engineering, AI/ML services, or automation consulting. Not SaaS. Not platforms. Services. ●Run discovery with CTO, CDO, VP Operations, or Head of Product, and translate a business problem into a technology solution scope without an engineer in the room.

* Can explain in plain English: what an LLM does, what an AI agent automates, what RAG enables. You don't need to code, but you need to be credible in a room with engineers.
* Generated net-new pipeline through outbound prospecting. Not just followed up on warm inbound.
* Comfortable working in a flexible schedule environment, including late-night or off-hours calls / meetings, in line with the demands of a global client-facing role.
* While the primary focus is AI services, the ideal candidate is adaptable and willing to take on business development responsibilities across other IT services / products lines as opportunities and business demands grow.

**Good to Have**

* Sold AI or automation services to fintech, healthcare, e-commerce, or logistics companies where the ROI case is already established.

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.description:
**Leading product and design across institutional and retail**

**Location:**

London or Dubai

**Reports to:**

Founder & CEO

**About Smart Bricks**

Smart Bricks is the applied AI lab for real assets.

Real estate is the world's largest asset class, and it still runs on Excel and PDFs. We build AI agents that screen, underwrite, diligence and monitor real estate across global markets, built on each client's own models, data and strategy. Work that took a deal team weeks arrives committee-ready, in the firm's own Excel and templates.

Our models predict and a deterministic engine does the maths, so the same inputs give the same numbers every time. Every number traces back to a source: a 94% hit rate within the confidence band, measured against confirmed transactions, across 207 countries and 10,000+ data sources.

We work with investment firms, developers, lenders, advisory firms, brokerages and wealth managers.

a16z speedrun led our $5M pre-seed, alongside Techstars, 500 Global and HBS Angels, with angels from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind. Exciting announcements soon! We're a team of 30+ from Blackstone, McKinsey, BCG, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan, and part of the Palantir Startup Fellowship (Cohort 003).

**Why exceptional product leaders join us**

🚀 $5M pre-seed led by a16z speedrun, with exciting announcements soon!

🤝 Backed by Techstars, 500 Global and HBS Angels, plus angels from OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind

🏆 Selected for the Palantir Startup Fellowship (Cohort 003)

🌍 Clients across the UK, Middle East and US

👥 A team of 30+ from Blackstone, McKinsey, BCG, Goldman Sachs and J.P. Morgan

🔒 ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified

🎯 Own the whole product, from institutions to retail

**Why this role?**

You'll own the entire product function at Smart Bricks: what we build, and what we don't.

Our product serves the whole of real estate, institutional and retail: investment firms and lenders, developers, brokers and advisors, governments, and private investors. Each wants something different. Your job is to turn all of it into one coherent product that every one of them uses, not a pile of bespoke builds.

You'll lead Product and Design, work directly with our CEO and CTO, and be on the ground in our client deployments. You'll also keep us at the frontier: what's changing in AI and in real estate, and what that means for our product before anyone else acts on it.

The questions you'll answer don't have settled answers yet: how should a fund partner, a broker or a government planner work with dozens of agents, and how do they come to trust what comes back?

**What you'll build**

**The whole product.**

Own the roadmap across institutional and retail: what we build now, what waits and what we say no to. One platform for investment firms, lenders, developers, brokers, advisors, governments and private investors, with the right amount tailored for each. Think years ahead while shipping fast today.

**AI-native product.**

Go beyond chat. Design around agents that screen, underwrite, diligence and write the memo, with outputs that arrive in the client's own Excel and templates.

**Trust.**

Build citations, audit trail and human sign-off into every step, so users always know what the agents did and why.

**The frontier.**

Track what's changing in models, agents and real estate technology, and decide what it means for our product before anyone else acts on it. Take the product from what it is today to what the category needs next.

**Client deployments & GTM.**

Be on the ground in discovery calls, pilots and deployments with fund partners and their teams. Spot what repeats across clients and build that, not one-off features. Work with our GTM lead on positioning, packaging and pricing.

**The product organisation.**

Hire a small team of product managers and designers who own whole areas. Set a design bar that is minimal, clear and agent-first: products people want to show other people.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within your first 12 months:

* Clients describe Smart Bricks as infrastructure, not a tool.
* Every client type, institutional and retail, runs on the same platform.
* The gap between a client asking and us shipping is weeks, not quarters.
* Product, Engineering, forward-deployed and GTM teams work from one plan.

**Who we're looking for**

We're looking for a product builder who can own one product for very different users, with strong opinions on what AI-native software should look like, and shipped work that proves it.

Specifically, you'll likely have:

* 10+ years in product, with real leadership responsibility.
* You've taken a product from early stage to scale at a high-growth technology company.
* A strong view on what AI-native software should look like, and shipped work that proves it.
* An unusually high bar for design and UX in complex enterprise software.
* You've worked directly with enterprise clients and with engineering and AI teams.
* You're comfortable saying no.

You don't need to be a CPO already. A standout VP Product or product lead from a fast-growing AI company could be a stronger fit than someone who has spent five years managing a large product organisation.

It's a plus if you also have:

* Experience at an AI lab or vertical AI company (e.g. Harvey, Hebbia, Rogo, Palantir, Model ML).
* Background in fintech, investment technology or data platforms.
* A design background, or you've led Design directly.
* Knowledge of real estate or private markets workflows.

**Compensation & Benefits**

We believe exceptional people should share in the value they create. You'll receive a highly competitive salary and a meaningful equity package, private healthcare, an annual learning and conference budget, flexible working, and access to the latest AI models and tooling.

**How We Work**

We hold exceptionally high standards. We start with customer problems, not features, move quickly without compromising quality, default to ownership, challenge assumptions respectfully and stay relentlessly curious. We optimise for outcomes, not process and hierarchy.

**Why Join**

Nobody has settled what AI-native software for real estate looks like yet, for institutions or for retail. You'll define it, with the whole product function yours and direct access to the Founder & CEO, our CTO and clients. Small team, fast decisions, your product in front of institutions within weeks.

If you're the type to get out of bed to define what AI-native real estate software becomes, Smart Bricks is the place for you. We'd love to talk.

jobs.title: Head of SEO/AEO

At NEXT Ventures, performance is more than numbers — it's the pulse that drives

search, backed by a business that moves fast and bets on people who take ownership.

Your next chapter begins here.

jobs.description:
**Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory**

Dubai, UAE | Full-time, office-based | AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive | Start: as soon as possible

**About Dreevo**

Dreevo is building a new kind of service marketplace in the UAE: one place where customers can discover, book and trust the services they need. We are live in Dubai with 8 service categories, 75 services and more than 300 SKUs, giving customers access to over AED 12 million worth of services through our provider network and our own mobile EV operation. We partner with vehicle manufacturers and are expanding across the UAE and into other verticals.

We are still an early-stage company. Product, technology, operations, partnerships, brand and commercial models are being built in parallel, which gives Legal a direct hand in how the business is structured and scaled.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Legal Counsel – Corporate, Commercial & Regulatory to become Dreevo's first dedicated in-house legal hire.

Reporting directly to the CEO and working closely with the Founder/Director and leadership team, you will take practical ownership of Dreevo's day-to-day corporate, commercial and regulatory legal matters.

This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded lawyer who is comfortable in a fast-moving environment. You will need to understand what the business is trying to achieve, identify the genuine legal and regulatory risks, recommend practical solutions, draft and negotiate agreements yourself, and decide when specialist external counsel is needed.

**Your First 90 Days**

- Redraft our service provider terms, customer terms and privacy policy, starting with how our marketplace contracting model should work.

- Finalise NDA and confidentiality documentation for upcoming partnerships.

- Put intercompany agreements in place across the Dreevo group.

- Support licensing and permits as we expand into new emirates.

- Register and protect the Dreevo brand and trademarks.

- Set up contract templates, a contract register and signing authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Commercial contracts***

- Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, including NDAs, MoUs, heads of terms, service, supplier, procurement, technology, SaaS, API and development agreements.

- Support partnerships with vehicle manufacturers and energy, technology and institutional partners.

- Advise the CEO, Founder/Director and leadership team on new services, partnerships and operating models.

***Marketplace, consumer and data***

- Build the legal framework for service providers on the marketplace, covering onboarding, service levels, payments, insurance, liability, suspension and termination.

- Draft and maintain customer terms, refund and cancellation policies, privacy notices and marketplace disclosures in line with UAE consumer protection and e-commerce rules.

- Lead UAE PDPL compliance, including data processing agreements, data retention and cross-border data.

- Protect Dreevo's intellectual property, including source code, designs, data, AI workflows and brand assets, and review open source and AI licensing terms with Product and Engineering.

***Regulatory and corporate***

- Manage licensing, permits and activity requirements for the marketplace and new verticals, working with the RTA and other UAE and Dubai authorities.

- Advise on mainland and free zone structures and intercompany arrangements.

- Coordinate entity set-up, constitutional documents, shareholder and director records and UBO filings with corporate service providers.

- Support fundraising, investor due diligence and corporate transactions alongside external counsel.

***Employment and legal operations***

- Advise on UAE employment matters and prepare employment, contractor, consultancy, IP assignment and confidentiality documents.

- Manage disputes, claims and settlement discussions, and instruct and manage external counsel.

- Build Dreevo's legal operating framework: templates, approval processes, signing authorities, contract register and governance records.

**Required Experience**

- Qualified lawyer in a recognised jurisdiction.

- A minimum of 5 years' post-qualification experience.

- Strong UAE/GCC experience, with exposure to corporate, commercial, employment, consumer and regulatory matters.

- A track record of drafting and negotiating commercial and technology agreements through to signature.

- Experience in-house, on secondment or in a commercially focused law firm.

- A strong understanding of technology, data, intellectual property and digital platform contracts.

- The ability to run several workstreams independently and prioritise by commercial and legal risk.

- Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain legal issues clearly and commercially.

**Preferred Experience**

Experience in startups, scale-ups, marketplaces, mobility, automotive, logistics, energy, fintech, e-commerce or on-demand services would be particularly valuable.

Experience with marketplace agreements, SaaS and API licensing, data sharing, strategic partnerships, privacy, intellectual property, AI or open source matters is an advantage.

Arabic is an advantage but not essential.

**Who We're Looking For**

We are looking for someone commercially minded, practical and decisive. You should be comfortable giving clear recommendations rather than simply identifying legal issues, and confident enough to challenge senior leadership when necessary.

This is not a passive contract review role or a traditional company secretarial role. You will help create Dreevo's legal foundations from the beginning.

You will draft, negotiate, organise, build systems and solve problems yourself, while developing repeatable legal processes that can scale with the company.

**What We Offer**

- Salary of AED 20,000 per month, all-inclusive

- UAE employment visa

- Medical insurance

- 24 working days' annual leave

- The chance to build Dreevo's legal function from the ground up

Work Location: In person

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

The Visa Direct CEMEA - Business Strategy and Planning - Director is the Business Planning & Strategy lead for Visa Direct in CEMEA, based in Dubai. The role works closely with the head of Strategy and Business Planning for CMS, as well as the VP, Head of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA, as strategic and planning partner on all internal and external initiatives. This role will help drive the strategy and transformation of Money Movement Solutions CEMEA while collaborating with key members of the CEMEA Leadership Team, Global Visa Direct Team, and other stakeholders.

Strategy**:**

The role sits in SuperApp Platform and reports to the Product Director. The Head defines the strategy for the domain, builds and leads a team, and is accountable for the impact of personalisation on multi-vertical growth.
  
  
It is a role at the intersection of Product, Marketing and Data, with a clear split of ownership:

* **Owns:** the orchestration layer (which user sees what, where and when), personalisation of the main screen and cross-sell placements, the communications platform, the MarTech stack strategy, and the experimentation that proves impact.
* **Influences:** campaign content and promo budgets (Marketing), offer business rules (vertical and loyalty owners), ads inventory rules (Ads), predictive models (Data Science).

Department

SuperApp and Growth Businesses Product

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Address Abu Dhabi, Emirate of Abu Dhabi

Workplace type

Hybrid

Requisition ID

6911

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Set the strategy:** Define the personalisation and MarTech strategy, from the user segments and intents we act on to which service, offer or message each user gets, where, and through which channel.
* **Build the orchestration layer:** Create one system that decides who sees what, where and when, with frequency caps to avoid overload. Offer and ads owners set their own rules. You own how those rules are combined and delivered.
* **Personalise the main screen and cross-sell:** Replace one-size-fits-all layouts with ones that adapt to each user, so more users try new verticals and use current ones more often.
* **Shape the MarTech stack:** Map current tools, set build-vs-buy criteria, and consolidate onto one platform, so teams launch communications without manual integrations.
* **Grow the communications platform:** Own triggered and segmented scenarios, channels (push, in-app, email, messengers), opt-outs and delivery quality.
* **Build and lead the team:** Grow a team focused on strong discovery, rigorous experimentation and outcomes over feature launches.

**What success looks like**

* Personalised surfaces and communications drive more multi-vertical users and higher order frequency.
* All offers and messages go through one orchestration layer, with proven lift and controlled communication load.
* Marketing and the verticals launch segmented communications without engineers.

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* **Product Experience:** 8+ years of product management experience in large-audience consumer products (Marketplace, Super App, E-commerce, FoodTech, or FinTech).
* **Leadership:** 3+ years leading and developing product managers.
* **Platform Products:** Proven track record of building scalable, platform-based product solutions in data-rich environments.
* **MarTech & Personalisation:** Deep expertise in MarTech ecosystems, personalisation, and customer data.
* **Strategy:** Strong ability to define product strategy and roadmap, and to turn business goals into product capabilities.
* **Data & Experimentation:** Data-driven mindset with a solid understanding of analytics, experimentation, and data governance.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Experienced in leading alignment across Marketing, Tech, and Data teams and leadership.
* **Communication:** Business-fluent English proficiency (B2/C1+ or equivalent).

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

jobs.title: PR & Communications Manager
jobs.description:
OneAsset is a Dubai-based real estate tokenisation and digital asset platform currently undergoing VARA licensing review. Combining institutional-grade real estate with regulated blockchain infrastructure, OneAsset is building its presence across financial services, commercial real estate, and digital asset markets.

### **The Role**

OneAsset is seeking a strategic, resourceful, and hands-on PR & Communications Manager to drive its media relations and external communications.

Working closely with the Head of Marketing and senior leadership, you will own narrative development, secure high-impact earned media coverage, and strengthen OneAsset's credibility across financial, commercial real estate, and digital asset audiences. This role requires an independent operator who takes ownership, thinks beyond day-to-day execution, and translates communications strategy into measurable commercial outcomes.

### **Key Responsibilities**

**Media Relations & PR Strategy**

* Develop and execute proactive PR and media relations strategies aligned with OneAsset's business and communications objectives.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, and key media stakeholders across financial services, business, commercial real estate, and digital assets.
* Identify, pitch, and secure meaningful earned media opportunities, including interviews, features, expert commentary, and contributed articles.
* Develop differentiated, newsworthy story angles informed by industry developments, market research, and editorial trends.
* Evaluate media opportunities based on outlet credibility, audience relevance, and strategic value, continuously refining outreach through performance monitoring.

**Corporate & Executive Communications**

* Draft and refine press releases, media pitches, op-eds, executive commentary, briefing notes, and external communications.

**Industry Relations & Speaking Opportunities**

* Identify and assess relevant speaking engagements, conferences, industry panels, and networking opportunities for OneAsset executives.
* Evaluate events based on audience composition, organiser credibility, strategic relevance, and ROI.

**Planning, Execution & Performance**

* Manage PR activities end-to-end—from planning and research through execution, follow-up, and reporting.
