jobs.title: Director, Commercial Payments, Visa Government Solutions - CEMEA
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Overview:

Visa Government Solutions (VGS) brings Visa’s consumer, commercial, money movement and value-added solutions to public sector clients globally. In this regional Director role, you will lead the commercial payments agenda for VGS in CEMEA, helping governments and public sector organizations modernize expenditure across procurement, travel, fleet, employee benefits, lending and related payment flows.

You will work closely with regional VGS sales teams, Visa Commercial Solutions (VCS) team, the Regional Head of GTM & Commercialization and the Global Head of VGS Commercial Payments to develop growth strategies, partnerships and go-to-market plans that position Visa as a leading partner for Government-to-Business (G2B) payments.

This is an opportunity to combine deep commercial payments expertise with strategic thinking, market insight and cross-functional influence. You will turn regional opportunities, client needs and ecosystem trends into practical solutions that accelerate VGS growth and support Visa’s broader 2030 roadmap.

The role offers a broad and varied remit. You will build understanding of regional market dynamics, regulatory considerations and economic drivers, while helping shape cross-functional plans for large ecosystem opportunities involving technology enablers, marketplaces, ERPs, system integrators, travel management companies, e-invoicing providers, issuers and acquirers.

As Visa moves from planning to execution of its 2030 roadmap, you will contribute to a strategic priority: deepening penetration of B2B and G2B spend. Your work will help shape regional go-to-market strategies, expand acceptance, strengthen market execution and unlock a share of the global addressable opportunity.

We are looking for a strategic, commercially minded payments leader who enjoys building relationships, connecting market insight to client need, and working through teams across the region and wider Visa organization. You will bring sound judgement, curiosity and the ability to turn complex opportunities into clear commercial strategies.

In this role, you will:

* Drive regional growth for VGS Government-to-Business (G2B) commercial payment solutions in partnership with dedicated VGS sales teams.
* Develop and own segment and vertical strategies that use Visa capabilities, enhanced propositions and external partnerships to position Visa competitively and grow share.
* Partner with the Global Head of Commercial Payments, VGS and regional/global VCS teams to identify product, software and capability gaps, and build prioritization cases for enhancements.
* Shape two-sided go-to-market strategies that serve both government buyers and industry sellers, improving client outcomes and driving incremental Visa revenue.
* Identify and evaluate external commercial enabler partnerships, including technology providers, marketplaces, ERPs, system integrators, TMCs, e-invoicing providers, issuers and acquirers.
* Work with local, regional and global Visa teams to address solution, pricing, rules, regulatory or acceptance challenges that may limit competitiveness.
* Maintain a strong understanding of relevant Visa capabilities across commercial solutions, acceptance, money movement, value-added services and emerging technologies.
* Explore how AI and other emerging technologies can improve public sector commercial payment strategies and support regional sales effectiveness.
* Develop thought leadership and sales enablement materials that build market understanding and strengthen the VGS commercial payments narrative.
* Equip CEMEA VGS sales teams with the technical knowledge, tools and messaging needed to identify and convert commercial payments opportunities.

Skills/competencies:

* Deep commercial payments expertise is essential, along with the ability to understand complex client processes, identify where Visa solutions can add value and communicate that opportunity clearly to senior stakeholders.
* The ideal candidate will bring curiosity and passion for payments, fintech and public sector transformation, combined with strong client relationship skills, executive presence, resilience and the ability to execute against ambitious goals.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

What we are looking for:

* 12+ years of experience in commercial cards, B2B payments, commercial issuing or related payment solutions.
* Proven background in a card scheme, global issuer, travel or ERP platform, B2B fintech, payments technology provider or equivalent environment.
* Deep knowledge of the global payments industry, with strong regional market understanding relevant to CEMEA.
* Strong understanding of commercial payment flows, two-sided network economics, acceptance, issuer dynamics, solutioning, commercialization and go-to-market models.
* Experience developing strategies across multiple markets, ideally within a regional or matrixed global organization.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders, build internal networks and translate complex payment concepts into clear commercial narratives.
* Comfort working without direct authority across sales, product, strategy, partnerships, commercialization and VCS teams.
* Experience working with issuers or ecosystem partners to develop, commercialize or scale commercial payment solutions.
* Familiarity with government procurement, public sector sales cycles, compliance requirements or public-sector go-to-market approaches.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

Head of Operational Risk
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced banking risk professional to lead the Operational Risk function at slice.

As a digital-first, AI-first bank, we are building banking products and experiences that challenge traditional ways of operating. We need someone who can think from first principles, anticipate risks in an evolving banking environment and build operational risk frameworks and processes that are robust, scalable and suited to how a modern bank operates.

This is a senior leadership role that goes beyond traditional risk monitoring and compliance. The individual will be responsible for identifying, assessing and managing operational risks across the bank, while building systems and controls that enable innovation, speed and responsible business growth.

Working closely with the Chief Risk Officer (CRO) and business leadership, this person will play a critical role in shaping how operational risk is understood, measured and managed across the organisation. We are looking for someone who combines strong banking risk fundamentals with the ability to question existing practices, solve complex problems and build for the future.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the development, implementation and continuous enhancement of the bank’s Operational Risk Management Framework (ORMF), policies, processes and controls, ensuring they are scalable and aligned with the bank’s digital-first operating model.
* Identify, assess, measure, monitor and mitigate operational risks across the bank, including emerging risks associated with digital banking, AI-led processes, technology, products and evolving business models.
* Support the CRO in developing and operationalising the bank’s risk appetite framework, including risk limits, thresholds, monitoring mechanisms and escalation processes.
* Establish and strengthen risk management practices including Risk and Control Self-Assessments (RCSA), Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), scenario analysis, operational loss event management and control effectiveness assessments.
* Lead the identification, investigation and escalation of operational risk incidents, including root-cause analysis, corrective actions and monitoring of remediation.
* Partner with business, Product, Technology and Operations teams to assess operational risks associated with new products, processes, partnerships and business initiatives, ensuring appropriate controls are embedded from the outset.
* Provide independent operational risk oversight across banking activities, including digital transactions, payments, deposits, lending and treasury-related operations, with a strong understanding of the operational implications of liquidity and market risks.
* Develop and strengthen operational risk controls for outsourcing and third-party arrangements, including vendor risk assessments, operational dependencies, business continuity and service disruptions.
* Support the CRO in enhancing risk governance, management reporting and committee dashboards, providing actionable insights on risk exposures, emerging trends, control effectiveness and remediation progress.
* Ensure the bank’s operational risk practices remain aligned with applicable RBI regulations, regulatory expectations and internal governance requirements.
* Act as an independent second line of defence, working closely with senior stakeholders across the bank to challenge decisions where necessary, strengthen risk ownership and enable responsible business growth.
* Build and lead a high-performing Operational Risk team, fostering a culture of accountability, proactive risk identification and continuous improvement.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Experience:**
  12–20 years of experience in the banking sector, with significant expertise in Operational Risk Management, preferably in a senior leadership role.
* **First-Principles Thinking:**
  Ability to challenge conventional approaches, identify risks in new and evolving business models, and design practical, scalable risk frameworks rather than relying solely on established processes.
* **Domain Expertise:**
  Strong understanding of banking operations and associated risks, particularly in digital banking, payments and transaction processing, with exposure to deposits/liabilities, treasury operations and related liquidity and market risks.
* **Risk Management:**
  Proven experience in building and strengthening operational risk frameworks, risk appetite monitoring, RCSA, KRIs, incident management and regulatory governance.
* **Regulatory Knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of RBI regulations, banking risk governance and experience engaging with risk committees, auditors and senior management.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to independently challenge senior business leaders, simplify complex risk issues and balance risk considerations with business priorities.
* **Leadership:**
  Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with experience building teams, establishing processes and driving cross-functional initiatives.
* **Qualifications:**
  Graduate or postgraduate degree in a relevant discipline. Professional certifications such as FRM or PRM would be an added advantage.

jobs.title: Vice President - Technology- Transformation
jobs.description:
Job Purpose
  
Senior Transformation Office Portfolio Leader is responsible for governing the technology projects portfolio of change across agreed Mashreq’s groups.
  
- Own and govern the technology change portfolio for one or more assigned Mashreq Groups, acting as the senior Transformation Office partner to Group leadership across investment planning, delivery governance, portfolio performance, value realization and forward forecasting.
  
- Provide an accurate, decision-oriented view of the portfolio from demand and budget formulation through initiation, execution, closure and benefits realization, maintaining a single source of truth and ensuring adherence to Mashreq project Methods.
  
- Act as a trusted advisor to Group Heads and senior stakeholders, proactively identifying portfolio risks, dependencies, delivery constraints and value leakage; drive resolution and escalate material concerns through the appropriate governance forums.
  
- Provide Project Quality Assurance across the assigned portfolio and strengthen project-management capability by assuring PM competence and Method compliance, coaching and training project managers, and directly leading selected critical projects where required.
  
- Works with the respective Owners within Groups to ensure that all transformation initiatives are aligned with Mashreq's strategic goals and objectives, by providing active support and coordination during the budgeting, initiation and planning cycles,
  
- Fosters close collaboration with senior leadership to ensure buy-in support, and effective decision-making throughout the transformation journeys.
  
- Agrees, establishes and applies prioritization criteria to the transformation initiatives to support the execution of the overall bank strategy and growth aspirations, leveraging on synergies where possible, ensuring a balanced focus on achieving short-term improvements while building long-term value for sustainable growth,
  
- Acts as Initiation Lead, either directly or by identifying resources to hold this role, and coordinate the activities related to initiation, planning, estimations, articulations of the benefits and business case to be included in the request for budgets in the form of the Executive Summary.
  
- Review Executive Summaries, make best effort to check for completeness of the estimates and be one of the mandatory signatories,
  
- Monitors and reports on the transformation initiatives roadmap at the Mashreq and Group levels, and escalates concerns as necessary,
  
- Ensures transparency and access to accurate information by maintaining the single source of truth on the transformation initiatives,
  
- Defines and implements a communication strategy to regularly disseminate and communicate progress updates and outcomes of transformation initiatives to the right stakeholders, ensuring transparency,
  
- Works with key stakeholders to optimize allocation of resources, including talent, technology, and finances, for efficient utilization toward delivery excellence.
  
- Leads projects managers in the management of projects within the Portfolio. Assures that the execution of projects is done in accordance with Mashreq’s Methods.
  
- Provides training and knowledge transfer as required on TO approved ways of working.
  
- Contributes to the development of Mashreq’s Delivery Methods.
  
- Work towards continuously improving Mashreq’s delivery capabilities thus maximizing the opportunities for business value creation from transformation initiatives.
  
  
Key Result Areas: --
  
A. Portfolio Strategy, Demand & Investment Planning
  
- Partner with assigned Groups to translate strategic priorities and change demand into an integrated technology portfolio and multi-year roadmap.
  
- Lead/support annual and in-year budget formulation for CAPEX and OPEX projects, challenging scope, estimates, sequencing, dependencies, resource needs, benefits and delivery readiness.
  
- Coordinate initiation, planning, estimations, benefits articulation and business-case / Executive Summary preparation; review submissions for completeness, quality and decision readiness and provide required Transformation Office sign-off.
  
- Apply agreed prioritization criteria and advise Group leadership on investment trade-offs, capacity constraints, synergies and sequencing.
  
  
B. Portfolio Execution, Control & Reporting
  
- Maintain an accurate portfolio inventory and single source of truth, clearly distinguishing projects not yet initiated, initiated/in planning, in execution, live/delivered, on hold and closed.
  
- Track projects against approved scope, schedule, cost, milestones, resourcing, risks, dependencies and benefits baselines; identify variance and require credible recovery actions.
  
- Produce concise, evidence-based Group portfolio reporting highlighting performance, exceptions, decisions required and forward outlook.
  
- Provide timely and accurate inputs into bank-wide Technology Projects reporting, ensuring consistent definitions, data quality and traceability across Groups.
  
- Forecast portfolio performance, delivery milestones, financial utilization, emerging risks and likely year-end outcomes; identify potential slippage, under-utilization or value leakage early.
  
C. Delivery Assurance & Mashreq Methods
  
  
- Act as Project Quality Assurance lead for assigned Groups, performing structured health checks against Mashreq project Methods, governance standards, mandatory artefacts and control gates.
  
- Assess whether project plans and baselines are credible, governance is operating effectively, RAID items and dependencies are actively managed, and executive decisions are captured and actioned.
  
- Escalate material non-compliance, delivery risk and control weakness, and track agreed remediation to closure.
  
- Assure that onboarded Project Managers understand and apply Mashreq Methods; provide coaching, training and targeted knowledge transfer.
  
- Where specifically required, act directly as Project Manager / recovery lead for selected critical or complex initiatives without diluting independent assurance across the wider portfolio.
  
- Contribute lessons learned and practical enhancements to Mashreq delivery Methods and Transformation Office standards.
  
D. Issue Resolution, Stakeholder Leadership & Advisory
  
  
  
- Work with Group Heads, project sponsors, business/technology owners and Project Managers to remove delivery blockers and resolve cross-project or cross-functional issues.
  
- Serve as trusted advisor on change demand, portfolio composition, prioritization, execution choices, dependencies, delivery risk and value creation.
  
- Create fact-based escalation paths for issues requiring senior leadership intervention, with clear options, impact and recommended action.
  
- Build effective working relationships across Technology, Business, Functions, Finance, Procurement, Technology GRC, ISG, ORM, Internal Audit, Compliance and other relevant functions.
  
E. Benefits & Value Realization
  
  
- Work with accountable business owners to define measurable financial and non-financial benefits, establish baselines, ownership and realization timelines.
  
- Ensure approved benefits are recorded, tracked and periodically validated through the delivery lifecycle and after go-live where applicable.
  
- Challenge gaps between investment cases, delivered capabilities, adoption and realized outcomes; escalate material benefit shortfalls and agree corrective actions.
  
  
  
F. Project Manager Leadership & Capability
  
- Provide functional leadership to Project Managers supporting assigned portfolios, setting expectations for delivery discipline, transparency and escalation.
  
- Assess PM onboarding/readiness, coach performance and reinforce consistent application of Mashreq Methods and reporting standards.
  
- Support assignment of appropriately skilled Project Managers to initiatives based on complexity, risk and critica

jobs.title: Associate Vice President
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**
The role supports the timely and accurate forecasting of ~900 nostro accounts across 10 centres, spanning intragroup accounts, 3rd party agents and central banks (totalling ~$500bn in managed liquidity per day). This is done in close partnership with funding and trading desks across Treasury and FX, and requires regular engagements with other teams across the bank. Finally, the role involves oversight for the banks throughput and intraday liquidity management at central banks. This footprint will expand as we onboard another 33 centres spanning ~1000 nostros and central banks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Be responsible and accountable for real time nostro management processes:**

* Team management / oversight to ensure the successful delivery of day-to-day forecasting, intraday liquidity (IDL) and cash management functions.
* Calculation and provision of funding forecasts to Treasury Markets and FX desks in line with agreed cutoffs on an intraday basis. Provision of root cause analysis on key funding drivers and forecast swings.
* Intraday liquidity monitoring and management of the firm’s central bank accounts
* Proactive management of payment scheduling systems to ensure the firm’s throughput requirements as well as time critical payments are met
* Drive strategies linked to forecasting and IDL related optimization
* Connect with global transformational programmes to ensure seamless operations
* Partner with the TS MT to further enhance and build on the teams Target Operating Model.
* Be a key business partner and support contact to Treasury Markets to ensure effective real time funding and liquidity management decision-making.
* Oversee cash management processes to manage IDL and funding
* Oversee real time forecasting and IDL related KRIs / dashboards for close monitoring and escalation on an intraday basis,
* Provision of Nostro MI in terms of next day balance reporting / explanations, monthly cost management, balance trends / root causes

**Risk Management**

**1. JOB PURPOSE**

To ensure effective, accurate and timely management of Finance and Accounting operations

for ESPL and its associated schools. The role is responsible for vendor accounting and

payments, employee reimbursements, statutory tax compliance, banking and cash

reconciliations, travel management, accounting operations, audit closure and accounts

receivable.

The position will also drive process standardisation, automation, centralisation of

accounting activities and continuous improvement in financial controls, ensuring adherence

to organisational policies and timely resolution of stakeholder queries.

**2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Finance & Accounting Operations**

1. Manage and ensure accurate accounting of all vendor bills and payments in **Zoho**

Books.

2. Ensure timely processing of vendor payments on a weekly basis.

3. Conduct vendor account reconciliations every six months (August and February).

4. Maintain and regularly update the Vendor Payment Tracker.

5. Process employee reimbursements through Zoho Expense with accuracy and within

the defined timelines.

6. Ensure timely processing of approved employee reimbursement payments every

Friday.

7. Address and resolve reimbursement-related queries and discrepancies raised by

**ESPL** employees.

8. Calculate and account for GST and TDS liabilities accurately and within applicable

timelines.

9. Ensure timely bank account reconciliation and resolution of discrepancies.

10. Monitor and reconcile petty cash and prepaid card transactions on a fortnightly

basis.

11. Coordinate with **Tally** support teams and assist schools in resolving accounting

software-related issues.

12. Ensure accurate day-to-day accounting entries and maintenance of financial records

in Zoho Books.

**B. Travel & Hotel Management**

1. Manage employee travel and hotel-related payments.

2. Ensure timely uploading and maintenance of travel balances wherever required.

3. Manage employee additions, deletions and modifications in the Travel Portal.

4. Address travel-related queries and provide timely support to employees.

5. Ensure proper reconciliation of travel and hotel accounts.

6. Maintain accurate records of travel-related expenses and payments.

**C. Statutory Compliance & Audit Management**

1. Ensure accurate accounting and maintenance of statutory financial records.

2. Monitor GST and TDS calculations and ensure timely accounting of applicable

liabilities.

3. Coordinate and manage statutory audit activities for ESPL.

4. Ensure availability and accuracy of supporting documents and financial records

required for audits.

5. Coordinate with auditors and internal stakeholders for timely closure of audit

observations.

6. Ensure audit closure within the prescribed TAT with minimal audit queries and

observations.

7. Take corrective action on audit observations and ensure that issues are not

repeated.

**D. Accounts Receivable & Revenue Accounting**

1. Raise tax invoices for revenues earned by Edunation in a timely and accurate

manner.

2. Ensure proper accounting of revenue transactions inZoho Books.

3. Monitor outstanding receivables and maintain accurate accounts receivable records.

4. Conduct regular follow-ups with concerned stakeholders for outstanding payments

and collections.

5. Ensure timely resolution of discrepancies relating to invoices and receivables.

**E. People Excellence & Operational Continuity**

1. Develop effective backup arrangements for all critical finance and accounting

activities.

2. Ensure continuity of operations during planned and unplanned absences.

3. Acquire knowledge of additional processes and cross-functional responsibilities.

4. Improve individual and team efficiency through learning and process familiarisation.

5. Ensure proper documentation and knowledge transfer of critical processes.

**F. Process Excellence, Automation & amp; ERP**

1. Identify opportunities for automation and ERP implementation across Finance and

Accounting operations.

2. Suggest and implement improvements to existing accounting processes.

3. Drive the implementation of centralised accounting processes across all schools.

4. Ensure strict adherence to the organisation's Finance Policy without deviations.

5. Identify process gaps and recommend corrective measures to strengthen internal

financial controls.

6. Standardise accounting practices and reporting processes across schools.

**G. Stakeholder Management & Service Delivery**

1. Respond proactively to feedback and queries received from schools and REN

employees.

2. Ensure timely resolution of finance-related issues within the defined turnaround

time.

3. Provide accurate and quality resolutions to improve stakeholder satisfaction.

4. Maintain professional and responsive communication with all internal stakeholders.

5. Ensure recurring issues are identified, analyzed and addressed to prevent repetition.

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. * Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results under tight deadlines.

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

The Business Management (BM) role provides centralized financial, operational, risk, and governance oversight for Accounting & Fund Services. The role focuses on producing executive-level reporting and dashboards, tracking, and managing financial targets and timely delivery of management information to senior leaders and governance forums. This role combines strategic oversight, financial and operational performance monitoring, business planning, regulatory and risk management, and cross-functional coordination to support the business head and leadership team. The Specialist works closely with business leaders and functions to develop and implement strategy, monitor results, and embed strong governance and controls. Success in this role requires a blend of big-picture strategic thinking and hands-on execution to optimize performance, manage risks, and deliver on business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial & Business Oversight**

* Manage workforce planning, including headcount tracking and resource allocation.
* Review, consolidate, and produce recurring financial and productivity reporting.
* Track and forecast dollar and FTE savings, including surrendered posts and productivity-driven closures.
* Lead development and communication of strategic business plans.
* Review financial forecasts provided by practice leads and ensure we are managing performance against plan.
* Quantifies the impact of efficiency initiatives on financial goals.
* Support development and maintenance of dashboards for decision making.
* Provide ad-hoc business management support and analytics for decision-making.

**Reporting & Dashboards**

* Develop and maintain key business metrics, including productivity measures and unit costs, and use these insights to support data-driven decisions.

* Review consolidated submissions, and prepare final reporting for COO operational reviews, weekly updates, and enterprise reporting requirements.
* Produce, review, and distribute consolidated weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting for A&FS leadership.
* Publish data to AFS dashboards and support increased transparency through standardized reporting.

**Post, Headcount & Workforce Management**

* Produce and maintain post-management and requisition status reporting at a global A&FS level.
* Track refills, replacements, new roles, IJPs, interns, and contractors; highlight exceptions and risks.
* Act as a central coordination point between practice leads, finance, recruiting, and operations.

**Risk, Audit & Regulatory Oversight**

* Monitors risk events, audit findings, and control issues, ensuring timely escalation and remediation.

* Monitor, consolidate, and report on operational risk events, data privacy events, regulatory breaches, audit issues, and remediation programs.
* Create content and reporting for Risk Committee, COO Risk Committee, and other governance forums.
* Track remediation actions, escalate risks, and ensure compliance with enterprise standards and regulatory programs.

**Governance & Controls**

jobs.title: Senior Financial Controller
jobs.description:
**Senior Financial Controller**  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat | Department: Finance | Reports to: CEO / CFO

**About the Company**

Our client is one of India's fastest-growing workspace and business infrastructure companies, offering Managed Offices, Coworking Spaces, Enterprise Workspace Solutions, Build-to-Suit Offices, Design & Build Services, and Business Infrastructure Solutions.

Founded with the vision of transforming how businesses experience workspaces, the company partners with startups, SMEs, large enterprises, GCCs, and multinational corporations by providing scalable, technology-enabled workplace solutions across India.

Today, it operates across multiple cities with a rapidly expanding footprint and manages millions of square feet of commercial real estate through long-term strategic partnerships. As it scales nationally through organic growth, strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and new business ventures, the company is looking for a strong, hands-on finance leader to own the controllership backbone of the organization while partnering closely with the CFO on strategic finance initiatives.

**Business Ecosystem**

The Senior Financial Controller will drive financial control and reporting discipline across the group's ecosystem, which includes multiple business verticals and associated entities involved in workspace development, operations, technology, and business services. The role operates in a multi-entity, high-growth environment and requires strong governance, process ownership, and financial discipline across:

* Managed Office Solutions
* Coworking Spaces
* Enterprise Workspace Solutions
* Commercial Real Estate
* Design & Build
* Infrastructure Development
* Facility & Workplace Operations
* Technology-enabled Workplace Solutions
* Business Support Services

**Role Purpose**

The Senior Financial Controller will own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, Compliance, Taxation, and MIS Reporting across the organization, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and control at every stage of the financial close and reporting cycle. As a senior member of the Finance leadership team, the role will work closely with the CFO and business heads to translate financial strategy into disciplined execution, and will step in on select strategic finance, treasury, and fundraising-support responsibilities that a growing multi-entity business demands.

This is a controllership-first role with meaningful exposure to strategic finance, ideal for a finance leader who wants to build and run the core finance engine of a fast-scaling company while growing into broader CFO-level responsibilities over time.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Finance & Accounting Operations (Core Ownership)**

* Own end-to-end Finance & Accounts, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Revenue Recognition, Fixed Assets, and Payroll Accounting.
* Lead timely monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing across all entities.
* Prepare and review Consolidated Financial Statements for the group.
* Own MIS Reporting and ensure accuracy, consistency, and timeliness of management reports.
* Build and maintain scalable accounting processes and standard operating procedures across a multi-entity structure.

**Taxation & Regulatory Compliance (Core Ownership)**

* Ensure full compliance across GST, Income Tax, TDS, and Companies Act requirements.
* Oversee Secretarial Compliance and ROC filings in coordination with company secretarial support.
* Lead Statutory Audits and Internal Audits, and act as the primary point of contact for auditors.
* Strengthen Internal Financial Controls (IFC) and overall financial governance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day cash flow planning and working capital optimization.
* Maintain and strengthen banking relationships across the group.
* Support debt servicing, liquidity management, and treasury operations.

**FP&A and Business Finance**

* Support the Annual Operating Plan (AOP), budgeting, forecasting, and rolling forecasts.
* Track financial KPIs and business intelligence reporting for leadership review.
* Partner with business leaders to evaluate profitability, support pricing decisions, and improve operational efficiency.
* Recommend and drive cost optimization initiatives across business units.

**Strategic Finance Support (Partnering with CFO)**

* Support financial due diligence for M&A, investments, and joint ventures as needed.
* Assist in preparing financial models, investor presentations, and materials for lender / PE / VC interactions.
* Contribute financial insights to Board-level and leadership reporting.
* Support post-merger financial integration for acquired businesses.

**Risk Management & Governance**

* Strengthen internal controls and enterprise risk management practices.
* Ensure compliance with corporate policies across all entities.
* Identify and mitigate financial and compliance risks proactively.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor the accounting, taxation, and compliance teams.
* Build a high-performing, process-driven finance function capable of supporting rapid national growth.
* Act as a key escalation point for finance operations, deputizing for the CFO on controllership matters when required.

**Requirements**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) or MBA Finance is mandatory.
* Minimum 10+ years of progressive experience in Finance & Accounts, with strong hands-on controllership exposure.
* Proven experience owning the complete accounting close, MIS, and compliance function.
* Strong exposure to Accounting, Taxation, Compliance, Audit, and Financial Governance; working exposure to FP&A and Treasury preferred.
* Experience managing finance teams in a multi-location / multi-entity organization.
* Exposure to fundraising, due diligence, or investor reporting is an added advantage but not mandatory.
* Strong process orientation with the ability to build scalable financial systems and controls.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Pay: Up to ₹2,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTIONAREA MANAGER – CREDIT & OPERATIONS

**Industry:** NBFC- Gold Loan  
**Location:** Thiruvananthapuram / Assigned Area  
**Department:** Credit & Operations  
**Reporting To:** Regional Manager / Head of Operations

1. Job Purpose

The Area Manager – Credit & Operations will be responsible for managing credit operations, customer visits, loan appraisal and approval, branch performance, business development and portfolio quality across assigned branches.

The position requires an experienced professional who can balance credit discipline with business growth, regularly visit branches, motivate employees, support customer acquisition and ensure efficient branch operations.

The Area Manager will play a key role in improving business performance across Gold Loan, Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan products.

2. Duties & Responsibilities

**A. Branch Visits & Business Development**

* Visit every assigned branch at least once a week.
* Review branch-wise business performance, loan disbursements, outstanding and collection efficiency.
* Motivate Branch Managers and employees to improve business sourcing and achieve assigned targets.
* Conduct regular meetings with branch teams to review performance and business plans.
* Identify local business opportunities and support branches in acquiring new customers.
* Participate in important customer meetings and assist branch teams in converting high-value loan proposals.
* Identify operational and business challenges and provide suitable solutions.
* Monitor staff productivity and provide guidance to improve individual performance.
* Develop strategies to improve branch business across Gold Loans, Business Loans and Commercial Property Loans.
* Submit weekly branch visit reports with observations, business updates and action plans.

**B. Customer Visits & Credit Assessment**

* Conduct regular customer visits for Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan proposals.
* Visit business premises, commercial establishments and properties to assess customer credentials and business activities.
* Evaluate customer repayment capacity, business operations and financial position.
* Independently verify information provided in loan applications and identify discrepancies.
* Meet prospective and existing customers to understand their financial requirements.
* Support branch teams in handling high-value and critical loan proposals.
* Ensure proper field verification and due diligence before recommending loan proposals.

**C. Credit Appraisal & Loan Approval**

* Review and evaluate loan applications across assigned branches.
* Assess customer eligibility, repayment capacity, income documents and credit history.
* Ensure proper assessment of collateral, property valuation and legal documentation.
* Review and approve or recommend loan proposals within delegated authority.
* Ensure adherence to credit policies, lending norms and product-specific eligibility criteria.
* Identify potential credit risks and take preventive measures.
* Ensure proper documentation and verification before loan disbursement.
* Improve credit processing turnaround time without compromising lending standards.

**D. Gold Loan Operations**

* Monitor gold loan appraisal procedures and ensure adherence to company guidelines.
* Ensure accuracy in gold purity testing, weight assessment and valuation.
* Monitor Loan-to-Value (LTV) compliance and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Conduct surprise inspections and verification of gold packets and vault procedures.
* Ensure proper custody, security and reconciliation of pledged gold ornaments.
* Monitor gold loan renewals, closures, overdue accounts and auction procedures.

**E. Business Loan & Commercial Property Loan Operations**

* Supervise credit evaluation and processing of Business Loan and Commercial Property Loan applications.
* Review financial statements, bank statements, income documents and business cash flows.
* Ensure proper property valuation, legal scrutiny and title verification for property-backed loans.
* Coordinate with legal, technical and credit teams for timely processing.
* Ensure compliance with approved lending policies and sanction conditions.
* Monitor documentation, disbursement and post-disbursement compliance.

**F. Branch Operations & Process Control**

* Monitor daily branch operations and ensure operational discipline.
* Conduct periodic branch inspections and operational audits.
* Ensure proper cash management, document custody and record maintenance.
* Review daily transactions, disbursement reports and operational MIS.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective measures.
* Ensure adherence to internal SOPs and operational guidelines.

**G. Portfolio Monitoring, Collections & Recovery**

* Monitor branch-wise portfolio performance and overdue accounts.
* Track NPA, delinquency and collection efficiency.
* Identify early warning signals and potentially stressed accounts.
* Coordinate with Branch Managers for recovery and overdue reduction.
* Ensure timely follow-up of maturing and overdue loan accounts.
* Recommend corrective actions to improve portfolio quality.

**H. Team Management & Motivation**

* Guide, supervise and motivate Branch Managers and branch employees.
* Train branch teams on credit policies, documentation and operational procedures.
* Conduct regular performance reviews and operational training.
* Ensure accountability and adherence to defined responsibilities.
* Support branch teams in achieving business and collection targets.
* Build a customer-focused and result-oriented working culture.

**I. Compliance, Risk Management & Audit**

* Ensure compliance with applicable RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Monitor KYC, AML and customer due diligence requirements.
* Coordinate internal, concurrent and statutory audits.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations.
* Report operational irregularities, fraud indicators and policy violations to management.
* Ensure effective implementation of risk management practices across branches.

**J. MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare and review branch-wise credit and operational performance reports.
* Monitor loan sanctions, disbursements, outstanding, collections and overdue positions.
* Submit periodic reports to Regional Management / Head Office.
* Analyse operational bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
* Prepare weekly branch visit reports and follow up on pending action points.
* Support management in implementing business growth and risk management strategies.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* **Branch Visits:** Minimum one visit to every assigned branch every week.
* **Business Growth:** Improvement in branch-wise sourcing and loan disbursements.
* **Customer Visits:** Regular field visits for customer verification and credit assessment.
* **Credit Approval:** Timely appraisal and decision-making.
* **Branch Motivation:** Regular performance meetings and staff engagement.
* **Credit Quality:** Effective control over NPA and overdue accounts.
* **Gold Loan Operations:** Accuracy in appraisal, LTV compliance and gold security.
* **Operational Efficiency:** Audit scores, process adherence and documentation quality.
* **Collections:** Improvement in recovery and collection efficiency.
* **Reporting:** Timely submission of weekly and monthly MIS reports.

4. Candidate Profile

* Graduate / Postgraduate in any discipline; finance or banking qualifications preferred.
* 8–15 years of experience in Banking or NBFC operations.
* Strong experience in credit appraisal, loan operations and branch administration.
* Exposure to Gold Loans, Business Loans and Loan Against Property / Commercial Property Loans.
* Experience in handling multiple branches or geographical areas preferred.
* Good knowledge of RBI regulations, KYC, AML and credit risk management.
* Strong customer relationship, business development and team leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel regularly

+ Confirm that transitions achieve safe landing into steady-state operations, with clear ownership, measurable readiness and no unmanaged residual risk.

+ Own and evolve selected elements of EY’s Finance Managed Services transition methodology, playbooks, quality standards and governance principles.

+ Build external market credibility through client forums, thought leadership, alliance activity and selected industry engagement.

* Analytical and Decision-Making Responsibilities

Some careers shine brighter than others.

If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Service Management

**The Opportunity**

This role engineers and operates the trusted data and retrieval layer powering the enterprise Knowledge Graph and its AI-enabled consumers. You’ll build production-grade pipelines that transform structured and unstructured enterprise data into high-quality entities, relationships and retrieval-ready representations with strong controls for provenance, security, quality and operability. The focus is on creating traceable data that links back to authoritative source records and remains reliable as sources and AI use cases grow. Success means dependable graph construction and retrieval datasets that support graph traversal, semantic and vector retrieval and GraphRAG/RAG patterns. You’ll help embed automated testing, observability and recovery across environments so delivery is repeatable rather than bespoke. The outcome is a reusable engineering foundation that reduces one-off integrations and keeps critical knowledge within the permanent team.

**What you'll be doing**

* Design, build, test and operate batch, incremental and event-driven pipelines from enterprise sources into the Knowledge Graph
* Implement graph construction logic including node and edge creation, canonical identifiers, relationship derivation, provenance capture and temporal handling
* Engineer entity resolution, record linkage, de-duplication and reconciliation across heterogeneous sources to prevent conflicting identities and relationships
* Build AI-ready pipelines for structured and unstructured data including extraction, cleansing, chunking or segmentation, and metadata enrichment
* Implement embedding generation and vector indexing pipelines where required, including model and version metadata and repeatable re-indexing processes
* Develop retrieval data services and query patterns for graph traversal, vector or semantic retrieval and hybrid or GraphRAG use cases
* Embed automated data-quality and graph-quality controls covering completeness, validity, freshness, duplicate entities, broken relationships and reconciliation to source
* Establish test frameworks and regression testing for mappings, transformations and retrieval datasets as schemas, ontologies, models and feeds evolve
* Implement end-to-end observability with alerts and recovery runbooks for pipeline health, ingest latency, load failures, indexing status and data freshness
* Optimise loads, transformations, indexing and retrieval performance for scale, latency and cost while maintaining integrity and auditability

**What we're looking for**

* Demonstrate advanced Python and SQL with strong software engineering practice including modular design, automated testing, Git, code review and performance optimisation
* Bring substantial ETL and ELT pipeline engineering experience across APIs, relational data, semi-structured formats and large enterprise datasets
* Apply hands-on graph engineering experience including property graph concepts, schema or ontology implementation and graph query languages such as Cypher or equivalent
* Build data preparation and indexing layers for AI retrieval patterns including embeddings, vector search, semantic or hybrid retrieval and RAG or GraphRAG
* Implement entity resolution and data matching using deterministic and probabilistic approaches with canonical identifiers and source reconciliation
* Establish data quality, metadata, lineage, provenance, schema evolution and data contract practices in production environments
* Deliver CI/CD, containers and platform engineering patterns with production support and infrastructure-aware troubleshooting
* Apply secure data engineering controls including IAM or service identities, secrets management, encryption and auditability suitable for a regulated enterprise

**Building trusted retrieval at scale**

If you want your work to shape how AI systems retrieve and ground information across an enterprise this role offers the scope to do it with rigour. You’ll build pipelines and controls that keep the Knowledge Graph reliable, traceable and ready for real production use cases. The work spans ingestion, graph construction, quality, observability and retrieval services and it’s designed to scale as adoption grows. If you’re ready to turn complex enterprise data into trusted graph and retrieval foundations we’d welcome your application.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

**Description**

At the World Bank, a member of the World Bank Group (WBG), you’ll join a diverse, global community working across cultures, disciplines, and borders to address the world’s most pressing development challenges. With 1.2 billion young people reaching working age in the decade ahead, the challenge of job creation has never been greater. Through partnerships across 145 countries and more than 182 offices worldwide, we work with governments, private sector, development partners and other stakeholders to invest in people, strengthen markets, and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions that generate more and better jobs and improve lives. For more information, visit https://www.worldbank.org/en/who-we-are/ibrd  
  
Treasury is the Vice Presidency, reporting to the Managing Director and World Bank Group Chief Financial Officer, performing treasury functions for the IBRD and IDA and, to varying degrees, for other members of the World Bank Group and other public sector investors. Its activities are organized and grouped into the following departments: Capital Markets & Investment Management, Client Asset Management and Advisory, and Treasury Operations.  
  
Treasury (TRE) has been a large and significant player in the international financial markets for over seventy years and has achieved a global reputation as a prudent and innovative borrower, investor and risk manager. Treasury is responsible for: (i) managing approximately $195 billion in assets for the World Bank and other official sector investors; (ii) leading IBRD’s and IDA’s triple-A rated financing programs in international and domestic bond and derivative markets; (iii) conducting asset and liability management for IBRD’s and IDA’s balance sheets; (iv) overseeing the development and outreach related to the financing and hedging products the Bank provides for its developing-country clients; and (v) collaborating with the World Bank member countries to help build their capacity. Staff in Treasury regularly interact and collaborate with other departments across the Bank and Finance Partners’ teams.  
  
The Treasury Operations Department (TREOP) provides a full range of operational support for Treasury’s asset management, capital markets and banking businesses. The Department is presently organized in 7 operational units: Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL), Quantitative Solutions and Analytics (TREQA), and Cash and Banking Operations (TREBK), Treasury Quantitative Modelling (TREQM), Treasury ALM & Collateral (TREAC), Treasury Market Data and Valuation (TREMV) and a Financial Technology coordination unit (TREFT).  
  
Treasury Asset and Liability Operations (TREAL) is the unit responsible for delivering on a range of operations functions supporting the funding, investment, and asset and liability management portfolios for internal World Bank Group (IBRD, IDA, MIGA, and Trust Funds) entities. In addition, the team supports investment portfolios for a growing roster of more than 60 client entities in domestic and international markets. The team provides integrated and end-to-end support for all trade execution and portfolio servicing activities including trade review, settlement and documentation, options monitoring, debt service and cash and collateral management across the full range of products including bonds, swaps, repos, deposits, and exchange-traded derivatives.  
  
In performing these functions, the team works closely with internal partners and market counterparts as well as external service providers such as technology vendors, custodians, and paying agents. In addition to managing the day-to-day operations, TREAL staff lead the research, coordination, and implementation of new products and markets across Treasury. The team has a heavy focus on, and takes a leadership role in, evaluating and deploying the latest products and technologies (core trading platforms and new initiatives and technologies like CBDC, blockchain, AI, robotics, etc.) to create efficiencies, reduce risk, and advance thought leadership amongst WB’s peers and clients. TREAL staff participate in capacity-building programs for clients in these areas of expertise. TREAL staff recently co-led projects where the World Bank issued innovative digital bonds using blockchain technology and CBDC. In recognition of their efforts to advance capital markets and asset management, the TREAL team received several industry awards including for “Innovation in Reserves Management” (2021) and “Asset Servicing Initiative of the year” (2023). The team has twice been shortlisted for “Operations Team of the Year” award (2023 and 2024).  
  
Treasury ALM & Collateral Operations (TREAC) delivers operations support for asset and liability management, client risk management and collateral activities across IBRD, IDA and IFC. It is the operational engine of Treasury Client Solutions (TCS) and the central collateral management provider for WBG entities and RAMP clients. Team covers the full transaction lifecycle for funding and client hedging transactions, from trade setup and confirmation through settlement, rate fixings, payment events, exception handling, reconciliations and reporting. On the collateral side, it manages margining for OTC derivatives, MBS and futures, including daily margin calls, dispute resolution, CSA agreement administration, and monitoring of valuation.  
  
The team also supports long-term local currency investment transactions through IFC in countries where market solutions are not sufficiently available under the IDA–IFC Private Sector Window. The team works closely with front office, risk, finance, legal and technology teams, and with external counterparties, custodians, brokers and clearing organizations. Operating from Washington, D.C., Chennai and Sofia give the unit time-zone coverage and continuity. Beyond daily operations, TREAC leads systems implementation, convergence and digital transformation, with a strong focus on operational risk, controls and governance. The team operates on a common WBG operating model that aligns with IBRD, IDA and IFC practices, reduces duplication and manual handoffs, and delivers scalable, traceable, automation-ready processes.  
  
**Duties and Accountabilities:**  
The TRE Operations Chennai (TRECH) is an integral part of TREOP and is responsible for a variety of duties providing vital support across its operational divisions. It works closely with the Headquarters in Washington D.C and another shared services center in Sofia, Bulgaria. Under the guidance and supervision of a Team Lead and/or Functional Lead, the incumbent will have responsibilities for specific individual tasks/projects as well as for working as an integral part of the team in executing the Treasury Operation’s work program, while maintaining close relationships with the other Treasury departments.  
  
The incumbent’s primary responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, some combination of the following activities:  
  

* Work closely with the team to understand various facets of post-execution activities for fixed income, derivatives, and cash products to identify, analyze and prioritize process reengineering, automation and streamlining opportunities focusing on enhancing efficiency and accuracy.
* Support data collection, analysis, visualization, and report writing, including by innovatively using data, stories, and analytics to build powerful narratives.
* Support automation initiatives and projects relating to various sub-operational areas including maintenance of databases, dashboards, and reports using

jobs.description:
Portage Point is a Chicago-headquartered advisory, interim management and investment banking firm focused on serving the middle-market. Backed by New Mountain Capital, the firm has grown at over 30% annually since its founding in 2016 and today operates from ten offices across the United States and an office in Gurugram.

The firm delivers integrated financial and operational solutions across Transaction Advisory Services, Transaction Execution Services, Office of the CFO, Valuations, Performance Improvement, Turnaround & Restructuring and Investment Banking. Triple P India (TPI) is a strategic extension of the firm's platform, established to build a high-quality team that operates as an integrated part of U.S.-based teams. Professionals in TPI are involved in live engagements from the outset, contributing to analysis, execution and client deliverables in coordination with colleagues across the firm. The platform is designed to provide meaningful responsibility, direct exposure to senior leadership and long-term growth in a high-performance environment.

The Technology function serves as the strategic and operational core of the firm's AI platform – building the enterprise-grade infrastructure, AI product platform and data foundation that power Portage Point's AI-enabled advisory model. The team architects and operates the multi-tenant Portage Point Platform, the Enterprise Data Vault and a portfolio of 15 AI products spanning all practice lines. Working directly with US leadership and practice line leaders, the team translates the firm's ambition – a digital AI version of every advisory capability – into a governed, scalable and commercially deployable technology platform.

The Director, Enterprise Technology Build & Operations will report directly into the CTO, and holds unified accountability for Portage Point corporate technology environment and security posture. As firm scales, there is a need for robust IT operations, security and infrastructure planning and management. This Director ensures the firm's IT foundation is reliable, secure and audit-ready, integrating network and endpoint operations, Microsoft 365 governance, ITSM delivery, Zero Trust security architecture, SOC 2 Type II compliance and AI-specific security controls under a single point of ownership. The role approves IT operations and service management designs, security architecture decisions, vendor engagements and infrastructure implementation decisions within CTO-approved standards.

### **Responsibilities**

* Design and operate enterprise network infrastructure (for e.g. Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, dual-ISP failover, next-gen firewall) and Microsoft 365 environment (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive, Microsoft Purview) — covering tenant governance, licensing optimisation, DLP, retention and compliance features; manage the endpoint platform (Intune / Autopilot) including device enrolment, configuration, patch management and Conditional Access compliance enforcement
* Partner with the Head of Innovation and Product Manager on the platform roadmap, product intake from practice lines and release readiness
* Own the ITSM framework (ServiceNow or Jira Service Management) across incident, change, problem, service request and asset management; operate the IT service desk with P1–P4 SLA tiers, CSAT measurement and self-service knowledge base; personally own IT onboarding (Day 1 device, accounts and access) and offboarding (account revocation and access audit) within defined SLAs
* Design and enforce end-to-end security architecture with Zero Trust Network Access, micro-segmentation, Azure AD / Entra ID PIM, Conditional Access, application-layer security (OWASP Top 10 controls for all AI products), encryption, key management (Azure Key Vault) and AI-specific controls covering prompt injection defenses, model access controls and audit trails for all LLM interactions
* Own the SOC 2 Type II program – map platform and corporate IT controls to AICPA Trust Services Criteria, manage gap remediation, coordinate the external audit and produce the SOC 2 report for client and PE sponsor review; maintain TPI's information security policy suite; ensure compliance (personal data mapping, legal basis documentation, breach notification); manage the third-party and vendor risk assessment program
* Design and operate the vulnerability management program (Tenable.io or Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management) with automated scanning and enforced remediation SLAs; deploy and operate SIEM (Microsoft Sentinel) for identity, data exfiltration and AI-specific threat detection; own the Incident Response Plan and personally lead all P1 and P2 security incidents
* Lead and develop the combined IT and security team of engineers and analysts; own IT procurement (TCO analysis, with CTO) and the full vendor portfolio; design and test IT BCP and DR procedures; produce monthly ITSM performance review and quarterly security dashboard for the CTO and COO
* Support talent acquisition and firm development efforts
* Lead technical trainings on architecture, data engineering and AI infrastructure
* Contribute to a high-performing and inclusive engineering culture

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree from a top undergraduate program required
* 11 plus years in IT leadership with demonstrated ownership of both corporate IT operations (infrastructure, service management) and cybersecurity (architecture, compliance)
* Experience as the senior IT and security lead in a professional services, advisory or GCC environment; Big Four or comparable advisory GCC experience a strong differentiator
* Located in or willing to relocate to Gurugram, India
* ITIL 4 Managing Professional (or above) and CISSP, CISM or equivalent cybersecurity certification required; must have designed and operated a live ITSM framework and personally owned a SOC 2 Type II program
* Production experience with the Microsoft security stack at scale (500+ users): Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Purview; enterprise network infrastructure (Cisco Meraki, SD-WAN, NGFW); ZTNA implementation experiences a differentiator
* ServiceNow or Jira Service Management administration — must have built incident, change and asset management workflows from scratch; hands-on PAM (HashiCorp Vault or CyberArk) and secrets management program ownership; vulnerability scanning and CI / CD security integration (SAST / DAST) experience
* Prior exposure to private equity, M&A, or restructuring transaction environments preferred; ability to collaborate across US and India time zones and willingness to flex working hours for cross-border stakeholder engagement
* Superior written and verbal communication skills, including executive-ready presentation and reporting skills
* Proven ability to thrive in lean, fast-moving teams
* High attention to detail, responsiveness and ownership mindset
* Track record of success in high-pressure, client-facing environments

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
Own the revenue cycle, cash and controls for UK healthcare organisations, lead the receivables and payables teams, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). A senior role in Dubai with real ownership.

About Salvone

Salvone Technology Solutions FZCO is a Dubai technology consultancy that delivers end to end transformation for organisations in healthcare, hospitality and other highly regulated industries. We have deep roots in UK health and social care and a growing presence across the Middle East and Asia.

Our healthcare clients include mental health hospitals, residential and nursing care, supported living, children's services and specialist complex care. In hospitality and F&B, we support multi-location brands with ERP, supply chain and workforce systems built to scale. We own the full journey, from discovery to optimisation, and design every solution around how our clients really operate.

The role

We are hiring a Financial Controller to own the revenue cycle and day-to-day finance operations for the UK healthcare organisations our Finance Healthcare team supports. You will be accountable for cash, billing integrity and financial controls across receivables, payables and banking, lead the teams that deliver them, and deputise for the Director, Finance (Healthcare). It is a senior role with real ownership in a function that is building to a corporate standard.

Reports to

Director, Finance (Healthcare)

What you will do

- Revenue cycle: own it end to end for the UK healthcare entities, from funding and contracts to cash, with full accountability for results.

- Leadership: lead and develop the receivables and payables functions, and set their standards, priorities and performance rhythm.

- Billing integrity: run billing as a controlled monthly close in Odoo, with every variance explained and leakage fixed at source.

- Cash and working capital: improve cash conversion and the aged debt profile, and handle escalated disputes with NHS bodies, ICBs and Local Authorities.

- Controls: own the control environment across receivables, payables and banking, to an audit-ready standard.

- Reporting: give the Director, Finance (Healthcare) a clear, timely view of cash, risk and the decisions needed.

- Deputy: act for the Director, Finance (Healthcare) within delegated authority.

What you bring

- Professionally qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA).

- 6 to 8 years in finance, including at least 2 years leading a team.

- Proven ownership of a revenue cycle or receivables function in a multi-entity business, with measurable impact on cash.

- Strong control and close discipline; comfortable leading audit work.

- Advanced ERP capability (Odoo preferred), including process and reporting design.

- Senior stakeholder presence: credible with senior stakeholders, funders and banks.

Nice to have

- UK health and social care funding (NHS, ICBs, Local Authorities, Continuing Healthcare, self-funders); we teach this during induction.

- Experience with healthcare billing or practice management systems.

- GBP accounting and supporting UK operations from overseas.

- External audit support and building finance processes from scratch.

Working pattern and location

Full time, on site, Monday to Friday, 10:00 to 19:00.

Armada Tower 2, Jumeirah Lake Towers (JLT), Dubai.

How to apply

Please apply through our careers page using this link:

https://careers.salvone.com/jobs/financial-controller-255?utm\_campaign=Job+Campaign&utm\_medium=Website&utm\_source=Indeed+-+paid+ad

We review every application and will contact you about next steps. Questions? Email careers@salvone.com.

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Dubai: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Application Question(s):

* Have you led a finance team for at least 2 years? Please give the team size and your role.
* Have you worked with Odoo? If yes, which versions and modules?

Experience:

* Finance: 6 years (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CPA) (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa is transforming the future of banking and payments through Pismo, Visa's cloud-native core banking and issuer processing platform. Built to help financial institutions modernize legacy infrastructure, launch innovative products faster, and scale securely in real time, Pismo is enabling the next generation of digital banking experiences across the globe.

As an Implementation Director, you will lead the successful delivery of some of Visa and Pismo's most strategic client transformation programs. Working with leading banks, fintechs, and financial institutions, you will be responsible for orchestrating large-scale platform implementations that redefine how clients issue cards, process transactions, manage accounts, and deliver modern payment experiences to their customers.

This is a highly visible leadership role that sits at the intersection of technology, payments, and transformation. You will act as the executive sponsor for complex implementation programs, partnering with senior client stakeholders and cross-functional Visa and Pismo teams to drive delivery excellence, mitigate risk, and accelerate value realization.

The successful candidate will combine strategic thinking, executive stakeholder management, and deep program leadership capabilities to guide clients through critical modernization journeys, helping them move from legacy platforms to cloud-native infrastructure that supports future growth and innovation.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead end-to-end implementation and transformation programs for strategic Pismo clients, from contract signature and mobilization through go-live and post-launch stabilization.
* Serve as the primary executive point of contact for client leadership teams, building trusted relationships with C-suite, business, operations, technology, and transformation stakeholders.
* Drive governance, delivery strategy, program execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation across complex multi-workstream initiatives.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Client Success, Information Security, Risk, and Commercial teams to ensure successful delivery against client commitments.
* Establish executive steering committees and governance forums, providing clear visibility into program progress, milestones, risks, decisions, and business outcomes.
* Navigate complex organizational environments to align stakeholders, resolve delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across large-scale transformation programs.
* Champion implementation excellence while ensuring clients achieve measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, and accelerated time-to-value.
* Support clients through change management, platform adoption, and operational readiness as they transition onto Pismo's cloud-native infrastructure.
* Capture lessons learned and implementation best practices to continuously strengthen Visa and Pismo's delivery frameworks.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications:**

* 10 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 8 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters/ MBA/JD/MD) or at least 3 years of work experience with a PhD

  

* Over 15 years of experience in technology-driven financial services, with a strong focus on leading large-scale implementation and transformation projects for global fintech's and banks.
* Detailed technical knowledge of payments ecosystem in GCC countries, more specifically implementation and certification of Jaywan and AEP Switch in UAE
* Technical knowledge of payments and banking platforms operating in the cloud in a microservice architecture, with REST/JSON API’s and data streaming.
* Educational background in solutions architecture and software engineering. Cloud certifications are a plus.
* Having completed a core banking, payments transformation implementation from contract signature to production live.
* Expertise in building and scaling high-performing teams, with a hands-on leadership style that emphasizes mentorship, empowerment, and a culture of accountability.
* Proven ability to deliver complex, multi-market projects on time and within scope, leveraging advanced project management methodologies (Agile, Lean, and hybrid models) and a pragmatic, results-oriented approach.
* Recognized for forging strong, trust-based relationships with C-level executives, clients, and cross-functional partners, ensuring alignment and transparency throughout the implementation lifecycle.
* Adept at translating business strategy into actionable plans, optimizing processes, and driving continuous improvement through data-driven decision-making and KPI management.
* Russian speaker is highly desirable

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!
  
  
**Job Description**
We are seeking a driven, analytical, and relationship-focused
**Manager**
to own end-to-end account management for our key Health Insurance partners. In this role, you will act as the strategic bridge between our organization and partner insurers. You will be responsible for line-of-business (LOB) growth, product/plan integrations, Annual Operating Plan (AOP) delivery, day-to-day operations, and partner account profitability.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Account & Relationship Management
* Act as the single point of contact (SPOC) for assigned health insurance partners.
* Build and nurture strong relationships with insurer teams across underwriting, product, operations, technology, and claims.
* Conduct regular performance reviews (Weekly/Monthly/Quarterly Business Reviews) with insurer leadership to track targets and resolve operational bottlenecks.
* AOP Strategy & Business Growth
* Own the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) for the assigned health insurance accounts, driving revenue targets and product mix strategies.
* Analyze sales trends, conversion funnels, and customer personas to identify new growth opportunities within health insurance.
* Work with cross-functional teams (Growth, Marketing, Operations) to run targeted campaigns and drive premium volumes.
* Product Integration & Plan Management
* Drive end-to-end onboarding and integration of new health insurance products and plan variants onto the platform.
* Coordinate with product and tech teams to ensure seamless API integrations, user journeys, policy issue workflows, and UI/UX flows.
* Regularly audit live insurance products for feature accuracy, pricing precision, and regulatory/underwriting updates.
* Account Profitability & Portfolio Management
* Monitor and manage unit economics, commission structures, loss ratios, and partner margins to ensure account profitability.
* Analyze portfolio performance across parameters like persistency, renewal rates, claim settlement rates, and ticket sizes.
* Negotiate commercial terms, payouts, and exclusive product offerings with insurance partners alongside senior management.
* Operational Excellence & Support
* Oversee day-to-day operational workflows, including policy issuance, endorsements, cancellation requests, and claim escalations.
* Streamline operations between partner underwriters and internal operations to minimize drop-offs and improve turn-around times (TAT).
* Ensure strict adherence to IRDAI (or local regulatory authority) guidelines, compliance standards, and internal risk policies.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Revenue & Volume: Achievement of Monthly/Quarterly/Annual AOP targets for assigned insurer accounts.
* Account Profitability: Margins, commission compliance, and portfolio loss ratio targets.
* Product Efficiency: On-time product integration, zero feature/pricing discrepancies, and optimized conversion funnels.
* Operational SLA: Turn-around time (TAT) for policy issuance, endorsement resolution, and claim escalations.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Commerce, or related fields (MBA preferred).
* Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in insurance operations, account management, or category management in an Insurtech, Broker, Web Aggregator, or Health Insurance company.
* Domain Expertise: Thorough practical knowledge of Health Insurance operations, medical underwriting processes, MER workflows, endorsement rules, and claims processing (Cashless & Reimbursement).
* Technical & Data Skills: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, or reporting tools (Tableau/PowerBI) to track daily issuance metrics, funnel drops, and operational dashboards.
* Problem-Solving & Communication: Strong execution ability, detail-oriented mindset, and effective negotiation skills when liaising with insurer operations desks.
