**Delivery Head**

**Location - Ahmedabad, India (on-site; travel to client geographies as needed)**

**Reports to- CEO**

**Experience- 10+ years in software services, 6+ years leading multi-account delivery**

**Scope- Full delivery P&L across all practices: AI, Enterprise Platforms, Data Engineering, Custom Software,CRM,CMS**

**The role-**

The Head of Delivery owns every client engagement from signed SOW to renewal: scope, schedule, quality, margin and client satisfaction. This is a new leadership role, created to give our portfolio a single accountable owner as we scale AI-led and multi-system programs.

You will run delivery as a business, not a reporting function. You own the delivery P&L, the delivery operating model, and the managers who run our accounts. You collaborate with the CEO, who owns client relationships and new business, and with the CTO, who owns technology strategy, architecture standards and engineering practices.

**Key responsibilities:**

**Portfolio and P&L-**

· Own delivery revenue, gross margin and utilization across all active engagements.

· Run monthly portfolio reviews covering health, burn, forecast, risk and margin for every account.

· Approve staffing plans and resource allocation across fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team models.

· Cut revenue leakage: unbilled effort, scope creep, bench cost and write-offs.

**Delivery operating model-**

· Define and enforce one delivery framework: governance cadence, status reporting, change control, RAID management and release readiness.

· Set delivery KPIs and make them visible to leadership weekly.

· Embed AI-assisted delivery practices (planning, estimation, testing, documentation) in collaboration with the CTO.

· Standardize estimation so fixed-price bids reflect real delivery data.

**Client delivery governance-**

· Act as the senior escalation point for delivery issues and recover at-risk programs.

· Run delivery-side steering committees and quarterly reviews with client stakeholders, alongside the CEO.

· Turn delivery performance into expansion: surface phase-2 and adjacent opportunities to the CEO.

**Pre-sales support-**

· Validate scope, estimates, team shape and delivery risk on every proposal and SOW before it is signed.

· Join solutioning calls for large or high-risk deals.

**People and leadership-**

· Lead, hire and develop delivery and project managers; build a bench of account-level leaders.

· Run performance reviews and succession planning for the delivery organization.

· Work with HR and practice heads on capacity planning, skills mix and hiring forecasts.

**Quality and compliance-**

· Ensure delivery meets security and compliance obligations (GDPR, HIPAA, SOC 2 where applicable) and client audit requirements.

· Run post-mortems on failed milestones and drive the fixes into the framework.

**Must-have requirements:**

· 10+ years in IT services or product engineering services, with 6+ years leading delivery across multiple concurrent client accounts.

· Has owned a delivery organization of 150+ engineers.

· Direct P&L accountability: has been measured on margin and utilization, not only on schedule.

· Has run fixed-price, time-and-materials and dedicated-team engagements and can explain where each one loses money.

· Has delivered for enterprise clients in the US, UK, Europe or Middle East, including C-level stakeholder management.

· Has turned around at least one failing program; can describe what was changed and the result.

· Hands-on with delivery governance: estimation, change control, RAID, SOW review and resource planning tools.

· Technical enough to challenge an architecture or estimate; engineering background strongly preferred.

· Bachelor's degree in engineering or computer science.

**Nice to have:**

· Delivery leadership on AI/ML, GenAI or data engineering programs taken to production.

· Experience with Salesforce, SAP, NetSuite or HubSpot implementation programs.

· Delivery for regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences or BFSI.

jobs.title: Sales Manager – Events & IPs
jobs.description:
### **About the Role**

Inc42 is looking for a Sales Manager – Events & IPs to drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across its events, conferences, communities and proprietary intellectual properties.

The role will focus on acquiring new brand partners, identifying sponsorship opportunities and building customised partnership proposals for companies looking to engage with India's startup and business ecosystem.

The ideal candidate should have a strong background in B2B sales and business development, with experience selling sponsorships, event partnerships, advertising solutions or other high-value B2B offerings. They should be comfortable pitching to marketing heads, founders, CXOs and senior decision-makers, and have the ability to take ownership of the complete sales cycle.

**Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably across events, media, publishing, experiential marketing agencies, advertising agencies or consulting firms. Front-end experience of selling to startups, technology companies and/or BFSI companies is mandatory.

### **Why This Role Is Unique**

**Impact:** Inc42's platforms collectively reach more than 300 Mn people online and have brought together over 50,000 attendees and 1,000 speakers. You will be responsible for building commercial partnerships across some of India's most influential startup and business events.

**Inc42 Network:** Engage directly with founders, CXOs, marketing leaders, investors and decision-makers across startups, enterprises,and consulting firms.

**Own a Revenue Vertical:** Drive sponsorship and partnership revenue across Inc42's flagship events, conferences, communities and proprietary IPs. Take ownership of pipeline creation, client acquisition, deal closure, receivables and account growth.

**Build Strategic Partnerships:** Work with brands to create meaningful associations with Inc42's platforms through sponsorships, event integrations, customised experiences and long-term partnerships.

### **About Inc42 Media**

Inc42 is India's #1 startup media and intelligence platform, informing, educating and empowering startup founders, business leaders and decision-makers through journalism, market intelligence, industry-leading events, executive communities and learning platforms.

Since launching in January 2015, Inc42 has grown into an authoritative voice on India's startup economy. Our reporting has been followed and cited by leading global publications, including The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg, Reuters and TechCrunch.

Today, Inc42 tracks over 50,000 startups and delivers market intelligence through in-depth research reports, while bringing together the startup ecosystem through some of India's most influential conferences, executive communities and leadership experiences.

Over the years, Inc42 has built several business platforms and communities, including Inc42 Plus, Griffin Club and D2CX, creating opportunities for founders, operators, investors and business leaders to connect and engage.

### **What You'll Do**

**1. Business Development & Sponsorship Sales**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and acquire new sponsors and brand partners across startups, technology companies, BFSI, large enterprises and consumer brands.
* **Sponsorship Sales:** Drive revenue by selling sponsorship opportunities, event integrations, brand partnerships and customised association packages across Inc42's conferences and events including the D2C & Retail Summit and AI Summit, among others.
* **Pipeline Ownership:** Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective sponsors through market research, outbound prospecting, networking, referrals and industry connections.
* **Revenue Targets:** Own monthly and quarterly sales targets and drive revenue across assigned events, communities and IPs.
* **Consultative Selling:** Understand client marketing objectives and identify relevant opportunities for brands to engage with Inc42's audience through sponsorships, partnerships and event-led experiences.
* **Deal Closure:** Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, pitching, proposal development, negotiations, closure and receivables.
* **Conceptualising Partnerships:** Work with internal teams to develop customised sponsorship ideas and brand integrations beyond standard event sponsorship packages.

**2. Account Management & Partnerships**

* **Client Relationships:** Build and maintain relationships with marketing heads, brand managers, founders, CXOs and other key decision-makers.
* **Account Growth:** Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities across Inc42's events, communities and other IPs to increase revenue from existing clients.
* **Partnership Delivery:** Coordinate with event, marketing, content, production and operations teams to ensure that sponsorship commitments and brand deliverables are executed as agreed.
* **Long-term Partnerships:** Build a strong portfolio of recurring clients and strategic brand partnerships across multiple Inc42 properties.
* **Client Feedback:** Gather feedback from partners, identify opportunities to improve sponsorship offerings and build case studies and testimonials.

**3. Sales Strategy & Market Development**

* **Market Research:** Track industry trends, competitor events, sponsorship opportunities and brand marketing spends to identify potential revenue opportunities.
* **Partnership Strategy:** Identify brands and categories that align with Inc42's events, communities and audience, and develop relevant partnership propositions.
* **Competitive Benchmarking:** Monitor competing conferences, media platforms and event properties to understand sponsorship models, pricing and market positioning.
* **New Revenue Streams:** Identify opportunities to build new partnerships and monetisation avenues across Inc42's existing and upcoming IPs.
* **Pipeline Analysis:** Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline reports and revenue tracking. Share client insights and market feedback with internal teams to improve offerings and commercial strategy.

### **Who We Are Looking For**

* **Experience:** 4–6 years of experience in B2B sales, business development or sponsorship sales, preferably in events, media, publishing, experiential marketing, advertising agencies or consulting.
* **Industry Exposure:** Prior front-end sales experience with startups, technology companies and/or BFSI clients is mandatory.
* **Sponsorship & Partnership Sales:** Experience in selling event sponsorships, brand partnerships, conference integrations, media properties or other B2B solutions will be preferred.
* **New Business Acquisition:** A proven track record of generating new business, building a pipeline and achieving revenue targets.
* **Consultative Selling:** Ability to understand brand objectives and develop customised sponsorship and partnership proposals.
* **Relationship Management:** Comfortable engaging with founders, CXOs, marketing heads, brand managers and senior business stakeholders.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong negotiation, presentation and deal-closing skills, with the ability to manage revenue targets and account growth.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced startup environment and manage multiple sales opportunities independently.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering or an equivalent discipline.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, organisational skills and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and at least one CRM tool, with the ability to maintain accurate pipeline and sales records.

**full-time** and **remote.**

* Existing network of [30–50]+ contacts among GCC operations, IT, HR, or site leaders

* Solid understanding of managed services across IT (service desk, infrastructure, application management, cybersecurity) and BPO operations, with depth in at least two areas

* Level of familiarity with ITSM and ITIL practices, cloud and hybrid infrastructure operations, and security and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA etc) sufficient to lead credible client discussions

* Ability to work across sales, solutions, delivery, finance and security teams

Established enterprises worldwide — including RBC Capital Markets, Bosch, Heineken, PSA Singapore, United Airlines, Schwarz Group, and hundreds more — have built their business around Solace to enable intelligent, real-time experiences, modernize their application and integration landscape, and create seamless digital journeys for their customers, partners, and employees.

  

So, the next time you drive a car, order furniture online, fly in a plane, check your bank balance on your phone, your positive experience could be a direct result of our technology—and your hard work!

  

**About the role**

You will be the technical lead on Solace opportunities across Indian government bodies, public sector undertakings and the country's largest enterprises, working with Account Executives, system integrators and channel partners.

  

**What You’ll Do**

Be a trusted advisor, not just a demonstrator

* Partner with Account Executives to qualify opportunities, shape account strategies and drive deals to closure.
* Educate customers on event-driven architecture (EDA) and agentic AI, and challenge them to think bigger about their real-time data and AI strategy.
* Guide customers on integration patterns and modernization strategies, including the convergence of EDA and multi-agent AI systems.

  

Build champions and relationships

* Build deep relationships with technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and CTOs to CIOs, department heads and programme officers, and turn users into advocates.
* Run on-site visits, regular check-ins and discovery sessions to stay aligned with evolving needs.
* Translate the Solace platform, from Event Broker to Agent Mesh, into outcomes customers care about.

  

Own technical validation and proof of value

* Lead demonstrations, Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Proofs of Value (PoVs) that map to customer objectives, including tender-mandated PoCs and bid-stage technical presentations.
* Own the evaluation process, guiding prospects through workshops, hands-on trials and technical validation.

  

Government and public sector engagement

Serve as the technical lead for Solace opportunities across central and state government departments, public sector undertakings (PSUs), regulators, defense and strategic establishments, smart-city programmes and government-owned platforms, typically alongside system integrators and channel partners.

* Translate programme requirements into validated event-driven and agentic AI solutions for use cases such as citizen and agency services, transport and aviation operations, logistics and sustainment, command-and-control style situational awareness, and real-time data exchange between departments.
* Position Solace Event Brokers, Event Mesh and Agent Mesh for on-premises, private-cloud and air-gapped deployments, including constrained or intermittently connected sites, and for hybrid deployments across state data centers and Indian cloud regions.
* Speak credibly to Indian security, data and compliance expectations, including MeitY cloud empanelment and GI Cloud (MeghRaj) hosting, the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, CERT-In directions, and sector rules such as RBI and SEBI requirements where public sector banks and market infrastructure are involved.
* Support government acquisition motions: respond to RFPs, RFIs and Expressions of Interest, write technical bid volumes and compliance matrices, handle pre-bid queries and corrigenda, and work within tender portals, GeM, GFR procurement norms and L1 and QCBS evaluation models.
* Understand Make in India public procurement preferences and local-content requirements, and help partners position Solace within them.
* Enable system integrators, OEM partners and channel partners (for example, national and global SIs with large public sector practices) so they can qualify, architect and deliver Solace-based solutions to government customers.
* Align Solace with national modernization priorities such as Digital India, data-centric and interoperable platforms, open standards, and responsible AI adoption.

  

Large enterprise engagement

Lead technical engagements with India's largest enterprises, where scale, resilience and regulatory pressure make real-time event infrastructure a board-level topic.

* **Banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI):** real-time payments and transaction flows, market data distribution, core banking modernization, fraud and risk signals, and AI agents for operations and customer service, within RBI, SEBI and IRDAI expectations on resilience, outsourcing and data localization.
* **Telecom and digital platforms:** real-time provisioning, recharge and balance events, customer 360 and channel modernization at very high volumes.
* **Aviation and transport:** airport and airline operations, flight and baggage events, and partner data exchange across heavily siloed ecosystems.
* **Manufacturing and energy:** plant-to-cloud event meshes, IoT and MQTT connectivity, supply chain visibility and Industry 4.0 programmes.
* **Logistics and retail:** shipment and fleet tracking, order orchestration and omnichannel inventory events.
* Help enterprises evolve beyond batch and request/response integration, and move from legacy middleware (IBM MQ, TIBCO, ESBs) towards a distributed, event-driven enterprise that can support real-time AI.
* Work with global system integrators and consulting partners that run large Indian enterprise transformation programmes.

  

Evangelise event-driven architecture

* Show deep command of core EDA concepts and patterns: publish/subscribe, event sourcing, CQRS, event streaming, and choreography versus orchestration, applied to real Indian enterprise and government architectures.
* Articulate the business value of EDA to executive and technical audiences: faster time-to-insight, operational resilience, accelerated digital transformation, and the ability to scale AI applications on a live data fabric.
* Position Solace Event Brokers against Apache Kafka, IBM MQ, RabbitMQ, TIBCO and cloud-native brokers, and against locally hosted open-source deployments that customers often start with. Be ready to explain where multi-protocol support, hybrid and multi-cloud event mesh, enterprise-grade QoS and dynamic topic routing create clear differentiation, and to defend total cost of ownership in L1-driven evaluations.
* Guide customers through an EDA maturity model, from point-to-point integration and basic messaging to a distributed, event-driven enterprise ready for real-time AI and autonomous systems.

  

Solace Agent Mesh subject matter expert

* Serve as the field voice for Agent Mesh adoption in India, feeding real use cases and objections back to Product and GTM teams.

**Domicile Leader – Captive & Insurance Management – Abu Dhabi**
Are you ready to lead and grow a new captive and insurance management platform in a fast‑developing jurisdiction?
  
  
Do you enjoy combining technical expertise, operational discipline and market‑building with senior stakeholder engagement?
  
  
This is a permanent, full‑time office based role based in Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates.
  
  
**Aon is in the business of better decisions**
At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.
  
  
As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.
  
  
**What The Day Will Look Like**
As Domicile Leader, you will be responsible for establishing, leading and growing Aon’s Captive & Insurance Management (ACIM) presence in Abu Dhabi, acting as the principal local representative of ACIM in the market. A typical day may include:
  
  

* Building Aon’s captive management profile in Abu Dhabi, representing ACIM credibly with clients, prospects, regulators, advisors and industry stakeholders.
* Leading the day‑to‑day operations of the Abu Dhabi office to ensure disciplined execution, high‑quality client service and adherence to agreed service standards.
* Monitoring local regulatory and market developments and translating insights into practical actions for clients, colleagues and the wider EMEA Hub.
* Personally leading selected senior client and prospect relationships where local credibility, trust and market knowledge are critical.
* Collaborating with colleagues across Commercial Risk, Reinsurance, Risk Capital and other Aon teams to deliver integrated captive and risk‑financing solutions.
* Leading and developing colleagues in Abu Dhabi, setting the cultural tone and aligning objectives to office, Hub and ACIM priorities.
* Ensuring the office operates in accordance with the ACIM Risk Management Framework, Aon policies and relevant Abu Dhabi and UAE regulatory requirements.
* Working closely with the Hub Leader and other Domicile Leaders to align Abu Dhabi with Hub strategy, priorities and service delivery expectations.

**How This Opportunity Is Different**
This is a rare opportunity to build and shape Aon’s captive and insurance management presence in a growing domicile from the ground up. You will:
  
  

* Lead a strategically important market for Aon, positioning Abu Dhabi as a compelling captive jurisdiction for regional and multinational clients.
* Have direct visibility with senior leaders across ACIM and the wider EMEA Hub, with access to deep technical expertise, operational support and scalable resources.
* Play a central role in developing Aon’s relationships with local regulators and authorities, helping to shape the evolution of the captive market in Abu Dhabi.
* Work at the intersection of global risk‑financing expertise and local market knowledge, collaborating with colleagues across multiple solution lines to deliver integrated client outcomes.
* Build and develop a high‑performing local team and culture, with the autonomy to influence how the office grows over time while being supported by Aon’s global platform.

* Strong understanding of captives, risk financing concepts, insurance governance and the practical requirements of operating in a regulated jurisdiction.
* Proven ability to build relationships and external networks, and to represent an organization credibly with senior stakeholders, regulators, clients and market participants.
* Demonstrated experience leading teams, developing people and creating an inclusive, collaborative and accountable culture.
* Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder‑management skills, with strong organisational, problem‑solving and decision‑making capability and the resilience to operate in a developing market.
* Experience in the Middle East, Abu Dhabi, the UAE or another developing financial services, insurance or captive jurisdiction, and/or a relevant professional qualification (e.g. ACII, CPCU, ACCA) would be an advantage.

jobs.title: Presales Director
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Drive
  
  
At Vegapay, a bank's idea for a new credit card or credit line on UPI shouldn't take months to reach customers. We build the configurable infrastructure behind next-generation credit and payment programs for banks, NBFCs and fintechs. We're looking for a Director, Presales to lead the function that turns a first conversation with a bank into a signed program: the person who can walk into a CXO room, understand the business problem and show how Vegapay solves it.
  
  
This isn't a pure sales role, and it isn't a pure solutioning role. You'll own the technical and commercial story of every strategic deal, from discovery and demos to RFP responses, proofs of concept and the handover to delivery.
  
  
As Director, Presales, you'll sit between our banking and fintech prospects, sales leadership, product and engineering. You'll shape how Vegapay is positioned across credit cards, credit line on UPI (CLOU), embedded lending, BRE, rewards, ledgering and reconciliation, and you'll build the team and playbooks that make every pursuit faster and sharper than the last.
  
  
You'll work directly with senior stakeholders at banks and NBFCs (heads of cards, lending, risk, technology and compliance) to understand how they operate, find the problems that matter most and define clear success criteria. Then you'll win them over with a solution they can see working. Success in this role takes deep fintech domain knowledge, credibility with technical and business leaders, and the ability to turn an ambiguous requirement into a clear, winning proposal.
  
  
The Hats You Will Wear
  
  

* Own the presales strategy and function end to end: set the operating model, targets and quality bar across discovery, solutioning, demos, RFPs and proofs of concept.
* Lead discovery with bank, NBFC and fintech prospects to map their current stack, workflows and regulatory constraints, identify the real bottleneck and define measurable success criteria.
* Partner with the CEO and sales leadership on strategic pursuits: qualify opportunities, build the win strategy and join CXO-level meetings as the solution and domain voice for Vegapay.
* Design tailored solutions across credit cards, credit line on UPI, embedded lending, BRE, rewards, forex, ledgering and reconciliation, with clear architecture, integration approach and timelines.
* Own RFP/RFI responses and commercial proposals, working with product, engineering, legal and finance on scope, pricing, SLAs and risk.
* Run high-impact demos and proofs of concept that show the configurable platform working on the prospect's own use cases, including sandbox and demo environments that stay current.
* Build, mentor and scale a team of solution architects, presales consultants and solution engineers, with clear career paths and performance standards.
* Create the presales playbook: reusable solution blueprints, battlecards, competitive positioning, objection handling, ROI and business-case models, and a library of RFP answers.
* Act as the voice of the market inside Vegapay: feed prospect needs, competitive gaps and regulatory shifts (RBI, NPCI) back to product and engineering to shape the roadmap.
* Hand over won deals cleanly to implementation and customer delivery, so what was promised in the pursuit is what gets built.
* Track and report presales metrics: pipeline coverage, win rate, sales-cycle length, POC conversion and RFP turnaround time.

The Perfect Fit
  
  

* 10 - 12 years of experience in presales, solution consulting or solution architecture at a fintech, payments or core-banking/card-processing vendor, with at least 5 years leading a presales or solutions team.
* Proven record of winning large, multi-stakeholder deals with banks, NBFCs or large fintechs, from first discovery to signed contract.
* Deep domain knowledge of at least one of credit cards, lending (BNPL, credit lines, personal loans), UPI or payments processing, including how card programs and lending products work end to end.
* Strong technical grounding: APIs, microservices, integrations, cloud deployment, security and data-privacy norms, enough to lead architecture conversations with a bank's CTO and CISO.
* Working knowledge of the Indian regulatory landscape: RBI guidelines on digital lending and credit cards, NPCI's UPI ecosystem, PCI-DSS and data localisation.
* Strong executive presence and storytelling: comfortable presenting to CXOs and boards, and equally comfortable in a whiteboard session with architects.
* Experience building and mentoring high-performing presales teams, with clear ownership and a culture of accountability.
* Skilled at RFP/RFI responses, commercial proposals, ROI and business-case modelling.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to work across sales, product, engineering and legal in a fast-moving startup.
* B.E./B.Tech in Computer Science or Engineering; an MBA is a plus.

Your Edge Over the Rest
  
  

* Hands-on experience with card management systems, credit line over UPI, loan management systems, ledger and reconciliation flows, or card network integrations (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay).
* An existing network among senior leaders at Indian banks, NBFCs and fintechs.
* AI-native: you use AI tools in your own work, and you can show prospects how AI-led workflows improve underwriting, servicing and operations.
* You've built a presales function from scratch, or scaled one through a sharp growth phase.
* Full ownership: a deal is yours until the program is live, not just until the contract is signed.
* Highest standards: you won't promise a bank what the platform can't deliver, and you care about getting the solution right the first time.

The Problem We're Solving
  
  
Financial institutions today are held back by legacy systems that are slow, rigid, and expensive to scale. Launching or evolving credit, lending, and UPI products often takes months, requires heavy engineering effort, and limits the ability to create personalized customer experiences.
  
  
At the same time, customer expectations have changed - speed, flexibility, and tailored financial products are no longer optional. Banks and fintechs need infrastructure that allows them to innovate quickly, adapt continuously, and scale without friction.
  
  
This is where we come in. Resource management associate will operate as the day-to-day staffing and workforce planning coordinator for Life Sciences. The role requires strong verbal and written communication, self-direction, comfort working with stakeholders from consultants through Partners/Directors, strong data-analysis skills, and the ability to manage a high volume of concurrent requests with accuracy and follow-through. The individual should be technology proficient, able to learn new systems quickly, and able to work hours that provide meaningful overlap with U.S. East Coast mornings and, when needed, UK stakeholders.

The Resource Management associate will help maintain an accurate, forward-looking view of staff availability and project demand, coordinate staffing changes, and support practice leadership with the data and follow-through needed to make timely staffing decisions. The role works closely with project managers, service-line leads, people managers, and practice leadership to balance project needs, employee skills and availability, utilization, and project economics.

**Specific responsibilities include:**

* Own day-to-day staffing coordination and serve as a central point of contact for project staffing requests, extensions, releases, holds, and schedule changes.
* Maintain accurate staffing plans and workplans in ProjectHub and related resource-management systems, including start/end dates, allocations, extensions, and temporary availability.
* Proactively follow up with project managers to confirm staffing plans, close outstanding requests, and ensure requested changes are completed and communicated.
* Monitor current and near-term staff availability, including partial availability and upcoming roll-offs, and identify potential staffing conflicts, over-allocation, underutilization, and opportunities to redeploy capacity.
* Match staffing needs with available resources based on skills, experience, availability, development interests, and project requirements; coordinate with project and service-line leaders when tradeoffs or conflicts require decisions.
* Support weekly staffing discussions by preparing the underlying data, tracking open needs and decisions, maintaining notes/action items, and following through on agreed staffing updates.
* Analyze staffing, utilization, scheduled hours, project budgets, and related financial data to identify exceptions and actionable insights for leadership.
* Support project financial and capacity-management activities, including monitoring scheduled versus budgeted hours, identifying excess or remaining hours, flagging potential over/under-budget conditions, and helping ensure staffing changes are reflected accurately in systems.
* Coordinate with project teams on special project setup and revenue/staffing requirements where standard scheduling does not fully capture the engagement model.
* Maintain high data quality across staffing tools and reports by cross-checking requests against current project and availability information before making changes.
* Adapt to evolving staffing processes and tools, including changes to ProjectHub, Engagement Hub, forecasting, and other firm resource-management systems.

**Qualifications:**

* BA/BS degree required.
* 3+ years of relevant work experience preferred, including experience in resource management, staffing operations, project management, consulting operations, workforce planning, or a similarly fast-paced environment.
* Strong interpersonal, customer-service, conflict-resolution, and negotiation skills, with the confidence to work effectively across organizational levels.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; able to follow up persistently and professionally with busy stakeholders and close the loop on open actions.
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to interpret staffing, utilization, capacity, and project financial data and translate it into clear actions.
* Highly organized and self-motivated; able to prioritize and execute numerous concurrent staffing requests and recurring processes with limited supervision.
* Strong proficiency with Excel and Microsoft Office, including manipulating and analyzing spreadsheets; demonstrated ability to learn new enterprise systems quickly.
* Experience with staffing, workforce-planning, project-management, ERP, or forecasting systems is strongly preferred.
* Ability to build trusted working relationships with project managers, practice leadership, people managers, and consultants while balancing business needs and employee considerations.

**About Us:**

Opensity Solutions is the largest tech‑enabled managed services organization serving leading law firms, financial institutions and professional services firms. At Opensity, we provide integrated operational platforms, automation and advisory services that enable clients to modernize operating models, reduce cost and accelerate growth. Our capabilities include IT and technology solutions, document processing and administrative support, marketing and communications, billing and AP/AR services, records and information governance, workflow automation, consulting and hospitality and facilities services.

**Our Mission:**

Our mission is to provide modernized technology platforms, elevated technology support, and valuable insights, empowering our clients to excel in what they do best.

Opensity Solutions delivers technology projects for professional services and enterprise clients. Our Project Managers own those projects — scope, commitments, budget, and the client relationship — and they are at their best when they are spending their time there, rather than rebuilding a resource schedule or chasing a missing time entry. The PMO Delivery Operations Coordinator takes that resource coordination load off them.

You will own the resource assignment and scheduling process across the projects you support: building and maintaining schedules against planned effort, processing modifications and confirming their downstream impact, monitoring availability and over-allocation across both project and support demand, and improving how scheduling works over time.

You will assist the PMO Director in monitoring time entry compliance in ServiceNow — reviewing entries and narratives for accuracy and routing corrections through the Project Manager and the engineer's resource manager, who are responsible for their team's accuracy.

And you will assist Project Managers with project plans, WBS structures, task records, RIDAC logs, change order documentation, recurring reporting, and meeting materials, working at their direction and with their approval.

We are looking for someone with 1–3 years in project coordination, project support, PMO analyst, scheduling, or project administration on technology projects, with hands-on exposure to a PPM platform — ServiceNow strongly preferred.

Experience with resource scheduling or assignment is the closest match to the core of this role, and experience reviewing timekeeping or billing data for accuracy is a significant advantage. jobs.description:
**The Role**

We’re looking for an ambitious, commercially driven, and well-connected individual to drive origination & corporate sales across MENA for the Finverity Capital business. You’ll be expected to personally bring in clients and close deals, and help to shape Finverity’s growth across key markets. This is a high-impact, front-line role for someone who knows how to win trust, structure deals, and deliver results.

**What You’ll Do**

**Own the Pipeline**

* Personally originate high-quality trade finance deals with mid-market corporates.
* Leverage your existing network to bring in new business quickly.
* Identify, engage, and build consensus with decision-makers in the prospect organisations.
* Prioritise speed-to-mandate with a strong commercial close rate.
* Own your numbers and KPIs.

**Close and Collaborate**

* Own the deals all the way through to the funding stage, including speaking to relevant funders in the Finverity ecosystem when appropriate.
* Collaborate with other members of the Finverity Capital team and cross-functionally with risk, legal, marketing and operations teams to ensure frictionless execution.
* Work directly with the CEO & Co-founder with associated access and accountability.

**Shape the Go-To-Market Strategy**

* Help refine Finverity’s go-to-market approach for the MENA region & beyond.
* Identify new industries, products, and market segments to accelerate growth.
* Build and manage strategic partnerships that feed the pipeline.
* Work with the marketing team to build out and execute marketing campaigns.
* Represent Finverity in client meetings and relevant conferences.

Requirements
  
  

**What We’re Looking for**

We’re looking for someone who knows how to bring in deals and who truly understands the dynamics of working capital and trade finance in the MENA region, especially in the UAE. This isn’t just about theory or strategy; it’s about knowing the clients, the structures, and how to get things done in the real world.

Here’s what would make you a great fit:

* You’ve spent
  **5+ years**
  in and around trade finance or working capital solutions, and you know the space inside and out. Fintech experience is a strong plus.
* You’ve
  **excelled in customer-facing roles selling to CFOs and Treasurers,**
  whether at a bank or fintech, or you have held a senior corporate finance role yourself.
* You have a
  **deep understanding of the working capital challenges**
  mid-market corporates face, because you’ve seen them first hand.
* Your
  **network in the MENA region is strong**
  , especially in the UAE. You know who the decision-makers are, and they know you. Global network is a plus.
* You’ve
  **personally originated and closed significant deals**
  , not as a supporting player, but as the one leading the charge.
* You
  **understand how to structure trade and supply chain finance transactions and programmes**
  , and can spot a strong opportunity from the first conversation, or quickly let go of one that doesn’t fit.
* You’re
  **comfortable assessing risk**
  and thinking like a credit officer, even if you're not one, enough to pre-qualify deals and ask the right questions.
* You’re
  **commercially sharp**
  , strategic when needed, and hands-on when it counts.
* You’re
  **confident in high-stakes conversations**
  and know how to build trust at C-level.
* Most importantly, you’re someone who
  **takes ownership, moves quickly,**
  and genuinely enjoys building relationships that last.

Benefits
  
  

**Why Join Us?**

* Help reshape how capital flows into real economies and make a difference.
* Take a leadership role in a high-growth fintech with global ambition.
* Work alongside a passionate, diverse, caring and execution-focused team.
* Be part of a company with strong momentum, clear market fit, and backing.
* Competitive compensation, flexible working environment and generous performance-based upside, plus UAE residence visa sponsorship and medical insurance.

**Job Description**
Vice President, Restructuring
  
  
**Location:**
Dubai, United Arab Emirates
  
  
**About Jefferies**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm, delivering strategic advisory, financing and capital markets solutions to corporate, sponsor and institutional clients worldwide.
  
  
Our Restructuring and Liability Management Advisory practice advises companies, shareholders, lenders, sovereign-related entities and other stakeholders on complex capital structure challenges, balance sheet optimisation, distressed situations, recapitalisations and strategic alternatives. As activity across the Middle East continues to evolve, we are looking to expand our Dubai-based team with the addition of an experienced Vice President.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to join a growing franchise and play a leading role in advising clients across the Middle East, North Africa and broader EMEA region on complex restructuring, liability management and special situations transactions.
  
  
The successful candidate will work directly with senior bankers and clients, leading transaction execution while helping to develop and grow Jefferies' restructuring advisory presence across the region.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead the execution of restructuring, refinancing, recapitalisation, liability management and distressed M&A mandates across the Middle East and broader EMEA region.
* Manage all aspects of transaction execution, including financial analysis, stakeholder coordination, due diligence and project management.
* Develop and review complex financial models, liquidity analyses, business plans, capital structure assessments and valuation materials.
* Prepare high-quality client presentations, strategic reviews, board materials and transaction documentation.
* Work closely with corporate clients, financial institutions, sovereign-related entities, private equity sponsors and creditor groups.
* Support Managing Directors in business development efforts, market coverage and origination activities.
* Identify and evaluate new restructuring and special situations opportunities across the region.
* Lead and mentor Analysts and Associates, ensuring high-quality work product and professional development.
* Coordinate effectively with legal advisers, accounting firms, lenders, investors and other external stakeholders throughout transaction processes.

Requirements
  
  

* 6-10+ years of relevant experience within an investment bank, restructuring advisory practice, financial advisory firm or leading professional services organisation.
* Strong transaction experience across restructuring advisory, special situations, leveraged finance, debt advisory or corporate finance.
* Excellent financial modelling, valuation and analytical skills.
* Strong understanding of debt products, capital structures, credit markets and restructuring solutions.
* Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and execute transactions in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience interacting with senior management teams, boards, lenders and investors.
* Exceptional presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong leadership capabilities with experience managing and developing junior team members.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline.

**About Us**
Jefferies is a leading global, full-service investment banking and capital markets firm that provides advisory, sales and trading, research, and wealth and asset management services. With more than 40 offices around the world, we offer insights and expertise to investors, companies, and governments.

As a result, we are able to pool our collective insights and intelligence to provide fresh and innovative thinking for our clients.

jobs.description:
**Financial Advisory Service Offerings**
----------------------------------------

Teneo guides companies and their stakeholders through periods of uncertainty and stress to assess options, address financing and/or balance sheet stresses, create liquidity headroom, reduce costs, improve profitability, more efficiently run their businesses and turnaround and/or exit underperforming businesses, whilst communicating appropriately with stakeholders. Our expert team also brings market-leading experience in developing and delivering contingency plans and insolvencies across multiple jurisdictions, providing credible fallback plans to protect value or helping to shape and affect a restructuring.

We advise clients on strategies and actions to create, protect and realize value across the full spectrum of stressed or distressed transactions and industries, while helping leaders solve complex business challenges and achieve their goals. No two situations are the same, and our advice and approach is tailored to each set of circumstances and client priorities.

**The Role**
------------

As part of ambitious growth plans for our already successful Middle East Financial Advisory business, we are looking for Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors to join our Financial Advisory team in the UAE. Our Managers, Associate Directors, Directors and Managing Directors have the opportunity to lead on a diverse range of engagements across different sectors and geographies, with responsibility for leading projects or key workstreams, managing junior staff and supporting senior leadership in client-facing delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Client service

* Lead and/or manage key parts of engagements, providing support to senior team members or often directly to the Senior Managing Directors.
* Support client management teams in preparing and challenging business plans, short and/or longer term cash flow forecasts and restructuring plans.
* Providing cash management services to clients to identify working capital and other cash flow improvements.
* Reviewing and stress-testing integrated business plans, budgeting and forecasting models using a fact-based, data driven approach, including KPI definition, data visualization, reporting automation and touchless forecasting.
* Reviewing detailed, integrated 3 statement forecasts (profit & loss, cashflow and balance sheet), and discounted cashflow (DCF).
* Preparing report outputs that may range from business plan documentation and board reports when working for a company, through to preparation of independent business reviews when working for creditors.
* Developing, analysing and presenting restructuring, refinancing and/or insolvency options using input from other teams, e.g. insolvency or tax analysis, sector and financial modelling.
* Liaising with the Company’s legal advisors to understand key aspects of legal documentation and also drive any documentation processes (term sheets, waivers, loan documentation etc.).
* Preparation of engagement letter(s) and ensuring adherence to all compliance requirements to support financial and risk management.
* Apply an understanding of engagement economics.

Knowledge acquisition

* Build client relationship skills, sector knowledge and continue to develop leadership skills.
* Continue to build technical expertise, broader business advisory and people management skills.
* Understand the market, topical issues and our Financial Advisory propositions.

People and leadership

* Support practice and talent development.
* Provide on-job coaching and development to staff.
* Develop junior staff outside of jobs through appraising and mentoring.
* Support wider Financial Advisory training initiatives.
* Manage diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognised for their contribution.

Business development

* Own elements of business development including actively supporting business development activities, building and expending your own contact network and supporting Middle East Financial Advisory marketing and sales activities.
* Participate in existing business development programmes and key client accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand jobs as well as opportunities to provide wider Teneo services to existing clients.
* Take responsibility for leading marketing initiatives aimed at specific channels to market, or events.

Examples of the types of projects you would be expected to work on include:

* Company diagnostic, turnaround planning, and implementation
* Debt restructuring
* Short-term cash flow forecasting and cash management office set-up
* Preparation and validation of business plans
* Independent business reviews and options analysis
* Working capital management
* Operational cost reduction
* Interim management and active PMO leadership

**Key Skills & Experience**
---------------------------

Basic Qualifications

* A minimum of 5 years Financial Advisory experience gained either as an advisor within a professional services company, consultancy or investment bank.
* Very strong analytical skills, including: business analytics, business planning, short term cash flows, financing options.
* Understanding of financial statements and related data to assess historical financial performance and future outlook for client companies and prospects.
* Good understanding of the Financial Advisory marketplace, its trends, and key players (principals and advisers).
* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong project management skills, with ability to lead mid-large teams and develop people.
* Understanding of debt markets, banking, loan agreements and other relevant financial and legal documentation.

Preferred Qualifications

* An Accounting degree and/or Qualified Accountant.
* Arabic language skills are strongly preferred, but not mandatory.
* Experience in the UAE or KSA market is strongly preferred.

**About Teneo**
---------------

Teneo is a leading global financial advisory powerhouse that provides innovative, market leading solutions from recognized experts across offices in the UK, US, The Caribbean and Bermuda, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia Pacific, supported by Teneo’s wider global offering of c.2,000 professionals. We offer our clients unique, integrated solutions to complex issues.

Teneo’s full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial advisory and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organisational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs. The breadth of our offering and our ability to provide bespoke and seamless advisory services, on either a standalone or integrated basis, makes us truly unique. Teneo's Middle East Financial Advisory senior leadership team has worked on the majority of the largest and most complex situations completed in the Middle East over the past 2 decades.

It oversees the development lifecycle and provides senior technical guidance to IT management and the technical team. * Design and document technical functionality, data flow, infrastructure, interfaces, and integrations end-to-end, so solutions are clear and buildable.
* Lead the design of cost-effective, audit-ready solutions with data integrity, lineage, and traceability, so they meet FINTRAC, Internal Audit and PMM standards.
* Define precise processing logic across multiple platforms, so specifications meet reporting and control requirements.

**Strategic Planning:**

* Contribute to the EAML technology roadmap, so it aligns with the bank's vision, regulatory landscape, and risk strategy.
* Lead multiple complex initiatives while maintaining consistency across the platform, so delivery stays coherent and adopts best practice.

* Drive and moderate design review sessions, so issues are resolved, and decisions are made.
* Mentor and support junior designers and developers through knowledge sharing and problem solving, so team capability grows.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Drive continuous improvement and adopt best practice across the platform, so quality and consistency increase.
* Champion control, reconciliation, and quality-by-design in every artifact, so solutions remain audit-ready.
* Evaluate and introduce emerging technology (cloud, AI/ML, automation, real-time data), so EAML's detection, reporting and operational capability improves.

**Operational Efficiency:**

* Introduce automation and modern data technology, so manual effort and operational risk are reduced.
* Evaluate AI/ML, cloud-native data platforms and advanced analytics, so detection accuracy, scalability and efficiency improve.
* Recommend improvements to business processes and designs, so operations are more efficient and effective.

**Learning and Development:**

* Build knowledge in financial crime, regulatory technology, and modern data architecture, so designs reflect current practice.
* Stay current with technology trends, particularly AI/ML for AML, real-time monitoring, and cloud-native data platforms, so solutions stay ahead of change.
* Adopt new tools and trends quickly, so the team can use them effectively.

* Internal: Collaborates with the project team to deliver designs and solutions.
* Internal: Works with compliance partners and oversight functions to align designs with regulatory expectations and obtain design approvals.
* Internal: Partners with business and engineering teams to define and shape solution architecture.
* Internal: Advises IT management on complex decisions and technology selection.
* Internal: Mentors junior designers and developers to share knowledge and solve problems.

* As an employee of CIBC, the incumbent must comply with all applicable CIBC and Line of Business policies, standards, guidelines, and controls.

**AUTHORITIES/DECISION RIGHTS:**

* As a key contributor to the business unit, this job has the authority to recommend changes to business processes in order to enhance operational efficiency and effectiveness.

**JOB DIMENSIONS:**

* Guides and mentors’ junior designers and developers.
* EAML platforms covering FINTRAC reporting (LCTR, STR, EFTR), transaction monitoring, customer risk rating, sanctions screening (SLMS, AMPECS) and case management.

**Experience:**
7+ years of experience

* 7+ years' experience designing, developing, implementing, and supporting enterprise data and application solutions.

**Experience:** 12–16 Years

### **Role Overview**

  
  

We are looking for an experienced Associate Director – ESG & Sustainability to lead enterprise-wide sustainability consulting, ESG transformation, and digital implementation engagements. The candidate should have extensive experience in ESG strategy, sustainability reporting, carbon accounting, regulatory compliance, and sustainability transformation initiatives.

**About Parexel**

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an Associate Director, Patient Safety Medical Writing to join our team in **Bengaluru**/**Hyderabad** in a **hybrid / on-site** capacity. As an Associate Director, Patient Safety Medical Writing, you will provide strategic direction and executive oversight across regional Safety Services, ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and alignment with organizational objectives. This position plays a key role in patient safety oversight, pharmacovigilance (PV) operations, and technology-driven safety innovation that supports clinical research and advances new treatments for patients.

Responsibilities include setting regional strategy and resource allocation, ensuring quality and regulatory compliance, leading people development and PV automation initiatives, and supporting client and business development, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence safety service outcomes.

You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through strategic leadership, pharmacovigilance automation and digital transformation, and client partnership. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Associate Director, Patient Safety can explore career paths and expand skills across clinical research.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive strategic direction and resource allocation for regional Safety Services in partnership with the Senior Director, and provide input into business plans, budgets, growth strategies, and global expansion.
* Align Safety Services with global organizational strategy, lead continuous improvement of regional processes and procedures, and collaborate with key stakeholders to ensure harmonized global pharmacovigilance operations.
* Ensure regulatory compliance, quality standards, and departmental procedures across regional Safety Services, demonstrating effective compliance and risk mitigation strategies and maintaining current knowledge of professional standards and safety regulations.
* Support audits and inspections related to pharmacovigilance processes and automation and respond to audit reports and address identified issues.
* Lead the implementation and optimization of pharmacovigilance automation tools and digital solutions, including supervising testing and validation of system upgrades and new technology implementations.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives to accelerate digital transformation in pharmacovigilance, assess emerging technologies, and develop and execute innovation roadmaps that enhance efficiency and compliance.
* Analyze performance metrics of automated safety processes, drive continuous improvement, and manage technology budgets and resource allocation for digital safety initiatives.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop team members through personnel management, recruitment, training, performance evaluation, and professional development, while fostering team building, morale, and motivation.
* Design and supervise technology-related training programs for the patient safety organization and team adoption of new safety technologies, and support the Global Head of Safety Services in training program development.
* Support Project Managers and team leaders to deliver projects to expected standards of productivity, quality, compliance, and revenue, oversee projects or processes for clients based on team size, complexity, and span of control, and provide project updates with forecasting and resourcing assessments to patient safety management.
* Oversee efficient budgeting and financial monitoring to maximize the profitability of assigned projects, manage individual, partner, stakeholder, and customer relationships and performance, and ensure appropriate changes in scope are escalated and executed.
* Deliver expert-level Safety Services consultation to internal teams, external partners, and clients, and represent the Safety Services organization at international conferences.
* Contribute strategic and project planning intelligence to proposal generation, support market and business development initiatives, attend business development meetings, bid defenses, and governance meetings, and provide Safety Services expertise and training across the organization.

**You'll thrive in this role if you bring:**

* Strengths in deep clinical, regulatory, and medical expertise, strategic leadership, and stakeholder management
* Experience working in clinical research, healthcare, or a regulated environment
* The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, with excellent negotiation skills
* An adaptable mindset, enthusiasm for learning, and a patient-focused approach
* Comfort working with pharmacovigilance automation and AI tools, digital safety solutions, and multi-region PV processes

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in Pharmacy, Nursing, Life Science, or another health-related field, or equivalent qualification or work experience
* 15+ years of experience in Safety Services, including demonstrated success in clinical, medical, or scientific domains and substantial senior-level clinical experience with progressive responsibilities
* Proven people management experience, including leading high-performing teams in professional services environments
* Comprehensive understanding of pharmacovigilance operations, clinical research methodologies, drug development processes, and global regulatory frameworks, with an excellent understanding of International Council for Harmonisation (ICH), Council for International Organizations of Medical Sciences (CIOMS), and Good Pharmacovigilance Practice (GVP) requirements, including Safety Quality standards
* Experience with automation and AI in pharmacovigilance
* Established history of successful business development and client relationship management
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

If this job doesn't sound like the next step in your career, but perhaps you know of someone who'd be a perfect fit, send them the link to apply!

Job Description:  
CGI Advantage is a large enterprise product portfolio supporting complex government operations across Financials, HRM/Payroll, Procurement, Framework, Analytics and related capabilities.  
As we evolve our Product Engineering organization toward stronger end-to-end Build & Run accountability, we are looking for a Director – Product Engineering Capability to build and sustain the functional, domain and specialist capabilities required across the Advantage portfolio.  
The Director will be accountable for ensuring that Advantage has the right capability, in the right roles, at the right level of maturity, when the business needs it. The role will establish common capability standards, strengthen domain and functional depth, build leadership and specialist pipelines, reduce critical-person dependencies and enable scarce expertise to be leveraged effectively across products.  
This is not a traditional learning or training role. It is a senior Product Engineering leadership position working closely with Product Engineering Directors, Product Leaders and functional leaders to ensure that the organization has the capability required to deliver product outcomes today while building the skills required for the future.

**Your future duties and responsibilities**

Key Responsibilities  
Capability Strategy & Workforce Readiness  

* Define the capability strategy and operating model across critical Product Engineering roles including functional/product roles, business analysis, domain SMEs, solution architecture and specialist engineering disciplines.
* Translate product strategy, roadmap, modernization, SaaS, cloud and AI priorities into future capability requirements.
* Develop product- and portfolio-level capability maps identifying critical skills, capacity risks, succession gaps and future capability needs.
* Ensure persistent/core capabilities and shared specialist capabilities are appropriately identified and developed.

Role & Competency Model  

* Establish clear role charters, competency expectations and proficiency models for critical roles.
* Create consistent expectations across Product Lines while allowing appropriate domain specialization.
* Define career and progression pathways that build deep functional, domain and technical expertise.

Talent Depth & Succession  

* Build strong pipelines for critical roles and reduce dependence on individual experts.
* Drive succession and readiness planning for business-critical positions.
* Enable mobility of talent and specialist expertise across Product Lines.
* Partner with Engineering Directors and leadership on build/buy/borrow decisions for emerging capability requirements.

Capability Excellence & Communities  

* Establish and strengthen communities of practice and capability forums across Advantage.
* Drive common methods, standards, reusable patterns, templates, accelerators and knowledge assets.
* Promote adoption of leading engineering, solutioning, analysis and product practices across teams.
* Ensure lessons and capabilities developed in one Product Line can be effectively leveraged across the broader portfolio.

Transformation & Future Skills  

* Lead capability transformation required for the evolving Build & Run model.
* Accelerate skills in AI-assisted engineering, cloud/SaaS, automation, modern architecture, product engineering and data-driven delivery.
* Identify opportunities where capability improvements can materially improve quality, productivity, predictability and engineering effectiveness.
* Create mechanisms for rapidly developing and scaling new capabilities as technology and market needs evolve.

Partnership with Product Engineering  

* Partner closely with Product Engineering Directors to understand capability demand and delivery challenges.
* Ensure capability development remains grounded in real Product Engineering outcomes rather than becoming a centralized or theoretical function.
* Support product organizations with the right specialist capability while avoiding unnecessary organizational hand-offs or approval layers.
* Provide transparent visibility into capability health, gaps, risks and readiness.

Capability Measurement  

* Establish a capability health framework and measurable indicators.
* Track areas such as critical-role coverage, proficiency maturity, succession readiness, capability-gap closure, specialist availability, mobility and reduction in key-person dependencies.
* Demonstrate tangible impact of capability initiatives on engineering quality, productivity and organizational effectiveness.

**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**

Must to have skill:  

* Typically 18+ years of experience in enterprise product engineering, software/product organizations, technology consulting or equivalent environments.
* Significant leadership experience in a large, complex, multi-product engineering organization.
* Demonstrated experience building capabilities, practices, CoEs, engineering excellence organizations or cross-product competency models.

jobs.title: Director, People Strategy
jobs.description:
Join the team behind iconic brands like Huggies®, Kleenex®, Cottonelle®, Scott®, Kotex®, Poise®, and Kimberly-Clark Professional®. At Kimberly-Clark, it’s all here for you - innovation, growth, and the chance to make a real impact.

  
  

You’re not the person who will settle for just any role. Neither are we. Because we’re out to create Better Care for a Better World, and that takes a certain kind of person and teams who care about making a difference. Here, you’ll bring your professional expertise, talent, and drive to building and managing our portfolio of iconic, ground-breaking brands. In this role, you’ll help us deliver better care for billions of people around the world. It starts with YOU.

  

**About You**

  
  

The Director, People Strategy will lead the development, integration and governance of our enterprise People Strategy. Acting as a principal strategy partner to the Global People Leadership Team, this role will translate business priorities into clear workforce, organization, talent, capability and People-function choices.

  
  

You will connect priorities across Centers of Excellence, People Business Partners, Global Business Services, Finance, People Analytics, Digital and Technology. You will bring clarity to complex enterprise challenges, identify necessary trade-offs and provide evidence-based recommendations that guide investment and strategic decision-making.

  
  

Key responsibilities

* Lead the development, periodic refresh, governance and communication of the enterprise People Strategy.
* Translate business strategy into clear workforce, organization, talent, capability, culture and People-function priorities.
* Serve as a trusted strategy partner to the Global People Leadership Team, shaping agendas and providing clear recommendations on enterprise-level choices.
* Integrate functional and Center of Excellence strategies into a coherent global People agenda, identifying gaps, overlaps and dependencies.
* Define enterprise business requirements and strategic principles for technology, data and AI-enabled People solutions.
* Develop evidence-based options and scenarios using workforce data, employee insights, financial information and external trends.
* Connect the People Strategy with portfolio priorities, investment decisions, multi-year roadmaps and annual planning.
* Define measures of success and prepare concise strategy papers, executive briefings and decision materials for senior leadership.
  

To succeed in this role, you will need the following qualifications:

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business, strategy, human resources, finance, economics, organizational development or a related field.

* Significant senior-level experience in enterprise strategy, corporate or functional strategy, human capital strategy, management consulting or business transformation.

* Proven experience translating enterprise strategy into functional priorities, business requirements and multi-year plans.

* Experience developing executive-level strategy papers, recommendations, scenarios and decision materials.

* Experience working within a global, highly complex or matrixed organization.

* Experience negotiating across senior functional leaders and resolving competing priorities through explicit choices and trade-offs.

* Excellent written, verbal and executive-level communication skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience developing or refreshing an enterprise People or workforce strategy.

* Experience integrating multiple HR or People functional agendas into one enterprise direction.

* Experience with mergers and acquisitions, business integration or significant operating-model transformation.

* Experience connecting strategy with portfolio prioritization, sequencing and investment decisions.

* Experience partnering with People Analytics, Finance and enterprise strategy teams.

* Understanding of how technology, data and AI can enable workforce and People strategies.

  

**What success looks like**

You will establish a clear and actionable People Strategy that reflects enterprise business requirements, aligns functional priorities and enables leadership to make better-informed decisions. Your work will help convert competing priorities into explicit choices, ensure People investments are connected to measurable outcomes and create a consistent direction across strategy, portfolio and transformation activities

  

**Led by Purpose. Driven by You.**

  
  

**Total Benefits**

We believe that our employees are our greatest asset, and we're committed to providing them with the resources they need to be successful.

If you're looking for a rewarding career with a company that cares about its employees, then Kimberly-Clark is the place for you.

**Great Support for Good Health**

**Hybrid Work Arrangement** - we understand the importance of work-life balance. Thanks to that, we are providing you with the flexibility to manage your commitments both inside and outside of work.

**Yearly Bonus** - to reward you for your hard work and dedication throughout the year. This bonus is based on individual and company performance and is a great way to recognize and appreciate your contributions.

**Learning & Growth** - we are committed to helping our employees develop and grow, which is why we offer a wide range of soft skills training on our internal training platform. These training sessions are available to every employee and can be tailored to your specific needs.

**International Environment** - a job at the very heart of Kimberly-Clark's finance organization in which you will be part of a great diverse team with wide exposure to the business functions and the opportunity to influence processes & drive optimization.

  
  

**To Be Considered**
  
Click the Apply button and complete the online application process. A member of our recruiting team will review your application and follow up if you seem like a great fit for this role.

  
  

**And finally, the fine print….**

*For Kimberly-Clark to grow and prosper, we must be an inclusive organization that applies the diverse experiences and passions of its team members to brands that make life better for people all around the world, which is why we seek to build a workforce that encompasses the experiences of our consumers.*

  
  

*When you bring your original thinking to Kimberly-Clark, you fuel the continued success of our enterprise. We are a committed equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

  
  

*The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees assigned to this classification. Statements are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and skills required for this position.*

  
  

*Employment is subject to verification of local policies.*

  
  

*This role is available for local candidates already authorized to work in the country’s role only. Kimberly-Clark will not provide relocation support for this role.*

 **Job Description**

AECOM is seeking a Senior Project Controls Engineer / Senior Project Controls Specialist to support the delivery of complex infrastructure and multidisciplinary construction projects for UAE based projects.

The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing and maintaining project controls processes, systems, and reporting frameworks to support effective project planning, forecasting, cost management, performance measurement, change control, and governance. The role will work closely with Project Managers, Finance, Project Directors, and Delivery teams to provide timely and accurate project performance insights and support informed decision-making throughout the project lifecycle.

This role may also provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior Project Controls professionals and support the continuous improvement of project controls practices across the business.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Project Controls Planning and Setup**

* Establish and maintain project control procedures, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), cost structures, and project baselines.
* Support project mobilization activities, including project setup within corporate financial and project management systems.
* Develop and maintain project control tools, reporting frameworks, and performance measurement processes.
* Ensure project controls activities are aligned with AECOM policies, procedures, and governance requirements.

**Cost Management and Forecasting**

* Monitor project budgets, costs, commitments, and expenditures throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare and maintain Estimates at Completion (EAC), forecasts, and resource projections.
* Analyse project performance against budget, funding limits, and approved baselines.
* Identify variances, trends, risks, and opportunities, and provide recommendations to project leadership.
* Support project reviews through the provision of accurate financial and performance data.

**Performance Measurement and Analysis**

* Collect, validate, and analyse project performance data.

* Contribute to the development and enhancement of project controls standards, procedures, and best practices.

* Typically 6+ years of relevant project controls experience within infrastructure, transportation, utilities, or major capital projects.
* Demonstrated experience in cost control, forecasting, project performance reporting, and change management.

**Preferred Qualifications**
