jobs.title: Services Analytics Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Services Analytics Team Leader**
==================================

You will lead analytics for the **Services** cluster — the set of domains that protect trust, safety, and quality across every interaction on our platform. This is where the integrity of the marketplace is safeguarded and where millions of passengers and drivers experience inDrive as a safe and reliable place to be. Your teams will span five closely connected areas: **Watchdocs** (driver document verification and work with the compliance base), **Trust & Safety** (everything related to trust and safety in rides — incidents and safety features), **Customer Support** (both the product tooling for handling user requests and the automation of that work, plus WFM analytics of support agents' performance), **Customer Experience** (Voice-of-the-Customer feedback and connecting satisfaction metrics such as CSAT/DSAT to business metrics), and **Antifraud** (protecting rides, transactions, ratings, and more from abuse across inDrive).

  

You will build and manage a team that partners closely with **product, operations, support, and compliance** to turn a large volume of behavioral, operational, and feedback signals into decisions that reduce risk and improve experience at the same time. From detecting and quantifying fraud across rides and transactions, to measuring the real business impact of safety features and support automation, to linking customer-feedback metrics (CSAT/DSAT) with core business outcomes — your work will define how the company balances protection, cost, and user satisfaction.

  

In this role, you will act as a **strategic partner** to product and business leaders, as well as to Trust & Safety and Compliance stakeholders — shaping the analytics agenda for the Services cluster, defending its strategy in front of senior leadership, and building scalable processes, metrics, and standards that make trust and safety measurable across the whole platform.

  

Department

Analytics Department

Employment Type

Full Time

Location

United Arab Emirates

Workplace type

Fully remote

Requisition ID

1635

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own the **analytics strategy and roadmap** for the Services cluster (Watchdocs, Trust & Safety, Customer Support, CX, Antifraud), align it with company-level priorities, and defend it in front of senior leadership
* Build, grow, and develop a **team of 11+** (analysts) — hiring, mentoring, and setting quality standards across the cluster
* Lead **Antifraud analytics**: detect and quantify fraudulent behavior across rides, transactions, and ratings; evaluate the effectiveness of anti-fraud rules and models and their trade-off with false positives
* Drive **Trust & Safety analytics**: measure incident rates, evaluate the impact of safety features, and help prioritize initiatives that reduce risk for passengers and drivers
* Oversee **Customer Support analytics**: assess support tooling and automation effectiveness, contact-rate drivers, resolution quality, and WFM analytics for agent capacity and performance
* Lead **CX analytics**: connect Voice-of-the-Customer metrics (CSAT/DSAT) to business outcomes such as retention and revenue, and turn feedback into prioritized product and operational actions
* Guide **Watchdocs analytics**: the document-verification funnel, compliance coverage, and the balance between compliance rigor and a smooth driver onboarding experience
* Define and **standardize metrics, definitions, and monitoring** across the cluster; ensure data quality in partnership with DWH, DS, and Engineering
* Establish best practices in **experimentation (A/B testing), causal inference, forecasting, and effect measurement** across the team
* Partner cross-functionally at the **company level** (Product & Tech & Business, DWH, DS, Engineering) and act as a trusted advisor to Head / Director / C-suite stakeholders

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* 6+ years of experience in data or product analytics, preferably in tech, ride-hailing, marketplace, or platform businesses
* 2+ years of people management, leading teams of 10+ people, including other managers or team leads
* Strong expertise in SQL and Python (or R), with a solid foundation in statistics and experimentation (A/B testing, causal inference)
* Proven ability to translate large volumes of behavioral, operational, and feedback data into decisions that balance risk, cost, and user experience
* Experience partnering with senior stakeholders (Head / Director / C-suite) and forming and defending strategy at the company level
* Proficiency in BI tools (Tableau, Looker, Redash, or similar)
* Strong communication skills and the ability to present complex findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Proven experience working on global products serving international audiences is required
* English: Professional Working Proficiency

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience in one of the Services domains — Trust & Safety, Antifraud, Customer Support / WFM, CX / Voice-of-the-Customer, or compliance
* Experience with fraud / risk modeling, anomaly detection, or safety analytics
* Familiarity with text / sentiment analysis for customer-feedback data
* Experience scaling analytics across multiple countries and verticals

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

* Establishing a process for continuous improvement of metrics - performance (delivery and discovery), quality, as well as team engagement and maturity
* Facilitating project or program-level events

  

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**
-----------------------------------

* **End-to-End Ownership.** Own end-to-end delivery of inDrive’s largest org-wide technical programs, from initiation and scoping through architecture, execution, launch and adoption, against measurable outcomes over multiple quarters
* **Product Partnership.** Partner with Product Managers across business verticals and platform to scope programs, challenge and sharpen requirements, agree what is in and out, and turn ambiguous product intent into a program with a defensible shape
* **Prioritisation and Phasing.** Drive prioritisation and phasing decisions with Product and Engineering — what ships first, what can wait, what can be split — so that value lands early and the plan survives contact with reality
* **Cross-Surface Dependencies.** Identify, map and resolve dependencies across the whole surface, including the ones nobody has noticed yet
* **Technical Depth.** Understand technical implementation at the architecture level and contribute to decisions on system design, scalability and reliability
* **Solution Architecture.** Own the technical coherence of end-to-end solutions that span multiple services, platforms, vendors and markets, and be accountable for the technical KPIs and SLAs your programs commit to
* **Technical Judgment.** Use your engineering background to help teams make sound design decisions, identify gaps in proposed solutions and weigh product-versus-technology trade-offs
* **Portfolio Management.** Own a portfolio of programs: sequence them, resolve cross-program dependencies and capacity conflicts, and make the calls on scope, timeline and technical approach
* **Structure in Ambiguity.** Create structure where none exists by defining program frameworks, decision points, operating cadences and communication models
* **Systemic Risk.** Detect risk visible only from a cross-program vantage point, and intervene to stabilise at-risk programs anywhere in the portfolio
* **Execution at Scale.** Identify where the organisation is losing speed, design scalable processes to fix it, and drive adoption across all Prod/Tech teams
* **Executive Partnership.** Partner directly with Product/Engineering Directors, VPs, the CTO and CPO on priorities, goals and trade-offs, and own executive communication so decisions are made quickly and with the right information
* **Craft Leadership.** Mentor Technical Program Managers and set the craft direction for the program management group

**Why join us**
---------------

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 47 countries.
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs.
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program.
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects.
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

  

**About inDrive**
-----------------

inDrive is a global tech company on a mission to challenge injustice through fair choices. We started in 2012 in the coldest city on Earth, when a group of friends created a way for people to agree on fair ride prices. That idea grew into one of the world’s top ride-hailing apps, now with 400M installs across 47 countries.

  
  

Today, we offer more than rides: from freight and delivery to intercity travel and financial services, all designed to put people first. We are committed to having a positive impact on people’s lives both through our core business, which supports local communities via a fair pricing model; and through the work of our impact programs.

Ready to ignite your inner drive?

At Kapture CX, we are looking for an **Associate Product Manager** in our **Product** team.

  

**Who are we?**

Kapture CX is an AI-native customer experience platform helping enterprises turn their messiest service operations into seamless, intelligent experiences. We build cutting-edge AI (agentic automation, voice AI, real-time intelligence) for industries where complexity is the default: banking, financial services, retail, ecommerce and beyond.

Today were a 400+ strong team, and were looking for people who want to build AI that actually ships, scales and solves real problems.

  

**What is this role all about?**

  

Dive into the heart of product innovation where you'll shape cutting-edge AI-driven CX solutions, collaborate with top talent, and drive real impact for global enterprisesall while accelerating your growth in product management.

What does success look like in this role?

  

You'll excel by delivering features that wow clients, hit key metrics like user adoption and satisfaction, and contribute to roadmaps that keep Kapture ahead of the CX curve.

**Here are the basic requirements:**

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager - Bangalore HQ - Karnataka - OTC Division
jobs.description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

  

This job opportunity is to drive the Over The Counter Sales Area field force of one of the most strategic area for DKT Healthcare India and reset the distribution model in-line with the goals.

  

Reporting directly to the Regional Sales Manager, the job owner will endorse the responsibility of recruiting and developing his/her team (Sales Representatives) footprint and sales best practices capabilities, enhancing and sustaining its productivity and impacting direct and indirect sales across the chemist distribution network as well as toward the Non-Traditional Outlets (NTO) channel. Manage a team of 5-6 personnel comprising of front-line staff.

  

He/She will actively participate in providing high quality, safe and affordable family planning (FP) and sexual reproductive health (SRH) products and methods to couples, women, and men, giving them choices to meet their contraceptive needs thanks to product visibility and access.

  

Provide pragmatic and relevant market analysis to his OTC Regional Sales Manager and internal DKT stakeholders (marketing and operations) enabling the company to make the right strategic and operational decisions to achieve the objectives set for his area. Understand the requirements of existing and prospective customers to ensure that their needs are met.

  

Develop, implement and monitor the commercial and route-to-market strategies to achieve sales and distribution targets, and deliver sustainable growth of DKT OTC portfolio and related CYPs with current franchise and upcoming leads. Manage middle- and first-line management using CRM tools, acting as key leader for his direct reports (Sales Representatives).

  

Manage in collaboration with his/her Regional Sales Manager, the relationships with distribution partners, Key stakeholders, and Key accounts (i.e. organized pharmacy chains). endorses responsibility for cash flow with DKT Healthcare Indias. Provides market information and realistic, well-founded sales forecasts to operations and marketing to ensure that production plans are in line with market demand.

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

**Provide strategic analysis & critical thinking to foster OTC commercial targets.**

* Analyse and evaluate the area market environment to find growth & market penetration opportunities based on critical insight into market dynamics and consumer demand switches.
* Set clear priorities and SMART targets to the within the defined area.
* Support Regional Sales Manager on the implementation of Company SOPs (i.e. Cycle planning, S&OP, company plan process and budget construction.

  

**Develop & implement TM&D initiatives to achieve OTC operational goals.**

* Design in collaboration with his/her RSM the area sales & distribution route to market strategy and coverage plan to reach both distributors and sales channels.
* Formulate and set up in collaboration with marketing and RSM, adequate sales promotion push/pull activities to foster selling in & selling out of DKT portfolio
* Direct and oversee in collaboration with RSM, relationships with SDBR, DBR, and key accounts such as organized pharmacies channels.
* Conduct market intelligence & activities monitoring to sustain rational decision-making.
* Support and lead CRM development and completion within his/her Area.

  

**Build up and manage a solid & result-oriented professional sales team.**

* Design, recruit, and implement effective sales representatives and solid area management.
* Set up clear KPIs & SMART targets for the entire FF.
* Strengthen sales & SRH skills of FF associates through effective off & on-the-job training.
* Evaluate and appraise staff and take immediate actions to address any drop-in sales targets.
* Provide area structure guidance to perform in line with DKT values.

  

**Endorse responsibility for sales-related cash flow and Area OTC target delivery.**

* Ensure activities are in line with budget planning or agreed operational changes.
* Monitor the performance of commercial activities and sales productivity using key metrics.
* Provide RSM qualitative trade reports on time and in full.

  

**Position Objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Position objectives.**

* To ensure effective distribution of OTC products (Core & enlarged portfolio) within the area.
* To achieve area sales targets and revenues / Contribute to overall OTC Division goals.
* Act as DKT OTC area expert on the SRH category and market expertise, sales trends, and competitor activities.

  

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Sales performance against area target & sales forecast / YOY organic growth / Sales Productivity / CYPs / POS brand visibility and access
* Distribution levels (availability) against business plan and forecast (numerical & weighted)
* Effective competence of Area OTC sales representatives.
* Benchmarking image of DKT Area OTC division across the Distribution network.
* Budget against expenditure & total control over cash flow.
* Effective Team management and full adherence to DKT values
* Effective support of CRM implementation and use.

  

**Qualifications and Skills Required**

  

**Education & Qualifications**  
 bachelors degree in business, marketing, commerce or equivalent in a related area.

  

**Work Experience**

  

- Minimum experience of 5 years in sales of OTC / In-depth market experience. Should posses work experience in Bangalore, Mysore and Mangalore.

-At least 5 years' progressive experience in sales / OTC, Personal Health Care Products with at least 3 years of successful experience as an area sales manager or in another relevant management role, leading a sales team at an area level.

- Experience in an international company (FMGC, Pharma, Medical-SRH, etc.) in line with OTC business. Experience in the SRH environment at area level Management is a plus.

- Track record of high performance, excellent management/leadership results and sales growth. Skills and abilities Experience in implementing local-level sales promotional activities (BTL) for special day promotions/events, product launches, displays, and product and POP visibility.

  

The candidate must share DKTs enthusiasm for providing and promoting contraceptives and should enjoy and be comfortable with all aspects of FP and SRH, including safe abortion.

  

* A results-oriented, pragmatic leader eager to challenge the status quo, work autonomously, and gifted to guide, coach and motivate teams to successfully deliver stretched targets.
* Excellent Analytical skills, capable of establishing, reviewing, and managing distribution networks across an area- Data-driven mindset for decision-making.
* Strong understanding of marketing principles, consumer behaviour, and market trends, including laws governing scheduled drugs in India.
* Excellent selling/negotiation skills. Commercial awareness partnered with a strategic mindset.
* Solid writing & communication skills, negotiation, and presentation skills with a sense of initiative problem-solver, and meeting deadlines.
* Ability to keep abreast of trends & market conditions to make effective decisions.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft and tools including CRM software.
* Solid organizational skills with aptitude to manage multiple engagements and prioritize tasks. Effective time management, critical and strategic analysis
* Field-oriented and ready to travel across his/her Area (around 80-100 % of the time)

  

**LANGUAGE SKILLS**

* Fluent in English, Hindi and other regional languages being a plus.
* Writing proficiency in both languages is a must.

  

**APPLICATION**

To apply, please submit your letter of interest, CV, and references to the Head of DKT HR at email ID: hr@dktindia.org

jobs.title: Presales Associate
jobs.description:
**We are hiring**

  

**Pre-Sales Associate**

Help parents discover the one class that changes how their child sees technology.

* **Bengaluru, HSR Layout • Onsite**
* **Full-time**
* **0- 2 years**
* **3.5 - 4.2 LPA Fixed**

  

**About Codingal**

Codingal is on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with coding.

We have empowered 500,000+ students to start learning to code through personalised 1:1 live classes with expert Computer Science teachers. Our curriculum is built on the K-12 Computer Science Framework and accredited by STEM.org, and kids find it genuinely fun. Parents and children in more than 70 countries trust Codingal for high-quality coding education. We are a global company headquartered in the US, backed by top investors including Y Combinator and Rebright Partners.

  

Coding improves logical thinking and problem-solving by 70% in young children, and lifts their performance in other school subjects too. Coding roles already make up more than 60% of all jobs in science, technology, engineering and maths, so kids who start early will be the creators of the future. Read what parents say about us at codingal.com/reviews-and-testimonials.

  

**About the role**

  

As a Pre-Sales Associate, you are the first human voice a parent hears from Codingal. You will call parents who have shown interest in coding for their child, understand what they are really looking for, and help them see the value of a free trial class. You are not pushing a product you are helping a parent make a good decision for their child, and setting up our sales team with a warm, well-qualified conversation.

  

It is a fast-paced, target-driven role with a lot of conversations every day. If you like talking to people, learn quickly, and want a clear path into a full sales career, this is a strong place to start.

  

**What you will do**

* Make outbound calls to prospective and existing Codingal parents to generate and qualify leads for coding classes.
* Run a customer needs assessment (CNA) on every lead understand the childs age, interests, school workload and the parents goals before recommending anything.
* Book and confirm free trial classes, and follow up with reminder calls so parents actually show up.
* Prime and nurture leads across channels calls, WhatsApp, email and SMS so no interested parent goes cold.
* Hand over qualified, well-documented leads to the Business Development team with clear context on what the parent wants.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in LeadSquared CRM and our telecalling tools every single day.
* Own your daily and monthly numbers calls made, connects, CNAs completed, trials booked and trial attendance.
* Track your own performance metrics, spot what is working, and share it with the team.

  

**What we are looking for**

* 0-2 years of experience in pre-sales, telecalling, inside sales or customer support. Freshers with strong communication are welcome.
* Clear, confident and warm communication in English and Hindi, spoken and written. Additional regional languages are a big plus.
* Genuine empathy you listen to what a parent is worried about before you talk about the product.
* The ability to ask sharp questions and qualify a need, rather than reading from a script.
* Comfort with numbers and targets, and the resilience to keep going in a high-performance environment.
* Strong multitasking and follow-through — you can hold 40+ conversations a day and still remember who needs a call back.
* A learning mindset. You should be able to understand our product well enough to speak to a parent about it within your first few days.
* Flexibility on working hours. Our parents are spread across 70+ countries, so some shifts include evenings or weekends.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.

  

**Why join Codingal**

* **Uncapped incentives.** Exceptionally high performance-linked rewards for top performers — your effort shows up in your payslip.
* **Real, fast growth.** We are scaling quickly and promote on performance, not tenure. Strong performers move into Business Development and then team leadership.
* **Genuine sales training.** You will learn structured discovery, objection handling and consultative selling — skills that stay with you for your whole career.
* **Work that means something.** Every trial class you book is a child who might discover they love building things. That is a good reason to pick up the phone.
* **A young, sharp team.** You will sit with people who are ambitious, collaborative and genuinely fun to work with, in our HSR Layout office.
* **Y Combinator-backed.** A globally recognised, well-funded EdTech company on your CV from day one.

  

**Where this role can take you**

We hire pre-sales associates as the start of a sales career, not a dead end. A typical strong performer moves along this path:

**Pre-Sales Associate Business Development Associate Senior BDA / Relationship Manager Team Lead**

  

Movement is based purely on performance. We would much rather promote from inside the team.

  

**Compensation and location**

* **Annual compensation:** 3,50,000 – 4,20,000 fixed per year, plus a variable performance incentive of up to 3,00,000. The final offer depends on your experience, communication skills and interview performance.
* **Location:** HSR Layout Sector 7, Bengaluru. This is an onsite role and cannot be done remotely.
* **Interviews:** Conducted at our Bengaluru office.

  

**Our hiring process**

* **1. Application review** — we look at your CV and communication.
* **2. Telephonic screening** — a short call to hear how you speak with people.
* **3. Interview at the HSR office** — including a live mock call with a parent scenario.
* **4. Offer** — we move fast and aim to close within a week.

  

**Frequently asked questions**

  

**What salary can I expect?**

3,50,000 to 4,20,000 a year — a fixed base -- plus a variable performance incentive of up to 3,00,000. Where you land depends on your experience, communication skills and interview performance. Top performers earn meaningfully more through incentives.

  

**What is the eligibility criteria?**

A graduate degree in any discipline and 0–2 years of experience. Freshers with excellent communication skills are encouraged to apply.

  

**What skills matter most for this job?**

Clear, confident spoken English and Hindi, real empathy for parents, and the discipline to follow up. A Computer Science background is not required — we will teach you the product.

  

**Who can apply for this role?**

Anyone who meets the criteria above. Codingal is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applicants of every gender, background, religion, caste and ability. We do not discriminate on any of these grounds.

  

**Is this a work-from-home job?**

No. This is a full-time onsite role at our HSR Layout Sector 7 office in Bengaluru.

  

**What do the working hours look like?**

Standard full-time hours with shift flexibility. Because we serve parents in 70+ countries, some shifts include evenings or weekends. Your shift is confirmed before you join.

  

**Are there any charges or deposits to apply or join?**

Absolutely not. Codingal never asks for money at any stage of hiring or employment. If anyone claiming to represent us asks you for a payment, it is a scam — please report it to us.

  

**Ready to apply?**

Come join a young, smart team on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with coding, and help us prepare every K-12 student for the future.

Apply at codingal.com/careers or write to careers@codingal.com.

jobs.title: Snowflake Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**The Team**

Deloittes Technology & Transformation practice can help you uncover and unlock the value buried deep inside vast amounts of data. Our global network provides strategic guidance and implementation services to help companies manage data from disparate sources and convert it into accurate, actionable information that can support fact-driven decision-making and generate an insight-driven advantage. Our practice addresses the continuum of opportunities in business intelligence & visualization, data management, performance management and next-generation analytics and technologies, including big data, cloud, cognitive and machine learning.

  

**Your work profile:**

The Snowflake data engineer is responsible for managing client relationships and overseeing the successful delivery of programs or accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact between the organization and its clients, ensuring alignment of goals, timelines, budgets, and expected outcomes while driving client satisfaction and business growth.

  

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* 68 Years of experience in developing and maintaining Snowflake data warehouse and Lakehouse components, including databases, schemas, tables, views, stages, file formats, and secure data access patterns.
* Build and operate batch and incremental ELT/ETL pipelines for structured and semi-structured data using SQL, Python, and suitable orchestration or integration tools.
* Implement Snowflake features such as Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Time Travel, Zero-Copy Cloning, External Tables, and Data Sharing where appropriate.
* Develop reusable transformations, dimensional models, data marts, and source-to-target mappings; use dbt or equivalent frameworks where applicable.
* Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage and services on AWS, Azure, or GCP, including secure ingestion and data movement patterns.
* Troubleshoot pipeline failures, reconcile data, implement data quality checks, and support production incidents through root-cause analysis.
* Tune SQL queries and workloads; apply appropriate warehouse sizing, caching, clustering, and resource-monitoring practices to balance performance and cost.
* Implement role-based access control, masking, secure views, secrets handling, and other data protection controls in line with platform standards.
* Use Git, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices to deliver maintainable and production-ready data assets.
* Collaborate with data architects, analysts, QA, platform teams, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver tested solutions.
* Hands-on Snowflake development experience, including core platform objects, loading patterns, workload execution, and operational troubleshooting.
* Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query plans, and performance tuning.
* Working proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, API integration, or pipeline utilities.
* Practical experience with at least one ETL/ELT or orchestration tool, such as dbt, Airflow, Matillion, Fivetran, Informatica, Talend, Azure Data Factory, or AWS Glue.
* Experience with at least one cloud platform: AWS (S3, Glue, Lambda), Azure (ADLS Gen2, ADF, Databricks), or GCP (GCS, Dataflow, Pub/Sub).
* Understanding of relational databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Teradata, or MySQL; familiarity with semi-structured formats such as JSON and Parquet.
* Familiarity with Git, code review, CI/CD, testing, logging, and secure cloud development practices.
* Ability to translate technical requirements into clear, tested data pipeline and transformation deliverables..
* Awareness of AI/ML and GenAI data requirements, including curated datasets for analytics or retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
* Banking and Financial Services domain experience is an advantage

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelors or Masters degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* SnowPro Core and/or relevant AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications are preferred.

  

**Success Metrics**

* Reliable, well-tested pipelines delivered to agreed quality and schedule.
* Reduced data defects and production incidents through validation, monitoring, and root-cause fixes.
* Measurable improvements in query performance, pipeline efficiency, and Snowflake credit consumption.
* Clear documentation, reusable code, and adherence to security and engineering standards.
* SnowPro Core and/or relevant AWS, Azure, or GCP certifications are preferred.
* Hands-on Snowflake development experience, including core platform objects, loading patterns, workload execution, and operational troubleshooting.
* Strong SQL skills, including complex joins, CTEs, window functions, query plans, and performance tuning.
* Working proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, API integration, or pipeline utilities.

  

**Location and way of working:**

* Base location: Pune
* This profile involves occasional travelling to client locations.
* Hybrid is our default way of working. Each domain has customized the hybrid approach to their unique needs.

This role is not only about selling products / services but also about understanding customer processes, identifying automation opportunities, and positioning the right technical solution with the support of engineering teams.

  

The Sales Manager acts as the bridge between customers and internal engineering teams, ensuring that customer expectations are translated into clear project requirements and commercial proposals.

  

**Detailed Job Role & Activities**

**1. Business Development**

* Identify new business opportunities in manufacturing and industrial sectors for automation projects and services.
* Develop relationships with OEMs, system integrators, and end-user industries.
* Foster a progressive and growth-oriented approach to continuously develop capabilities and build a future-ready team, supporting sustainable business expansion.

  

**2. Customer Engagement**

* Understand customer processes, pain points, and automation needs.
* Conduct technical discussions along with the engineering team to propose suitable solutions.

  

**3. Proposal & Commercial Management**

* Prepare techno-commercial proposals in coordination with engineering and estimation teams.
* Participate in negotiations and close orders with mutually beneficial terms.

  

**4. Market Intelligence:**

* Track industry trends, competitor activities, and emerging automation opportunities.
* Identify sectors with potential for automation upgrades.

  

**5. Relationship Management:**

* Build strong long-term relationships with customers.
* Maintain regular engagement even after project delivery to generate repeat business.

  

**6. Internal Coordination:**

* Coordinate with engineering, project, and service teams during project execution to ensure customer expectations are met.

  

**7. Staying Updated on Industry Trends:**

* Stay abreast of industry trends, technological advancements, and regulatory changes affecting the industrial automation sector. Use this knowledge to adapt sales and marketing strategies accordingly and maintain a competitive edge in the market.

  

**Mandatory Skill Set Requirements**

**1. Education**

* MBA (Marketing) or Equivalent Qualifications
* Graduation: Engineering-Electronics/ Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Mechanical/ Automation

  

**2. Competency Requirement**

* 10+ years of experience as Business Development Role specialised Industrial Automation Industry.
* The ability to understand how automation solutions improve manufacturing efficiency.
* Basic Understanding about technical specs:
* PLC programming (Rockwell/Allen Bradley preferred) o HMI & SCADA development (FactoryTalk desirable) o Motion control & drive integration o Machine automation and safety systems o Control panels & electrical systems

  

**3. Behavioural & Professional Competencies**

* Strong communication and customer-handling skills.
* Problem solving and solution-based approach.
* High ownership mindset with willingness to take responsibility and accountability.
* Ability to manage time, travel, and multi-tasking effectively.
* Expert in business negotiation, close deals without damaging relationships.
* Good existing network and relationship in Industrial Automation industry.

  

**Work Environment & Support**

We ensure a safe, supportive, and structured environment, including:

* Planned travel schedules
* Clear documentation and engineering standards
* Team assistance during critical phases

  

**Compensation**

We offer a competitive salary aligned with industry standards.

Family Insurance to support and provide security.

Performance based incentives

  

**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to Work on high-value automation solution sales, not just products
* Strong technical team support for proposals and execution
* Opportunity to build long-term customer relationships
* Ownership and flexibility in driving your sales strategy
* Exposure to multiple industrial sectors
* Growth driven by performance and results
* Backed by a stable and growing global organization EPIQ Machinery.

jobs.title: Walk-in || Senior Manager Accounts & Finance
jobs.description:
HOT VACANCY | Senior Manager Accounts & Finance

**Company:** Ananta Rubber LLP  
**Location:** Attapur, Pillar 128, Hyderabad, Telangana  
**Department:** Finance & Accounts  
**Experience:** 10–15 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Joining:** Immediate / Short Notice Preferred

About the Role

Ananta Rubber LLP is looking for an experienced and competent Senior Accounts & Finance Manager with a strong background in manufacturing and export-oriented businesses.

The candidate will be responsible for independently managing the company's complete finance and accounts function, including financial planning, cash flow management, banking operations, statutory compliance, audits, taxation, working capital management and financial reporting.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in managing manufacturing company accounts, export transactions, banking facilities, audits and all applicable statutory and regulatory compliances.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Management & Planning

* Manage the complete finance and accounts function of the organisation.
* Prepare annual budgets, financial forecasts, cash flow projections and fund requirement plans.
* Monitor daily, weekly and monthly cash flows and working capital requirements.
* Prepare periodic financial statements, MIS reports and management dashboards.
* Analyse profitability, cost structures, expenses and financial performance.
* Monitor fund utilisation, financial commitments and business cash requirements.
* Establish internal financial controls and improve accounting processes.

2. Banking & Treasury Operations

* Independently handle banking relationships and coordinate with banks for day-to-day financial operations.
* Manage working capital facilities, CC/OD limits, term loans, bank guarantees and Letters of Credit (LC).
* Handle import and export-related banking transactions, including LC documentation, bill discounting, foreign remittances and forex transactions.
* Manage bank documentation, renewals, stock statements, book debt statements and CMA data.
* Coordinate with banks for loan disbursements, repayments, interest calculations and facility enhancements.
* Monitor banking costs, interest expenses, fund utilisation and foreign exchange exposure.

3. Export & Import Accounting

* Handle accounting and financial documentation related to export and import transactions.
* Strong understanding of export documentation, foreign currency transactions and exchange rate differences.
* Knowledge of Letter of Credit (LC), advance payments, export bills, inward remittances and bank realisation documentation.
* Handle GST export procedures, LUT, refund claims, and reconciliation of export transactions.
* Knowledge of Advance Authorisation, EPCG and other applicable foreign trade schemes.
* Coordinate with EXIM, logistics and commercial teams to ensure proper documentation and accounting compliance.

4. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

* Ensure timely compliance with all applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.
* Strong practical knowledge of GST, including returns, input tax credit reconciliation, e-invoicing, e-way bills and GST audits.
* Handle direct taxation, advance tax, TDS/TCS, income tax returns and tax assessments.
* Ensure compliance with Companies Act / LLP Act, as applicable.
* Manage professional tax, PF, ESI, labour-related statutory payments and other applicable compliances.
* Coordinate with consultants and authorities for notices, assessments, scrutiny and statutory proceedings.
* Maintain statutory registers, records and compliance calendars.

5. Audit Management

* Independently coordinate and manage statutory audits, tax audits, internal audits and GST audits.
* Liaise with statutory auditors, tax consultants, internal auditors and financial institutions.
* Prepare audit schedules, financial statements, ledger reconciliations and supporting documentation.
* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.
* Maintain proper books of accounts and ensure audit readiness throughout the year.

6. Manufacturing Finance & Cost Control

* Must have practical experience in manufacturing company accounting and financial management.
* Monitor raw material consumption, production costs, inventory valuation and finished goods accounting.
* Understand BOM, material costing, production overheads, WIP and cost of goods manufactured.
* Monitor inventory reconciliation, physical stock verification and valuation.
* Analyse product-wise profitability, manufacturing costs and operational variances.
* Coordinate with production, purchase, stores and management teams for financial controls.
* Implement cost control measures and identify opportunities for improving operational efficiency.

7. Accounts & Team Management

* Supervise accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger and banking operations.
* Ensure timely vendor payments, customer collections and reconciliation of outstanding balances.
* Review monthly, quarterly and annual financial closures.
* Lead and supervise the accounts and finance team.
* Establish standard operating procedures for financial transactions and documentation.
* Ensure accuracy, transparency and timely reporting across all financial activities.

Mandatory Skills & Experience

* 8–15 years of experience in Accounts & Finance, preferably in a manufacturing organisation.

To manage, support, enhance and optimize SAP S/4HANA Finance and Controlling (FICO) processes, ensuring accurate financial reporting, accounting compliance, effective cost management and seamless integration with other SAP modules.

The consultant will independently manage business requirements, functional configurations, production support, enhancements, testing and implementation of finance solutions aligned with business objectives.

* Configure chart of accounts, company codes, fiscal year variants and posting periods.

* Configure and support automatic account determination.
* Manage recurring entries, accruals, provisions and journal postings.
* Experience in month-end and year-end closing activities.

**B. Accounts Payable (FI-AP)**

* Invoice verification and vendor accounting.
* Automatic payment program configuration and execution.
* Payment methods, payment terms and bank determination.
* Withholding tax and GST-related accounting.
* Vendor advances, down payments and special G/L transactions.
* Vendor reconciliation and open-item management.

**C. Accounts Receivable (FI-AR)**

* Customer invoicing and incoming payment processing.
* Credit management and collection processes.
* Customer advances and down payments.
* Dunning procedures and dispute management.
* Customer reconciliation and open-item management.
* Integration with SD billing and revenue accounting.

**D. Asset Accounting (FI-AA)**

* Asset master creation and maintenance.
* Asset acquisition, capitalization and retirement.
* Depreciation areas and depreciation key configuration.
* Asset transfers and construction-in-progress (AUC).
* Integration with General Ledger.
* Asset accounting reconciliation and year-end closing.

**E. Controlling (CO)**

* Cost center and profit center accounting.
* Internal orders and cost allocation.
* Assessment and distribution cycles.
* Product costing and cost component structure.
* Standard costing and cost estimates.
* WIP calculation and variance analysis.
* Production order settlement.
* Material Ledger and Actual Costing.
* Profitability Analysis (Margin Analysis / CO-PA).
* Integration with SAP PP, MM and SD.

**F. Banking & Treasury**

* House bank and bank account configuration.
* Electronic Bank Statement (EBS) configuration and processing.
* Bank reconciliation and clearing.
* Payment file generation and bank integration.
* Experience with SAP Multi-Bank Connectivity (MBC) is preferred.
* Knowledge of SWIFT, API and Host-to-Host banking interfaces.
* Cash management and liquidity reporting knowledge is an advantage.

**4. GST, Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Strong understanding of Indian GST processes and SAP integration.
* CGST, SGST, IGST and input tax credit accounting.
* TDS and withholding tax configuration.
* GST input and output reconciliation.
* Experience in tax determination and tax procedure configuration.

**5. Integration Knowledge**

Strong integration experience with the following SAP modules:

Procure-to-Pay, GR/IR, invoice verification, inventory valuation

Order-to-Cash, billing, revenue and customer accounting

Production order costing, WIP, variance and settlement

Quality-related inventory valuation and accounting impact

Maintenance order settlement and cost allocation

EWM

  

Inventory movements and financial postings

Provide pragmatic and relevant market analysis to his OTC Regional Sales Manager and internal DKT stakeholders (marketing and operations) enabling the company to make the right strategic and operational decisions to achieve the objectives set for his area. Understand the requirements of existing and prospective customers to ensure that their needs are met.

**Position Objectives and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

 bachelors degree in business, marketing, commerce or equivalent in a related area.

* Stay updated on industry hiring trends, market demands, and corporate hiring patterns.
* Represent NxtWave at corporate networking events, industry forums, job fairs, and business events.
* Support client testimonials, case studies, and partnership initiatives to strengthen corporate brand positioning.

**Role Description**

This is a senior HRBP Leadership role at the intersection of HR strategy, people capability, and organisational effectiveness. The Senior Manager HR Business Partnering & Learning serves as the primary people strategy architect for the Centre of Excellence, operating at the confluence of business partnership, workforce development, and HR governance.

The role demands someone who can seamlessly shift between strategic advisory and operational rigour translating enterprise people priorities into tangible centre outcomes, while simultaneously building HR capability that is future-ready, data- informed, and deeply human.

Success looks like a CoE where HR is a strategic growth enabler rather than a support function: where leaders are advised with confidence and where HR frameworks and systems are built to scale not just maintained.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. HR Business Partnering Excellence

* Drive a high-quality, end-to-end HR delivery model across the employee lifecycle, anchored in business alignment and proactive people stewardship.
* Architect and lead BU-aligned HRBP delivery positioning the HR function as a strategic growth partner, not a transactional support layer.
* Own the people strategy narrative for the CoE: translate enterprise priorities and business goals into relevant, timely people interventions that move the needle on talent, culture, and productivity.
* Lead workforce planning and organisation design conversations in partnership with the Centre Head and global HR ensuring role architecture, career pathways, and headcount structures are built for scale and sustainability.
* Navigate complex employee relations with sound judgement, genuine empathy, and legal rigour including performance interventions, probations, and compliance cases protecting both people and the organisation.
* Champion the 'How We Work' operating framework, holding the centre accountable to process integrity and behavioural standards that define the people experience.

  

2. People Management

* Build and sustain a high-performing HR team that operates with cohesion, care, and a shared commitment to delivering for the business and for each other.
* Lead, coach, and inspire a team creating clarity of purpose, consistency of delivery, and genuine pride in the function.
* Own the individual development journeys within the team: conduct regular 1:1 coaching conversations, co-create IDPs, and actively sponsor internal mobility and career growth.
* Monitor team health as a strategic priority act on engagement signals early, manage attrition proactively, and build a psychologically safe environment where diverse voices are heard and valued.

  

3 . Stakeholder Engagement

* Build the credibility and visibility of HR as an indispensable strategic voice trusted by leaders, valued by managers, and respected across the global HR community.
* Cultivate trusted, long-term partnerships with business leaders, people managers, global HRA partners, and senior CoE leadership serving as a proactive, credible, and commercially-aware HR voice.
* Design and operationalise a structured Stakeholder Engagement Framework: regular business reviews, HRBP connect cadences, and leadership feedback loops that create accountability and shared ownership.
* Represent the HR function with authority in CoE leadership forums, People Leader connects, and cross-functional governance bodies — influencing decisions that shape the people's agenda.

  

4. Operational Efficiency & Process Governance

* Ensure accurate and timely execution across HR processes such as- PIP, probation, ER, IJP, and HWW cycles — serving as the quality control layer that protects process integrity and employee experience simultaneously.
* Lead continuous process re-engineering: reduce manual effort, improve turnaround times, define clear accountability structures, and regularly simplify HR processes to keep pace with a growing organisation.5. External Intelligence
* Position as a destination employer and HR thought-leader — bringing the outside in, and representing the organisation with conviction on public platforms.
* Actively represent in the HR ecosystem through conferences, panel discussions, and professional forums (People Matters TechHR, SHRM India, and equivalent platforms).
* Continuously import external best practices, emerging talent trends, and market benchmarks into the CoE — ensuring the HR function evolves ahead of, not behind, the business.
* Model a growth mindset across the team and the centre — investing in personal development, embracing learning publicly, and building a culture where curiosity and continuous improvement are celebrated.

  

**Knowledge and Skills**

* Strong business acumen, with the ability to translate strategic priorities into practical people plans that drive measurable outcomes.
* Coaching skills, to guide and coach senior leaders
* Data literacy and analytical thinking: able to use HR metrics, engagement data, and workforce analytics to diagnose issues and inform decisions.
* High stakeholder influence and executive communication skills — comfortable presenting to and influencing CHROs, Centre Heads, and global HR leadership.
* Operational rigour: able to maintain high execution standards across a broad portfolio without losing sight of the strategic agenda.
* Demonstrable experience in org design, workforce planning, succession management, and leadership development at scale.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for experienced professionals in Business Transformation, Process Excellence and AI-enabled Transformation to drive business process redesign, operating model transformation and digital innovation across Marketing, Commerce, B2B Sales and Customer Service functions.

The role involves assessing existing business processes, identifying improvement opportunities, designing future-state processes and operating models, and integrating AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI and intelligent automation to improve business efficiency, customer experience and operational effectiveness.

The candidate will work closely with business and technology stakeholders to deliver transformation initiatives, facilitate workshops, develop strategic recommendations and drive measurable business outcomes.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
About Vista Equity Partners

Vista Equity Partners is a leading global investment firm focused exclusively on enterprise software, data, and technology-enabled businesses. With over $100 billion in assets under management and a portfolio of more than 90 software companies worldwide, Vista supports growth through operational excellence, shared expertise, and long-term partnership.

Through its Agentic AI Factory, Vista is helping its portfolio companies apply generative AI responsibly across products, operations, and decision-making. Vista also supports learning and development through portfolio-wide programs, leadership workshops, and AI initiatives.

About Amtech

Amtech provides enterprise software for the packaging, printing, and manufacturing industries. Our integrated systems support order management, production planning, scheduling, inventory, and business analytics, helping customers improve efficiency and operational performance.

With Vistas investment and strategic guidance, Amtech combines the agility of a growing technology organization with the stability and career opportunities of a global software ecosystem.

Our Employee Value Proposition

At Amtech, you can:

* **Make an impact:** Help shape manufacturing and supply chain operations through mission-critical enterprise software.
* **Keep growing:** Access learning, leadership development, and opportunities across Vista’s global network.
* **Work collaboratively:** Join a transparent, people-first culture grounded in accountability and integrity.
* **Contribute to innovation:** Help modernize business processes and explore technologies such as AI-driven automation.

Role Overview

We are hiring Product Owners at the **Product Owner II and Senior Product Owner levels** to support product execution across Amtech’s labeling and corrugated ERP platforms, with a focus on automated scheduling applications.

Depending on experience and scope, the role may focus on owning the scheduling product backlog or performing product-management execution for the labeling product line while coordinating and supporting the product-owner community across both product lines.

In either focus, you will work with product management, engineering, QA, UX, architecture, and customer-facing teams to turn roadmap initiatives and manufacturing needs into clear development work and useful product outcomes.

The Senior Product Owner focus includes coordinating agile planning and ceremonies, supporting product owners, and maintaining quality standards for product development lifecycle (PDLC) artifacts. This is a coordination and enablement role and does not carry direct people-management responsibility. Market-facing direction, priorities, and customer strategy are set in partnership with in-market product leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership and Execution

* Own or support the product backlog for automated scheduling applications and related labeling or corrugated ERP capabilities.
* Work with Product Managers and in-market product leadership to translate roadmap initiatives into epics, user stories, and actionable backlog items.
* Define and prioritize features, enhancements, and fixes based on customer needs, product direction, and business goals.
* Write clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and ensure items are ready for sprint planning.
* Work with tech leads and development teams to plan delivery across multiple sprints and longer-term initiatives.
* Maintain product artifacts and, at the Senior Product Owner level, review PDLC artifacts for completeness and quality.

Manufacturing and Customer Insight

* Engage with customers, customer support, implementation, and services teams to understand manufacturing workflows and scheduling challenges.
* Translate production scheduling and manufacturing requirements into scalable product capabilities.
* Help resolve software defects and define customer-specific features in collaboration with product management.
* Ensure product decisions reflect customer needs and support broader product goals.

Agile Delivery and Coordination

* Work closely with engineering, QA, UX, and architecture teams during planning, development, and release cycles.
* Coordinate with Product Managers, tech leads, and development teams in Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Participate in or facilitate sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and other agile ceremonies.
* Clarify requirements and help teams understand the intended product outcomes.
* At the Senior Product Owner level, coordinate and support product owners across the India-based labeling and corrugated teams, and help build shared practices through a community of practice.

Product Delivery and Continuous Improvement

* Validate delivered functionality against acceptance criteria and business objectives.
* Support product releases through documentation, training, and internal enablement.
* Provide product expertise to internal stakeholders and contribute to continuous improvement of scheduling capabilities and product-owner practices.

Skills and Qualifications

* **Product Owner II:** Typically 3–5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or in a similar software product role.
* **Senior Product Owner:** Typically 7+ years of experience in product ownership, product management, or business analysis, including experience coordinating or supporting other Product Owners.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum software development environments.
* Experience managing product backlogs, writing user stories, and defining requirements.
* Experience with ERP systems and the ability to translate business needs into technical product specifications.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including experience working with distributed teams.
* For the Senior Product Owner focus, experience facilitating agile ceremonies, including PI planning, and establishing or maintaining standards for product artifacts.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience with manufacturing, production scheduling, scheduling optimization, or ERP applications.
* Knowledge of production operations, shop-floor workflows, or manufacturing analytics.
* Experience with ERP integrations and manufacturing workflows.
* Experience working with in-market product leadership in a distributed or offshore delivery model.
* Experience coaching or supporting other Product Owners or building a community of practice.
* Familiarity with Jira or similar backlog-management tools.

Why Join Amtech

At Amtech, you’ll help deliver software that supports real manufacturing operations while benefiting from Vista’s global ecosystem. You’ll collaborate with talented teams, access cross-portfolio learning opportunities, and contribute to the continued development of Amtech’s ERP and scheduling products.

jobs.title: Manager, Finance Transformation Risk and Assurance
jobs.description:
Key responsibilities

* **Own the risk view for an assigned workstream.** Proactively assess the assigned process or risk domain across deployment waves using the common Risk & Compliance methodology. Apply sound judgment to new scope, process variants, handoffs and emerging risks, and update mitigations as design and implementation progress.
* **Build strong partnerships with assigned functions.** Engage functional leads across Plan, Make, Source, Deliver, Finance, Customer Excellence or Master Data as relevant, including Global Process Owners, Technical Process Owners and business process owners. Understand how their decisions affect controls and end-to-end outcomes.
* **Connect business risks to financial outcomes.** Examine how transactions are initiated, approved, recorded, reconciled and reported. Prioritize risks to completeness, accuracy, valuation, authorization and timely reporting, alongside material operational risks within the assigned processes.
* **Design and document the future control environment.** Partner with process owners and Finance to define preventive and detective controls, including automated and manual steps, exception management, control ownership, frequency, evidence and escalation. Challenge gaps and avoid controls that cannot operate sustainably after go-live.
* **Address transition and coexistence risks.** Assess handoffs and reconciliations between legacy and S/4HANA environments, temporary workarounds, changing responsibilities and controls during phased deployment; define mitigation and monitoring until the target process is stable.
* **Translate risks into testing and deployment evidence.** Specify risk-based business scenarios, negative cases, end-to-end outcomes and acceptance criteria. Work with testing, data migration, cutover and dress rehearsal teams to ensure relevant risks are tested, exceptions are resolved or mitigated, and evidence is retained.
* **Track issues and residual risks to closure.** Maintain a clear record of assessments, control decisions, test outcomes, open gaps, owners and agreed actions across releases within the assigned workstream. Explain implications for deployment milestones and escalate material issues in time for informed decisions.
* **Support audit readiness and pre-implementation reviews.** Organize the risk and control narrative, design decisions, test evidence and issue status for the assigned workstream. Engage with internal and external auditors during pre-implementation audits, respond to inquiries with the relevant process and program teams, address findings and track remediation through closure.
* **Connect risks across processes, programs and technology.** Identify upstream and downstream effects, dependencies on other transformation programs, and risks at process or system handoffs. Partner with Digital Solution Risk & Assurance on configuration, applications, interfaces, automation and data flows; align with IT compliance and access specialists as needed.
* **Build the integrated release risk profile.** Share risks, evidence gaps and dependencies with other Risk & Compliance Managers and the Senior Manager. Combine findings across workstreams to explain the end-to-end release risk story and inform appropriate de-risking actions and leadership decisions.

**Support control adoption after deployment.** Confirm that process and control owners understand their responsibilities, that procedures and evidence expectations are usable, and that early-live issues feed back into control improvements and subsequent releases.

**Qualifications and experience**

  

* Experience in business process risk, internal controls, Finance transformation or deployment assurance on a complex ERP program, preferably SAP S/4HANA. Direct involvement in at least one implementation or major release is important.
* Ability to map an end-to-end process, identify meaningful failure points and turn them into workable control requirements, test scenarios and evidence expectations.
* Sound understanding of financial risk and controls in supply chain processes, including transaction flows, reconciliations, master data and period-end implications.
* Experience preparing risk and control documentation and evidence for internal or external audit reviews, including pre-implementation audits; familiarity with SOX requirements is advantageous.
* Ability to build effective working relationships with Global Process Owners, Technical Process Owners, functional leads and delivery teams, and to challenge decisions constructively in a matrix organization.
* Ability to connect risks within an assigned stream to upstream and downstream processes, parallel programs and digital solution changes, and contribute clearly to an integrated release risk profile.
* Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment in prioritizing risks, and willingness to investigate process detail while presenting concise conclusions to senior stakeholders.
* University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems or a related field. Experience in a regulated life-sciences environment is advantageous.

The company has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Its platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30+ countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance.

  

**Global Footprint**

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, the company brings together 170+ engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

* Global in mindset: curious about diverse markets and ideas.

**Why this role**

**Who you are**

* High agency. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, own it and close it.
* You get stuff done. You finish what you start and chase it until it ships.
* Ambitious and hungry to prove yourself; you want more ownership, fast.
* Ready to get your hands dirty: test the build, fix the data, sit with ops.
* Happy to work hard, especially around go-lives.

  

**What the Company Offers**

Join the company and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. The company provides competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

**Role & responsibilities**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and lifecycle management of Heavy Equipments products. The role involves close collaboration with engineering, sales, marketing, operations, and service teams to deliver high-performance, safe, reliable, cost-effective, and market-leading crane solutions aligned with customer needs and business objectives.

  

Key Responsibilities

1. Product Strategy & Planning

* Define and execute the product roadmap for Heavy Equipment’s products based on market trends, customer requirements, competitive landscape, and business strategy.
* Identify new product opportunities, product enhancements, and technology innovations to maintain competitive advantage.
* Develop business cases, pricing strategies, product positioning, and profitability models for new and existing products.
* Define product portfolio strategy across relevant Heavy Equipment’s products segments, applications, capacities, and configurations.
* Establish product value propositions based on performance, safety, productivity, total cost of ownership, and customer requirements.

2. Market & Customer Insights

* Conduct market research to understand construction, infrastructure, industrial, and material-handling market trends, customer needs, and regulatory requirements.
* Gather Voice of Customer (VOC) from contractors, fleet owners, rental companies, dealers, EPC companies, project consultants, and other key stakeholders.
* Analyze competitor products, technologies, specifications, pricing, features, and market positioning.
* Identify emerging applications, customer pain points, and market opportunities for new crane products and solutions.
* Monitor developments in crane technologies, including safety systems, telematics, automation, electrification, digital solutions, and operator-assistance technologies.

3. Product Development & Lifecycle Management

* Work closely with R&D, engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and quality teams to define product specifications and ensure timely product development.
* Manage the complete product lifecycle from concept, feasibility, development, testing, validation, and launch through product maturity and phase-out.
* Define product requirements based on customer applications, duty cycles, capacity, reach, mobility, operating conditions, and applicable standards.
* Ensure products meet required quality, safety, performance, reliability, and environmental standards.
* Drive continuous product improvements based on field performance, customer feedback, warranty data, and market requirements.
* Coordinate product testing, field trials, demonstrations, and validation activities before commercial launch.

4. Cross-functional Collaboration

* Coordinate with sales and marketing teams to develop effective go-to-market strategies, product positioning, sales tools, and launch plans.
* Support sales teams with technical presentations, product training, customer meetings, demonstrations, and tender support.
* Work closely with service and after-sales teams to identify recurring product issues and improve product reliability, serviceability, uptime, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with manufacturing and supply-chain teams to improve product cost, manufacturability, delivery timelines, and overall competitiveness.
* Act as the key interface between customers, commercial teams, and engineering for product-related requirements and decisions.

5. Performance Monitoring & Product Optimization

* Track product performance metrics such as sales volume, market share, revenue, margins, utilization, customer satisfaction, warranty performance, and product reliability.
* Monitor product profitability and identify opportunities for cost optimization and value enhancement.
* Analyze field performance and customer feedback to identify opportunities for product improvement.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions in collaboration with engineering, quality, and service teams.
* Continuously optimize the product portfolio based on data-driven insights, market feedback, and business performance.

Education

Experience

* Strong understanding of crane products, lifting applications, construction equipment, and material-handling solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead  Ultima Platform
jobs.description:
Job Title

Senior Technical Lead Ultima Platform

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)

Department: Engineering – Platform / Infrastructure

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience Level: Senior (10–15+ years)

Role Summary

Diamanti is seeking a Senior Technical Lead to lead the design, development, and

evolution of the Ultima platform, a Kubernetes-native hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI)

appliance.

This role requires deep expertise across Kubernetes internals, CSI and CNI subsystems,

storage architecture, embedded and kernel-level development, and high-performance

networking (including SR-IOV). You will act as a hands-on technical authority, owning

critical platform subsystems end-to-end while also serving as a senior escalation point

for complex customer issues.

Key Responsibilities

Ultima Platform & Storage Architecture Ownership

* Own the end-to-end storage architecture for the Ultima platform, supporting

enterprise-grade, stateful Kubernetes workloads.

* Design and evolve storage solutions across:
* NVMe-based block storage
* Distributed storage concepts
* Performance tiers and failure domains
* Make architectural decisions balancing performance, scalability, durability, and

operational simplicity.

* Define and maintain storage best practices and reference architectures for

internal teams and customers.

CSI-Based Storage Subsystems

* Architect, implement, and optimize Diamanti CSI drivers, including:
* Volume provisioning and lifecycle management
* Snapshots, cloning, resizing, and performance classes
* Failure handling, idempotency, and upgrade safety
* Ensure CSI subsystems integrate correctly with:
* Kubernetes scheduling and lifecycle events
* Kernel block layer and underlying storage hardware
* Drive root cause analysis for complex CSI and storage-related issues.

CNI, Networking & Acceleration

* Own CNI-based networking subsystems, including:
* Pod networking models and isolation
* Network policy enforcement
* Performance-critical data paths
* Lead design and optimization of high-performance networking, including:
* SR-IOV and NIC offloading
* Low-latency, high-throughput data paths
* Ensure tight integration between CNI, kernel networking, and hardware

acceleration.

Embedded & Kernel-Level Development

* Design and develop embedded Linux services, kernel modules, and low-level

platform components.

* Lead kernel-level debugging and optimization across:
* Storage I/O paths
* Networking stacks
* Interrupt handling, memory management, and performance tuning
* Ensure kernel and embedded components meet enterprise reliability and stability

requirements.

Performance, Reliability & Failure Handling

* Own platform performance benchmarking and regression analysis for storage

and networking.

* Define performance baselines (latency, IOPS, throughput) and track them across

releases.

* Design and validate behavior under:
* Disk, node, and network failures
* Power loss and restart scenarios
* Rolling upgrades and scale operations
* Ensure data durability, recoverability, and predictable failure behavior.

Customer Escalations & Technical Leadership

* Act as a senior technical escalation point for complex customer issues related to:
* Storage, CSI, and CNI subsystems
* Kernel-level and performance-critical problems
* Lead deep-dive investigations into customer-reported issues, working across

Engineering, QA, and Support.

* Provide clear technical guidance and direction to engineering teams during

escalations.

* Ensure customer issues are driven to root cause, resolution, and long-term fix,

not just workarounds.

* Translate customer learnings into product and platform improvements.

Team Leadership & Mentorship

* Provide hands-on technical leadership and mentorship to engineers across:
* Storage and networking
* CSI/CNI subsystems
* Kernel and embedded development
* Review designs, code, and test plans to ensure high quality, performance, and

maintainability.

* Raise the bar for systems engineering excellence across the team.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Partner closely with:
* Product Management to translate customer requirements into technical

solutions

* QA to ensure comprehensive validation of platform subsystems
* Support and Services teams for smooth customer deployments and

escalations

* Act as a technical bridge between internal teams and customer-facing functions.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 10–15+ years of experience in systems, platform, embedded, or infrastructure

engineering.

Mandatory Requirements

* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD) – required
* Deep hands-on expertise in:
* Kubernetes architecture and internals
* CSI and CNI frameworks and implementations
* Linux kernel internals and kernel-level development
* Embedded Linux systems

Storage & Networking Expertise

* Strong experience with:
* NVMe and block storage architectures
* Distributed storage concepts
* CSI driver development and lifecycle management
* CNI plugin development and pod networking
* SR-IOV, NIC offloads, and high-performance networking

Preferred / Differentiating Skills

* Experience with Kubernetes-native HCI platforms or appliance-based

infrastructure products.

* Strong programming skills in C, C++, Go, and Python.
* Experience compiling and customizing Linux kernels.
* Familiarity with hardware bring-up, PCIe devices, or firmware interactions.
* Experience working in on-prem, air-gapped, or regulated environments.
* Prior experience as a Technical Lead, Staff Engineer, or Architect.

Key Success Metrics

* Stability, performance, and scalability of storage, CSI, CNI, and kernel subsystems.
* Reduction in customer escalations related to platform, storage, and networking.
* Time-to-resolution and quality of root cause analysis for critical issues.
* Successful delivery of complex platform initiatives.
* Technical growth and effectiveness of the engineering team.

Why Join Diamanti?

* Lead deep systems engineering for a Kubernetes-native HCI appliance.
* Own storage, networking, and kernel subsystems with real enterprise impact.
* Act as a key technical authority for customer-critical issues.
* Influence long-term platform architecture and technical direction.
* Build mission-critical on-prem infrastructure for modern workloads

* Project, cost & supplier management: Manage multiple projects, milestones and budgets; coordinate with Sales, Purchase, SCM, Quality, Production and PPC; drive VA/VE, localization, alternate components and cost optimization.
* Team leadership & problem solving: Lead, allocate and review work of 2 Mechanical and 2 Electronics Engineers; develop team competency; lead RCA, 8D and corrective actions; report project status, risks and performance to management.

3. **Authorities**

Review and approve designs, drawings, BOM, technical specifications and development plans within the approval matrix; allocate team resources; coordinate customer and supplier technical matters; recommend prototypes, testing, tooling, software, equipment and CAPEX; initiate engineering changes and escalate critical risks.

4. **Qualification**, Experience & Competencies

B.E./B.Tech in Electronics / Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering; minimum 15 years of relevant automotive product design and development experience. Proven ability to lead both Mechanical and Electronics engineering teams and manage products from concept to mass production. Strong understanding of electronic circuit/PCB design, sensors, actuators, embedded systems, mechanical design, 2D/3D modelling, GD&T, tooling, DFM/DFA, product testing, APQP, PPAP, DFMEA/PFMEA and IATF 16949. Strong leadership, customer-handling, project management and problem-solving skills. Mechanical CAD and electronics design software knowledge preferred.

5. **Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

On-time project completion; customer design and PPAP approvals; successful product validation and mass-production handover; design quality and reduction in design-related failures; development cost and VA/VE savings; timely closure of customer/audit issues; effective team performance and competency development.

6. **Key Interfaces & General Responsibilities**

Internal: Sales, Purchase/SCM, Production, Quality, PPC and Management. External: Domestic/export customers, component suppliers, tooling vendors and testing laboratories. Maintain confidentiality of customer/company designs and records; follow company procedures, quality, safety and statutory requirements; perform other relevant duties assigned by management.
