**Product Manager Corporate Functions**

**Function:** Digital Transformation & Innovation  
 **Department:** Digital & IT  
 **Location:** Hyderabad  
 **Reporting To:** Lead – Digital Transformation & Innovation  
 **Role Type:** Full-time

**1. Role Purpose**

Own the digital product roadmap and transformation initiatives across Olectra's corporate and business functions, driving process efficiency, automation, employee experience and business productivity through technology.

The role will work closely with functional stakeholders to identify business challenges, translate requirements into digital solutions, manage product lifecycles and ensure successful adoption and measurable business outcomes.

The Product Manager will act as the bridge between business functions, technology teams and external solution partners, ensuring that digital capabilities evolve in alignment with Olectra's business priorities.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Develop and maintain a digital product roadmap for corporate and business functions.
* Identify opportunities for process digitisation, simplification, automation and innovation.
* Evaluate business requirements and prioritise initiatives based on business value, feasibility and strategic alignment.
* Define product vision, objectives, milestones and success metrics.

**B. Business Process Transformation**

* Engage with functional leaders and process owners across Finance, HR, Procurement, Administration, Legal and other corporate functions.
* Understand existing business processes, identify bottlenecks and recommend technology-led improvements.
* Drive standardisation and process optimisation before translating requirements into digital solutions.
* Identify opportunities for workflow automation, low-code/no-code solutions, AI and intelligent automation.

**C. Product Development & Delivery**

* Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories and product requirements.
* Work with internal technology teams, implementation partners and vendors to design and deliver solutions.
* Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, sprint planning, testing and release management, as applicable.
* Ensure seamless integration with enterprise platforms and existing applications.
* Drive solution delivery within agreed timelines, scope and budgets.

**D. Stakeholder & Vendor Management**

* Act as the primary product interface between business stakeholders and technology teams.
* Facilitate requirement workshops, solution discussions and product demonstrations.
* Manage external product vendors and implementation partners.
* Evaluate solution proposals, product capabilities, scalability and commercial considerations.
* Ensure alignment between business expectations and technology delivery.

**E. Product Lifecycle & Adoption**

* Own the product lifecycle from ideation and business case through implementation, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Drive user acceptance testing, change management, training and adoption.
* Monitor product performance and identify opportunities for enhancement.
* Establish product KPIs and measure business benefits, productivity improvements and user satisfaction.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, governance, security and support arrangements.

**3. Key Deliverables**

* Corporate Functions Digital Transformation Roadmap.
* Prioritised digital product portfolio and implementation pipeline.
* Business process digitisation and automation initiatives.
* Functional requirements, product specifications and solution designs.
* Successful implementation and adoption of digital products.
* Measurable improvements in process efficiency, turnaround time and productivity.
* Product performance dashboards and benefits realisation reports.

**4. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of enterprise business processes across corporate functions.
* Product management and business process transformation capabilities.
* Experience in workflow automation, enterprise applications and digital solutions.
* Understanding of API integrations, application architecture and enterprise technology ecosystems.
* Ability to translate business problems into technology solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience managing vendors, implementation partners and cross-functional teams.
* Analytical thinking, problem-solving and prioritisation capabilities.
* Working knowledge of Agile methodologies and product lifecycle management.

**5. Educational Qualification & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* MBA or relevant postgraduate qualification preferred.
* 7–12 years of overall experience in enterprise technology, digital transformation, business applications or product management.
* At least 3–5 years of experience in product management, digital solution delivery or business transformation roles.
* Experience working with corporate functions such as Finance, HR, Procurement, Administration or other enterprise functions.
* Experience in manufacturing or automotive organisations will be an added advantage.

**6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Delivery of the approved corporate digital product roadmap.
* Number of business processes digitised or automated.
* Reduction in manual effort and process turnaround time.
* Improvement in employee and business-user experience.
* Product adoption and active usage.
* Realisation of defined business benefits and productivity improvements.
* Delivery adherence against approved timelines and budgets.

**7. Ideal Candidate Profile**

A business-oriented technology professional who understands enterprise processes, thinks like a product owner and can independently drive digital transformation initiatives. The candidate should be equally comfortable engaging with business leaders, challenging existing processes, defining product requirements and working with technology teams to deliver scalable solutions.

jobs.title: Marketing Excellence Manager
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

**Management Level**

7 / Manager

**Must Have Skills**

Marketing Process Redesign, Marketing Operating Model Transformation, AI & Automation Integration, Client Consulting

**Good to Have Skills**

Agent Experience (AX) Design, Process Mapping/Mining, MarTech and AdTech Ecosystems, Data Visualization (Tableau/Power BI)

**Job Summary**

Practice: I&P | Global Network - SONG | Areas of Work: Marketing Process Excellence, AI-Enabled Marketing Transformation, Future-State Marketing Process Design, Marketing Operating Model Redesign, Agent Experience (AX) Design, Functional Consulting.

As a Manager, you will help clients reimagine how marketing work gets done across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, content, media, CRM, social, search, and measurement through process redesign, digital innovation, data-driven decision-making, and AI-powered ways of working. Operating at the intersection of customer experience, marketing, analytics, technology, and operations, you will lead workstreams, conduct capability and process assessments, define future-state processes and operating models, shape transformation roadmaps, and deliver measurable outcomes that improve growth, customer value, and operational effectiveness.

**You Are**

You are a hands-on marketing transformation leader who can take ownership of a client workstream from diagnostic through future-state design. You combine practical knowledge of how modern marketing functions operate with structured process excellence methods, and you can translate business priorities into clear process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, and adoption requirements.

You design at the intersection of marketer, AI agent, platform, and process. You apply Agent Experience (AX) Design principles to determine where AI agents can support or automate work, where human judgment is essential, and how roles, controls, escalation, and handoffs should be designed to improve speed, quality, compliance, and business outcomes.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

Use AI tools across research, analysis, design, and deliverable creation, and identify opportunities to embed AI and agentic solutions into redesigned marketing processes. As a Manager, you will be expected to independently lead workstreams, facilitate client discussions, and convert analysis into implementation-ready recommendations. Your responsibilities include:

**Marketing Transformation & Benchmarking**

* Assess marketing trends, customer and channel shifts, and peer practices to identify process reinvention opportunities across customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty, campaign planning, content operations, media, CRM/lifecycle marketing, social and influencer marketing, search, marketing operations, and measurement.
* Lead capability and process diagnostics and benchmarking to identify performance gaps, pain points, control issues, duplication, and opportunities to improve productivity, speed-to-market, customer experience, marketing effectiveness, and cost efficiency.
* Build data-driven assessments and executive-ready insights using AI-assisted analysis and visualization tools, translating findings into clear transformation priorities.

**Future-State Marketing Process Design**

* Lead future-state marketing process and operating model design covering AI integration points, workflow automation, decision rights, governance, human-machine interaction, platform enablement, measurement, and workforce adoption.
* Lead client discovery workshops and stakeholder interviews; facilitate co-creation across marketing, content, media, CRM, analytics, technology, and operations teams; and present recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
* Connect future-state marketing processes to MarTech/AdTech platforms and delivery realities so that transformation designs are practical, scalable, measurable, and ready for implementation.

**Operating Model, Change & Adoption**

* Develop change-impact assessments covering roles, skills, governance, ways of working, service delivery, and adoption implications created by redesigned marketing processes.
* Build and maintain marketing process playbooks, redesign methods, benchmarks, and reusable assets; contribute to proposals and thought leadership; and coach junior practitioners on marketing process excellence and operating model design.

**AI & AX Design Application**

* Embed Agent Experience (AX) Design principles into marketing process specifications by defining AI agent roles, autonomy levels, decision boundaries, controls, escalation triggers, and human-agent handoffs within redesigned workflows.
* Identify practical agentic use cases across marketing planning, insight generation, content and campaign operations, optimization, measurement, and reporting, with appropriate controls and governance.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* 2-8 years of experience in process excellence, marketing transformation, functional consulting, or management consulting, with increasing independence across engagements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead client workstreams, conduct capability and current-state process assessments, facilitate workshops, and present future-state recommendations to senior stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of marketing operating models and processes across two or more areas such as campaign management, content operations, media, CRM, social and influencer marketing, search, MarTech, or measurement.
* Working knowledge of how AI, automation, and agentic solutions can be integrated into marketing processes, including operating model and governance implications.
* Experience with process mapping, benchmarking, change-impact analysis, and business case development; ability to translate data into structured, business-ready recommendations.
* Strong communication, workshop facilitation, and client relationship skills, with the ability to explain complex process, AI, data, and technology choices in business terms.
* Ability to connect customer and growth outcomes with marketing process, operating model, technology, data, AI, governance, measurement, and adoption requirements.
* Experience working in fast-paced, matrixed, global consulting environments and managing multiple workstreams with client-facing accountability.
* Experience contributing to business development, proposal/RFP development, reusable assets, or thought leadership, and coaching junior practitioners, is preferred.

**Additional Information**

* Experience in consumer-led B2C industries is strongly preferred, including Consumer Goods & Services, Retail, Life Sciences, Automotive, Travel, Communications & Media, or similar sectors with scaled marketing operations.
* Familiarity with process mapping or process mining tools such as Visio, Signavio, ARIS, or equivalent is a strong differentiator.
* Exposure to MarTech/AdTech ecosystems such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Salesforce, Sprinklr, Google Marketing Platform, or comparable enterprise platforms is desirable.
* Applied knowledge of Agent Experience (AX) Design principles - including agent autonomy, handoffs, escalation, controls, and human oversight - is preferred.
* Strong analytical skills and ability to connect process improvements to measurable marketing outcomes such as productivity, speed-to-market, engagement, conversion, ROI, or customer experience.
* Proactive approach to continuous learning; stays current on AI, agentic marketing, automation, marketing operating models, and emerging digital marketing practices.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

jobs.title: Manager, Digital & AI Solutions
jobs.description:
**About Ghintell**  
Ghintell is the AI-first healthcare intelligence, research and analytics company within Zealth Group. Together with Zealth, our market access business, and ijovi, our strategy and creative business, we support some of the worlds largest pharmaceutical companies. Our Bengaluru centre of excellence brings together expertise in medical research, analytics and health economics.  
We are expanding how we deliver that expertise through web applications, interactive dashboards and connected data solutions that help clients access insights and put them to work.

**The opportunity**  
We are looking for an internationally experienced, business-minded leader to head our Digital & AI Solutions team in Bengaluru and help our pharmaceutical clients get more value from data, analytics and AI.  
You will be the bridge between our clients, our consultants and our technical team. You will understand what clients need, shape the right solution with the team and explain technical choices in understandable language, so that clients and colleagues can make good decisions with confidence.  
You will lead a team spanning analytics, IT and web application engineering. This is not a hands-on development role, but it calls for enough technical understanding to set direction, ask the right questions and ensure that everything we deliver is secure, reliable and well run.  
The role is international by nature. You will work across cultures and time zones, with colleagues in Copenhagen and the US and with clients across North America, Europe and international markets.  
You will report to the VP of Finance, IT and AI Analytics, with a dotted line to the Site Head in Bengaluru.

**What you will do**  
**Lead and develop the team.** Set priorities, coach team members and build a culture of quality, ownership and continuous improvement.  
**Understand client needs.** Work with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business questions and turn them into clear, practical solutions.  
**Translate between business and technology.** Explain technical options, risks and trade-offs in simple terms, and make sure the team understands the business context.  
**Own delivery.** Make sure solutions are delivered on time, to the agreed quality and within budget, from scoping to handover and ongoing support.  
 **Keep solutions secure and well run.** Make sure the team follows good practice for security, data protection and client IT requirements, and lead our input into client IT and security reviews.  
**Grow what we offer.** Shape new services in data, analytics and AI with colleagues across Zealth Group, and contribute to proposals and client conversations.  
**Oversee internal IT.** Work with our Senior IT Partner to keep internal systems reliable and aligned with business priorities.

**How you will work with AI**  
AI is changing how we deliver. Our consultants and analysts create prototypes, dashboards and tools with AI. You will help the team turn the best of these into solutions clients can rely on, decide where AI adds real value for clients, and make sure it is used responsibly, with the right tools and data for each engagement.  
Deep AI engineering expertise is not required. We value curiosity, sound judgement and the ability to explain clearly what AI can and cannot do.

**What you bring**

* At least six years of experience in consulting, professional services, analytics or digital delivery, including experience leading teams.
* Substantial experience in international companies or with clients across several countries, working comfortably across cultures and time zones.
* A track record of working directly with clients and senior stakeholders and building trusted relationships.  
   Strong business acumen and the ability to connect technical work to client value.
* Sufficient technical understanding of data, analytics, web applications and cloud services to guide a technical team and make sound decisions.
* The ability to explain complex technical topics clearly and simply.  
   Excellent written and spoken English at a professional, client-facing level.
* Experience in pharmaceutical, life science or healthcare, a consulting or professional services background, and experience with AI-enabled services or digital products would be valuable.

**What we offer**

* A leadership role with an established team and a direct say in how the function grows.
* Meaningful ownership of solutions used by leading pharmaceutical companies.
* Close collaboration with colleagues across Bengaluru, Copenhagen and the US.
* An environment where you can apply new technology to practical client needs and see the impact of your work.

The role and responsibilities of the Medical Copywriter includes the following:

* The role works within medical, regulatory, and legal guidelines to ensure compliance with legislation and regulations in the Netherlands, including the client's internal policies. It also ensures that all content is supported by authentic, current, and up-to-date references. A working understanding of the CGR Code (Code Geneesmiddelenreclame) and the Dutch Medicines Act is required.
* There may be occasional opportunities to be involved in creative projects involving ideation and moving image for campaign level activity.
* Working in partnership with a graphic design team (on the needs for copy and content), with the brand and production teams on briefs, workshops and project deliveries.
* Ensuring compliance to local legislation and regulations including client internal policies, ensuring that content development & activities are supported by authentic and up-to-date references.
* Follow best practices in the department regarding processes, communication (internal and external), project management, documentation and technical requirements such as language, grammar, stylization, content search, summarizing, data conflicts, and referencing
* Adherence to the highest editorial standards is expected while creating copy drafts
* Participating in assigned training programs and working on assignments as per requirement.
* Participating in client calls as per project requirements
* Use of, overseeing and harnessing the advantages of AI tools in providing accurate and relevant copy content.
* Being compliant to quality, confidentiality, and security; adhering to and following quality systems, processes, and policies; and being compliant to training and specifications.

Ideal Profile:

* Education related healthcare Degree/Masters or equivalent qualification preferable
* Minimum of 3+ years of experience, including an in-house creative or agency role working with Pharma sector clients
* Awareness of local and country/region specific regulatory requirements
* Familiarity with / intermediate understanding of, the fields of medicine and good to have respiratory & immunology, cardiovascular, renal & metabolic, oncology therapy areas
* Be open to developing such knowledge, outlined immediately above, further working with relevant Medical teams
* Strong flair, skills and passion for writing with conceptual ability and a solid knowledge of the digital landscape
* Strong written and verbal communication/presentation skills
* To have had relevant experience and being skilled in SEO copywriting, pairing best practices that drive traffic (keyword research), with compelling copy, encouraging a desired action, is a distinct advantage.
* Passion for networking and stakeholder engagement.
* Being up to date with the latest technical/scientific developments and relating them to various projects
* Client-oriented attitude with focus on creating strong long-term relationships with clients and encouraging others to work toward this goal
* Ability to assure timely completion of assignments
* Skilled in problem identification and problem solving
* Detail oriented, well organized and timeline driven with the ability to multitask.
* Experience working within a large multi-national company in a matrix corporate environment preferable.
* Should have both strong written and verbal communication skills in native Dutch language and good business English language skills.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing - Intern
jobs.description:
**About AstroLokal**

AstroLokal is a rapidly growing astrology platform that connects users with experienced astrologers through chat, audio, and consultation services. Were building a trusted ecosystem where astrologers can grow their practice while helping users find guidance in their preferred language.

As we continue to grow, were looking for creative minds who can help us reach new audiences through relatable stories, engaging content, and compelling regional-language advertisements.

  

**Role Overview**

As a Content & Creative Executive, you'll play a key role in creating advertisements that attract new users and drive app growth for AstroLokal.

This role combines creative writing, storytelling, and audience understanding with performance marketing. You'll get the opportunity to explore different content formats, experiment with creative ideas, and understand how your work translates into measurable business results.

You don't need to be a performance marketing expert already. We're looking for someone with strong writing skills, creative thinking, and a curiosity to learn what makes an advertisement successful.

  

**Role & responsibilities** :

* Research audience preferences, regional trends, and competitor advertisements to identify creative opportunities.
* Develop ad concepts, catchy hooks, copy, and video scripts in **Regional** language.
* Brief and collaborate with designers, video editors, and creators to bring your ideas to life.
* Create and experiment with **80 to 100 creative variations** per week.
* Track creative performance using metrics such as CTR, CPI, and CAC.
* Analyse results, identify winning concepts, and improve creatives based on performance insights.
* Maintain a record of creative experiments, results, and key learnings.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong reading and writing skills, with native-level proficiency in **Regional Language and good command of English**.
* Experience in copywriting, content creation, scriptwriting, or social media. Internships and freelance projects count too!
* A creative mindset with an eye for storytelling and engaging content.
* Basic understanding of performance marketing metrics such as **CTR, CPI, and CAC.**
* Someone who enjoys experimenting, takes feedback positively, and loves creating content.

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile** :

  

* 0 to 1 years. Freshers are welcome!
* Personal blogs, Instagram pages, YouTube channels, college projects, and writing portfolios are all a plus.
* No prior experience managing ad campaigns is required. We'll help you learn performance marketing along the way.

**Love creating content? Curious about what makes people click? Come turn your creativity into campaigns that drive results!**

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Voice and Digital Sales
jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**

The Digital Sales professional will own the sales pipeline generated through digital channels, end to end. Beyond closing deals, the role turns every customer interaction and funnel stage into intelligence that improves marketing messaging, targeting, and funnel design. The person acts as the bridge between Sales, Marketing, and Product, using 360-degree funnel feedback to find and fix leaks from the first ad impression to activation.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Digital Sales Ownership

* Own revenue and conversion targets for leads sourced from digital channels (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, website, referral, and other digital sources).
* Manage the inbound enquiry-to-activation cycle: lead qualification, follow-up cadence, plan recommendation, objection handling, and closure.
* Set and enforce SLAs for lead response time, follow-up, and activation, and track adherence.
* Work with the Field and Sales organisation so digital leads are routed, tracked, and closed consistently.

2. 360-Degree Funnel Feedback

* Build and maintain a view of the full funnel: awareness enquiry qualification plan selection payment installation activation retention and referral.
* Track conversion, drop-off, and time-in-stage at every step, split by lead source, city, plan, and persona.
* Identify where prospects stall, abandon, or go cold, and diagnose the cause (price, speed of response, plan fit, availability, form friction, trust, or competitor offer).
* Produce a fortnightly funnel health report with clear actions, owners, and expected impact.

3. Customer Interaction Insights

* Capture structured call and chat insights: objections, questions, competitor mentions, and reasons for drop-off or purchase.
* Convert recurring objections and questions into a prioritised list for marketing (messaging gaps) and product (feature or process gaps).
* Listen to call recordings and chat transcripts regularly to validate what the data shows.

4. Marketing Loophole Detection

* Audit end-to-end marketing journeys, from ad copy and landing page to enquiry form, thank-you page, and sales follow-up, to find breaks in the chain.
* Flag mismatches between what ads promise and what the sales conversation delivers (for example, speed, price, coverage, or installation timelines).
* Identify attribution and lead-quality gaps, such as junk referrals, duplicate enquiries, or leads from channels that never convert.

5. Funnel and Messaging Recommendations

* Recommend changes to messaging at each stage: ad copy, landing page, plan descriptions, sales script, and follow-up communication.
* Recommend targeting changes based on which audiences, geographies, and personas convert and retain best.
* Propose funnel changes such as form simplification, call-back triggers, instant-activation flows, or offer structures, and back each with a hypothesis.
* Run A/B tests or structured pilots on recommendations and report results.

6. Cross-Functional Execution

* Partner with Digital Marketing (Performance, SEO, CRO) on campaign and landing page changes.
* Partner with Product on SmartWiFi, the super app, and onboarding flows based on customer feedback.
* Partner with Field and Sales leadership on lead handover, territory coverage, and objection-handling training.
* Present funnel findings and recommendations to senior leadership, with a clear impact estimate for each.

Impact Expectations

For each recommendation, the role is expected to state the expected action, the outcome it should drive, and the business impact (for example, higher lead-to-activation rate, lower cost per activation, or faster response time). Results are reviewed monthly against that forecast.

jobs.description:
**Looking for Senior Digital Marketing Consultant**

**Experience:** 3-5 Years  
**Location:** Pune (Work from Office)  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

  

**Job Overview:**

We are looking for an experienced Senior Digital Marketing Consultant to plan, strategise, execute, and manage end-to-end digital marketing activities for multiple clients across diverse industries. The role involves developing integrated marketing strategies, managing client relationships, driving campaign performance, coordinating internal teams, and identifying growth opportunities.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

**1. 360 Digital Marketing Strategy & Planning**

* Develop and execute customised digital marketing strategies for clients across diverse industries.
* Understand client objectives, target audiences, products, services, and competitors to create marketing roadmaps.
* Plan integrated campaigns to improve brand visibility, engagement, lead generation, customer acquisition, and conversions.
* Identify new marketing opportunities, platforms, and emerging digital trends.

**2. Performance Marketing & Paid Advertising**

* Plan, execute, manage, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and other relevant platforms. • Manage budgets, audience targeting, bidding strategies, A/B testing, ad creatives, and landing page recommendations.
* Monitor CPL, CPA, CPC, CTR, ROAS, conversion rates, and other campaign metrics.
* Continuously optimise campaigns to improve performance and advertising ROI.

**3. Social Media & Community Marketing**

* Develop social media strategies across Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
* Prepare monthly content calendars, campaign themes, and platform-specific distribution plans.
* Plan posts, carousels, reels, stories, videos, and other engaging formats.
* Execute community marketing across Reddit, Quora, Medium, and relevant online communities to build awareness, reach, and credibility.

**4. Marketplace & E-commerce Marketing**

* Manage marketplace marketing across Amazon, Flipkart, eBay, Gumtree, and other e-commerce platforms, as well as Blinkit and Zepto wherever applicable.
* Plan product visibility campaigns, sponsored advertising, promotions, and marketplace optimisation.
* Coordinate product listings, catalogues, descriptions, images, A+ content, and brand stores.
* Monitor product performance, sales, conversions, and advertising ROI.

**5. Content Marketing & Blog Management**

* Develop content strategies aligned with client objectives and campaign requirements.
* Plan and coordinate blogs, articles, website content, newsletters, case studies, and marketing collaterals.
* Create blogs and marketing content as required for assigned projects. • Maintain brand messaging, content quality, and consistency while coordinating with writers and designers.

**6. Email, Influencer & Video Marketing**

* Plan email campaigns, newsletters, audience segmentation, and automation.
* Identify influencers, creators, and industry experts; manage outreach, briefs, collaborations, and deliverables.
* Plan video initiatives including reels, promotional and product videos, brand films, and testimonials.
* Explore AI-powered content creation and emerging digital formats.

**7. Client Relationship & Account Management**

* Conduct client meetings, understand business requirements, and present marketing strategies and recommendations.
* Manage end-to-end client communication, project updates, deliverables, timelines, and feedback.
* Act as the primary point of contact between assigned clients and internal teams.
* Prepare proposals, campaign plans, presentations, and monthly roadmaps; handle additional projects and ad-hoc requirements.
* Identify opportunities to expand client engagements through additional marketing services.

**8. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Optimisation**

* Track campaigns using GA4, Google Ads, Meta Business Suite, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, marketplace dashboards, and other analytics tools.
* Prepare weekly and monthly reports against defined KPIs and business objectives.
* Analyse data, identify performance gaps, and recommend actionable improvements.
* Present campaign insights and ensure budgets are utilised effectively

**9. Team Management & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with design, content, video production, SEO, website development, and other internal teams.
* Prepare briefs, allocate deliverables, monitor progress, and ensure timely execution.
* Guide and mentor junior digital marketing executives whenever required.
* Review campaign quality and manage multiple projects while meeting deadlines and client expectations.

**10. Marketing Research & Industry Awareness**

* Conduct competitor analysis, market research, audience research, and digital presence audits.
* Stay updated with digital marketing trends, advertising technologies, marketplace developments, and industry practices.
* Explore new channels, AI tools, campaign formats, and growth opportunities.
* Recommend strategies to improve brand visibility, campaign performance, and client outcomes

  

**Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.

* Strong knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, SEO/SEM, and analytics tools.
* Understanding of social media, performance, marketplace, community, and content marketing.
* Experience managing multiple client accounts and end-to-end campaigns.
* Excellent client communication, presentation, project management, and leadership skills.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage projects independently, coordinate teams, and deliver measurable results.

  

**Good to Have**

* Experience in B2B marketing and growth-driven strategies.
* Knowledge of marketplace advertising and e-commerce marketing.

* Experience with Canva, Figma, or Adobe Creative Suite.

jobs.description:
**Assistant Manager - IT Compliance, CSV & QMS (Pharma).**

  

**Department:** Information Technology (IT)   
**Function:** IT Compliance, Computer System Validation (CSV), QMS & Digitalization   
**Industry:** Pharmaceutical / Life Sciences   
**Qualification:** Degree / Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Instrumentation, or related discipline   
**Experience:** 8-10 Years

  

**Position Summary**

The role is responsible for ensuring compliance, validation, and lifecycle management of GxP-regulated computerized systems across Manufacturing, Operational Technology (OT), and Enterprise Applications. The incumbent shall support Computer System Validation (CSV), Quality Management System (QMS) activities, digital transformation initiatives, and regulatory compliance while maintaining the validated state of business-critical systems. The position requires expertise in enterprise applications, OT systems, data integrity, and pharmaceutical regulatory requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. IT Compliance & Regulatory Governance**

* Ensure compliance of computerized systems with GxP requirements, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, and applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Support Data Integrity initiatives in alignment with ALCOA+ principles.
* Participate in regulatory inspections, customer audits, and internal compliance audits.
* Develop, review, and maintain IT policies, procedures, standards, and validation documents.
* Manage and support Quality Management System (QMS) activities including Change Control, CAPA, Deviations, Risk Assessments, and Audit Observations.
* Monitor compliance status of GxP systems and ensure inspection readiness.

**2. Computer System Validation (CSV)**

* Lead and execute the complete CSV lifecycle for Quality Control, Manufacturing, OT, and Enterprise Applications.
* Prepare, review, and execute validation deliverables including:
* Validation Plan
* User Requirement Specification (URS)
* Functional Requirement Specification (FRS)
* Functional Risk Assessment (FRA)
* Design Specification (DS)
* Installation Qualification (IQ)
* Operational Qualification (OQ)
* Performance Qualification (PQ)
* Traceability Matrix
* Validation Summary Report (VSR)
* Implement risk-based validation methodologies in accordance with GAMP 5 guidelines.
* Conduct periodic reviews, revalidation, and system assessments to maintain validated status.
* Evaluate system changes and perform impact assessments as part of change management.

**3. Enterprise Applications Support**

* Support and maintain validated enterprise applications such as:
* TrackWise
* PAS-X
* Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS)
* SAP
* Other GxP-regulated business applications
* Ensure system availability, security, compliance, and data integrity.
* Coordinate application upgrades, patches, enhancements, and validation activities.
* Provide user support, troubleshooting, and training as required.

**4. Operational Technology (OT) Systems**

* Support implementation and qualification of Level-1 and Level-2 automation/OT projects.
* Manage and maintain OT infrastructure and systems including:
* PLC
* SCADA
* Historians
* Manufacturing Automation Systems
* Troubleshoot PLC programming and automation-related issues.
* Support qualification and validation activities for OT systems.
* Maintain high-level understanding of OT databases and system architecture.
* Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to improve operational efficiency and system reliability.

**5. Digitalization & Project Management**

* Participate in digital transformation and Industry 4.0 initiatives.
* Lead and coordinate IT compliance, CSV, and automation-related projects.
* Manage project timelines, documentation, resources, and stakeholder expectations.
* Coordinate with external vendors, consultants, and service providers.
* Ensure project execution aligns with compliance and validation requirements.
* Track project deliverables, risks, and mitigation actions.

**6. Functional Competencies**

* Regulatory Compliance Management
* Audit & Inspection Readiness
* Risk Assessment & Impact Analysis
* Root Cause Investigation
* Documentation Management
* Validation Planning & Execution
* Vendor Management
* Cross-functional Collaboration

**7. Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Leadership and project coordination abilities.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving approach.
* High attention to quality, compliance, and documentation accuracy.
* Ability to work effectively with QA, QC, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Corporate IT teams.

**8. Preferred Experience**

* Experience in Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or Life Sciences industry.
* Participation in US FDA, MHRA, WHO, EU GMP, or customer audits.
* Exposure to Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), PAS-X, TrackWise, SAP, and LIMS.
* Experience in Digital Transformation, Industry 4.0, Automation, and OT cybersecurity initiatives.
* Knowledge of computerized system qualification and validation of laboratory and manufacturing systems.

jobs.title: RDE India Lead
jobs.description:
Job Description and Requirements

  

BHS Corrugated India Pvt Ltd, based in Pune, has been a subsidiary of BHS Corrugated, Germany, since 2011. We bring together start-up culture and decades of corporate experience, and we work on the digital future of the corrugated cardboard industry.

We are building GCC RDE India (Research, Development & Engineering), a delivery organisation in our Pune Global Capability Centre that works for our engineering sites in Weiherhammer (Germany) and at BHS Intralogistics. As its Director, you build and run this organisation and its three areas: Development, Lifecycle and AI.

  

AI is more than a third area of its own. AI-enabled workflows, agents and engineering harnesses are also built into Development and Lifecycle. You drive delivery across all three areas and make sure they work as one organisation, not as silos.

Your Future Tasks

* Lead GCC RDE India as a delivery organisation. You lead the three area leads (Development, Lifecycle, AI) and, through them, their teams.
* Own the budget. You own the budget of all three areas, and that includes AI usage. You control cost against this budget and release in writing any spending beyond an area's approved budget. This includes AI consumption (tokens), also for work packages Weiherhammer commissions in India, as well as building harnesses and agents, trial work, cloud hosting during trials and AI governance effort.
* Make AI consumption measurable. You set up how AI consumption is measured for each work package of Weiherhammer commissions, with KPIs that compare the tokens used with the output they produce, and the reasoning behind each number. You discuss this mechanism with the ordering sites, get it approved, and then report against it.
* Deliver against commitments. You turn the requirements and work packages from the ordering sites into delivery plans that Pune can execute: who works on what, milestones, quality criteria, acceptance and escalation. You agree quality criteria with the ordering sites, make sure results are checked before they are handed over, and follow up on defects.
* Report. You deliver a monthly report per area on bookings, consumption, forecast and milestones to the programme coordination in Germany.
* Orchestrate the three area leads: capacities, priorities, dependencies, interfaces and escalation paths.
* Keep one shared technical foundation. Weiherhammer and BHS Intralogistics both order from GCC RDE India. You orchestrate their orders so that the areas build on one shared foundation and no parallel world grows up beside it.

  

* Be the single point of contact between GCC RDE India, the ordering sites, the Head GCC and top management, and translate technical progress into clear business updates. For our global engineering and AI transformation programme, you present delivery status, business value, budget and forecast, risks, resource needs and decision requests credibly to senior and top management.
* Build the leadership team. You lead senior hiring together with the Head GCC and HR, and you onboard, develop and retain the area leads.
* Connect Pune and Germany. You lead Pune delegations to Weiherhammer and host German delegations in Pune, in the rhythm the current topics need, with the leads and experts those topics need.
* Grow the organisation on delivery. Growth follows demonstrated delivery and is re-assessed at each step.

  

What This Role Is Not

  

This is a leadership and delivery role, not a specialist role. Technical direction runs from the technical architects in Germany directly to the area leads, and the area leads own their technology. You need enough technical understanding to follow and challenge them, but you do not decide technical questions.

You must understand AI-enabled engineering delivery well enough to challenge feasibility, capacity demand, delivery risk and business value, and to turn technical direction into delivery that works across functions.

  

Requirements

  

Must have:

* Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology or a comparable qualification.
* 15+ years of professional experience, of which 5+ years leading managers.
* Has run a GCC, a captive centre or the delivery organisation of an offshore engineering or development centre for a European or German parent.
* Proven experience managing complex cross-functional engineering or digital-transformation work packages across onshore and offshore teams, with measurable responsibility for delivery, cost, quality and schedule.
* Budget and cost responsibility across several teams, with controlling discipline.
* Has managed managers, not only individual contributors, and has grown an organisation of several teams step by step, tied to delivery.
* Board-level stakeholder management across sites and cultures, in English.
* Hiring and onboarding of senior people in the Pune talent market.

  

* General technical background in engineering, manufacturing or industrial equipment, enough to understand a technical strategy built on engineering data, cloud and AI, and to follow what the three area leads talk about.
* Experience establishing scalable, reusable workflows or platforms across several engineering processes and tools, rather than managing individual software licences or isolated AI use cases. Relevant examples include SAP, Solid Edge, MATLAB, other engineering software and lifecycle workflows.
* Strong business acumen, strategic thinking and decision-making, with a structured and delivery-oriented approach.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and leadership skills across diverse teams and geographies.
* Very good written and spoken English; willingness to travel to Germany regularly.

  

Good to have:

* German language skills, or experience working with a German headquarters.
* Experience in industrial machinery, capital equipment, manufacturing or R&D environments.

  

Explicitly not required:

  

* Specialist depth in mechanical, electrical, data or AI engineering.

  

We Offer You

  

* The chance to build and lead a new delivery organization inside a growing Global Capability Centre.
* Close work with international leadership and technical teams in Germany and India.
* Ownership and responsibility from the first day, in a solidly financed organization.
* Influence on organizational capabilities, processes and long-term growth.
* Flexibility, openness and an entrepreneurial working culture.

  
  

Regards,

Rivka Pawar

HRBP

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Core Platform
jobs.description:
***Note:** Tarlan is hiring a Senior Product Manager, Core Platform for a global logistics technology company.*

  

**Location: Bangalore (On-site; full-time)**

  

**About the Company**

The company offers an agentic Transportation Management System for all-mile and all-channel, trusted by global enterprises.

  

The platform unifies orders, capacity, and carrier networks into one living plan, aligning planning, execution, and settlement so promises become proof. AI co-pilots with guardrails surface risk early and recommend the next best move to protect SLAs and reduce empty miles.

  

**The Company's Journey and Impact**

The company has been on a mission to make logistics decision-making intelligent, sustainable, and real-world ready. Its platform has powered billions of deliveries across 30+ countries for global enterprises, driving measurable impact in cost savings, carbon reduction, and SLA performance.

  

**The Company's Global Footprint**

Headquartered in Bangalore, with teams across the U.S., U.K., UAE, and Southeast Asia, the company brings together 170+ engineers, designers, and problem-solvers united by a single goal: to reinvent how the world moves goods.

  

**Traits the Company Values**

The company looks for people who are:

* **Global in mindset:** curious about diverse markets and ideas.
* **Unrelenting in drive:** energized by complex challenges.
* **Intelligent in approach:** analytical, creative, and thoughtful.
* **Dynamic in execution:** adaptive and decisive in fast-moving contexts.
* **Exact in craft:** detail-oriented and committed to excellence.

  

**Why this role**

Every product at the company runs on one shared platform: the building blocks for data models, workflows, rules, documents, notifications, access and AI agents. The company needs an SPM to move that platform forward, fast, so product teams build on it instead of around it.

  

**What you will do**

* Own platform areas end to end: the AI platform (agents and LLM tooling), the data platform, and the document and template framework.
* Start by executing the company's existing platform roadmap; grow into shaping it.
* Turn what product teams need into capabilities everyone can reuse, not one-off builds.
* Write clear specs and acceptance criteria, down to APIs, data models and edge cases; work daily with platform engineers to ship.
* Close the known gaps that slow product teams down: missing building blocks, heavy setup, reliability.
* Explain each capability so product, solutions and engineering teams can use it.

  

**You have**

* 6 to 10 years in product, with at least 2 on a platform, developer or infrastructure product.
* Hands-on AI familiarity: you have built with LLMs or agents and know where they fail.
* Comfort with APIs, data models, events and multi-tenant SaaS: you can read a schema and a payload.
* Clear, short writing. Daily use of AI tools.
* Logistics or supply chain experience is a plus.

  

**Who you are**

* High agency. You don't wait to be told. You see the gap, own it and close it.
* You get stuff done. You finish what you start and chase it until it ships.
* Ambitious and hungry to prove yourself; you want more ownership, fast.
* Ready to get your hands dirty: read the code path, test the API, fix the data.
* Happy to work hard when it matters.

  

**What the Company Offers**

Join the company and become part of a visionary team that is redefining logistics through innovation and smart distribution. The company provides competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a collaborative environment where your expertise will drive both your growth and that of the organization.

  

The company is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Experience: 8-12 years

  

Location: Bengaluru, India

  

Job Type: Full time

  

**Job Summary:**

As a Genesys Product Owner, you will lead the product vision, roadmap and backlog for our global contact center platform, with a strong focus on Genesys Cloud capabilities, Universal UI, AI capabilities and business value realization. You will work closely with customer service stakeholders, architects, business analysts, developers and operations teams to define, prioritize and deliver scalable omnichannel solutions that enhance customer experience, improve agent productivity and support global standardization across Siemens Healthineers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Own and manage the product backlog for Genesys Cloud and related contact center capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities, customer needs and global transformation objectives.

2. Define product vision, roadmap and release priorities for contact center features including routing, IVR, digital channels, reporting, workforce optimization and integrations.

3. Collaborate with business stakeholders, regional teams and technical experts to gather requirements, refine user stories and translate strategic goals into actionable delivery plans.

4. Prioritize demand, change requests and technical enablers based on business value, operational impact, compliance needs and platform scalability.

5. Partner with architects and engineering teams to ensure solution design decisions are feasible, supportable and aligned with enterprise standards.

4. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to align business, operations and technical teams across regions and time zones.

3. Demonstrated experience with omnichannel contact center solutions and a solid understanding of customer service operations, call flows and service processes.

4. Experience working with cross-functional teams spanning business, architecture, development, testing and operations.

5. Knowledge of integration with adjacent enterprise platforms such as CRM, reporting, workforce management or automation tools is an advantage.

6. Experience working in global programs with distributed teams and stakeholders across multiple countries and time zones.

You will own the Integrations product surface so that partners can integrate faster with higher reliability, enabling new experiences and AI/agentic workflows. Integration

**Ownership Scope**

You will own all external integration modalities at Alegeus, including:

* Data integrations: Public APIs, webhooks, event streams, real-time interfaces, and asynchronous messaging patterns
* File-based integrations: EDI, CSV, batch processing, and secure file transfer (e.g., SFTP)
* Experience integrations: front-end microservices, embeddable widgets, and partner-facing UI extensions
* This role ensures that the above is designed, delivered, and evolved as one cohesive platform, not disconnected channels, with shared standards for security, versioning, observability, reliability, and partner experience.

**Outcomes you'll own**

* Reduce partner time to first value and increase adoption across key use cases.
* Ship a coherent v2 API set with clear versioning, deprecation, and a reliable release cadence.
* Launch a webhook/event framework (subscribe, replay, DLQ, idempotency) with partnergrade SLAs.
* Deliver a developer experience that delights: dev portal, docs, SDKs, samples, error taxonomy, sandbox, chatbot, etc.
* Establish product analytics KPIs (adoption, latency, reliability, errors, partner NPS) with dashboards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the roadmap for Data, File and Experience integrations; define problem statements, success metrics, and crisp PRDs.
* Partner with design/engineering/Product owners to deliver secure, scalable interfaces and reference implementations.

* Drive packaging, auth models (OAuth/OIDC), rate limits, quotas, SLAs, and change management.
* Orchestrate launches: docs, changelogs, guides, enablement, and internal readiness.

**Required Qualifications**

* 6-10+ years in PM with SaaS integrations as your product (not just "has APIs").

**How we'll measure success**

* Adoption of v2 endpoints webhook subscriptions; reduction in partner integration time.
* Reliability (SLO attainment), latency improvements, and error rate reductions for integration flows.

**About Wego**

**Wego is the leading travel app and the largest online travel marketplace in the Middle East and North Africa. Our mission is to make travel better by helping millions of people discover, compare, and book flights, hotels, and travel experiences with confidence.**

**Founded in 2005, Wego has grown from a metasearch engine into a full travel platform, combining search with our own OTA products. We dont just point travelers at a fare: we sell it, ticket it, and stand behind it when plans change.**

**That means we own the whole transaction: the checkout, everything we sell alongside the ticket, and the tools our support agents use when a traveler needs help. This role works across all three.**

**Role summary**

**You will own product work across three areas of our flights booking business: new ancillary services, booking funnel optimisation, and improvements to the Customer Support Admin Tool our support agents use every day. You will join a team of product managers, including a Senior Product Manager who leads our post-booking work, and you will take features from problem definition to launch and measured result.**

**This is a product execution role. We care more about how well you take a problem from definition to a measured outcome than about how many years you have spent in travel. Flights experience helps, and you will learn the domain fast here, because the people around you know it deeply and the problems are concrete.**

**Key responsibilities**

**Feature ownership.** Own features and initiatives from problem statement to launch and measured result. Make the product calls within your scope, and know when to escalate.

**Specification.** Write clear PRDs, user stories, decision tables and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from without a meeting. Cover the edge cases, the failure paths, and what we will not do.

**Delivery with engineering and design.** Work daily with engineering and design on scope, sequencing and trade-offs. Unblock decisions quickly. Keep scope honest when timelines slip.

**Experimentation.** Design and run A/B tests on the booking funnel and on ancillary offers. Define one primary metric and guardrails up front, test one change at a time where you can, and report results you would defend.

**Testing and launch.** Define test scenarios with QA and operations, run acceptance testing, plan staged rollouts with clear go/no-go criteria, and check that it works in production, not just in staging.

**Measurement.** Define the success metric for every feature before it is built. Instrument it, read the data yourself, and report what moved and why.

**Partnership with operations and commercial.** Work with customer support, finance and commercial teams, and with ancillary partners. Make sure every launch includes what support agents need to handle it.

**Communication.** Keep stakeholders informed with short written updates: what shipped, what it did, whats next, and what is blocked.

**Who you are** **Required**

* **3+ years in product management, with direct ownership of features that shipped to customers or operational users.**
* **A strong execution record. You can point to features you took from a messy problem to a measured outcome, and explain the trade-offs you made along the way.**
* **Hands-on experimentation. You have designed and read A/B tests yourself, and you know the common ways they mislead.**
* **Excellent written specifications. Your PRDs and acceptance criteria are precise, cover edge cases, and hold up when engineers build from them.**
* **Analytical and hands-on with data. You write your own queries (SQL or equivalent), build the dashboard you need, and change your mind on evidence.**
* **Experience building for operational users, such as support agents, fulfillment or back-office teams, or a clear interest in doing so.**
* **Clear, direct communication with technical and non-technical audiences, and the confidence to raise a problem early.**

**Preferred**

* **Experience in travel, ideally flights: OTA, airline, GDS or travel-tech.**
* **E-commerce checkout, payments or conversion optimization.**
* **Ancillary or add-on products: insurance, protection, upsells, bundles.**
* **Internal tools for customer support or operations, such as agent consoles or case management.**

**This is probably not the role for you if**

* **You prefer setting strategy to getting the details of a launch right.**
* **Youd rather hand testing, experiment analysis and post-launch checks to someone else.**
* **You see internal tools as less important than customer-facing products.**

*Were committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*

About Cogentiq CX

Cogentiq CX is Fractal s enterprise contact center AI platform, purpose-built for regulated industries such as Banking, Insurance, and Healthcare. It combines voice and chat automation, agent assist, and agentic AI workflows to help enterprises resolve customer interactions faster without compromising compliance, security, or customer trust.

  
 The Role

We re looking for a Product Manager to own the roadmap and delivery of key capabilities across Cogentiq CX s voice, chat, and agentic AI stack. You ll work with engineering, AI/ML, solutions, sales, and customer success to turn customer problems into products that run in production in demanding enterprise contact centers.

  
 What You ll Do

* Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for voice and chat automation and agentic AI capabilities
* Translate enterprise customer needs, pilot learnings, and market signals into clear PRDs, user stories, and prioritized backlogs
* Drive design of agentic experiences: orchestration, tool and API integration, guardrails, escalation to human agents, and evaluation frameworks
* Define success metrics (containment, resolution rate, AHT, CSAT, latency, hallucination and compliance rates) and use them to guide iteration
* Partner with engineering and AI teams on architecture trade-offs across ASR/TTS, LLMs, telephony, and CCaaS integrations
* Work with pre-sales, FDEs, and customer success on pilots, POCs, and RFx responses, and carry the learnings back into the product
* Support go-to-market with positioning, demos, sales enablement, and analyst/partner conversations
* Track the competitive landscape (CCaaS vendors, conversational AI platforms, voice AI startups) and sharpen differentiation
* Ensure products meet the security, privacy, and compliance expectations of regulated industries

  
 What You Bring

**Must have**

* 7+ years in product management, with 3+ years on contact center, conversational AI, or CX products
* Hands-on experience shipping voice and/or chat products (IVR modernization, voicebots, chatbots, virtual agents, agent assist)
* Working knowledge of agentic AI: LLM-based agents, tool use, RAG, orchestration, prompt design, and evaluation and guardrails
* Familiarity with the contact center ecosystem: CCaaS platforms (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Avaya, etc.), telephony/SIP, CRM and ticketing integrations
* Experience with enterprise B2B products, including long sales cycles, pilots-to-production, and complex stakeholder environments
* Strong analytical skills and comfort with metrics, experimentation, and data-driven prioritization
* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to engage both technical teams and C-level buyers

  

**Good to have**

* Prior experience with regulated industries (BFSI, healthcare) and related compliance requirements (PCI-DSS, HIPAA, SOC 2, data residency)
* Background in classical NLP/NLU (intent and entity models, dialog management) and experience through the shift to GenAI
* Experience with real-time voice challenges: latency, barge-in, turn-taking, multilingual and accent handling
* Exposure to observability, QA, and analytics tooling for conversational systems
* Technical background (engineering or data science) or comfort reading API docs and reviewing architecture
* Experience with partner and marketplace integrations

*Airties is an established SaaS company that provides AI-based Connectivity Experience Management solutions to internet service providers around the globe. Airties designs and develops software that enables exceptional Wi-Fi experiences for residential subscribers and small businesses. The comprehensive solution portfolio includes network analytics and optimization software, customer support and business intelligence tools, mobile apps, cyber security and motion sensing applications, embedded software for Wi-Fi routers and extenders, Wi-Fi test and measurement solutions, and engineering services. Airties software is licensed and integrated in hundreds of third-party hardware products and service provider IT systems. Airties has been active in the telecommunications field for over 20 years and is well positioned to continue to innovate in this field and grow the business.*

  

*Airties is seeking an experienced Product Manager to strengthen the Product Management team. As a Product Manager you will be responsible for all aspects of products and solutions including developing propositions and business cases, product definition, user experience design, overseeing product development, deciding on product releases, conducting beta, launch, demand creation and end-of-life processes. In collaboration with the Marketing and Sales teams, you will introduce new products and solutions to the market and communicate features and benefits to both internal and external audiences. You will have significant contact with customers and partners at a strategic level, to ensure that requirements and changing market demands are incorporated into product design and development.*

* Customer oriented, business sense, able to work with marketing and sales proactively to develop new value propositions and drive business growth

* Team player who interacts easily with the different layers of the companys management

  

**Responsibilities**

* The responsibility offered comprises assisting in defining the strategy for Airties Connectivity Experience Management solutions and adjacent products

CDW is seeking a Product Manager to help define, build, launch, and continuously improve strategic solutions that solve meaningful customer business and technology challenges.

The Product Manager will own the end-to-end solution lifecycle-from customer discovery and solution definition through launch and ongoing enhancement-for one or more solutions within CDW's Solutions portfolio.

This role partners closely with customers, Practice Areas, Engineering, AI teams, Delivery, Sales Enablement, Partner Management, and Solution Owners to develop scalable, repeatable offerings that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, AI, accelerators, and delivery methodologies.

This role requires strong customer empathy, structured problem solving, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

  
   
  **Key Areas of Responsibility**    
   
  **Customer Discovery & Solution Definition**    

* Define customer problem statements, target personas, use cases, business outcomes, and solution requirements through customer engagement and market research.

  
   
  **Solution Strategy & Roadmap**    

* Develop solution strategies, value propositions, business cases, and roadmaps aligned to customer needs and CDW priorities.
* Create and manage a prioritized backlog of solution enhancements, features, and capabilities.

  
   
  **Solution Development & Delivery**    

* Lead solution development across Engineering, Delivery, Practice Areas, and Partner teams.
* Drive solutions through the defined lifecycle from discovery and planning through build, testing, launch, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, commercially viable, and operationally ready for delivery.
* Define implementation guidance, delivery playbooks, reference architectures, reusable assets, and supporting documentation.
* Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and tradeoffs while aligning diverse stakeholder groups.

  
   
  **AI, Feedback & Continuous Improvement**    

* Gather customer, seller, and delivery feedback and translate insights into solution improvements.
* Leverage AI, automation, and reusable intellectual property to improve customer outcomes and delivery efficiency.
* Establish success metrics and measure solution adoption, customer impact, and business outcomes.

  
   
  **Working Model**    

The Product Manager partners closely with a Solution Owner.

The Solution Owner is responsible for commercial strategy, go-to-market execution, portfolio performance, seller adoption, and business success.

The Product Manager is responsible for customer discovery, solution strategy, roadmap management, cross-functional execution, and ensuring solutions are scalable, repeatable, and ready for successful customer adoption.

  
   
  **Key Performance Indicators (Examples)**    

* Customer problem statements and solution requirements validated through discovery activities.
* Roadmap commitments delivered on time and with quality.
* Time-to-market for new solutions and enhancements.
* Solution adoption and customer satisfaction.
* Delivery readiness, including documentation, playbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Reuse of accelerators, automation, AI capabilities, and reusable assets.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
* Measurable customer and business outcomes delivered through solutions.

  
   
  **Qualifications**    
   
  **Education and/or Experience Qualifications**    

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of experience in Product Management, Solutions Management, Presales, or related roles.
* Experience building enterprise solutions that combine technology, services, partner capabilities, and delivery models.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional initiatives without direct authority.
* Strong customer discovery, requirements definition, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience translating customer needs into scalable, repeatable offerings.
* Strong communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to balance customer needs, business priorities, and technical feasibility.
* Experience working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.

  
   
  **Preferred Qualifications**    

* Experience in one or more of the following:
* Artificial Intelligence & Automation
* Cloud Platforms
* Data & Analytics
* Cybersecurity
* Infrastructure Modernization
* Experience with Design Thinking
* Jobs-to-be-Done
* Agile Product Management
* Lean Product Development

  
   
  **Customer Focus and Quality Management Responsibilities**    

Each CDW coworker is responsible for maintaining customer focus and conforms to the CDW quality management system. Specific responsibilities include:

* Periodic reviews of CDW Circle of Service Philosophy and the Quality Policy to understand CDW's commitment to excellent client service and continual improvement and to conform to these policies and philosophies at all times.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Authentication - India
jobs.description:
### Job Summary

About the Role: Identity is the new security perimeter, and JumpCloud's Access Authentication team owns it.

With remote work and the domainless enterprise here to stay, every login is now a security decision. Our products decide who gets access to what across devices, SSO apps, servers, RADIUS and LDAP. They power MFA, passwordless, and Zero Trust conditional access built on identity, location, risk, and certificate-based device trust.

As a Senior PM, you'll define how millions of users prove who they are. You'll balance two customers: IT admins who need control, and users who just want to get to work. And you'll shape the strategy for our platform in a market being redefined right now. If you want to prove security and simplicity aren't a tradeoff, join us.

JumpCloud is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help drive the authentication roadmap and significantly influence the future of frictionless authentication at JumpCloud. You will own one or more product capabilities and be responsible for strategy, meeting KPIs and objectives.

If you love authentication and are passionate about Kerberos, Zero Trust principles, and conditional access; let's have a conversation.

### Responsibilities

* Setting strategy and roadmap. Stay close to customers, competitors, and the market, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
* Championing the customer. Understand what IT admins and end users need, not just what they ask for, and make sure it shapes what we build.
* Making access simple. Partner with UX, architecture, and engineering to turn complex authentication flows into experiences that feel effortless.
* Driving outcomes across teams. Align engineering, design, security, and go-to-market around shared goals, and deliver against them.

### Requirements

* 5+ years of product management experience owning strategy and execution for SaaS, enterprise, or security products.
* Deep domain knowledge in identity and authentication, including several of the following: certificate-based authentication, Kerberos, MFA, FIDO and passwordless, Zero Trust, and continuous authentication.
* A talent for untangling complexity. You can take a messy, interconnected authentication landscape, make it simple, and get a cross-functional team moving in one direction.
* Fluency with AI tools in your day-to-day product work, from customer research and specs to analysis and prototyping.

### Bonus Points for

* A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience. An MBA is a plus.

### Location / Language

**Location:** JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.

This role is remote in the country of India. You must be located in and authorized to work in India to be considered for this role.

**Language:** JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

### Notes

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, transcribing or summarizing interviews, and assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment in hiring decisions, which are ultimately made by humans.
