jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
**Senior Product Manager**

Product Team | Pune, India | In Campus

  
 **The Role**

We are seeking a high-ownership Product Manager to own the complete software surface of our robotics platform - spanning the core robot software stack, fleet management across the sorting systems, AMRs, customer integration pipelines, and the operator-facing UI applications used on the warehouse floor every day. You will be the single owner of the software experience, from intelligence running on each robot to the dashboard a warehouse manager opens every morning.

**The opportunity**

Own the product direction and business outcomes of assigned product lines, from customer discovery and new product development through launch, adoption and improvement of systems already operating at customer sites. Turn market needs and field evidence into a clear strategy, measurable product requirements and a prioritised roadmap.

You will work across robots, induction and discharge systems, embedded controls, batteries and fleet software. Bring the technical judgment to challenge engineering assumptions, the commercial discipline to choose valuable opportunities, and the ownership to verify that customers realise the promised value. Expect to spend time in warehouses, engineering labs and the factory.

**How the role works with other teams**

You own customer problems, product strategy, priorities, product requirements and acceptance criteria. The Technical Program Manager owns the integrated delivery plan and dependencies.

Engineering leaders own architecture, technical decisions and validation; Engineering Managers own people and capacity. Operations and Service own manufacturing, deployment and support execution. You drive scope and priority decisions, challenge commitments and escalate gaps.

Release decisions follow assigned authority, with the required technical, safety, quality and operational approvals.

**Key responsibilities**

Customer insight and product definition

**Customer discovery and market choices**

1. Observe warehouse workflows and speak directly with operators, supervisors, maintenance teams, buyers and integration partners. Combine site visits, customer interviews, usage data and win/loss analysis to identify unmet needs and validate demand.
2. Define target segments, priority use cases, competitive positioning and the conditions in which the product is a strong fit. Evaluate alternatives, including existing manual processes and other automation, and recommend opportunities to pursue, defer or stop.

**Strategy and product economics**

1. Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap, balancing new capabilities, reliability improvements, customer commitments and platform reuse. Prioritise investments using customer value, market potential, evidence, cost, risk and engineering capacity.
2. Build business cases covering addressable demand, customer payback, pricing and packaging, product cost, deployment effort and lifetime service costs. Set cost and margin objectives with Finance, Engineering and Operations; track commercial results with Sales and refine the investment case as evidence changes.

**Requirements and customer experience**

1. Own business and product requirements (BRDs and PRDs), use cases, operating assumptions and measurable acceptance criteria. Work with Systems and domain Engineering to derive traceable system and subsystem requirements and assess changes.
2. Define sustained throughput, accuracy, availability, parcel and payload ranges, footprint, scalability and operator productivity targets under representative workloads. Specify installation, recovery, diagnostics and serviceability needs so performance claims reflect real operating conditions.
3. Define operator and supervisor workflows, exception handling, reporting and warehouse software integration needs. Work with design and engineering teams to make systems practical to learn, operate, recover and maintain.

**Technical judgment and commitments**

1. Challenge estimates, dependencies, capacity assumptions and validation evidence with the TPM and engineering leaders. Make explicit scope and priority decisions when performance, cost, reliability or timing changes, and drive timely resolution of decisions affecting customer commitments.
2. Assess technical alternatives for their customer value and lifecycle implications. Ensure intended use, safety and compliance requirements inform product decisions from the start, with engineering and functional safety owners retaining technical approval.

**Key responsibilities**

New products, commercial launch and the installed base

**New Product development and pilots**

1. Define customer hypotheses, target outcomes and evidence for concept, prototype, pilot and production gates. Use representative workload sand, where appropriate, simulation with Engineering to test assumptions, assess capacity and validate sizing claims before scaling.
2. Agree pilot baselines, supported configurations, acceptance criteria and rollout conditions with customers, Solutioning, Engineering and Delivery. Own the product acceptance assessment and launch recommendation; use results to decide whether to scale, iterate or stop.

**Launch and repeatable growth**

1. Lead product launch planning with Sales, Marketing, Solutioning, Operations and Service. Equip teams with clear positioning, validated capabilities, sizing limits,pricing guidance, demonstrations, documentation and training requirements; measure adoption and realised value after deployment.
2. Define standard capabilities and configurable options.Evaluate customer-specific requests against strategic value, repeatability, engineering effort and support cost. Keep proposals and commitments within validated productlimits, with exceptions explicitly assessed and approved.

**Deployed products and lifecycle decisions**

1. Own the improvement backlog. Define product metrics and instrumentation requirements with Engineering, establish reliable baselines, and prioritise work using telemetry, customer feedback and recurring field issues. Verify with Engineering and Service that releases improve customer outcomes.
2. Own product policies and requirements for supported variants, compatibility, upgrades, migration, component obsolescence and end of life. Align lifecycle decisions with Engineering, Supply Chain and Service, including the cost and operational impact on installed systems.

**What you will deliver**

An evidence-backed product strategy and business case; a prioritised roadmap and backlog; clear product requirements and acceptance criteria; launch and lifecycle plans; and a product scorecard linking customer outcomes to commercial performance.

**First 90 days**

Review customer workflows, installed systems and economics. Agree product metrics, reliable baselines and priority gaps. Prioritise the roadmap and backlog. Define the next pilot or release scope, supported configurations, acceptance evidence and decision owners.

**Experience and capabilities**

The background and results we are looking for

1. Typically 10-15 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years owning hardware and software products. Product decisions, technical judgment and results matter more than tenure alone.
2. Evidence of taking a complex product from discovery through production and customer deployment, with measurable outcomes after launch.
3. Engineering grounding across mechanical systems, electronics, embedded software, controls, power and software architecture, sufficient to challenge assumptions and assess system trade-offs.
4. Experience with structured NPD, pilot builds, change control and software releases. Understand how design risk reviews, DFMEA and validation evidence inform product decisions.
5. Strong commercial and analytical skills: assess customer ROI, product economics and pricing, analyse operational data, and defend investment and priority decisions.
6. A record of influencing multidisciplinary team

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
Data Governance and Data Hygiene Product Owner

One role Contract-to-hire India

Role summary

You will own the data hygiene program day to day. You will turn a backlog of more than 40 known data problems into defined, prioritized, and verified cleanup work. Over time, you will build that into a lasting data governance practice. You work directly with business leaders and operations teams, so clear communication and a real understanding of how the business runs matter as much as technical skill.

What you will do

* Own and prioritize the data hygiene backlog, sequenced against the 2027 roadmap releases.
* Meet with business owners and operations leads to understand their processes, why the data breaks, and what clean data has to look like for them.
* Write clear business definitions and a business glossary for each data domain, in plain language business users can sign off on.
* Define critical fields, data quality rules, and how quality is measured for each domain.
* Plan bulk cleanups: what to fix, how (mass update, matching algorithm, or reload), how to validate it, and who signs off.
* Lead the two Data Quality Analysts: assign work, review their output, and remove blockers.
* Keep a gap log of each data issue found, who owns the fix, and when it closed.
* Work with the data platform and Salesforce teams on field and model changes, and with the data team on automated quality checks.
* Report progress to U.S. leadership in short, clear updates: what was cleaned, what changed in the numbers, and what is next.
* Over time, set up change control for new fields and definitions with business owners.

What we are looking for Critical (must have)

* **Communication.** You explain data problems and trade-offs clearly to nontechnical business leaders, in writing and live. You run a meeting, push back politely, and follow up.
* **Business understanding.** You learn how an operations business works (how work moves from sale to field to invoice) and connect each data problem to its business impact.
* **Technical skill.** You write and read SQL well enough to profile data, check a cleanup, and challenge an analysts work. Snowflake experience is preferred.

Also required

* 5+ years in data governance, data quality, master data management, or a data product owner or business analyst role.
* Experience owning a backlog and prioritizing with business stakeholders.
* Experience writing data definitions, glossaries, or data quality rules.
* **Comfortable working with U.S. teams until at least 12:00 p.m. Pacific.**

Nice to have

* Field service, facilities, utilities, telecom, or energy industry experience.
* Salesforce data model experience (Service Cloud or Field Service).
* Experience with data catalog or governance tools.
* Power BI or another BI tool.
* Agile and Azure DevOps.

What success looks like in the first 90 days

* Glossaries and quality baselines in place for the asset and technician domains.
* The first bulk cleanups delivered and signed off by their business owners.
* A working weekly rhythm with business owners and the analysts, with a backlog leadership can see.

Required Skills

Business Process Modeling Presentation and Communication skills Power BI Snowflake Stakeholder Communication ADO SQL Agile Methodologies

jobs.description:
Role: Accounts Payable Associate

Experience Range: 3 to 5years

Location: Bellandur-Bengaluru

Shift timing: 12pm to 09:30pm IST

Work Mode: Hybrid; 3 to 4days work from office every week is a must

  
  

ROLE SUMMARY:

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Associate for a key client we are partnered with, who is looking to hire for this position. This role is based in Bengaluru and will work closely with the US Team.

The Accounts Payable Associate supports the clients Accounts Payable function through the accurate and timely processing of invoices, payments, vendor information and related transactions. Working under the direction of the Accounts Payable Manager, the role performs assigned Accounts Payable activities in accordance with established service levels, approval requirements, internal controls and operating procedures.

The Accounts Payable Associate works closely with property teams, corporate functions, vendors and other members of the Accounting organization to resolve routine issues, maintain accurate records and support a high-volume Accounts Payable operation. The role is expected to identify exceptions promptly, maintain complete supporting documentation and escalate matters requiring additional review or judgement.

  

PRIMARY ROLE:

* Process high volumes of invoices and other payment requests accurately and timely, ensuring appropriate coding, supporting documentation, approvals and compliance with established Accounts Payable procedures.
* Review invoice and payment information for completeness and accuracy, identify discrepancies or exceptions, and resolve routine issues or escalate them to the Accounts Payable Manager as appropriate.
* Support payment execution activities, including preparation and validation of approved payments, research of returned or rejected payments and resolution of assigned payment exceptions.
* Maintain vendor records and support vendor onboarding activities, including collection and validation of required documentation and adherence to established vendor master data procedures.
* Respond to Accounts Payable inquiries from property teams, corporate stakeholders and external vendors, providing timely and service-oriented resolution in accordance with established procedures.
* Monitor assigned invoice queues, ageing items and unresolved exceptions, proactively following up on required approvals, missing information and other items that could delay processing or payment.
* Support period-end Accounts Payable activities, including account reconciliations, outstanding-item research, accrual support and other close-related deliverables as assigned.
* Maintain complete and organized transaction documentation and audit trails in accordance with company policies, internal control requirements and established record-retention standards.
* Perform assigned Accounts Payable controls and procedures, including adherence to approval authorities, segregation-of-duties requirements and other elements of the internal control framework.
* Collaborate with Accounting and other internal teams to research and resolve invoice, vendor, payment and accounting discrepancies.
* Identify recurring processing issues and opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort and improve transaction accuracy, and communicate improvement opportunities to the Accounts Payable Manager.
* Maintain proficiency in the clients Accounts Payable systems, Oracle Fusion, Excel and other tools used to process, research and report Accounts Payable activity.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during month-end close and peak processing cycles.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

  

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

* Bachelors degree in accounting, finance, commerce, business administration or a related field is preferred.
* 3 to 5 years of experience in Accounts Payable, shared services, accounting operations or a related transactional finance role; experience in a high-volume environment is preferred.
* Working knowledge of core Accounts Payable processes, including invoice processing, payment workflows, vendor maintenance, exception handling and period-end activities.
* Experience using an ERP or Accounts Payable platform is required; Oracle Fusion experience is preferred.
* Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to process large volumes of transactions accurately and within established deadlines.
* Ability to review supporting documentation, identify discrepancies and resolve routine issues while escalating matters requiring additional judgement or approval.
* Basic understanding of internal controls, approval requirements and segregation-of-duties concepts within an Accounts Payable environment.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple work queues, deadlines and competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other standard Microsoft Office applications; experience using Excel for reconciliations, research and transaction analysis is preferred.

**Role:** Accounts Payable Manager

**Work Mode:** Hybrid, 3days from office

**Shift Timings:** 2pm to 11pm IST

**Work Location:** Bellandur, Bengaluru

**Notice Period:** Between 30 to 60days only

  

**ROLE SUMMARY:**

We are partnering with one of our clients and they are currently seeking an Accounts Payable Manager for a Real Estate portfolio company in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India and is hired through Revantage India.

  

The Accounts Payable Manager is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of Accounts Payable function, including invoice processing, approval workflows, payment execution, vendor management, exception resolution and period-end activities. The role leads the Bengaluru-based Accounts Payable team and is accountable for the accuracy, timeliness and quality of the teams output, while maintaining strong service levels for property, corporate and vendor stakeholders.

  

The Accounts Payable Manager, in consultation with finance and accounting leadership, establishes operating standards, procedures and controls for the function; monitors performance against defined service levels and key metrics; and ensures compliance with policies, internal control requirements and applicable vendor reporting obligations. The role partners closely with US-based leadership and other functions to resolve issues, strengthen processes and drive automation and scalability across Accounts Payable. The position also provides oversight of certain Development Accounting activities, including review of monthly development draws.

  

**Primary Role:**

* Provide leadership over the end-to-end execution of Accounts Payable operations, including invoice processing, non-invoice (i.e. tenant) payment processing, approval workflows, payment execution, vendor maintenance, exception resolution and period-end activities, ensuring transactions are processed accurately, timely and in accordance with established service levels.
* Lead the Bengaluru-based Accounts Payable team, establishing clear performance expectations, allocating workload, managing priorities and developing team capability through coaching, training and ongoing performance management.
* Establish and monitor key operating metrics for the Accounts Payable function, including invoice processing timeliness, payment execution, aging, unresolved exceptions, error rates and other measures of quality, productivity and service.
* Partner closely with leadership in overseeing payment processing and related controls, ensuring approved obligations are paid accurately and on time and that payment exceptions, returned payments and other issues are identified and resolved promptly.
* Own vendor onboarding and vendor master data governance, including appropriate validation, vendor record maintenance and compliance with 1099 and applicable reporting requirements.
* Establish and maintain scalable Accounts Payable policies, procedures, workflows and review standards, and ensure they are consistently understood and followed across the team.
* Maintain a strong Accounts Payable control environment in accordance with the control framework, including compliance with internal control requirements, segregation-of-duties standards, approval authorities, internal policies and documented operating procedures.
* Working with US-based leadership, serve as a key Accounts Payable liaison and subject-matter leader across property teams, corporate functions and external vendors, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of payment, invoice, vendor and process-related issues.
* Oversee and work in close partnership with the Accounting teams preparation of monthly development draws and related activities, ensuring completeness, accuracy and timely delivery in support of development and construction teams.
* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives across Accounts Payable, identifying opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual effort, strengthen controls and improve transaction accuracy and service levels, leveraging AI and inherent ERP automation capabilities.
* Maintain a strong working knowledge of evolving accounting best practices and strategies that can be applied to day-to-day work, the department and the organization, and proactively communicate these to the relevant team members and leadership.
* Partner with US-based leadership and Revantage India on staffing, hiring, performance management and organizational development to ensure the Accounts Payable function has the appropriate capacity and capabilities to support the business.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide a meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected during month-end close and peak processing cycles.
* Perform other projects and responsibilities as assigned.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:**

* Bachelors degree in accounting is preferred; a professional qualification such as CA, CMA or MBA (Finance) is an advantage.
* Minimum of six years of related professional experience within a large organisation processing high volumes of invoices.
* Four or more years of supervisory experience is required, including managing and developing a team.
* Hands-on experience with accounts payable ERP platforms (Oracle Fusion preferred), paperless accounts payable systems, travel and expense (T&E) software, and ACH or card payment methods.
* Working knowledge of key internal control requirements and internal control environments within an accounts payable function.
* Experience with vendor onboarding, vendor master data governance and 1099 or equivalent statutory reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead process improvement, system implementations and software conversions within a finance function.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with high attention to detail when working with large volumes of transactional data.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in business English, with the ability to document procedures and communicate them clearly to staff and stakeholders.
* Strong organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines and ensure on-time delivery.
* A service-oriented approach to supporting internal stakeholders and external vendors, with the ability to build trust with onshore teams across time zones.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, with emphasis on Excel.

jobs.title: CA Industrial Trainee
jobs.description:
**Job description**

Hello Aspirants,

At Finnable we like to keep things uncomplicated, exciting, and fast well, that’s our brand promise to our customers also. We want to give them loans in under 3 minutes -UNCOMPLICATED AND FAST!

**So, who are we?**

We are a fintech start-up based out of Bangalore. We are three founders onto our 2nd innings. All three of us are ex-bankers. Nitin and Viraj are successful entrepreneurs, and Amit is a seasoned banker.

Finnable Credit is an RBI-registered NBFC offering personal loans to salaried professionals and loans against property, through a digital-first, tech-led lending model.

We are backed by marquee investors including Claypond Capital (Ranjan Pai), Z47, TVS Capital, Wealth Company and Pratithi Investment, among others.

**Are you the right person for the job?**

* At Finnable, we believe in “Getting Things Done”. If you are a self-starter who can take ownership of deliverables with minimal direction, you will love this role!
* A start-up enthusiast including the ability to swoop and soar, charting your own path, and being crazy to dream big are a few must-haves if you want to enjoy this ride!
* This is a challenging role in a fast-paced, agile start-up environment. Priorities shift quickly, problems rarely come with a playbook, and you will be trusted with real responsibility from day one.
* Strong command of Excel and a genuine comfort with numbers and data. Working knowledge of Power BI is a plus. If you don’t know SQL or Python yet, be ready to learn them on the job.
* A structured thinker with a sharp eye for detail, who can turn data into clear, crisp insights for senior leadership.
* Must have cleared both groups of CA Inter in first attempt.
* Must be eligible and ready to join Industrial Training immediately, with close to 12 months of Industrial Training tenure remaining.

**Job Description**

**1. Management Dashboard & Business MIS**

* Build and own an end-to-end **management dashboard** that gives leadership a single, reliable view of business performance across functions.
* Define KPIs and metrics in line with **industry best practices** for lending and fintech businesses (disbursements, portfolio quality, collections, unit economics, cost metrics).
* **Automate recurring MIS and reports** to cut manual effort and turnaround time.
* Keep dashboards accurate, consistent and decision-ready, with clear commentary on trends and exceptions.

**2. Data Management & Reconciliation**

* Take **ownership of organising and structuring the company’s financial and operational databases**, so that data is clean, consistent and easy to use.
* Lead **data clean-up exercises**: identify gaps, duplicates and inconsistencies across systems, and fix them at the source.
* Perform and streamline **reconciliations** between the loan management system, books of accounts, bank and partner data, and drive closure of open reconciling items.
* **Automate everything that can be automated**: data pulls, reconciliations and recurring reports, so that manual work becomes the exception and not the norm.
* Put in place **data hygiene checks and documentation** so the data stays reliable going forward.

**3. Business Analytics**

* Analyse business, portfolio and financial data to surface **trends, risks and opportunities**.
* Carry out deep-dive analyses such as **product and channel profitability, cohort and vintage analysis**, and cost and efficiency reviews.
* Convert analysis into **crisp presentations and actionable recommendations** for senior leadership.

**4. Special Projects**

* Work closely with **senior leadership on high-priority, cross-functional strategic projects**.
* Support **fundraising, investor and board reporting**, and due diligence data requirements.
* Research and evaluate new initiatives, partnerships and process improvements, and build **business cases** to support decisions.
* Coordinate with Business, Product, Risk, Operations and Technology teams to drive projects to closure.
* Any other ad hoc assignments as required by the business.

**5. What you will gain**

* Exposure to how a **regulated fintech NBFC** is run end to end, across finance, strategy, risk and operations.
* **Direct visibility to senior leadership** and the way key business decisions are made.
* Ownership of **real, high-impact work** that the leadership team uses every day.

**Stipend**

35,000 per month.

We are seeking a sharp, analytical Assistant Manager / Senior Executive to own Bill of Materials (BOM) standardization, SKU-level margin analysis, and third-party (3P) manufacturing productivity. * **3P Productivity & Conversion Cost Control:** Benchmark and monitor production yields, line efficiency, and conversion costs across 3P manufacturers; lead cost-reduction and process-efficiency initiatives.
* **Procurement & Demand Planning Alignment:** Collaborate with procurement and supply chain teams to translate demand forecasts into accurate BOM material requirements, preventing stockouts and excess inventory.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Logistics Controller Global SCF FP&A
jobs.description:
**JD for Senior Analyst Logistics Controller, Europe**

  

**Job Title:** Senior Analyst Logistics Controller, Europe

**Band:** 14

**Department:** Global Supply Chain Finance

**Industry**: Preferably from FMCG / Manufacturing Industry

**Location:** Bangalore, Karnataka, India

**Reports To:** Manager – Global Supply Chain Finance at GCC Bangalore, India

**Timing**: 12:30 PM to 9:30 PM Indian time

**Work Model**: Hybrid (3 days office, 2 days WFH)

  

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking a strong, business-oriented Finance Professional to join our Global Supply Chain Finance team as Logistics Controller for Europe. The role will have end-to-end financial ownership of logistics accounting and controlling activities for Europe, ensuring accurate bookkeeping, SAP postings, reconciliations, accruals, allocations, cross-charges, and month-end reporting. The role will also strengthen financial controls, analyze logistics cost performance, identify key cost drivers, risks and opportunities, and provide actionable financial insights to business stakeholders. In addition, the role will partner with Logistics Operations, Accounting/A2R, Procurement and Supply Chain Finance teams, and review existing processes to drive standardization, simplification and automation across Europe. The ideal candidate combines a strong accounting and controllership foundation with SAP knowledge, analytical capability, logistics finance understanding, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

  

**Role Scope & Expectations:**

* **Scope:** Up to 10 Business Units (USD 185M FY spend), onboarded in phases.
* **Expected outcome:** All recurring routines (month-end close, reconciliations, reporting and controls) delivered on time and in full, while improving current ways of working to deliver smoother, standardized and automated processes.
* **Role type:** Individual contributor with no direct reports, requiring strong peer influencing to align country and cross-functional teams.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* **Month-End Close & Accounting**
* Own logistics accounting and controlling activities for Europe, ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting.
* Manage logistics-related month-end closing activities, including review and validation of postings, accruals, provisions, allocations, recharges, and cross-charges.
* Review SAP postings and ensure logistics expenses are recorded accurately against the appropriate GL accounts, cost centers and business dimensions.

  

* **Reconciliations & Financial Controls**
* Perform detailed reconciliation of logistics spend across SAP General Ledger, invoices, accruals, and other supporting financial information, identifying and resolving discrepancies.
* Maintain and strengthen financial controls, accounting processes, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Challenge unexplained spend, incorrect financial treatment, unsupported assumptions, and recurring accounting issues.

  

* **Logistics Cost & Performance Analysis**
* Analyze transportation, freight, warehousing, handling, and other logistics costs to improve visibility and control over logistics spend.
* Analyze actual financial performance against AOP, forecast, prior year, and run rate, identifying key variances, risks, opportunities, and underlying cost drivers.
* Differentiate between accounting/timing variances and underlying operational or commercial drivers to provide a clear understanding of logistics performance.
* Perform root-cause analysis of significant cost movements, unusual transactions, recurring accounting issues, and reconciliation differences.

  

* **Business Partnering**
* Partner with Logistics Operations, Procurement, Accounting/A2R, Supply Chain Finance, and other relevant stakeholders to resolve financial issues and ensure accurate reporting.
* Support management with clear, fact-based and actionable insights and recommendations on logistics financial performance, key cost trends, risks, and opportunities.

  

* **Continuous Improvement & Automation**
* Identify opportunities to simplify and standardize finance processes, reduce manual activities, and improve process efficiency and data quality.
* Drive continuous improvement and automation using SAP, Advanced Excel, Power Query, Power BI, and other analytical tools where appropriate.
* Influence peers and cross-functional teams to promote ownership, accountability, strong financial discipline, continuous improvement, and collaboration.

  

**Key Stakeholders**

* Europe Country Finance teams
* Europe Logistics Operations
* Logistics Controllers and Logistics FP&A
* Accounting / A2R team
* Procurement team
* Global & Regional Supply Chain Finance teams
* Business / Zone Finance teams

  

**Qualifications and Skills**

  

**1. Education:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
* Preferred: professional finance/accounting qualification such as CA, CMA, ACCA, or MBA Finance.

**2.** **Experience:**

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in Accounting, Financial Controllership, Supply Chain Finance, Logistics Finance, or a similar controlling role.
* Strong hands-on experience in month-end closing, accounting reconciliation, accruals, and financial reporting.
* Experience working with SAP financial postings and General Ledger transactions.
* Good understanding of P&L, balance sheet, cost centers, GL accounts, accruals, allocations, and cross-charges.
* Preferred: experience in logistics, supply chain, manufacturing, or FMCG finance.
* Preferred: experience supporting multiple countries or business units in a global or multinational environment, with strong business-partnering exposure.
* Preferred: exposure to budgeting, forecasting, AOP, and financial variance analysis.

**3. Technical Skills:**

* ERP: SAP, with a strong understanding of financial postings.
* Advanced MS Excel, including the ability to work with and reconcile large financial datasets.
* Strong financial reconciliation, variance analysis, and root-cause-analysis capability.
* Good understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.

4. **Soft Skills:**

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and financial storytelling skills.
* High level of ownership and accountability.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly around financial accuracy.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to align peers and cross-functional teams without direct authority.
* Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams across Finance, Accounting, Procurement, and Logistics.
* Ability to challenge financial results and assumptions constructively.
* Strong stakeholder-management and business-partnering skills.
* Proactive and continuous-improvement mindset.
* Strong coordination and follow-up, with the ability to manage multiple countries and tight deadlines.

To lead CAPEX planning and management, zero-based costing (ZBC), cost-saving initiatives and cost optimization across manufacturing operations. The role will focus on improving cost efficiency, optimizing investments, controlling expenditure and driving sustainable savings through financial analysis, process improvements and cross-functional collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities (KRAs)**

**1. CAPEX Planning & Management**

* Develop and manage annual CAPEX budgets and investment plans.
* Evaluate CAPEX proposals, business cases, ROI, IRR and payback periods.
* Monitor CAPEX utilization, expenditure and budget variance.
* Ensure effective utilization of capital investments and timely project execution.
* Conduct post-investment reviews to assess actual returns against projected benefits.
* Identify opportunities to optimize capital expenditure.

**2. Zero-Based Costing (ZBC)**

* Drive zero-based costing initiatives across manufacturing operations.
* Review existing cost structures and challenge traditional budget assumptions.
* Analyze material, labour, overhead, utilities and operational costs.
* Identify cost reduction opportunities through detailed cost breakdown analysis.
* Work with production, procurement, engineering and finance teams to implement ZBC initiatives.

**3. Cost Saving & Optimization**

* Identify and implement cost-saving opportunities across all business functions.
* Drive productivity improvement, waste reduction and process optimization.
* Monitor manufacturing costs, conversion costs and operational expenses.
* Develop cost reduction strategies without compromising product quality.
* Track savings achieved against targets and ensure sustainability of cost-saving initiatives.

**4. Financial Analysis & Budgetary Control**

* Prepare cost analysis reports, budgets and financial dashboards.
* Conduct variance analysis and identify areas of cost overruns.
* Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets.
* Support management in strategic financial decision-making.
* Establish cost benchmarks and performance measurement systems.

**5. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Finance, Manufacturing, Procurement, Engineering, Maintenance and Operations teams.
* Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives.
* Present cost optimization strategies and savings reports to senior management.
* Ensure accountability for cost-saving targets across departments.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* CA / CMA / MBA Finance / B.Com with relevant experience.
* 10–15+ years of experience in CAPEX management, costing, cost optimization and financial planning.
* Strong experience in automotive, auto components or manufacturing industries.
* Hands-on experience in Zero-Based Budgeting / Zero-Based Costing.
* Strong knowledge of CAPEX budgeting, ROI, IRR, payback analysis and investment evaluation.
* Experience in identifying and implementing cost-saving initiatives.
* Strong analytical, financial modelling and stakeholder management skills.
* Knowledge of SAP / ERP systems and advanced Excel.

**Key Skills Required**

* CAPEX Budgeting & Control
* Zero-Based Costing (ZBC)
* Zero-Based Budgeting (ZBB)
* Cost Reduction & Optimization
* Cost Benefit Analysis
* ROI / IRR / Payback Analysis
* Manufacturing Costing
* Budgetary Control & Variance Analysis
* Productivity Improvement
* Lean Manufacturing / Continuous Improvement
* Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
* SAP / ERP

**Job Description Accounts Receivable Specialist**

  

Position: Accounts Receivable Specialist

  

**Experience:** 37 Years  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Shift:** US Shift / Flexible as per business requirements

  

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Accounts Receivable (AR) Specialist** with strong experience in **direct client coordination, invoicing, collections, payment reconciliation, and SAP Ariba**. The candidate will be responsible for managing the end-to-end accounts receivable process, coordinating directly with clients regarding invoices and payments, resolving billing discrepancies, and ensuring timely collections.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the **end-to-end Accounts Receivable process**, including invoicing, payment tracking, reconciliation, and collections.
* Coordinate **directly with clients/customers** regarding invoices, payment status, outstanding balances, and billing discrepancies.
* Prepare, review, and submit invoices through **SAP Ariba** and other client/vendor portals.
* Manage **SAP Ariba invoice processing**, including invoice submission, status tracking, rejection resolution, and payment follow-up.
* Monitor **Accounts Receivable aging reports** and proactively follow up on overdue invoices.
* Perform **cash application and payment reconciliation** against customer accounts.
* Investigate and resolve invoice discrepancies, short payments, deductions, credit notes, and billing issues.
* Work closely with internal **Sales, Operations, Finance, Billing, and Delivery teams** to resolve client billing issues.
* Maintain accurate records of invoices, payments, collections, and customer account balances.
* Respond to client queries related to invoices, purchase orders, payment terms, tax details, and account statements.
* Follow up with clients for **POs, service confirmations, approvals, and payment commitments**.
* Prepare regular **AR aging, collections, outstanding invoices, and cash-flow reports** for management.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, client requirements, and financial controls.
* Support month-end and year-end **AR closing activities**.
* Identify recurring billing/payment issues and recommend process improvements.

  

**Required Skills**

* 37 years of relevant experience in **Accounts Receivable / Order-to-Cash (O2C)**.
* Strong hands-on experience with **SAP Ariba**, particularly invoice submission and invoice/payment status tracking.
* Experience working with **direct clients/customers** in the US or international market.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Maintain day-to-day accounting entries and books of accounts in **Tally** (sales, purchases, payments, receipts, journal entries, bank reconciliation).

**Required Skills**

* Any graduate with Tally certification or practical experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in accounting/bookkeeping (experience in trading/distribution or medical/pharma companies is a plus).

**What We Are Looking For**

* A **skilled, honest, and responsible** person who takes ownership of accounts and records.
* Someone **willing to learn and grow** with the company — we are expanding, and this role can grow into a senior accounts & operations position.

**Why Join Us**

* Stable, growing business in the healthcare/medical devices sector.

jobs.title: HCM Cloud Payroll Functional Consultant (Principal/Sr Principal)
jobs.description:
**Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant**

  

*Deliver accurate, integrated payroll solutions across country legislations with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.*

  
  

**Role Overview**

  

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant, you will translate business and legislative requirements into Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll solutions. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and stabilization, helping clients achieve accurate payroll processing and production readiness. Working with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, you will apply mandatory Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment dependencies and coordinate related HCM integrations. The role requires 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience; at least two full end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll; and implementation experience across at least two country legislations. You will bring strong hands-on Global Payroll expertise and moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, translating business and legislative needs into functional designs and Oracle Payroll configurations.
* Configure Legislative Data Groups, Payroll Statutory Units, Tax Reporting Units, payroll definitions, calendars, consolidation groups, and payment methods to establish payroll structures.
* Configure elements, eligibility, balances, calculation cards, rates, earnings, deductions, employer contributions, retroactivity, proration, and termination settlements to support accurate payroll calculations.
* Design and validate payroll flows, gross-to-net calculations, statutory reports, payments, payslips, costing, and reconciliation to meet business and legislative requirements.
* Apply Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment data, resolve dependencies with Absence Management, Time and Labor, Benefits, and Compensation, and define functional requirements for banking, statutory, third-party payroll, time, benefits, and Finance integrations.
* Create, modify, and troubleshoot Payroll Fast Formulas; support migration mapping, preparation, loading, validation, and reconciliation using HDL/HSDL where applicable, including opening and year-to-date balances.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, operating procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials to support delivery and payroll operations.
* Conduct functional testing, lead payroll parallel runs, resolve discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish payroll readiness.
* Support cutover, initial payroll cycles, and stabilization; assess quarterly updates and legislative changes and support regression testing to maintain reliable payroll processing.
* Communicate deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions to clients and project leadership; mentor consultants and lead the Payroll workstream when required.

  

**Skills - Mandatory**

**Experience**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience.
* At least two full, completed end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll, with demonstrated hands-on functional ownership.
* Implementation experience across at least two country legislations from the areas below. For Middle East experience, identify the specific countries implemented.

**Country-specific functional expertise**

* United States: Federal, state, and local taxation; deductions; garnishments; multi-state payroll; and quarterly and year-end reporting.
* United Kingdom: PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, student loans, RTI, and P45/P60 processing.
* Middle East: Country-specific payroll localization, social insurance or pensions, end-of-service benefits, gratuity, and WPS where applicable.
* India: Income tax/TDS, tax regimes, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, gratuity, arrears, and full-and-final settlements.
* Canada: Federal and provincial taxation, CPP/QPP, EI, QPIP where applicable, taxable benefits, ROE, and year-end reporting.
* Strong understanding of gross-to-net processing, retroactivity, proration, balances, payments, costing, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading payroll parallel testing, resolving discrepancies, and supporting payroll acceptance and production readiness.
* Understanding of HCM security and appropriate access to sensitive payroll information.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll, with the majority of relevant experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Mandatory functional knowledge of Core HR and its dependencies with Payroll.

**Technical Skills**

* Moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to independently facilitate workshops, explain solution options, and resolve complex functional issues.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with global or multi-country Payroll implementations.
* Experience with midyear transitions, opening balance migration, and the first statutory year-end following go-live.
* Experience with Payroll-to-General Ledger integration and accounting reconciliation.
* Relevant Oracle Payroll Cloud certifications.
* Experience mentoring consultants or leading functional delivery teams.
* Presales experience covering demonstrations, proposals, solution assessments, or estimation.
* Experience using AI and automation tools to support implementation delivery, with appropriate data access and output validation.

jobs.title: HCM Cloud Payroll Functional Consultant (Principal/Sr Principal)
jobs.description:
**Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant**

  

*Deliver accurate, integrated payroll solutions across country legislations with Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.*

  
  

**Role Overview**

  

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Payroll Functional Consultant, you will translate business and legislative requirements into Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll solutions. You will independently deliver requirements gathering, solution design, configuration, testing, data migration, cutover, and stabilization, helping clients achieve accurate payroll processing and production readiness. Working with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, you will apply mandatory Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment dependencies and coordinate related HCM integrations. The role requires 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience; at least two full end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll; and implementation experience across at least two country legislations. You will bring strong hands-on Global Payroll expertise and moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

You will work with geographically distributed clients and delivery teams. Hiring location, employment model, travel expectations, and required overlap with client working hours will be confirmed during recruitment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead requirements and design workshops with HR, Payroll, Finance, and technical stakeholders, translating business and legislative needs into functional designs and Oracle Payroll configurations.
* Configure Legislative Data Groups, Payroll Statutory Units, Tax Reporting Units, payroll definitions, calendars, consolidation groups, and payment methods to establish payroll structures.
* Configure elements, eligibility, balances, calculation cards, rates, earnings, deductions, employer contributions, retroactivity, proration, and termination settlements to support accurate payroll calculations.
* Design and validate payroll flows, gross-to-net calculations, statutory reports, payments, payslips, costing, and reconciliation to meet business and legislative requirements.
* Apply Core HR knowledge to worker and assignment data, resolve dependencies with Absence Management, Time and Labor, Benefits, and Compensation, and define functional requirements for banking, statutory, third-party payroll, time, benefits, and Finance integrations.
* Create, modify, and troubleshoot Payroll Fast Formulas; support migration mapping, preparation, loading, validation, and reconciliation using HDL/HSDL where applicable, including opening and year-to-date balances.
* Prepare functional designs, configuration workbooks, test scenarios, operating procedures, and knowledge-transfer materials to support delivery and payroll operations.
* Conduct functional testing, lead payroll parallel runs, resolve discrepancies, support system integration and user acceptance testing, and obtain stakeholder sign-off to establish payroll readiness.
* Support cutover, initial payroll cycles, and stabilization; assess quarterly updates and legislative changes and support regression testing to maintain reliable payroll processing.
* Communicate deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, and decisions to clients and project leadership; mentor consultants and lead the Payroll workstream when required.

  

**Skills - Mandatory**

**Experience**

* 8+ years of overall professional experience relevant to HCM consulting, including Oracle Cloud payroll implementation experience.
* At least two full, completed end-to-end Oracle Cloud HCM implementations involving Payroll, with demonstrated hands-on functional ownership.
* Implementation experience across at least two country legislations from the areas below. For Middle East experience, identify the specific countries implemented.

**Country-specific functional expertise**

* United States: Federal, state, and local taxation; deductions; garnishments; multi-state payroll; and quarterly and year-end reporting.
* United Kingdom: PAYE, National Insurance, statutory payments, pension auto-enrolment, student loans, RTI, and P45/P60 processing.
* Middle East: Country-specific payroll localization, social insurance or pensions, end-of-service benefits, gratuity, and WPS where applicable.
* India: Income tax/TDS, tax regimes, PF, ESI, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, gratuity, arrears, and full-and-final settlements.
* Canada: Federal and provincial taxation, CPP/QPP, EI, QPIP where applicable, taxable benefits, ROE, and year-end reporting.
* Strong understanding of gross-to-net processing, retroactivity, proration, balances, payments, costing, and reconciliation.
* Experience leading payroll parallel testing, resolving discrepancies, and supporting payroll acceptance and production readiness.
* Understanding of HCM security and appropriate access to sensitive payroll information.

**Oracle Products**

* Strong hands-on expertise in Oracle Fusion Cloud Global Payroll, with the majority of relevant experience in Oracle HCM Cloud.
* Mandatory functional knowledge of Core HR and its dependencies with Payroll.

**Technical Skills**

* Moderate hands-on proficiency in Payroll Fast Formulas and data migration.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Ability to independently facilitate workshops, explain solution options, and resolve complex functional issues.
* Strong analytical, documentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Good to Have

* Experience with global or multi-country Payroll implementations.
* Experience with midyear transitions, opening balance migration, and the first statutory year-end following go-live.
* Experience with Payroll-to-General Ledger integration and accounting reconciliation.
* Relevant Oracle Payroll Cloud certifications.
* Experience mentoring consultants or leading functional delivery teams.
* Presales experience covering demonstrations, proposals, solution assessments, or estimation.
* Experience using AI and automation tools to support implementation delivery, with appropriate data access and output validation.

jobs.title: Delivery Manager – EdTech Sector
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Delivery Manager to oversee the planning and execution of training programs in the EdTech sector. This role ensures programs are delivered on time and to agreed quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Program Delivery:** Manage training programs from planning and scheduling through execution and completion. Ensure delivery requirements, timelines, and service standards are met.
* **Team Leadership:** Lead, guide, and support a team of 35 Delivery Executives. Allocate batches and responsibilities, monitor workload and performance, and coach team members.
* **Batch and Escalation Management:** Oversee batch operations and step in to manage a batch when delivery coverage is required. Ensure clear handovers and timely resolution of escalated issues.
* **Training Logistics:** Coordinate trainer and learner schedules, virtual or classroom arrangements, training materials, and trainer travel and accommodation where required.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:** Coordinate with trainers, clients, participants, and internal teams. Communicate schedules, requirements, and changes clearly and promptly.
* **Client and Learner Support:** Provide responsive support to clients and participants and follow concerns through to resolution. Build strong client relationships.
* **Quality and Continuous Improvement:** Monitor delivery quality, learner feedback, and program outcomes. Identify recurring issues and recommend improvements.
* **Reporting and Measurable Outcomes:** Maintain accurate program records and report on batch status, delivery performance, risks, issues, and outcomes. Track performance against agreed targets for:

+ On-time batch launches
+ Learner attendance and completion
+ Learner and client satisfaction
+ Issue-resolution time and responsiveness
+ Delivery costs and budget adherence

* **Project and Resource Management:** Coordinate resources across multiple programs, track milestones and dependencies, identify risks early, and keep programs on schedule.
* **Budget and Cost Awareness:** Monitor delivery-related expenses and use resources efficiently while maintaining service and quality standards.
* **Process and Policy Compliance:** Follow organizational delivery processes, client requirements, data-handling practices, and applicable policies.

**Essential Requirements**

* Bachelors degree in Education, Business Management, Human Resources, or a related field; a Masters degree is preferred.
* At least 5 years of experience in training delivery, program coordination, or delivery management in an EdTech or corporate learning environment.
* Experience leading, coaching, or coordinating a team of Delivery Executives or program coordinators.
* Proven ability to manage multiple training programs and batches simultaneously.
* Strong organizational, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.
* Dependable, with the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook; familiarity with Microsoft Teams and task-management tools.
* Strong verbal & written communication along with professional email-writing skills.
* Proactive and detail-oriented.
* Familiarity with CRM and Learning Management Systems (LMS).
* Familiarity with AI tools that support reporting, communication, workflow efficiency, or learning operations.
* Experience using delivery performance metrics to improve service quality.

jobs.title: Sales Trainer / Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description Sales Manager (Inside Sales – B2B / B2C)

**Company:** Black Panda Enterprises  
**Department:** Sales / Business Development  
**Location:** Pune  
**Experience:** 3–5 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

  

Role Overview

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Manager with strong experience in inside sales, team management and sales training.

The candidate will be responsible for managing the inside sales team, driving revenue and conversion targets, developing sales capabilities, conducting regular training sessions and ensuring consistent sales performance across B2B and B2C business segments.

The ideal candidate should be equally comfortable managing sales operations, coaching team members and actively contributing to sales closures.

  

Key Responsibilities

**1. Sales Team Management & Target Achievement**

* Lead, manage and motivate the inside sales team.
* Set individual and team sales targets and monitor performance.
* Drive daily, weekly and monthly sales activities.
* Monitor calling volumes, lead follow-ups, pipeline movement and conversions.
* Support team members in handling difficult prospects and closing deals.
* Identify performance gaps and implement improvement plans.

  

**2. Sales Training & Development**

* Conduct onboarding and sales process training for new joiners.
* Develop and deliver training modules for B2B and B2C inside sales.
* Train employees on cold calling, lead qualification, pitching, objection handling, negotiation and closing techniques.
* Conduct mock calls, role-plays and practical sales exercises.
* Improve product/service knowledge and customer engagement skills.
* Provide regular one-on-one coaching and feedback.

  

**3. Call Monitoring & Performance Improvement**

* Monitor and audit sales calls to evaluate pitch quality and communication.
* Identify individual skill gaps and provide actionable feedback.
* Coach underperforming employees to improve conversions.
* Work on improving lead-to-meeting and meeting-to-conversion ratios.
* Track new-hire ramp-up time and training effectiveness.

  

**4. Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth**

* Develop and execute sales strategies for B2B and B2C segments.
* Manage the sales pipeline and drive customer acquisition.
* Handle key prospects, escalations and complex negotiations.
* Identify upselling, cross-selling and repeat-business opportunities.
* Work with management to improve sales processes and revenue performance.

  

**5. Reporting & Sales Analytics**

* Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance.
* Monitor KPIs including calls, connects, qualified leads, meetings, conversions and revenue.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and sales reports.
* Prepare sales forecasts and performance dashboards.
* Track training outcomes and improvements in team productivity.

  

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in inside sales, telesales or business development.
* At least 1–2 years of experience managing or mentoring a sales team.
* Hands-on experience in B2B and/or B2C sales.
* Prior experience conducting sales training, call audits and performance coaching.
* Strong understanding of sales funnels, lead management and conversion metrics.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and leadership skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and CRM tools.
* Strong target orientation and problem-solving abilities.

  

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Achievement of individual and team revenue targets.
* Improvement in lead conversion and closure rates.
* Sales team productivity and target achievement.
* Improvement in call quality and sales effectiveness.
* Reduction in new-hire training and ramp-up time.
* Training effectiveness and employee performance improvement.

  

Ideal Candidate Profile

A hands-on sales professional who can lead from the front, drive business numbers, train and mentor sales executives, monitor sales quality and build a consistently high-performing inside sales team. and WHO CAN JOIN IMMEDIATELY IN BANER, PUNE

jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

We are looking for a travel-industry professional from a tour operator, travel agency, DMC or holiday company to grow our Costa Rica tours business from India. You will build relationships with the travel trade, promote our tours, create new partnership ideas and make sure every trip is delivered well, working with our team on the ground in Costa Rica. Key responsibilities:

* **Travel-trade partnerships:** Build relationships with tour operators, travel agencies, travel agents and travel influencers in USA, Canada, India and other regions; sign them up to sell our tours and agree commission and terms.
* **Tour promotion & sales:** Promote our Milestone Celebration, Honeymoon Special and custom Costa Rica tours through partner networks, webinars, social media and travel trade events.
* **Inquiries to bookings:** Handle inquiries from partners and travellers, build quotes and convert them into confirmed, paid bookings on WeTravel.
* **New packages & ideas:** Design new packages and partnership models based on Indian traveller demand, such as group departures, honeymoon, family and incentive (MICE) trips.
* **Tour execution: You will work closely with our team in Costa Rica to** Coordinate end-to-end delivery: itineraries, flights, visa guidance, travel insurance, pre-departure briefings and on-trip support.
* **Reporting:** Track the partner pipeline, bookings, revenue and competitor packages, and share weekly KPIs with the Founder.

  

**Preferred candidate profile**

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline; a degree or diploma in Travel & Tourism or Hospitality, an MBA, or IATA certification is a plus.
* **Experience:** 38 years with a tour operator, travel agency, DMC or holiday company in sales, B2B partnerships, products or operations; international (long-haul) travel experience preferred.
* **Network:** Existing relationships with travel agents and tour operators in Pune and Maharashtra.
* **Travel skills:** Itinerary planning and costing, package pricing, negotiation and closing sales.
* **Digital & AI:** Comfortable with WhatsApp Business, social media, Google Sheets and AI tools.
* **Communication:** Excellent English plus Hindi and/or Marathi; and willingness to learn Spanish.
* **Location & schedule:** Based in Pune or nearby; works daytime IST plus about 2 hours in the evening (around 8:30–10:30 pm IST) to work with Costa Rica.
* **Mindset:** Self-motivated, entrepreneurial and target-driven.

jobs.description:
# Job Description – Business Development Manager (BDM)  
\*\*Department:\*\* Sales – Sanitary Ware, Tiles & Hey Concrete   
\*\*Designation:\*\* Business Development Manager   
\*\*Reporting To:\*\* Directors / Managing Director   
\*\*Experience:\*\* 7+ Years   
\*\*Relevant Experience:\*\* Minimum 5+ Years in Home Improvement, Building Materials, Sanitary Ware or Tiles   
\*\*Qualification:\*\* MBA in Sales & Marketing   
\*\*Location:\*\* Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad   
\*\*Salary:\*\* Up to 8 LPA   
  
### Job Summary  
  
We are looking for an experienced Business Development Manager to drive business growth and expand market presence across the sanitary ware, tiles and Hey Concrete segments. The candidate will be responsible for developing strategic relationships with architects, interior designers, HNI clients and other key stakeholders to generate business opportunities and achieve sales targets.  
  
### Key Responsibilities  
  
\*\*1. Business Development & Client Engagement\*\*  
- Identify and develop new business opportunities in the building materials and home improvement sectors.  
- Build and maintain strong relationships with architects, interior designers, contractors and HNI clients.  
- Conduct regular client visits and generate leads through networking and market research.  
- Bring potential clients to the showroom to increase footfall and business conversions.  
  
\*\*2. Sales & Revenue Generation\*\*  
- Drive sales growth and achieve assigned business targets.  
- Identify upcoming projects and convert them into business opportunities.  
- Develop strategies to improve market penetration and revenue.  
- Ensure timely submission of presentations and quotations to clients through the sales team.  
  
\*\*3. Relationship Management\*\*  
- Maintain long-term relationships with existing and potential clients.  
- Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable product solutions.  
- Ensure customer satisfaction through effective coordination and after-sales support.  
  
\*\*4. Team Coordination\*\*  
- Coordinate with the sales team and sales coordinators to ensure smooth operations.  
- Monitor follow-ups, presentations, quotations and client interactions.  
- Coordinate with management for pricing, discounts and approvals.  
  
### Required Skills  
- Strong business development and sales management skills.  
- Excellent communication and negotiation abilities.  
- Strong networking and relationship-building skills.  
- Knowledge of sanitary ware, tiles and building materials.  
- Ability to generate leads and convert high-value sales.  
- Strategic planning and market development skills.  
  
### Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)  
- Achievement of monthly and annual sales targets.  
- Number of new architects and interior designers onboarded.  
- Number of client visits and business leads generated.  
- Showroom footfall generated through business relationships.  
- Lead conversion and revenue growth.  
- Customer satisfaction and retention.

* Willingness to travel across India as required.

jobs.title: Sales Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT SAPCON STEELS PVT LTD**  
At Sapcon, we don't just trade steel - we power the backbone of India's industrial growth. As one of the country's leading names in steel and industrial commodities, we've built our reputation on a simple promise: the right material, to the right customer, at the right time, every time.  
  
With 35+ strategically located supply hubs across India and trusted partnerships with industry titans like JSPL, AMNS, SAIL and JSW, we sit at the intersection of scale and agility. From automotive plants and shipyards to solar farms, HVAC manufacturers, and the infrastructure shaping India's skylines, our steel moves industries forward.  
  
Join us, and your work will directly fuel the projects transforming a nation.  
  
**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**  
\* Identify and pursue new business opportunities while managing and expanding existing institutional client accounts.  
\* Generate and qualify leads, deliver compelling sales presentations, and drive seamless end-to-end deal closures.  
\* Build long-term client relationships through consistent engagement, high service standards, and a deep understanding of client needs.  
\* Serve as the primary liaison between clients and internal teams, ensuring aligned communication, timely resolutions, and smooth execution.  
\* Drive sales across institutional, project-based, and corporate segments by offering strategic, solution-driven proposals tailored to client requirements.  
\* Leverage internal collaboration and external networks to support client acquisition, retention, and revenue growth.  
\* Conduct timely follow-ups with active clients while continuously building a strong pipeline of new prospects.  
\* Deliver on acquisition and revenue targets through sustained client engagement and strategic account development.  
  
**QUALIFICATIONS**  
\* 4-6 years of proven experience in institutional, corporate, or project-based sales within the different industries with applications of steel.  
\* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related technical/commercial discipline.  
\* Post-graduate qualification preferred; an MBA in Sales, Marketing, or Operations will be an added advantage.  
\* Prior exposure to client-facing roles with a strong track record of meeting sales targets will be highly valued.  
  
**SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**  
\* Solid technical knowledge of steel products, grades, specifications, and applications across industries will be a plus point.  
\* Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiarity with CRM systems and sales reporting tools.  
\* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities to understand client needs and offer tailored solutions.  
\* Exceptional communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to build and sustain high- value relationships.  
\* Ability to work independently in a field sales environment while coordinating effectively with cross-functional teams.  
\* High degree of adaptability and readiness to travel across assigned regions to support sales objectives.

jobs.title: IT Recruitment Manager(3rd Party -Whitefield)
jobs.description:
**Job Description: Manager IT / Technology Recruitment**

**Role Purpose**

The IT Recruitment Manager will lead end-to-end talent acquisition for technology functions, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality talent across both volume and niche technology requirements. The role will manage a team of recruiters, partner closely with technology and business leaders, develop sourcing strategies, and drive recruitment performance through data, market intelligence, and process discipline.

The position requires a strong combination of **technology recruitment expertise, people leadership, stakeholder management, sourcing strategy, and recruitment analytics**.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technology Recruitment Delivery**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment for technology roles across multiple levels, from individual contributors through senior leadership.
* Manage hiring across areas such as:

+ Software Engineering and Application Development
+ Cloud and Infrastructure
+ Cybersecurity
+ Data Engineering, Data Science and Analytics
+ AI / Machine Learning and GenAI
+ DevOps / SRE
+ Enterprise Applications
+ Product and Agile roles
+ Technology Architecture
+ IT Operations and Support

* Own recruitment delivery against agreed hiring plans, SLAs and workforce priorities.
* Monitor recruitment funnel performance including sourcing, screening, interviews, offers, joins and offer dropouts.

**2. Team Leadership**

* Lead and develop a team of technology recruiters and/or sourcing specialists.
* Allocate requirements based on recruiter capability, workload and business priority.
* Establish clear performance expectations around hiring delivery, quality, candidate experience and stakeholder management.
* Conduct regular hiring reviews, pipeline discussions and recruiter coaching sessions.
* Build capability within the team for niche and emerging technology hiring.

**3. Stakeholder Management**

* Partner with Technology leaders, Hiring Managers, HR Business Partners and Workforce Planning teams to understand hiring demand and business priorities.
* Conduct intake meetings to clarify technical skills, role expectations, candidate profiles, compensation parameters and sourcing strategy.
* Challenge unrealistic hiring expectations using talent-market data and recruitment insights.
* Provide regular updates on pipeline health, recruitment risks, ageing positions and hiring outcomes.
* Act as a trusted Talent Acquisition advisor rather than solely an execution partner.

**4. Sourcing & Talent Strategy**

* Develop sourcing strategies for difficult-to-hire and business-critical technology capabilities.
* Build proactive talent pipelines for recurring and niche skills.
* Drive an appropriate sourcing mix across employee referrals, direct sourcing, recruitment partners, internal mobility, professional networks and campus/early-career channels where relevant.
* Promote direct sourcing through platforms such as **LinkedIn Recruiter, Naukri and GitHub**, alongside targeted technology communities and professional networks.
* Develop talent maps for specialist skills and competitor organizations.
* Reduce dependency on external agencies through stronger internal sourcing capability.

**5. Technology Talent Market Intelligence**

* Track demand, supply and compensation trends for technology talent across major Indian markets including Bengaluru, Gurugram/Noida, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai and Mumbai.
* Provide hiring managers with actionable intelligence on talent availability, location strategy and competitive hiring conditions.
* Identify emerging skill areas and proactively develop pipelines for future requirements.

**6. Recruitment Analytics & Governance**

* Track key TA metrics such as:

+ Time to Fill
+ Time to Offer
+ Ageing of requisitions
+ Offer-to-Join ratio
+ Interview-to-Offer conversion
+ Source effectiveness
+ Diversity representation
+ Hiring-manager satisfaction
+ Candidate experience

* Use recruitment dashboards and data to identify bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure recruitment processes comply with internal governance, data privacy and hiring policies.
* Promote consistent, structured and bias-aware selection practices.

**7. Candidate Experience & Employer Brand**

* Ensure candidates receive timely, transparent and professional communication throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
* Partner with Employer Branding and business teams on targeted campaigns for technology talent.
* Support recruitment events, hiring drives, referral campaigns and targeted talent-engagement initiatives.

**8. Continuous Improvement & Recruitment Technology**

* Identify opportunities to simplify and automate recruitment processes.
* Drive effective utilization of ATS, sourcing platforms, recruitment dashboards and AI-enabled recruiting capabilities.
* Encourage responsible use of GenAI and automation for activities such as talent research, sourcing support, market mapping and recruitment content.
* Continuously improve recruitment efficiency while maintaining candidate quality and compliance.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Technology or a related discipline.
* MBA / postgraduate qualification in HR would be advantageous.
* Typically **8–12+ years of Talent Acquisition experience**, with significant exposure to technology recruitment.
* Typically **2–4+ years of team leadership or recruitment delivery leadership experience**.
* Experience working in a large multinational, GCC, IT services, consulting, financial services or technology organization is preferred.

**Required Experience & Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong understanding of the India technology talent market.
* Proven experience recruiting across multiple technology domains.
* Experience managing high-volume as well as niche technology requirements.
* Strong sourcing and talent-mapping capability.
* Experience managing recruiters and driving recruitment delivery.
* Strong hiring-manager and senior-stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to interpret recruitment data and translate it into actionable recommendations.
* Strong negotiation, influencing and communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience recruiting across multiple India locations.
* Exposure to financial services, insurance, consulting or GCC environments.
* Experience with ATS and recruitment technology platforms.
* Understanding of skills-based hiring and structured interviewing.
* Experience using AI-enabled sourcing or recruitment productivity tools.

**Key Competencies**

* Technology Talent Acquisition Expertise
* People Leadership
* Business & Stakeholder Partnership
* Strategic Sourcing
* Talent Market Intelligence
* Data-driven Decision Making
* Candidate Experience
* Negotiation & Influencing
* Recruitment Governance
* Operational Excellence
* Change & Continuous Improvement

**Success Measures**

Success in this role would be demonstrated through:

* Consistent achievement of hiring plans and agreed service levels.
* Improved time-to-fill and reduction in ageing technology requisitions.
* Strong offer acceptance and joining conversion.
* Increased direct-sourcing contribution.
* Stronger pipelines for niche and critical technology capabilities.
* High-quality engagement with technology leaders and hiring managers.
* Effective development and utilization of the recruitment team.
* Improved visibility of recruitment performance through dashboards and analytics.
* Consistent candidate experience and adherence to recruitment governance.

.**Role & responsibilities**

  
  

**Preferred candidate profile**
