**Role:** Machine Learning Engineer

**Location:** Bengaluru and Hyderabad

**Years of Experience:** 4-8 Years

  

**Role Summary:**

  

The Machine Learning Engineer will design, build, and productionize machine learning solutions for the Manufacturing AI Suite. The role will work with product, data, cloud, and manufacturing domain teams to transform plant and enterprise data into reliable models and services for use cases such as asset health, quality inspection, production performance, and forecasting etc. The engineer will contribute across the ML lifecycle, from data exploration and experimentation through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* Develop, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models for manufacturing use cases, including predictive maintenance, quality prediction, anomaly detection, and process optimization.
* Build robust data preparation and feature engineering workflows for structured, time-series, image, and sensor data from manufacturing environments.
* Collaborate with other engineers and architects to integrate data from plant and enterprise systems and address data quality, latency, and availability constraints.
* Design and implement reproducible ML pipelines for experimentation, training, validation, deployment, and retraining.
* Deploy models to cloud and, where needed, edge environments; support integration with applications, APIs, and operational workflows.
* Monitor model performance, drift, reliability, and business impact in production, and implement improvements based on observed outcomes.
* Apply appropriate explainability, validation, security, and responsible AI practices to support reliable use of models in industrial settings.
* Document model assumptions, data requirements, evaluation results, deployment decisions, and operational procedures.
* Work with product and customer-facing teams to understand requirements, assess feasibility, and translate business problems into measurable ML solutions.

  

**Must-Have Skills:**

  

* 4 to 7 years of experience in machine learning, data science, or ML engineering, including experience deploying models into production.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience with common ML and DL libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
* Experience with data preparation, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and optimization for real-world datasets.
* Experience with of time-series forecasting, computer vision, anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, or quality analytics.
* Hands-on experience building production ML pipelines and deploying models through APIs, batch workflows, or streaming applications.
* Working knowledge of cloud-based ML and data services on AWS or Azure, and containerization tools such as Docker.
* Understanding of model monitoring, drift detection, versioning, reproducibility, and CI/CD or MLOps practices.
* Ability to work with time-series, sensor, image, or other operational data and communicate model results to technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, collaboration, and written communication skills.

  

**Good-to-Have Skills:**

* Experience with manufacturing, Industrial IoT, Industry 4.0, or industrial data such as equipment, process, quality, or production records.
* Full-Stack Development (React/Angular, NodeJS etc) Familiarity with MES, SCADA, PLC, historians, OPC UA, or MQTT and the practical constraints of plant data environments.
* Experience deploying ML workloads to edge devices or hybrid cloud-edge environments.
* Experience with MLflow, SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Kubeflow, or similar MLOps platforms.
* Exposure to GenAI or LLM applications, including retrieval-augmented generation, when relevant to manufacturing workflows.
* Relevant certifications in cloud, machine learning, or data engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Data Modeler
jobs.description:
**Senior Enterprise Data Modeler Contract Consultant**

  

**Location: Remote (Prefer from Pune / Mumbai)**

**Experience: 8 to12 Years**

**Engagement: Contract / Consultant**

**Budget: 1525 LPA equivalent**

  

**Role Overview**

**We are looking for an experienced Senior Enterprise Data Modeler to design and deliver conceptual, logical and physical data models for enterprise data platforms for our esteemed USA client.**

  

**The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, data architects, data engineers and reporting teams to understand business requirements, reporting needs and analytical use cases, and translate them into scalable enterprise and dimensional data models.**

  

**The role requires strong expertise in data warehousing, dimensional modelling and modern cloud data platforms, particularly Snowflake and Databricks, along with an understanding of Power BI reporting and analytics requirements.**

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**- Design conceptual, logical and physical data models.**

**- Develop enterprise data models covering business entities, attributes, relationships and business rules.**

**- Analyse business reporting and analytics requirements to identify measures, dimensions, KPIs, hierarchies, granularity and historical data requirements.**

**- Work closely with Power BI developers and reporting teams to translate reporting requirements into effective dimensional models.**

**- Design dimensional models, star schemas, fact and dimension tables, conformed dimensions and slowly changing dimensions (SCD).**

**- Ensure dimensional models support multiple reporting requirements, analytical use cases and self-service BI.**

**- Develop data models for modern cloud data platforms, particularly Snowflake and Databricks.**

**- Work on data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, including medallion architecture.**

**- Define business glossary, data dictionaries and metadata requirements.**

**- Develop source-to-target mappings and data transformation specifications.**

**- Apply data modelling standards, normalization and database design principles.**

**- Collaborate with business and technical teams to ensure models meet business and analytical requirements.**

  

**Required Skills**

**- 8–12 years of experience in data modelling and data warehousing.**

**- Strong expertise in conceptual, logical and physical data modelling.**

**- Hands-on experience in dimensional modelling and data warehouse design.**

**- Experience analysing reporting and analytics requirements and translating them into dimensional models.**

**- Understanding of Power BI reporting concepts, including measures, KPIs, filter dimensions, hierarchies and semantic models.**

**- Working experience with Snowflake and/or Databricks.**

**- Strong SQL and relational database design skills.**

**- Understanding of data governance and metadata management.**

**- Hands-on experience with ERwin Data Modeler is strongly preferred.**

**- Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills.**

  

**Preferred Skills**

**- Experience in enterprise data architecture and data governance initiatives.**

**- Knowledge of Data Vault, MDM and Critical Data Elements.**

**- Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog or Snowflake Horizon.**

**- Exposure to Power BI data models, DAX and performance considerations.**

**- Familiarity with other modelling tools such as ER/Studio or PowerDesigner.**

jobs.title: Machine-Learning Operations Engineer- Pune
jobs.description:
**Role & responsibilities**

  

**SECTION A: POSITION SUMMARY**

*State the objective and purpose of the role.*

Lead the machine-learning operations team in India, operating the organisations traditional data-science / ML models in production for example churn prediction, fraud and revenue assurance, and network capacity forecasting across the consumer, enterprise (B2B) and network businesses. Own the discipline that keeps predictive models accurate and safe in production: drift monitoring, retraining and validation, deployment and rollback, lineage, and cost. Lead a team of two engineers and report to the Lead of AI & Agent Operations in Singapore, coordinating on change, incidents and standards. This role is classical MLOps.

  
  

**SECTION B: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND RESULTS**

*Indicate key responsibilities and performance indicators of this role.*

**#**

**Key Responsibilities & Expected Results**

**1**

Lead and develop the India ML operations team; set direction, standards and priorities for the model estate. Comfortable in translating Business requirements and communicating to his repartees. Preferred to hold prior experience in handling churn models.

**2**

Own the deployment and retraining discipline validation gates (backtest / champion-challenger) before any model is promoted, with a rehearsed rollback path.

**3**

Own drift and performance monitoring across the portfolio (data, feature and concept drift), and the retraining triggers and thresholds per model.

**4**

Own the lineage registry (version, training data, baseline, last-known-good) and model auditability for the estate.

**5**

Own the responsibility of applying Business requested model changes in agreed timelines. Model responsibility — monitoring bias / fairness on decision-making models (e.g. churn, fraud) and keeping humans in the loop where appropriate.

**6**

Manage the partnership with Data Engineering — data contracts, freshness and change-notification — and treat data-quality issues as first-class.

**7**

Coordinate with the Singapore lead and team on change scheduling, incidents affecting shared services, and estate-wide standards.

**8**

Report model health, deployment success and portfolio performance into the function’s KPIs.

**SECTION C: MAJOR CHALLENGES / TYPICAL PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED**

*List the principal challenges or problems faced by the role in achieving the results of the position.*

* Running the model estate from India while the overall function is led from Singapore — cross-border coordination on standards, change and incidents.
* Classic MLOps challenges — drift, model decay, retraining discipline and data-quality dependence — across a portfolio, with a lean team of three.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description:
**Data Engineer**  
**Data Vault , Oracle  •  ODI 12c  •  Snowflake**  
**Contract -1 Years**  
**Shift -2pm IST -11 pm IST**  
**Experience: 7 Years   •**  
**Role type: Individual contributor, hands-on**

  

**Apply - nidhi@intersourcesinc.com, sarang@intersourcesinc.com**

**The Role**  
We run a complex, Data Vault 2.0based data warehouse on Oracle, orchestrated end-to-end in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) 12c with our own batch-control framework. We are looking for a senior, self-driven engineer who can own this environment: design and extend the Data Vault model, write and tune heavy SQL on Oracle, and triage production ODI issues quickly and independently.  
Genuine Data Vault depth is rare, so we value a sharp engineer who can pick up Data Vault concepts fast and apply them to a real, intricate ODI implementation — as much as someone who already has deep DV experience.  
**Key Responsibilities**  
•Design, build and maintain Data Vault 2.0 structures (Hubs, Links, Satellites) and the loads that feed them on Oracle.  
•Write high-performance SQL and tune it on Oracle — execution plans, indexing/partitioning, MERGE/bulk patterns, and diagnosing long-running or unstable jobs.  
•Own batch execution through our ODI batch-control tables: scheduling, dependencies, restart/recovery, and keeping nightly/incremental loads reliable.  
•Triage and resolve ODI 12c issues end-to-end — from Operator errors and session logs down to the generated SQL and knowledge modules.  
•Extend and optimize ODI mappings, packages, load plans and knowledge modules using advanced ODI features.  
•Contribute to replication/streaming into Snowflake and support downstream consumption.  
•Document designs and work independently against delivery timelines.  
**What We're Looking For**  
**Must have**  
•SQL & Oracle performance tuning: Expert-level SQL and strong hands-on Oracle performance tuning (reading explain plans, indexing, partitioning, statistics, set-based/bulk processing).  
•ODI 12c — issue triaging: Proven ability to triage and fix ODI 12c problems quickly: Operator, session logs, scenarios, agents, generated code.  
•ODI 12c — advanced & navigation: Very strong, fluent ODI navigation and advanced concepts — knowledge modules, load plans, variables, scenarios, reusable mappings, topology.  
•Batch execution: Hands-on experience running data loads via batch-control tables (batch IDs, dependencies, restart/recovery), as we use in our Data Vault executions.  
•Snowflake: Hands-on Snowflake experience (SQL, loading, warehouse/query basics).  
•Data Vault aptitude: Either solid Data Vault 2.0 knowledge, or a demonstrated ability to learn complex modeling concepts fast and apply them in a demanding ODI environment.  
•Mindset: Self-driven, independent problem-solver comfortable owning a complex system with limited hand-holding.  
**Good to have**  
•Working knowledge of Kafka (streaming/CDC into the warehouse).  
•Prior exposure to a Data Vault implementation in production.  
•Experience with CDC, data replication, or GoldenGate-style pipelines.

* **Data Analysis & Reporting**

+ Provide professional support and input into delivering TMF's OPTIX Migration Service offering to prospective local and regional clients and guidance into the best fit to meet a client's specific requirements in collaboration with Onboarding & other stakeholders.
+ Analyze migration trends, risks, and data quality metrics.
+ Develop migration dashboards and reports using Power BI, Excel, or similar reporting tools.
+ Monitor migration KPIs and provide regular progress updates to stakeholders.
+ To take responsibility for the ongoing migration of HRP integration solutions and effectively manage the liaison with internal stakeholders and Client Onboarding Teams.
+ Supports complex client technology transformation projects including leading the business requirement gathering and ownership of blueprinting phase.
+ Become technical SME for migration team (Data collection).

* **Data Quality & Governance**

+ Accountable to accurate data collection from local office & maintain the allocated migration timelines.
+ Responsible to validate data from HRP systems including TMF Local Payroll systems, Enate, and Lexicon before data transitioning to another migrating platform.
+ Perform data quality assessments and validation checks.
+ Define and maintain data validation rules and reconciliation procedures.
+ Support data governance initiatives and compliance requirements.
+ Undertake periodic reviews of solution optimisation, document process improvements and work with migration & internal stakeholders for the improvements.
+ Work with local offices and TMF IT development to build mappings documents to support transformation of client integration files for processing by TMF Local Offices.

* **Automation & Continuous Improvement**

+ Identify opportunities to automate migration processes.
+ Create reusable templates, mapping frameworks, and data validation tools.
+ Support continuous improvement initiatives across the migration programme.

* **Stakeholder Management**

+ Ensure documentation and internal communications relating to the evolution of the OPTIX migration are complete, current, and appropriately shared. This could include high-level training/webinars internally to team.
+ Track, escalate and support the resolution of any solution or migration risks and issues as necessary in conjunction with TMF and/or Client Project Manager(s).
+ Share Knowledge & contribute to internal discussion forums with initiatives aimed at improving and promoting both the way TMF structures its HRP global offerings and the related global on-boarding process.
+ Partner with local offices to resolve data quality issues.
+ Provide guidance and training on migration readiness requirements.
+ Facilitate workshops to gather migration requirements.

  

**Preferred candidate profile:**

  

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of web services and APIs (Application Programming Interfaces) to enable seamless communication between multiple HRIS systems like Oracle, SAP, or Workday
* Expertise in HR and Payroll implementation would be plus.
* Knowledge of XML and XSLT for data transformation and manipulation
* Experience working in Agile development methodology to manage development projects effectively.

  

**Project Management**

* Project Plans and internal project documents are kept up to date.
* Adhere to relevant escalation processes to escalate resource issues, delayed project phases, missed deadlines and other planning issues.

* Monitor the project/s assigned, ensuring issues are resolved in a timely manner, and the appropriate corrective actions are implemented, escalating appropriately where required
* Perform Lessons Learned where appropriate and share with relevant stakeholders.
* Team player, support development of more junior team members through delivering constructive feedback and support as needed.
* Attend required internal and external meetings.

Role Summary:

HCLSoftware is seeking a Domain and Product Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join the Incubate Delivery function. This is not a core product development role. The Incubate product and solution teams own the architecture, engineering, and roadmap of the core products. This role makes those products work in the customers environment, configuring, extending, and customising them to deliver the outcomes the engagement has been designed to achieve. In traditional delivery, this would be recognised as a Product Specialist or Domain SME. In AIcentred delivery, the distinction matters more. Solutions built on AI, orchestration, and agentic capabilities need people who understand both the product and the business domain well enough to configure intelligently without defaulting to unnecessary custom development, and without losing sight of what the customer is actually trying to achieve. The role requires the judgement to know when to configure versus when to customise, when to use product capability as intended versus when to extend it, and when to push back on a requirement that would be better served by a different approach. That judgement comes from combining product knowledge with practical domain understanding. Ensure that configured solutions are robust, maintainable, and aligned to the product’s intended architecture and design patterns. Implement business guardrails and constraints that keep agent behaviour aligned to the customer's expectations, regulatory context, and risk appetite, including tone, scope boundaries, escalation triggers, and response limitations. 2. Domain Expertise and Product Fluency Bring practical understanding of the business domain to inform how solutions are designed and configured, ensuring they reflect how the customer’s processes, decisions, and workflows actually operate. Maintain deep fluency in Incubate product capabilities, tooling, and configuration options, staying current as products evolve. Use domain and product knowledge together to identify the most effective solution approach for each use case, avoiding over-engineering and unnecessary complexity. Advise the Context and Data Strategist and Value Owner where requirements may benefit from adjustment based on product capability or domain insight. Establish and maintain SME feedback loops working with customer subject matter experts to review agent behaviour, validate output quality, and iteratively refine prompt templates and behavioural configuration based on real-world performance. 3 HCLSoftware | Domain and Product FDE – Strategic Programmes 3. Working from Requirements and Detailed Design Take documented requirements and detailed design from the Context and Data Strategist as the primary input for build work. Seek clarification from the Context and Data Strategist where specifications are ambiguous, incomplete, or where product constraints create a gap between what is specified and what can be delivered. Ensure traceability between documented requirements and what is actually built, so that QA and validation activities have a clear baseline. Flag risks, constraints, and dependencies back to the delivery team early, particularly where product limitations or data readiness issues may affect the planned approach. 4. Collaboration and Delivery Integration Work as part of the integrated delivery team, collaborating closely with AI Orchestration and Engineering colleagues, the Context and Data Strategist, and the Quality and Compliance team. Participate in delivery ceremonies, technical discussions, and review sessions as needed. Support solution walkthroughs and demonstrations where product and domain expertise is required, without owning customer communication directly. Coordinate with other Domain and Product FDEs where multiple use cases or workstreams are running in parallel within an engagement. 5. Quality, Testing, and Handover Ensure that configured solutions are built to a standard that supports effective testing, validation, and acceptance. Support the Quality and Compliance team in validating that delivered solutions meet the documented requirements, acceptance criteria, and governance standards. Contribute to go-live readiness activities, including solution documentation, configuration records, and handover materials for the operate phase. Support operate-phase activities where ongoing configuration, refinement, or extension of solutions is required after initial go-live. 6. Document configuration decisions, design rationale, and lessons learned so that knowledge is retained and transferable. Hetero Healthcare Ltd is a leading innovative pharmaceutical company in India. jobs.title: B2B Inside Sales & Proposal Specialist
jobs.description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and organized **B2B Inside Sales & Proposal Specialist** to support our business growth initiatives in New York.

This role combines proposal coordination with lead generation, prospect research, and sales follow-up. You will work closely with the Marketing & Sales Managers and collaborate with our technical, operations, and leadership teams to identify business opportunities, coordinate proposal submissions, and maintain consistent communication with prospective and existing clients.

The ideal candidate has strong written and verbal communication skills, excellent attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a remote work environment.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. RFP, RFI, & RFQ Research and Coordination**

* Identify and monitor relevant Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Quotations (RFQs), tenders, and other business opportunities.
* Research government procurement portals, public-sector opportunities, corporate procurement platforms, and relevant industry sources.
* Review solicitation documents to identify eligibility criteria, submission requirements, deadlines, and mandatory documentation.
* Maintain a centralized tracker of opportunities, deadlines, submission status, and follow-up actions.
* Coordinate with technical, operations, finance, and leadership teams to collect the information required for submissions.
* Draft, format, proofread, and compile proposal responses and supporting documents.
* Ensure submissions are complete, accurate, professionally presented, and delivered before deadlines.
* Maintain an organized repository of previous proposals, company profiles, case studies, certifications, and standard response documents.
* Track submission outcomes and help identify opportunities to improve the quality and efficiency of future proposals.

  

**2. Lead Generation & Prospect Research**

* Research potential clients, target industries, government agencies, and organizations that may require IT products, managed services, and/or cybersecurity solutions.
* Build and maintain targeted prospect lists using online research, company websites, professional networks, procurement portals, and other relevant sources.
* Identify relevant decision-makers and business contacts within target organizations.
* Support outbound lead generation activities through personalized email outreach, LinkedIn research, and other approved channels.
* Identify potential opportunities for cross-selling, repeat business, and engagement with existing clients.

  

**3. Lead Follow-Up & Sales Support**

* Follow up with prospective clients after initial outreach, meetings, referrals, proposals, and other sales interactions.
* Track leads, outstanding responses, upcoming follow-ups, and sales opportunities to ensure timely action.
* Support the Marketing & Sales Manager in maintaining an organized sales pipeline.
* Help re-engage existing clients and previous contacts through relevant, professional communications.
* Prepare basic sales reports covering lead activity, follow-ups, proposal submissions, and opportunity status.

  

**4. Marketing & Business Development Support**

* Assist with market, competitor, and industry research to identify growth opportunities.
* Support the execution of targeted B2B marketing and lead generation campaigns.
* Assist with company presentations, capability statements, service descriptions, and other sales collateral.
* Support social media and content-related activities when required.
* Maintain accurate records of campaign responses, lead sources, and business development activities.
* Provide administrative and coordination support for other marketing and business development initiatives as needed.

  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Approximately 25 years of relevant experience in proposal coordination, business development support, sales operations, or B2B lead generation.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience researching business opportunities and coordinating documentation against defined requirements.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
* Ability to write professional business emails and follow up confidently with prospects.
* Strong ownership, reliability, time management, and follow-through in a remote working environment.
* Willingness to work hours that provide sufficient overlap with U.S. business teams.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with an IT Managed Service Provider (MSP), cybersecurity company, IT consulting firm, or technology services provider.
* Experience with government or public-sector RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and procurement portals.
* Familiarity with North American B2B sales processes and business communication practices.
* Experience using platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Microsoft Planner, or similar tools.
* Basic understanding of managed IT services, cloud services, and cybersecurity solutions.
* Experience supporting proposal libraries, reusable content, compliance checklists, and submission workflows.

  

**Who Will Thrive in This Role?**

You are someone who takes ownership of tasks and sees them through to completion. You enjoy research, organizing information, writing professional communications, and coordinating with different teams. You are comfortable balancing detailed documentation with proactive business development activities and understand that consistent follow-up is essential to building business relationships.

If you are organized, resourceful, and eager to contribute to the growth of a technology and cybersecurity services business, we would like to hear from you.

* Certification in ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

* Strong JavaScript development skills and proficiency with ServiceNow scripting APIs and development frameworks.
* Experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, App Engine Studio, Service Portal, UI Builder, and Workspace development.
* Certifications in any of the following:
  + ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

  + ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience building and supporting REST/SOAP integrations and API-based solutions.
* Knowledge of platform security, application scoping, ACLs, and governance best practices.
* Experience with CMDB, CSDM, Discovery, or Service Mapping is preferred.
* Familiarity with source control, Git, update sets, CI/CD, and DevOps practices.
